units.id: mission:Deep: Syndicate Convoy|name|16|0
units.english: Pickup from Hephaestus
units.italian: Rifornimento da Hephaestus

units.id: mission:Deep: Syndicate Convoy|description|17|0
units.english: Escort a convoy of freighters to <stopovers> where they will pick up materials needed for scientific experiments. Return the convoy to <destination> by <date> for payment (<payment>).
units.italian: Scorta un convoglio di mercantili fino a <stopovers>, dove dovranno caricare i materiali necessari agli esperimenti scientifici. Riporta il convoglio su <destination> entro il <date> per un pagamento di <payment>.

units.id: mission:Deep: Syndicate Convoy|You are approached by a man in a Deep Security uniform who asks if you would be willing to escort a few freighters to <stopovers> and back by <day>. "We would normally have our own fleet do it," he says, "but we're short on available ships given certain circumstances."|35|0
units.english: You are approached by a man in a Deep Security uniform who asks if you would be willing to escort a few freighters to <stopovers> and back by <day>. "We would normally have our own fleet do it," he says, "but we're short on available ships given certain circumstances."
units.italian: Un uomo in uniforme della Sicurezza del Deep ti si avvicina e ti chiede se saresti disposto a scortare qualche mercantile fino a <stopovers> e ritorno entro il <day>. "Normalmente se ne occuperebbe la nostra flotta," dice, "ma per certe circostanze abbiamo poche navi disponibili."

units.id: mission:Deep: Syndicate Convoy|	"Sure, I can do that."|37|0
units.english: "Sure, I can do that."
units.italian: "Certo, posso farlo."

units.id: mission:Deep: Syndicate Convoy|	"Sorry, but I won't be traveling in that direction any time soon."|38|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I won't be traveling in that direction any time soon."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non andrò in quella direzione a breve."

units.id: mission:Deep: Syndicate Convoy|	"Good. Before you leave, know that there may be pirate forces waiting for you in Alphard, Sirius, and Altair. You can try to avoid them, but make sure you get the freighters back on time."|41|0
units.english: "Good. Before you leave, know that there may be pirate forces waiting for you in Alphard, Sirius, and Altair. You can try to avoid them, but make sure you get the freighters back on time."
units.italian: "Bene. Prima di partire sappi che potrebbero esserci forze pirata ad aspettarti su Alphard, Sirius e Altair. Puoi provare a evitarle, ma assicurati di riportare indietro i mercantili in tempo."

units.id: mission:Deep: Syndicate Convoy|	The Deep Security officer wishes you good luck and walks off, leaving you to wonder how he knows where pirate fleets might be waiting for you.|42|0
units.english: The Deep Security officer wishes you good luck and walks off, leaving you to wonder how he knows where pirate fleets might be waiting for you.
units.italian: L'ufficiale della Sicurezza del Deep ti augura buona fortuna e si allontana, lasciandoti a chiederti come faccia a sapere dove potrebbero aspettarti le flotte pirata.

units.id: mission:Deep: Syndicate Convoy|dialog|95|0
units.english: You arrive at the pickup location on the night side of Hephaestus. The Syndicate employees who load the freighters do not allow you to see what is inside the cargo, and advise you to leave quickly once the cargo is loaded.
units.italian: Arrivi sul punto di carico, sul lato notturno di Hephaestus. Gli impiegati del Sindacato che caricano i mercantili non ti lasciano vedere cosa c'è dentro il carico, e ti consigliano di partire in fretta una volta completato.

units.id: mission:Deep: Syndicate Convoy|dialog|97|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you're missing something! Either you haven't visited <stopovers>, or you left part of the convoy behind.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma ti manca qualcosa! O non sei passato da <stopovers>, o hai lasciato indietro una parte del convoglio.

units.id: mission:Deep: Syndicate Convoy|A Deep Security officer greets you when you return to <planet> with the freighters. The officer hands you <payment> and thanks you for accepting the job on such short notice. "We'll make sure to contact you in the future should we need your help. If you want to help us further at the moment, I suggest you check the job boards in the Deep for mystery delivery and retrieval jobs."|102|0
units.english: A Deep Security officer greets you when you return to <planet> with the freighters. The officer hands you <payment> and thanks you for accepting the job on such short notice. "We'll make sure to contact you in the future should we need your help. If you want to help us further at the moment, I suggest you check the job boards in the Deep for mystery delivery and retrieval jobs."
units.italian: Un ufficiale della Sicurezza del Deep ti accoglie quando torni su <planet> con i mercantili. Ti consegna <payment> e ti ringrazia per aver accettato il lavoro con così poco preavviso. "Ci assicureremo di contattarti in futuro, se dovessimo aver bisogno del tuo aiuto. Se vuoi darci una mano anche adesso, ti suggerisco di guardare le bacheche degli incarichi nel Deep: ci sono incarichi di consegna e recupero di merci misteriose."

units.id: mission:Deep: Tarazed Convoy|name|108|0
units.english: Pickup from Tarazed
units.italian: Rifornimento da Tarazed

units.id: mission:Deep: Tarazed Convoy|description|109|0
units.english: Escort a convoy of freighters to <stopovers> where they will pick up materials needed for scientific experiments. Return the convoy to <destination> by <date> for payment (<payment>).
units.italian: Scorta un convoglio di mercantili fino a <stopovers>, dove dovranno caricare i materiali necessari agli esperimenti scientifici. Riporta il convoglio su <destination> entro il <date> per un pagamento di <payment>.

units.id: mission:Deep: Tarazed Convoy|As you are walking through the spaceport, a woman in a Deep Security uniform stops you. "You're Captain <last>, correct?" You nod. "Would you be willing to transport a handful of freighters to <stopovers> to pick up some cargo? We'd need them to return here by <day>. Normally this kind of job would be done by Deep Security, but we have no ships to spare at the moment."|127|0
units.english: As you are walking through the spaceport, a woman in a Deep Security uniform stops you. "You're Captain <last>, correct?" You nod. "Would you be willing to transport a handful of freighters to <stopovers> to pick up some cargo? We'd need them to return here by <day>. Normally this kind of job would be done by Deep Security, but we have no ships to spare at the moment."
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, una donna in uniforme della Sicurezza del Deep ti ferma. "Tu sei il capitano <last>, giusto?" Annuisci. "Saresti disposto a scortare un gruppetto di mercantili fino a <stopovers> per caricare del carico? Dovrebbero tornare qui entro il <day>. Normalmente questo tipo di incarico lo svolgerebbe la Sicurezza del Deep, ma in questo momento non abbiamo navi da spendere."

units.id: mission:Deep: Tarazed Convoy|	"Sure, I can do that."|129|0
units.english: "Sure, I can do that."
units.italian: "Certo, posso farlo."

units.id: mission:Deep: Tarazed Convoy|	"Sorry, but I won't be traveling in that direction any time soon."|130|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I won't be traveling in that direction any time soon."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non andrò in quella direzione a breve."

units.id: mission:Deep: Tarazed Convoy|	"Thank you, Captain. Before you go, I need to inform you that you may encounter pirate fleets near Tania Australis, Muphrid, and Ascella, and you might not have time to go around these systems."|133|0
units.english: "Thank you, Captain. Before you go, I need to inform you that you may encounter pirate fleets near Tania Australis, Muphrid, and Ascella, and you might not have time to go around these systems."
units.italian: "Grazie, capitano. Prima di partire devo avvertirti che potresti incontrare flotte pirata vicino a Tania Australis, Muphrid e Ascella, e potresti non avere il tempo di aggirare questi sistemi."

units.id: mission:Deep: Tarazed Convoy|	The Deep Security officer wishes you good luck and walks off, leaving you to wonder how she knows where pirate fleets might be waiting for you.|134|0
units.english: The Deep Security officer wishes you good luck and walks off, leaving you to wonder how she knows where pirate fleets might be waiting for you.
units.italian: L'ufficiale della Sicurezza del Deep ti augura buona fortuna e si allontana, lasciandoti a chiederti come lei sappia dove potrebbero aspettarti le flotte pirata.

units.id: mission:Deep: Tarazed Convoy|dialog|190|0
units.english: You and the freighters are directed to park in a private hangar owned by the Tarazed Corporation. While watching the cargo crates get loaded onto the freighters, you notice that the crates have labels on them which read "To be opened by addressee only" in large red letters.
units.italian: Tu e i mercantili venite indirizzati a un hangar privato della Tarazed Corporation. Mentre guardi le casse di carico venire imbarcate, noti che hanno etichette con la scritta "Da aprire solo dal destinatario" in grandi lettere rosse.

units.id: mission:Deep: Tarazed Convoy|dialog|192|0

units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma ti manca qualcosa! O non sei passato da <stopovers>, o hai lasciato indietro una parte del convoglio.

units.english: Pickup from Kraz
units.italian: Rifornimento da Kraz

units.id: mission:Deep: Kraz Convoy|description|204|0
units.english: Escort a convoy of freighters to <stopovers> where they will pick up materials needed for scientific experiments. Return the convoy to <destination> by <date> for payment (<payment>).
units.italian: Scorta un convoglio di mercantili fino a <stopovers>, dove dovranno caricare i materiali necessari agli esperimenti scientifici. Riporta il convoglio su <destination> entro il <date> per un pagamento di <payment>.

units.id: mission:Deep: Kraz Convoy|A Deep Security officer approaches you when you enter the spaceport and asks if you would be able to do a job for the Deep. "We're short on Deep Security ships at the moment, but we need three Behemoths escorted to <stopovers>. After they pick up the cargo, bring them back here by <day>."|222|0
units.english: A Deep Security officer approaches you when you enter the spaceport and asks if you would be able to do a job for the Deep. "We're short on Deep Security ships at the moment, but we need three Behemoths escorted to <stopovers>. After they pick up the cargo, bring them back here by <day>."
units.italian: Un ufficiale della Sicurezza del Deep ti si avvicina quando entri nello spazioporto e ti chiede se potresti fare un lavoro per il Deep. "In questo momento siamo a corto di navi della Sicurezza, ma dobbiamo scortare tre Behemoth fino a <stopovers>. Dopo che avranno caricato il carico, riportali qui entro il <day>."

units.id: mission:Deep: Kraz Convoy|	"Sure, I can do that."|224|0
units.english: "Sure, I can do that."
units.italian: "Certo, posso farlo."

units.id: mission:Deep: Kraz Convoy|	"Sorry, but I won't be traveling in that direction any time soon."|225|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I won't be traveling in that direction any time soon."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non andrò in quella direzione a breve."

units.id: mission:Deep: Kraz Convoy|	"Much appreciated, Captain. And for your well-being as well as that of the cargo, you must know that there may be pirates waiting in Algieba, Cor Caroli, and Wei. Behemoths are tough ships, so you should be able to travel through those systems and not slow yourself down by taking alternative routes."|228|0
units.english: "Much appreciated, Captain. And for your well-being as well as that of the cargo, you must know that there may be pirates waiting in Algieba, Cor Caroli, and Wei. Behemoths are tough ships, so you should be able to travel through those systems and not slow yourself down by taking alternative routes."
units.italian: "Molto apprezzato, capitano. E per il tuo bene come per quello del carico, devi sapere che potrebbero esserci pirati in agguato su Algieba, Cor Caroli e Wei. I Behemoth sono navi robuste, quindi dovresti poter attraversare quei sistemi senza perdere tempo con rotte alternative."

units.id: mission:Deep: Kraz Convoy|	The Deep Security officer wishes you good luck and walks off, leaving you to wonder how she knows where pirate fleets might be waiting for you.|229|0
units.english: The Deep Security officer wishes you good luck and walks off, leaving you to wonder how she knows where pirate fleets might be waiting for you.
units.italian: L'ufficiale della Sicurezza del Deep ti augura buona fortuna e si allontana, lasciandoti a chiederti come lei sappia dove potrebbero aspettarti le flotte pirata.

units.id: mission:Deep: Kraz Convoy|dialog|275|0
units.english: When you arrive, Kraz Cybernetics already has the cargo waiting by the spaceport. After a few hours of loading the massive freighters, the spaceport crew gives you the 'all clear' signal, and the Behemoth captains get ready to depart.
units.italian: Quando arrivi, la Kraz Cybernetics ha già il carico pronto accanto allo spazioporto. Dopo alcune ore di carico sui giganteschi mercantili, l'equipaggio del porto ti dà il segnale di via libera, e i capitani dei Behemoth si preparano a partire.

Se vuoi darci una mano anche adesso, ti suggerisco di guardare le bacheche degli incarichi nel Deep: ci sono incarichi di consegna e recupero di merci misteriose."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|name|288|0
units.english: Gaining an Edge
units.italian: Un vantaggio

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|description|289|0
units.english: Land on the designated systems to place the mysterious cubes that Lieutenant Paris has given you, then return to <destination>.
units.italian: Atterra nei sistemi indicati per collocare i misteriosi cubi che ti ha dato il tenente Paris, poi torna su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|A Deep Security officer calls your name and approaches you as you enter the spaceport's central market. "Greetings, Captain <last>, I'm Lieutenant Paris. Would you be interested in conducting some more work for the Deep? We are currently in need of a few extra ships to assist in an ongoing situation."|313|0
units.english: A Deep Security officer calls your name and approaches you as you enter the spaceport's central market. "Greetings, Captain <last>, I'm Lieutenant Paris. Would you be interested in conducting some more work for the Deep? We are currently in need of a few extra ships to assist in an ongoing situation."
units.italian: Un ufficiale della Sicurezza del Deep chiama il tuo nome e ti si avvicina mentre entri nel mercato centrale dello spazioporto. "Salve, capitano <last>, sono il tenente Paris. Ti interesserebbe svolgere altro lavoro per il Deep? Al momento ci servono alcune navi in più per fronteggiare una situazione in corso."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|	"I'd love to help. What's the situation?"|315|0
units.english: "I'd love to help. What's the situation?"
units.italian: "Mi piacerebbe aiutare. Di che situazione si tratta?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|	"Sorry, but I can't help right now."|317|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I can't help right now."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non posso aiutare adesso."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|	"Whatever plans you have, I suggest you change them, as this is an urgent situation."|319|0
units.english: "Whatever plans you have, I suggest you change them, as this is an urgent situation."
units.italian: "Qualunque programma tu abbia, ti suggerisco di cambiarlo: la situazione è urgente."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|	"Okay, I'll help. What is the situation?"|321|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll help. What is the situation?"
units.italian: "Va bene, aiuterò. Che situazione è?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|	"Then I can't help you. Sorry."|322|0
units.english: "Then I can't help you. Sorry."
units.italian: "Allora non posso aiutarti. Mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|	"Excellent. I'm sure that you are aware that much of Deep Security is currently preoccupied, hence why we have been recruiting merchants to escort many of the Deep's convoys. The reason this is the case is that we have been attempting to detain a particularly meddlesome pirate warlord who goes by the name of 'Beelzebub.' From what we can ascertain, Beelzebub has extensive knowledge on the inner workings of Deep Security, which is making tracking him down rather difficult, as he seems to know our every move. That is where you and a few other merchants come in."|326|0
units.english: "Excellent. I'm sure that you are aware that much of Deep Security is currently preoccupied, hence why we have been recruiting merchants to escort many of the Deep's convoys. The reason this is the case is that we have been attempting to detain a particularly meddlesome pirate warlord who goes by the name of 'Beelzebub.' From what we can ascertain, Beelzebub has extensive knowledge on the inner workings of Deep Security, which is making tracking him down rather difficult, as he seems to know our every move. That is where you and a few other merchants come in."
units.italian: "Eccellente. Sono certo che saprai che gran parte della Sicurezza del Deep è impegnata altrove, ed è per questo che stiamo reclutando mercanti per scortare molti dei convogli del Deep. Il motivo è che stiamo cercando di fermare un signore della guerra pirata particolarmente fastidioso, che si fa chiamare 'Belzebù'. Da quanto possiamo capire, Belzebù conosce a fondo i meccanismi interni della Sicurezza del Deep, il che rende difficile rintracciarlo: sembra sapere ogni nostra mossa. Ed è qui che entrate in gioco tu e qualche altro mercante."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|	Paris reaches into his pocket and pulls out a bag. Inside of the bag are at least two dozen of the mysterious cubes that you have transported in the past, only with one distinct difference: a thick red streak running down the middle of each cube.|327|0
units.english: Paris reaches into his pocket and pulls out a bag. Inside of the bag are at least two dozen of the mysterious cubes that you have transported in the past, only with one distinct difference: a thick red streak running down the middle of each cube.
units.italian: Paris fruga in tasca e tira fuori una borsa. Dentro ci sono almeno due dozzine dei misteriosi cubi che hai trasportato in passato, con una sola, netta differenza: una spessa striscia rossa che corre al centro di ogni cubo.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|	"The Deep requires that you place these on a number of worlds in the Dirt Belt which I will mark on your map for you. Place at least four of these devices around the spaceport of each marked planet, then come to <destination> where I will collect any remaining cubes that you may have. If a Deep Security ship did this then it would likely catch the attention of any pirates in the system and that information would make its way to Beelzebub, but random merchants should be inconspicuous enough to throw Beelzebub off our trail. Is that clear?"|328|0
units.english: "The Deep requires that you place these on a number of worlds in the Dirt Belt which I will mark on your map for you. Place at least four of these devices around the spaceport of each marked planet, then come to <destination> where I will collect any remaining cubes that you may have. If a Deep Security ship did this then it would likely catch the attention of any pirates in the system and that information would make its way to Beelzebub, but random merchants should be inconspicuous enough to throw Beelzebub off our trail. Is that clear?"
units.italian: "Il Deep ha bisogno che tu li collochi su diversi mondi della Dirt Belt, che ti segnerò sulla mappa. Metti almeno quattro di questi dispositivi intorno allo spazioporto di ogni pianeta indicato, poi raggiungi <destination>, dove ritirerò i cubi che ti restano. Se lo facesse una nave della Sicurezza del Deep attirerebbe l'attenzione dei pirati presenti nel sistema, e l'informazione arriverebbe a Belzebù; dei mercanti qualsiasi invece sono abbastanza anonimi da sviarlo. È chiaro?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|	"Crystal clear, Lieutenant. I will prepare to leave shortly."|330|0
units.english: "Crystal clear, Lieutenant. I will prepare to leave shortly."
units.italian: "Chiarissimo, tenente. Mi preparerò a partire a breve."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|	"What do these cubes do?"|332|0
units.english: "What do these cubes do?"
units.italian: "A cosa servono questi cubi?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|	"I don't believe that I am authorized to tell you that. Just know that they will help us catch Beelzebub."|334|0
units.english: "I don't believe that I am authorized to tell you that. Just know that they will help us catch Beelzebub."
units.italian: "Non credo di essere autorizzato a dirtelo. Sappi solo che ci aiuteranno a catturare Belzebù."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|	"Understood. I'll place the cubes for you."|336|0
units.english: "Understood. I'll place the cubes for you."
units.italian: "Capito. Collocherò i cubi per te."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|	"This feels too secretive for me. I don't want to help anymore."|338|0
units.english: "This feels too secretive for me. I don't want to help anymore."
units.italian: "Mi sembra troppo segreto per i miei gusti. Non voglio più aiutare."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|dialog|360|0
units.english: You have placed cubes on the last of the planets that Paris has asked you to. When you look into the bag you find that there are three left. Go to <destination> to give the remaining cubes to Paris.
units.italian: Hai collocato i cubi sull'ultimo dei pianeti che Paris ti aveva indicato. Guardando nella borsa scopri che ne restano tre. Vai su <destination> per consegnare i cubi rimanenti a Paris.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|log|364|0
units.english: Placed multiple mysterious cubes on planets in the Dirt Belt for the Deep. Deep Security is using these cubes to somehow help in their hunt for a pirate warlord named "Beelzebub."
units.italian: Ho collocato diversi cubi misteriosi su pianeti della Dirt Belt per il Deep. La Sicurezza del Deep usa questi cubi per aiutarsi, in qualche modo, nella caccia a un signore della guerra pirata di nome "Belzebù".

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|You find Lieutenant Paris waiting for you in the spaceport. You hand him the bag of remaining cubes, and he hands you <payment> for helping.|366|0
units.english: You find Lieutenant Paris waiting for you in the spaceport. You hand him the bag of remaining cubes, and he hands you <payment> for helping.
units.italian: Trovi il tenente Paris che ti aspetta nello spazioporto. Gli consegni la borsa con i cubi rimanenti, e lui ti dà <payment> per l'aiuto.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|	"Is there anything else that you need me to do?"|368|0
units.english: "Is there anything else that you need me to do?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcos'altro che vuoi che faccia?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|	"Are you able to tell me what the cubes are for?"|370|0
units.english: "Are you able to tell me what the cubes are for?"
units.italian: "Puoi dirmi a cosa servono i cubi?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|	Paris takes a moment to pause before responding. "They're sensor devices. They are used to track the movement of pirate fleets, but they are almost useless alone; dozens could be needed in a single system to track entire fleets. The ones that I gave you were fine-tuned though, designed to only detect the ship that we know that Beelzebub is using. That is all that I am allowed to tell you, at least for the time being."|372|0
units.english: Paris takes a moment to pause before responding. "They're sensor devices. They are used to track the movement of pirate fleets, but they are almost useless alone; dozens could be needed in a single system to track entire fleets. The ones that I gave you were fine-tuned though, designed to only detect the ship that we know that Beelzebub is using. That is all that I am allowed to tell you, at least for the time being."
units.italian: Paris si prende una pausa prima di rispondere. "Sono dispositivi sensore. Servono a tracciare i movimenti delle flotte pirata, ma da soli sono quasi inutili; in un solo sistema potrebbero servire dozzine di cubi per seguire intere flotte. Quelli che ti ho dato, però, sono stati tarati con precisione: sono progettati per rilevare solo la nave che sappiamo essere di Belzebù. È tutto quello che mi è permesso dirti, almeno per ora."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|	"Is there anything else that you need me to do?"|375|0
units.english: "Is there anything else that you need me to do?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcos'altro che vuoi che faccia?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 0|	"Not at the moment, Captain, but I'll contact you should anything else arise."|378|0
units.english: "Not at the moment, Captain, but I'll contact you should anything else arise."
units.italian: "Non al momento, capitano, ma ti contatterò se dovesse sorgere altro."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 1|name|386|0
units.english: Travel to <planet>
units.italian: Raggiungi <planet>

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 1|description|387|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> to learn more about the situation with the warlord Beelzebub.
units.italian: Raggiungi <destination> per saperne di più sulla situazione con il signore della guerra Belzebù.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 1|dialog|399|0
units.english: You receive a message from Lieutenant Paris. "Greetings, Captain. The situation involving Beelzebub has gone slightly sour, and the Navy is involved now. I have been asked to gather the merchants who assisted the Deep previously in placing the cubes. If you are interested, please come to <destination>."
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio dal tenente Paris. "Salve, capitano. La situazione con Belzebù si è un po' guastata, e ora è coinvolta anche la Marina. Mi è stato chiesto di radunare i mercanti che avevano aiutato il Deep a collocare i cubi. Se ti interessa, vieni su <destination>."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|name|405|0
units.english: Blockading the Devil
units.italian: Bloccare il Diavolo

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|description|406|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> to set up a blockade in hopes of capturing the warlord Beelzebub.
units.italian: Raggiungi <destination> per istituire un blocco nella speranza di catturare il signore della guerra Belzebù.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|log|414|0
units.english: Traveled to a restricted Navy base on Luna. Beelzebub has been causing trouble for both Deep Security and the Navy, so they have begun recruiting merchants to help in the search for the warlord.
units.italian: Sono arrivato a una base riservata della Marina sulla Luna. Belzebù sta creando problemi sia alla Sicurezza del Deep sia alla Marina, che ha cominciato a reclutare mercanti per la ricerca del signore della guerra.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|A pair of men in Navy uniforms escort you to a restricted area of the Luna facility. One of them uses a keycard to open an elevator and ushers you in. The elevator opens up many floors below the spaceport, to an area of the facility that looks far newer than that on the surface.|416|0
units.english: A pair of men in Navy uniforms escort you to a restricted area of the Luna facility. One of them uses a keycard to open an elevator and ushers you in. The elevator opens up many floors below the spaceport, to an area of the facility that looks far newer than that on the surface.
units.italian: Due uomini in uniforme della Marina ti scortano in una zona riservata dell'impianto lunare. Uno di loro usa una tessera per aprire un ascensore e ti fa cenno di entrare. L'ascensore si apre molti piani sotto lo spazioporto, in una zona dell'impianto che sembra molto più nuova di quella in superficie.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|	You are kept in what looks like a waiting room along with five others. After a bit of talking, you find out that these are the other merchant captains who helped place the cubes across different regions of the galaxy.|417|0
units.english: You are kept in what looks like a waiting room along with five others. After a bit of talking, you find out that these are the other merchant captains who helped place the cubes across different regions of the galaxy.
units.italian: Ti sistemano in quella che sembra una sala d'attesa, insieme ad altre cinque persone. Dopo qualche chiacchiera scopri che sono gli altri capitani mercantili che hanno aiutato a collocare i cubi in diverse regioni della galassia.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|	An hour of waiting passes, and Lieutenant Paris walks into the room followed by a Navy admiral. "I hope you are all enjoying your stay," the admiral remarks. "Now. How is it that most of the cubes you placed were mysteriously disabled shortly after pirates entered each system?"|418|0
units.english: An hour of waiting passes, and Lieutenant Paris walks into the room followed by a Navy admiral. "I hope you are all enjoying your stay," the admiral remarks. "Now. How is it that most of the cubes you placed were mysteriously disabled shortly after pirates entered each system?"
units.italian: Passa un'ora di attesa, poi il tenente Paris entra nella stanza seguito da un ammiraglio della Marina. "Spero che il soggiorno vi piaccia," osserva l'ammiraglio. "Ora. Come mai la maggior parte dei cubi che avete collocato è stata misteriosamente disattivata poco dopo l'arrivo dei pirati in ciascun sistema?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|	The admiral looks to each of the captains in the room, seemingly waiting for a response.|419|0
units.english: The admiral looks to each of the captains in the room, seemingly waiting for a response.
units.italian: L'ammiraglio guarda ciascuno dei capitani nella stanza, come in attesa di una risposta.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|	(Say nothing.)|421|0
units.english: (Say nothing.)
units.italian: (Non dire nulla.)

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|	"Maybe they know how to detect the cubes."|423|0
units.english: "Maybe they know how to detect the cubes."
units.italian: "Forse sanno come individuare i cubi."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|	The admiral looks at you. "Doubtful." Paris nods, as if to back up this claim.|425|0
units.english: The admiral looks at you. "Doubtful." Paris nods, as if to back up this claim.
units.italian: L'ammiraglio ti guarda. "Ne dubito." Paris annuisce, come per avallare l'affermazione.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|	He clears his throat and continues, "Allow me to explain the situation. Roughly two weeks after the last of your 'deliveries' were activated, the sensors identified Beelzebub's ship in the northern reaches of the Dirt Belt. We dispatched half of the nearest Navy garrison to apprehend the vessel, only to arrive and find a convoy of Star Barges instead.|427|0
units.english: He clears his throat and continues, "Allow me to explain the situation. Roughly two weeks after the last of your 'deliveries' were activated, the sensors identified Beelzebub's ship in the northern reaches of the Dirt Belt. We dispatched half of the nearest Navy garrison to apprehend the vessel, only to arrive and find a convoy of Star Barges instead.
units.italian: Si schiarisce la voce e continua: "Permettetemi di spiegarvi la situazione. Circa due settimane dopo l'attivazione dell'ultima delle vostre 'consegne', i sensori hanno identificato la nave di Belzebù nelle propaggini settentrionali della Dirt Belt. Abbiamo inviato metà della guarnigione della Marina più vicina a fermare la nave, per scoprire poi, arrivati sul posto, che si trattava di un convoglio di Star Barge.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|	"Worse, while our ships were in pursuit of the decoys, a pirate fleet managed to assault their home base and captured a handful of docked Cruisers. And, amidst the chaos, most of the cubes you placed in the Dirt Belt and Core were disabled!"|428|0
units.english: "Worse, while our ships were in pursuit of the decoys, a pirate fleet managed to assault their home base and captured a handful of docked Cruisers. And, amidst the chaos, most of the cubes you placed in the Dirt Belt and Core were disabled!"
units.italian: "Peggio: mentre le nostre navi inseguivano gli esche, una flotta pirata è riuscita ad assaltare la loro base e a catturare un pugno di Incrociatori ormeggiati. E, nel caos, la maggior parte dei cubi che avevate collocato nella Dirt Belt e nel Core è stata disattivata!"

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|	Before the admiral can work himself up further, Paris intercedes with the rest of the story. "The cubes that Deep Security had you position on multiple worlds were surveillance devices - sensor cubes, as we call them - designed to track Beelzebub's ship and notify us when the ship was located. It can be presumed that Beelzebub now has access to these cubes and has undoubtedly converted them to work in his favor. It may take us weeks to retrieve them, but at the moment it can be assumed that Beelzebub knows where we will be."|429|0
units.english: Before the admiral can work himself up further, Paris intercedes with the rest of the story. "The cubes that Deep Security had you position on multiple worlds were surveillance devices - sensor cubes, as we call them - designed to track Beelzebub's ship and notify us when the ship was located. It can be presumed that Beelzebub now has access to these cubes and has undoubtedly converted them to work in his favor. It may take us weeks to retrieve them, but at the moment it can be assumed that Beelzebub knows where we will be."
units.italian: Prima che l'ammiraglio possa infervorarsi ancora, Paris interviene con il resto della storia. "I cubi che la Sicurezza del Deep vi ha fatto collocare su più mondi erano dispositivi di sorveglianza (cubi sensore, come li chiamiamo), progettati per tracciare la nave di Belzebù e avvisarci quando fosse stata localizzata. Si può presumere che Belzebù ora abbia accesso a quei cubi e li abbia senza dubbio convertiti a proprio favore. Potrebbero servirci settimane per recuperarli, ma al momento dobbiamo dare per scontato che Belzebù sappia dove saremo."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|	"Why are you involving us in this?"|431|0
units.english: "Why are you involving us in this?"
units.italian: "Perché coinvolgete noi in tutto questo?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|	"Are we part of a plan to take Beelzebub down?"|432|0
units.english: "Are we part of a plan to take Beelzebub down?"
units.italian: "Facciamo parte di un piano per abbattere Belzebù?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|	"Beelzebub is perhaps the most wanted pirate warlord since the 28th century. With both Navy and Deep technology now in the hands of this criminal, every available ship will be required to take him down. Given this, we are now hoping that you would be willing to assist us in trapping Beelzebub. The six of your fleets combined would certainly make up for anything that the Navy has lost in the attack."|434|0
units.english: "Beelzebub is perhaps the most wanted pirate warlord since the 28th century. With both Navy and Deep technology now in the hands of this criminal, every available ship will be required to take him down. Given this, we are now hoping that you would be willing to assist us in trapping Beelzebub. The six of your fleets combined would certainly make up for anything that the Navy has lost in the attack."
units.italian: "Belzebù è forse il signore della guerra pirata più ricercato dal ventottesimo secolo. Con la tecnologia della Marina e del Deep ora nelle mani di questo criminale, servirà ogni nave disponibile per abbatterlo. Per questo speriamo che vogliate aiutarci a intrappolarlo: le vostre sei flotte insieme compenserebbero certo tutto ciò che la Marina ha perso nell'attacco."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|	"How much will we be paid?" one of the other merchant captains asks. "At minimum, one million credits," the admiral replies. The captain who asked instantly agrees to help, as do two others.|435|0
units.english: "How much will we be paid?" one of the other merchant captains asks. "At minimum, one million credits," the admiral replies. The captain who asked instantly agrees to help, as do two others.
units.italian: "Quanto ci pagherete?" chiede uno degli altri capitani mercantili. "Almeno un milione di crediti," risponde l'ammiraglio. Il capitano che ha chiesto accetta subito, e così altri due.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|	"I'll help as well."|437|0
units.english: "I'll help as well."
units.italian: "Aiuterò anch'io."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|	"Sorry, but I am not interested in helping."|439|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I am not interested in helping."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non mi interessa aiutare."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|	One other merchant captain also declines, and you both are escorted out of the room, into the waiting elevator. The trip back to the surface is silent, and your escort dismisses you both with a simple "Goodbye."|441|0
units.english: One other merchant captain also declines, and you both are escorted out of the room, into the waiting elevator. The trip back to the surface is silent, and your escort dismisses you both with a simple "Goodbye."
units.italian: Anche un altro capitano mercantile rifiuta, e venite entrambi scortati fuori dalla stanza, nell'ascensore in attesa. Il viaggio di ritorno in superficie è silenzioso, e la scorta vi congeda con un semplice "Arrivederci."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|	In the end, only one of the merchant captains declines. She is escorted out of the room, and the admiral explains each merchant captain's new role.|445|0
units.english: In the end, only one of the merchant captains declines. She is escorted out of the room, and the admiral explains each merchant captain's new role.
units.italian: Alla fine solo una dei capitani mercantili rifiuta. Viene scortata fuori dalla stanza, e l'ammiraglio spiega il nuovo ruolo di ciascun capitano.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|	"We assume that Beelzebub knows where we will be, but we know where he is as well - the stolen Cruisers and the pirate fleet that attacked our base moved toward the Core. Given the severity of the crime that Beelzebub has just committed, he will undoubtedly attempt to get as far away from the law as possible. That leaves us only two possible destinations: Buccaneer Bay, or the anarchist colonies of the Far North. Our best guess is that the colonies are the more appealing option to a warlord.|446|0
units.english: "We assume that Beelzebub knows where we will be, but we know where he is as well - the stolen Cruisers and the pirate fleet that attacked our base moved toward the Core. Given the severity of the crime that Beelzebub has just committed, he will undoubtedly attempt to get as far away from the law as possible. That leaves us only two possible destinations: Buccaneer Bay, or the anarchist colonies of the Far North. Our best guess is that the colonies are the more appealing option to a warlord.
units.italian: "Diamo per scontato che Belzebù sappia dove saremo, ma sappiamo anche dove si trova lui: gli Incrociatori rubati e la flotta pirata che ha attaccato la nostra base si sono mossi verso il Core. Data la gravità del crimine appena commesso, Belzebù cercherà senza dubbio di allontanarsi il più possibile dalla legge. Restano quindi solo due destinazioni possibili: Baia dei Bucanieri, o le colonie anarchiche del Far North. La nostra ipotesi migliore è che le colonie siano l'opzione più attraente per un signore della guerra.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|	"We'll be setting up multiple blockades in hopes of boxing Beelzebub in as a number of fleets sweep the galaxy. Captain <last>, you will be stationed on <destination> with Lieutenant Paris and a small Navy fleet. Please gather your things and travel there immediately."|447|0
units.english: "We'll be setting up multiple blockades in hopes of boxing Beelzebub in as a number of fleets sweep the galaxy. Captain <last>, you will be stationed on <destination> with Lieutenant Paris and a small Navy fleet. Please gather your things and travel there immediately."
units.italian: "Istituiremo diversi blocchi nella speranza di stringere Belzebù mentre varie flotte setacciano la galassia. Capitano <last>, tu sarai di stanza su <destination> con il tenente Paris e una piccola flotta della Marina. Per favore, raduna le tue cose e raggiungici subito."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 2|dialog|451|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but some of your escorts have not yet reached the system. Wait for all escorts to enter the system before landing.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma alcune delle tue scorte non sono ancora arrivate nel sistema. Aspetta che tutte le scorte entrino nel sistema prima di atterrare.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 3|name|512|0
units.english: Defend <planet>
units.italian: Difendi <planet>

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 3|description|513|0
units.english: Destroy the pirates attacking <planet>.
units.italian: Distruggi i pirati che attaccano <planet>.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 3|Several of the <planet> spaceport landing pads are suitable for even the largest of Navy capital ships. Paris explains to you that at one time this world was used as a major Navy base, but has since been replaced by Farpoint closer to the Far North anarchist worlds.|520|0
units.english: Several of the <planet> spaceport landing pads are suitable for even the largest of Navy capital ships. Paris explains to you that at one time this world was used as a major Navy base, but has since been replaced by Farpoint closer to the Far North anarchist worlds.
units.italian: Diverse piazzole dello spazioporto di <planet> sono adatte persino alle più grandi capitali della Marina. Paris ti spiega che un tempo questo mondo era una grande base della Marina, ma è stato poi sostituito da Farpoint, più vicino ai mondi anarchici del Far North.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 3|	Once every ship is parked, a captains' briefing is held on an empty landing pad. "Don't expect this job to be fun," Lieutenant Paris states. "We could be waiting around here for days before anything happens, and we need to stay in system the entire time."|521|0
units.english: Once every ship is parked, a captains' briefing is held on an empty landing pad. "Don't expect this job to be fun," Lieutenant Paris states. "We could be waiting around here for days before anything happens, and we need to stay in system the entire time."
units.italian: Una volta ormeggiate tutte le navi, si tiene un briefing dei capitani su una piazzola vuota. "Non aspettarti che questo incarico sia divertente," dichiara il tenente Paris. "Potremmo restare qui ad aspettare per giorni prima che succeda qualcosa, e dobbiamo rimanere nel sistema tutto il tempo."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 3|	"What do we do while we wait?"|523|0
units.english: "What do we do while we wait?"
units.italian: "Che facciamo mentre aspettiamo?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 3|	"For now, you can walk around the spaceport and see what there might be to do, but don't stray too far, otherwise you might never get back to your ship in time." Paris hands you a communication device. "This way you can be notified when something happens regardless of where you are. I'm going to stay on my ship and monitor the incoming transmissions."|524|0
units.english: "For now, you can walk around the spaceport and see what there might be to do, but don't stray too far, otherwise you might never get back to your ship in time." Paris hands you a communication device. "This way you can be notified when something happens regardless of where you are. I'm going to stay on my ship and monitor the incoming transmissions."
units.italian: "Per ora puoi girare per lo spazioporto e vedere cosa c'è da fare, ma non allontanarti troppo, altrimenti potresti non fare in tempo a tornare alla nave. " Paris ti consegna un dispositivo di comunicazione. "Così potrai essere avvisato quando succede qualcosa, ovunque tu sia. Io resto sulla mia nave a controllare le trasmissioni in arrivo."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 3|	(Wander the spaceport.)|526|0
units.english: (Wander the spaceport.)
units.italian: (Gironzola per lo spazioporto.)

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 3|	(Stay near my ship.)|527|0
units.english: (Stay near my ship.)
units.italian: (Resta vicino alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 3|	Other than the occasional blaring of a train whistle, the spaceport of <planet> is rather tranquil. You pass the time by talking to a few tourists, most of whom are getting ready to go rock climbing. While walking through the restaurant district, the ground begins to shake slightly. Many of the locals don't even react to the earthquake, and eventually it subsides. Once you have walked through the entire spaceport and seen all that it has to offer, you begin to make your way back to your ship.|529|0
units.english: Other than the occasional blaring of a train whistle, the spaceport of <planet> is rather tranquil. You pass the time by talking to a few tourists, most of whom are getting ready to go rock climbing. While walking through the restaurant district, the ground begins to shake slightly. Many of the locals don't even react to the earthquake, and eventually it subsides. Once you have walked through the entire spaceport and seen all that it has to offer, you begin to make your way back to your ship.
units.italian: A parte il fischio occasionale di un treno, lo spazioporto di <planet> è piuttosto tranquillo. Passi il tempo parlando con qualche turista, la maggior parte dei quali si sta preparando ad andare ad arrampicare. Mentre attraversi il quartiere dei ristoranti, il terreno comincia a tremare leggermente. Molti dei locali non reagiscono nemmeno al terremoto, che alla fine si placa. Dopo aver percorso tutto lo spazioporto e visto ciò che offre, cominci a tornare verso la nave.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 3|	One of the Navy crewmen produces a football from their cabin, and a small game begins inside of an open landing pad. Others try to pass the time by reading or writing. Everyone comes to a standstill though once the ground begins to rumble; an earthquake. A Navy member calls out to everyone, "Don't worry, this is a small one. We get earthquakes like this a lot on Gemstone." The shaking eventually subsides, and you decide to go into your ship to rest.|533|0
units.english: One of the Navy crewmen produces a football from their cabin, and a small game begins inside of an open landing pad. Others try to pass the time by reading or writing. Everyone comes to a standstill though once the ground begins to rumble; an earthquake. A Navy member calls out to everyone, "Don't worry, this is a small one. We get earthquakes like this a lot on Gemstone." The shaking eventually subsides, and you decide to go into your ship to rest.
units.italian: Uno degli uomini della Marina tira fuori un pallone dalla cabina, e su una piazzola libera comincia una partitella. Altri passano il tempo leggendo o scrivendo. Tutti però si fermano quando il terreno comincia a rimbombare: un terremoto. Un membro della Marina grida a tutti: "Non preoccupatevi, è piccolo. Su Gemstone ne abbiamo spesso, di terremoti così." Alla fine le scosse si placano, e decidi di rientrare in nave a riposare.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 3|	Suddenly, your communication device beeps and you hear Lieutenant Paris' voice, "The blockade in Mirfak has just been attacked. I repeat, the blockade in Mirfak has just been attacked. Reports are that the blockade has sustained heavy losses as the pirate fleet included one of the stolen Cruisers."|536|0
units.english: Suddenly, your communication device beeps and you hear Lieutenant Paris' voice, "The blockade in Mirfak has just been attacked. I repeat, the blockade in Mirfak has just been attacked. Reports are that the blockade has sustained heavy losses as the pirate fleet included one of the stolen Cruisers."
units.italian: All'improvviso il dispositivo di comunicazione emette un bip e senti la voce del tenente Paris: "Il blocco di Mirfak è appena stato attaccato. Ripeto, il blocco di Mirfak è appena stato attaccato. I rapporti dicono che ha subito perdite pesanti, perché la flotta pirata includeva uno degli Incrociatori rubati."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 3|	A rather young recruit asks, "Should we go help them?" to which a senior officer responds, "We were given orders and we're going to follow them unless told otherwise." The comms fall silent, and the waiting resumes.|537|0
units.english: A rather young recruit asks, "Should we go help them?" to which a senior officer responds, "We were given orders and we're going to follow them unless told otherwise." The comms fall silent, and the waiting resumes.
units.italian: Una recluta piuttosto giovane chiede: "Dovremmo andare ad aiutarli?" e un ufficiale anziano risponde: "Abbiamo ricevuto ordini e li seguiremo, a meno che non ci dicano il contrario." Le comunicazioni tacciono, e l'attesa riprende.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 3|	A few anxious hours pass with no new information. Suddenly, without warning, one of the Ravens takes off and your communications device begins blaring. "A pirate fleet just jumped into the system, alongside two Navy Cruisers painted in pirate colors!" All the captains and their crew scatter for their ships, ready to fight.|539|0
units.english: A few anxious hours pass with no new information. Suddenly, without warning, one of the Ravens takes off and your communications device begins blaring. "A pirate fleet just jumped into the system, alongside two Navy Cruisers painted in pirate colors!" All the captains and their crew scatter for their ships, ready to fight.
units.italian: Passano alcune ore di ansia senza nuove informazioni. Poi, senza preavviso, uno dei Raven decolla e il tuo dispositivo di comunicazione comincia a strillare: "Una flotta pirata è appena saltata nel sistema, insieme a due Incrociatori della Marina dipinti con i colori dei pirati!" Tutti i capitani e i loro equipaggi corrono alle navi, pronti a combattere.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 4|name|555|0
units.english: Rendezvous on <planet>
units.italian: Appuntamento su <planet>

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 4|description|556|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> with reinforcements for its blockade.
units.italian: Raggiungi <destination> con rinforzi per il suo blocco.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 4|Despite the commandeered Navy Cruisers, the pirates were unable to break through the blockade. After all of your group has landed, Paris invites the captains into his ship and makes contact with mission control. He relays the battle report, and you hear that the blockade in Matar was also attacked, but no stolen Cruisers were sighted.|564|0
units.english: Despite the commandeered Navy Cruisers, the pirates were unable to break through the blockade. After all of your group has landed, Paris invites the captains into his ship and makes contact with mission control. He relays the battle report, and you hear that the blockade in Matar was also attacked, but no stolen Cruisers were sighted.
units.italian: Nonostante gli Incrociatori della Marina requisiti, i pirati non sono riusciti a sfondare il blocco. Dopo che tutto il tuo gruppo è atterrato, Paris invita i capitani sulla sua nave e contatta il comando missione. Riferisce il rapporto della battaglia, e senti che anche il blocco di Matar è stato attaccato, ma senza avvistamenti di Incrociatori rubati.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 4|	"What are your orders, Admiral?" Paris asks over the comms.|565|0
units.english: "What are your orders, Admiral?" Paris asks over the comms.
units.italian: "Quali sono i suoi ordini, ammiraglio?" chiede Paris via radio.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 4|	"Lieutenant, your report makes three Cruisers accounted for, yet still no sign of Beelzebub. Our recon fleets have almost reached the blockades, meaning we'll catch this warlord soon enough. After the Navy fleet sweeping toward your post enters Nihal, I want you to lead everyone to <destination>. Beelzebub may be planning an attack on the blockade there with the remaining three Cruisers."|566|0
units.english: "Lieutenant, your report makes three Cruisers accounted for, yet still no sign of Beelzebub. Our recon fleets have almost reached the blockades, meaning we'll catch this warlord soon enough. After the Navy fleet sweeping toward your post enters Nihal, I want you to lead everyone to <destination>. Beelzebub may be planning an attack on the blockade there with the remaining three Cruisers."
units.italian: "Tenente, il suo rapporto giustifica tre Incrociatori, eppure di Belzebù nessuna traccia. Le nostre flotte da ricognizione hanno quasi raggiunto i blocchi, il che significa che prenderemo questo signore della guerra abbastanza presto. Dopo che la flotta della Marina diretta verso la vostra postazione sarà entrata in Nihal, voglio che portiate tutti su <destination>. Belzebù potrebbe stare pianificando un attacco al blocco laggiù con i tre Incrociatori rimanenti."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 4|	"Understood sir." After contacting the captain of the Navy fleet approaching <origin>, Paris holds a short all-hands briefing to inform the crew that they should be ready to leave for <destination> in a few hours.|567|0
units.english: "Understood sir." After contacting the captain of the Navy fleet approaching <origin>, Paris holds a short all-hands briefing to inform the crew that they should be ready to leave for <destination> in a few hours.
units.italian: "Capito, signore." Dopo aver contattato il capitano della flotta della Marina in avvicinamento a <origin>, Paris tiene un breve briefing generale per informare l'equipaggio che dovrà essere pronto a partire per <destination> nel giro di poche ore.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 4|dialog|643|0
units.english: Alnitak is in chaos when you enter the system. An outnumbered defense fleet is fighting a group of pirate ships, and among the pirates your sensors identify the three stolen Cruisers.
units.italian: Alnitak è nel caos quando entri nel sistema. Una flotta di difesa in inferiorità numerica sta combattendo contro un gruppo di navi pirata, e tra i pirati i tuoi sensori identificano i tre Incrociatori rubati.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 4|dialog|645|0
units.english: You have landed on <planet>, but there are still pirates attacking the system. Defeat all of the pirates in order to complete this mission.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ci sono ancora pirati che attaccano il sistema. Sconfiggi tutti i pirati per completare questa missione.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 4|log|651|0
units.english: Helped to destroy the last of the Navy Cruisers stolen by Beelzebub, but he has escaped. The Navy is still searching, but is no longer asking for help from merchants.
units.italian: Ho contribuito a distruggere l'ultimo degli Incrociatori della Marina rubati da Belzebù, ma lui è fuggito. La Marina sta ancora cercando, ma non chiede più aiuto ai mercanti.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 4|log|652|0
units.english: Beelzebub, as many call them, is one of the most notorious pirates in human space. They're responsible for committing countless acts of crimes against both humanity and the Republic government and are still at large somewhere in the galaxy despite a major setback.
units.italian: Belzebù, come lo chiamano in molti, è uno dei pirati più famigerati dello spazio umano. È responsabile di innumerevoli crimini contro l'umanità e contro il governo della Repubblica, e nonostante una battuta d'arresto importante è ancora latitante da qualche parte nella galassia.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 4|As you come in for a landing, you can see that a number of buildings have taken fire from the pirate fleet above. White tents have been set up to tend to the wounded and multiple ships are being repaired. You are directed to an unscathed building in which a number of Navy officers, the admiral you met on Luna, Lieutenant Paris, and your fellow merchant captains have convened. After you enter the room and get settled down, the admiral begins to speak.|654|0
units.english: As you come in for a landing, you can see that a number of buildings have taken fire from the pirate fleet above. White tents have been set up to tend to the wounded and multiple ships are being repaired. You are directed to an unscathed building in which a number of Navy officers, the admiral you met on Luna, Lieutenant Paris, and your fellow merchant captains have convened. After you enter the room and get settled down, the admiral begins to speak.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini all'atterraggio, vedi che diversi edifici sono stati colpiti dal fuoco della flotta pirata sopra di te. Sono state montate tende bianche per curare i feriti, e varie navi vengono riparate. Ti indirizzano verso un edificio intatto, dove si sono riuniti alcuni ufficiali della Marina, l'ammiraglio che hai incontrato sulla Luna, il tenente Paris e gli altri capitani mercantili. Dopo che entri nella stanza e ti sistemi, l'ammiraglio comincia a parlare.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 4|	"Here's the sitrep. Beelzebub's ship was spotted entering the system, followed by the rest of the pirate fleet. His ship seemed to disappear in the confusion, so we have no idea where he went. Either Beelzebub is currently hiding on the anarchist worlds or has made a dash for the Core, in which case the chase goes on."|655|0
units.english: "Here's the sitrep. Beelzebub's ship was spotted entering the system, followed by the rest of the pirate fleet. His ship seemed to disappear in the confusion, so we have no idea where he went. Either Beelzebub is currently hiding on the anarchist worlds or has made a dash for the Core, in which case the chase goes on."
units.italian: "Ecco la situazione. La nave di Belzebù è stata avvistata mentre entrava nel sistema, seguita dal resto della flotta pirata. La sua nave sembra sparita nella confusione, quindi non abbiamo idea di dove sia finito. O Belzebù si sta nascondendo sui mondi anarchici, o si è lanciato verso il Core: in quel caso la caccia continua."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 4|	"Beelzebub can't have gone to the Core," Paris butts in. "We traveled here through the uninhabited systems. We would have seen Beelzebub had he gone that way."|659|0
units.english: "Beelzebub can't have gone to the Core," Paris butts in. "We traveled here through the uninhabited systems. We would have seen Beelzebub had he gone that way."
units.italian: "Belzebù non può essere andato nel Core," interviene Paris. "Siamo arrivati qui attraverso i sistemi disabitati. Se fosse passato di là l'avremmo visto."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 4|	"That's good news then. All we have to do is wait Beelzebub out until he decides to poke his little head back out.|660|0
units.english: "That's good news then. All we have to do is wait Beelzebub out until he decides to poke his little head back out.
units.italian: "Allora è una buona notizia. Dobbiamo solo aspettare che Belzebù si stanchi e decida di rifare capolino.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 4|	"Luckily, all six stolen Cruisers are accounted for, albeit destroyed. Deep Security forces have begun to collect the stolen sensor cubes. We can confirm that Beelzebub was watching our every move, since the cubes are being found all over the Paradise Worlds and Core. They should all be retrieved within the next week." The admiral then turns to the merchant captains. "Now that Beelzebub doesn't have the upper hand anymore, you are no longer needed. As promised, <payment> will be transferred to each of your accounts for your services."|663|0
units.english: "Luckily, all six stolen Cruisers are accounted for, albeit destroyed. Deep Security forces have begun to collect the stolen sensor cubes. We can confirm that Beelzebub was watching our every move, since the cubes are being found all over the Paradise Worlds and Core. They should all be retrieved within the next week." The admiral then turns to the merchant captains. "Now that Beelzebub doesn't have the upper hand anymore, you are no longer needed. As promised, <payment> will be transferred to each of your accounts for your services."
units.italian: "Per fortuna tutti e sei gli Incrociatori rubati sono stati individuati, anche se distrutti. Le forze della Sicurezza del Deep hanno cominciato a recuperare i cubi sensore rubati. Possiamo confermare che Belzebù osservava ogni nostra mossa, dato che i cubi stanno saltando fuori in tutti i Mondi Paradisiaci e nel Core. Dovrebbero essere recuperati tutti entro la prossima settimana." Poi l'ammiraglio si volta verso i capitani mercantili. "Ora che Belzebù non ha più il sopravvento, non ci servite più. Come promesso, <payment> verrà trasferito su ciascuno dei vostri conti per i vostri servizi."

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 4|	"Thank you, Admiral," one of the captains replies.|664|0
units.english: "Thank you, Admiral," one of the captains replies.
units.italian: "Grazie, ammiraglio," risponde uno dei capitani.

units.id: mission:Deep: Mystery Cubes 4|	"No, thank you. All of you. You didn't have to accept this risk but you did, and I speak for the whole Navy when I say that we are grateful for that."|665|0
units.english: "No, thank you. All of you. You didn't have to accept this risk but you did, and I speak for the whole Navy when I say that we are grateful for that."
units.italian: "No, grazie a voi. A tutti voi. Non eravate obbligati a correre questo rischio, e invece l'avete fatto: parlo a nome di tutta la Marina quando dico che vi siamo grati."

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|name|673|0
units.english: Find "There Might Be Riots"
units.italian: Trova i "There Might Be Riots"

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|description|674|0
units.english: Find "There Might Be Riots" by <date> and convince them to throw a concert on <destination>.
units.italian: Trova i "There Might Be Riots" entro il <date> e convincili a tenere un concerto su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|When you enter the <origin> spaceport, you hear what is undoubtedly a "There Might Be Riots" song playing loudly enough for everyone in the spaceport to hear. A quick glance around reveals the source of the noise to be the external speakers of a nearby Bounder and several people dancing.|691|0
units.english: When you enter the <origin> spaceport, you hear what is undoubtedly a "There Might Be Riots" song playing loudly enough for everyone in the spaceport to hear. A quick glance around reveals the source of the noise to be the external speakers of a nearby Bounder and several people dancing.
units.italian: Quando entri nello spazioporto di <origin>, senti quella che è senza dubbio una canzone dei "There Might Be Riots", a volume tale che tutto lo spazioporto la sente. Un rapido sguardo in giro rivela che il rumore viene dagli altoparlanti esterni di un Bounder lì vicino, con diverse persone che ballano.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	(Dance with them.)|693|0
units.english: (Dance with them.)
units.italian: (Balla con loro.)

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	(See what's going on.)|695|0
units.english: (See what's going on.)
units.italian: (Vedi cosa succede.)

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	(Ignore them.)|696|0
units.english: (Ignore them.)
units.italian: (Ignorali.)

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	You approach the Bounder and count five people dancing in total: three women and two men. One of the women dancing notices you walking over and exclaims, "Looks like someone else is about to join the party!" Her shout is met by a raucous cheer from the rest of the dancers, but you refuse to dance when they try to pull you into the fray.|699|0
units.english: You approach the Bounder and count five people dancing in total: three women and two men. One of the women dancing notices you walking over and exclaims, "Looks like someone else is about to join the party!" Her shout is met by a raucous cheer from the rest of the dancers, but you refuse to dance when they try to pull you into the fray.
units.italian: Ti avvicini al Bounder e conti cinque persone che ballano: tre donne e due uomini. Una delle donne ti nota mentre ti avvicini ed esclama: "Pare che qualcun altro stia per unirsi alla festa!" Al suo grido segue un'ovazione chiassosa degli altri ballerini, ma rifiuti di ballare quando provano a trascinarti nella mischia.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	After the music begins to subside, one of the dancers introduces himself to you as Garrison. Garrison then lists off the names of his fellow dancers: Pierre, Rayna, Hannah, and Laura. As you make your introductions, you learn that everyone here is part of the same research team, working for one of the Deep's many science bureaus, and they are currently wrapping up a short vacation by listening to their favorite band before they travel to Midgard on assignment.|700|0
units.english: After the music begins to subside, one of the dancers introduces himself to you as Garrison. Garrison then lists off the names of his fellow dancers: Pierre, Rayna, Hannah, and Laura. As you make your introductions, you learn that everyone here is part of the same research team, working for one of the Deep's many science bureaus, and they are currently wrapping up a short vacation by listening to their favorite band before they travel to Midgard on assignment.
units.italian: Quando la musica comincia a calare, uno dei ballerini si presenta: si chiama Garrison. Poi elenca i nomi degli altri: Pierre, Rayna, Hannah e Laura. Mentre vi presentate, scopri che tutti fanno parte della stessa squadra di ricerca, alle dipendenze di uno dei tanti uffici scientifici del Deep, e che stanno chiudendo una breve vacanza ascoltando la loro band preferita prima di partire per Midgard in missione.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	You approach the Bounder and count five people dancing in total: three women and two men. One of the women dancing notices you walking over and exclaims, "Looks like someone else is about to join the party!" Her shout is met by a raucous cheer from the rest of the dancers, and they pull you into the fray.|704|0
units.english: You approach the Bounder and count five people dancing in total: three women and two men. One of the women dancing notices you walking over and exclaims, "Looks like someone else is about to join the party!" Her shout is met by a raucous cheer from the rest of the dancers, and they pull you into the fray.
units.italian: Ti avvicini al Bounder e conti cinque persone che ballano: tre donne e due uomini. Una delle donne ti nota mentre ti avvicini ed esclama: "Pare che qualcun altro stia per unirsi alla festa!" Al suo grido segue un'ovazione chiassosa degli altri ballerini, che ti trascinano nella mischia.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	After a few minutes of dancing, the music begins to subside. One of the dancers introduces himself to you as Garrison, and lists off the names of his fellow dancers: Pierre, Rayna, Hannah, and Laura. As you make your introductions, you learn that everyone here is part of the same research team, working for one of the Deep's many science bureaus, and they are currently wrapping up a short vacation by listening to their favorite band before they travel to Midgard on assignment.|705|0
units.english: After a few minutes of dancing, the music begins to subside. One of the dancers introduces himself to you as Garrison, and lists off the names of his fellow dancers: Pierre, Rayna, Hannah, and Laura. As you make your introductions, you learn that everyone here is part of the same research team, working for one of the Deep's many science bureaus, and they are currently wrapping up a short vacation by listening to their favorite band before they travel to Midgard on assignment.
units.italian: Dopo qualche minuto di ballo la musica comincia a calare. Uno dei ballerini si presenta: si chiama Garrison, ed elenca i nomi degli altri: Pierre, Rayna, Hannah e Laura. Mentre vi presentate, scopri che tutti fanno parte della stessa squadra di ricerca, alle dipendenze di uno dei tanti uffici scientifici del Deep, e che stanno chiudendo una breve vacanza ascoltando la loro band preferita prima di partire per Midgard in missione.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	"How do you know about 'There Might Be Riots?'" Hannah asks you.|708|0
units.english: "How do you know about 'There Might Be Riots?'" Hannah asks you.
units.italian: "Come fai a conoscere i 'There Might Be Riots?'" ti chiede Hannah.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	"I've met them."|710|0
units.english: "I've met them."
units.italian: "Li ho conosciuti."

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	"I just like to listen to their music."|712|0
units.english: "I just like to listen to their music."
units.italian: "Mi piace solo ascoltare la loro musica."

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	One of the other scientists, an older looking man named Pierre, looks right at you and stares. After a few moments he says, "I know you! You were in the 'Songs for the End of Civilization' broadcast from Pilot!" The rest of the scientists start agreeing with him as they look at you closer.|714|0
units.english: One of the other scientists, an older looking man named Pierre, looks right at you and stares. After a few moments he says, "I know you! You were in the 'Songs for the End of Civilization' broadcast from Pilot!" The rest of the scientists start agreeing with him as they look at you closer.
units.italian: Uno degli altri scienziati, un uomo dall'aria più anziana di nome Pierre, ti fissa dritto negli occhi. Dopo qualche istante dice: "Ti conosco! Eri nella trasmissione 'Canzoni per la fine della civiltà' da Pilot!" Gli altri scienziati cominciano a dargli ragione, guardandoti più da vicino.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	"You know 'There Might Be Riots?' You are so lucky!" says Rayna.|717|0
units.english: "You know 'There Might Be Riots?' You are so lucky!" says Rayna.
units.italian: "Conosci i 'There Might Be Riots?' Che fortuna!" dice Rayna.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	"I couldn't even see them during the 'Trouble on the Tarmac' tour, but you've met them? That's insane!" shrieks Laura.|718|0
units.english: "I couldn't even see them during the 'Trouble on the Tarmac' tour, but you've met them? That's insane!" shrieks Laura.
units.italian: "Io non sono nemmeno riuscita a vederli durante il tour 'Trouble on the Tarmac', e tu li hai conosciuti? È assurdo!" strilla Laura.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	Hannah chimes in, "Do you know where the band is? They've been quiet for a while now, ever since that broadcast. I heard rumors that the Republic detained them for trespassing, but since you're here..."|719|0
units.english: Hannah chimes in, "Do you know where the band is? They've been quiet for a while now, ever since that broadcast. I heard rumors that the Republic detained them for trespassing, but since you're here..."
units.italian: Hannah interviene: "Sai dove sono? Sono spariti da un po', da quella trasmissione. Ho sentito voci che la Repubblica li abbia fermati per violazione di proprietà, ma visto che sei qui..."

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	"I know where they are and rest assured, they're safe."|721|0
units.english: "I know where they are and rest assured, they're safe."
units.italian: "So dove sono, e stai tranquilla: sono al sicuro."

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	"Sorry, I don't know where they are."|722|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't know where they are."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non so dove siano."

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	The group falls silent until Rayna asks "Do you think you could bring them to us for a live concert?"|725|0
units.english: The group falls silent until Rayna asks "Do you think you could bring them to us for a live concert?"
units.italian: Il gruppo ammutolisce, finché Rayna chiede: "Pensi che potresti portarli da noi per un concerto dal vivo?"

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	"I'd love to."|727|0
units.english: "I'd love to."
units.italian: "Mi piacerebbe molto."

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	"No thanks. I have better things to do."|728|0
units.english: "No thanks. I have better things to do."
units.italian: "No grazie. Ho cose migliori da fare."

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	All five scientists burst out in a cheer, clearly excited for the chance to see their favorite band live. As the cheering dies down Laura says, "We must get going now, <first>. We're being stationed on Midgard for the next few months, so if you do find 'There Might Be Riots,' please bring them there." Each member of the group says goodbye to you as they depart.|731|0
units.english: All five scientists burst out in a cheer, clearly excited for the chance to see their favorite band live. As the cheering dies down Laura says, "We must get going now, <first>. We're being stationed on Midgard for the next few months, so if you do find 'There Might Be Riots,' please bring them there." Each member of the group says goodbye to you as they depart.
units.italian: Tutti e cinque gli scienziati prorompono in un'ovazione, chiaramente entusiasti all'idea di vedere dal vivo la loro band preferita. Quando il clamore si spegne, Laura dice: "Ora dobbiamo andare, <first>. Saremo di stanza su Midgard per i prossimi mesi, quindi se trovi i 'There Might Be Riots' portali là, per favore." Ognuno del gruppo ti saluta mentre si allontana.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 0|	The group looks visibly disappointed. A few minutes of talking later, they inform you that they must depart for Midgard and say their farewells.|735|0
units.english: The group looks visibly disappointed. A few minutes of talking later, they inform you that they must depart for Midgard and say their farewells.
units.italian: Il gruppo ha l'aria visibilmente delusa. Dopo qualche minuto di conversazione ti informano che devono partire per Midgard e ti salutano.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR: Hint|name|745|0
units.english: Reunite with the band
units.italian: Ritrova la band

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR: Hint|description|746|0
units.english: A human on <origin> indicated she saw "There Might Be Riots" perform on <destination> last week. Hopefully they are still there.
units.italian: Una donna su <origin> ha detto di aver visto i "There Might Be Riots" esibirsi su <destination> la settimana scorsa. Speriamo che siano ancora là.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR: Hint|It takes you a while, but after a few hours of asking around the spaceport, you finally find someone who knows where the band is. "I saw them on <destination>," she says. "They were throwing a pretty gnarly concert just last week. I haven't heard of them playing anywhere else, so they might still be there."|759|0
units.english: It takes you a while, but after a few hours of asking around the spaceport, you finally find someone who knows where the band is. "I saw them on <destination>," she says. "They were throwing a pretty gnarly concert just last week. I haven't heard of them playing anywhere else, so they might still be there."
units.italian: Ci vuole un po', ma dopo qualche ora di domande per lo spazioporto trovi finalmente qualcuno che sa dove sia la band. "Li ho visti su <destination>," dice. "Hanno tenuto un concerto niente male proprio la settimana scorsa. Non ho sentito che abbiano suonato altrove, quindi potrebbero essere ancora là."

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 1|name|766|0
units.english: Transport band to <planet>
units.italian: Trasporta la band su <planet>

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 1|description|767|0
units.english: Give the band "There Might Be Riots" a ride to <destination> so that they can perform for the Deep scientists.
units.italian: Porta la band "There Might Be Riots" fino a <destination>, così che possa esibirsi per gli scienziati del Deep.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 1|blocked|770|0
units.english: You have reached <origin>, but you'll need <capacity> to continue this mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <origin>, ma ti serve <capacity> per continuare questa missione. Torna qui quando avrai liberato lo spazio necessario.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 1|You find "There Might Be Riots" playing a gig right in the spaceport of <origin>. Judging by the large number of Hai in the audience, they seem to have amassed quite the following, even in Hai space.|777|0
units.english: You find "There Might Be Riots" playing a gig right in the spaceport of <origin>. Judging by the large number of Hai in the audience, they seem to have amassed quite the following, even in Hai space.
units.italian: Trovi i "There Might Be Riots" che suonano proprio nello spazioporto di <origin>. A giudicare dal gran numero di Hai tra il pubblico, sembra che si siano costruiti un bel seguito, anche nello spazio Hai.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 1|	While the band intermixes crowd favorites and some new songs clearly inspired by their time in Hai space, you make your way to the side of the makeshift stage. Once the concert ends, Ulrich notices you and approaches.|778|0
units.english: While the band intermixes crowd favorites and some new songs clearly inspired by their time in Hai space, you make your way to the side of the makeshift stage. Once the concert ends, Ulrich notices you and approaches.
units.italian: Mentre la band alterna i pezzi più amati dal pubblico e alcune canzoni nuove, chiaramente ispirate al periodo nello spazio Hai, ti fai largo fino al lato del palco improvvisato. Quando il concerto finisce, Ulrich ti nota e si avvicina.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 1|	"Captain <last>, it's been a while! We've been having a great time with the peaceful squirrels ever since you dropped us off. It's the craziest experience we've ever had." He regales you with a number of adventures the band has been on since they came to Hai space, and how they were all surprised that even in such an idyllic place war was still a reality. "Say, what brings you here?"|779|0
units.english: "Captain <last>, it's been a while! We've been having a great time with the peaceful squirrels ever since you dropped us off. It's the craziest experience we've ever had." He regales you with a number of adventures the band has been on since they came to Hai space, and how they were all surprised that even in such an idyllic place war was still a reality. "Say, what brings you here?"
units.italian: "Capitano <last>, quanto tempo! Ci siamo divertiti un mondo con gli scoiattoli pacifici da quando ci hai lasciati qui. È l'esperienza più assurda che abbiamo mai fatto." Ti racconta una serie di avventure vissute dalla band da quando è arrivata nello spazio Hai, e di come siano rimasti tutti sorpresi che anche in un posto così idilliaco la guerra fosse una realtà. "Dimmi, cosa ti porta qui?"

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 1|	He listens intently to your story of the scientists on <planet>, but his brow furrows when you mention the rumor of imprisonment by the Republic.|780|0
