units.english: He listens intently to your story of the scientists on <planet>, but his brow furrows when you mention the rumor of imprisonment by the Republic.
units.italian: Ascolta con attenzione il tuo racconto degli scienziati su <planet>, ma aggrotta la fronte quando accenni alla voce del fermo da parte della Repubblica.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 1|	"Maybe we've been away long enough. I thought there would be some rumors or recordings that made it back to the Republic from here, but this place is a pretty well-kept secret, so perhaps not. Maybe it's time to go back to the land of the humans."|781|0
units.english: "Maybe we've been away long enough. I thought there would be some rumors or recordings that made it back to the Republic from here, but this place is a pretty well-kept secret, so perhaps not. Maybe it's time to go back to the land of the humans."
units.italian: "Forse siamo stati via abbastanza a lungo. Pensavo che da qui sarebbero arrivate alla Repubblica voci o registrazioni, ma questo posto è un segreto ben custodito, quindi forse no. Forse è tempo di tornare nella terra degli umani."

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 1|	Ulrich gathers up the rest of the band and they pack up their supplies. You chart a course for <destination> as they load their musical equipment on your ship and get ready for the long ride back to human space.|782|0
units.english: Ulrich gathers up the rest of the band and they pack up their supplies. You chart a course for <destination> as they load their musical equipment on your ship and get ready for the long ride back to human space.
units.italian: Ulrich raduna il resto della band e fanno i bagagli. Tracci una rotta per <destination> mentre caricano la loro attrezzatura musicale sulla tua nave e si preparano al lungo viaggio di ritorno nello spazio umano.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 1|dialog|785|0
units.english: You arrive on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the band and their supplies has not arrived yet. Better depart and wait for your escorts to enter the system.
units.italian: Arrivi su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con la band e la loro attrezzatura non è ancora arrivata. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che le scorte entrino nel sistema.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 1|log|788|0
units.english: Brought "There Might Be Riots" back to human space from their vacation in Hai space to play a concert for a team of scientists in the Deep.
units.italian: Ho riportato i "There Might Be Riots" nello spazio umano dalla loro vacanza nello spazio Hai, per tenere un concerto per una squadra di scienziati del Deep.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 1|Almost as soon as "There Might Be Riots" steps off your ship, a crowd gathers. When it is clear that the band is not simply disembarking, but preparing to perform, the uproar makes you glad that you had not given any advance notification to the locals. As the band gets ready, you contact the spaceport authorities and have them notify Garrison and the other scientists that you have returned. The authorities don't seem too enthused about hosting a concert with no advance warning, but they agree to send your message.|790|0
units.english: Almost as soon as "There Might Be Riots" steps off your ship, a crowd gathers. When it is clear that the band is not simply disembarking, but preparing to perform, the uproar makes you glad that you had not given any advance notification to the locals. As the band gets ready, you contact the spaceport authorities and have them notify Garrison and the other scientists that you have returned. The authorities don't seem too enthused about hosting a concert with no advance warning, but they agree to send your message.
units.italian: Quasi appena i "There Might Be Riots" scendono dalla nave, si raduna una folla. Quando appare chiaro che la band non sta solo sbarcando, ma si sta preparando a suonare, il clamore ti fa felice di non aver avvisato prima i locali. Mentre la band si sistema, contatti le autorità dello spazioporto e fai avvisare Garrison e gli altri scienziati del tuo ritorno. Le autorità non sembrano entusiaste all'idea di ospitare un concerto senza preavviso, ma accettano di inviare il messaggio.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 1|	The crowd gets larger and larger over time, and judging by the increased number of ships landing, word has quickly spread that "There Might Be Riots" is back.|791|0
units.english: The crowd gets larger and larger over time, and judging by the increased number of ships landing, word has quickly spread that "There Might Be Riots" is back.
units.italian: La folla cresce di continuo, e a giudicare dal numero crescente di navi che atterrano, la voce che i "There Might Be Riots" sono tornati si è sparsa in fretta.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 1|	As Ulrich and the band take the stage, you spot the scientists in the front row, grinning and cheering wildly. The first song is one you heard them play in Hai space, and even though none in the audience know the words to sing along, they appear to love the message, and the cheers and screams only grow more frenetic.|792|0
units.english: As Ulrich and the band take the stage, you spot the scientists in the front row, grinning and cheering wildly. The first song is one you heard them play in Hai space, and even though none in the audience know the words to sing along, they appear to love the message, and the cheers and screams only grow more frenetic.
units.italian: Quando Ulrich e la band salgono sul palco, scorgi gli scienziati in prima fila, che sorridono e acclamano senza sosta. La prima canzone è una che li hai sentiti suonare nello spazio Hai, e anche se nessuno del pubblico conosce le parole per cantarla, sembrano amarne il messaggio: applausi e urla diventano via via più frenetici.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 1|	During an intermission, you invite the scientists onto your ship to personally meet the band. The thrill in the eyes of each of the scientists is astounding as they meet the members of "There Might Be Riots."|793|0
units.english: During an intermission, you invite the scientists onto your ship to personally meet the band. The thrill in the eyes of each of the scientists is astounding as they meet the members of "There Might Be Riots."
units.italian: Durante un intervallo inviti gli scienziati sulla tua nave per conoscere personalmente la band. L'emozione negli occhi di ognuno di loro, mentre incontrano i membri dei "There Might Be Riots", è sorprendente.

units.id: mission:Deep: TMBR 1|	Before the intermission ends, each of the scientists thank you personally for bringing the band to Midgard, and Pierre even hands you <payment>. "It's the least we could give you," he adds. As the scientists start to depart your ship to listen to the rest of the concert, Hannah runs back to hug you before rejoining her friends in the crowd.|794|0
units.english: Before the intermission ends, each of the scientists thank you personally for bringing the band to Midgard, and Pierre even hands you <payment>. "It's the least we could give you," he adds. As the scientists start to depart your ship to listen to the rest of the concert, Hannah runs back to hug you before rejoining her friends in the crowd.
units.italian: Prima che l'intervallo finisca, ciascuno degli scienziati ti ringrazia di persona per aver portato la band su Midgard, e Pierre ti consegna persino <payment>. "È il minimo che possiamo darti," aggiunge. Mentre gli scienziati cominciano a lasciare la nave per ascoltare il resto del concerto, Hannah torna di corsa ad abbracciarti prima di riunirsi agli amici tra la folla.

units.id: mission:Deep: Interrogation|log|811|0
units.english: Was interrogated by the Deep for helping Albert Foster. The Deep now knows that Albert Foster thinks that there is an artificial singularity on Midgard.
units.italian: Sono stato interrogato dal Deep per aver aiutato Albert Foster. Il Deep ora sa che Albert Foster ritiene che su Midgard esista una singolarità artificiale.

units.id: mission:Deep: Questions|name|818|0
units.english: Mysterious Message
units.italian: Messaggio misterioso

units.id: mission:Deep: Questions|description|819|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> to meet the author of an encrypted message.
units.italian: Raggiungi <destination> per incontrare l'autore di un messaggio criptato.

units.id: mission:Deep: Questions|dialog|832|0
units.english: Upon landing, you receive an encrypted message from an unknown sender. "Hello, Captain <last>. Your recent assistance of the Deep is much appreciated. I'd like to speak with you on <destination> if you are interested." The message is not signed.
units.italian: All'atterraggio ricevi un messaggio criptato da un mittente sconosciuto. "Salve, capitano <last>. Il tuo recente aiuto al Deep è molto apprezzato. Se ti interessa, vorrei parlarti su <destination>." Il messaggio non è firmato.

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|When you land on <origin> and open your ship's main hatch, you find yourself face-to-face with two Deep Security officers, neither of whom appear armed. "Hello, Captain <last>. We're going to need to ask you some questions. If you would please step off of your ship and follow us, that would be much appreciated."|842|0
units.english: When you land on <origin> and open your ship's main hatch, you find yourself face-to-face with two Deep Security officers, neither of whom appear armed. "Hello, Captain <last>. We're going to need to ask you some questions. If you would please step off of your ship and follow us, that would be much appreciated."
units.italian: Quando atterri su <origin> e apri il portello principale della nave, ti trovi faccia a faccia con due ufficiali della Sicurezza del Deep, nessuno dei due armato in apparenza. "Salve, capitano <last>. Dobbiamo farti alcune domande. Se vuoi scendere dalla nave e seguirci, te ne saremmo grati."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	(Follow their orders.)|844|0
units.english: (Follow their orders.)
units.italian: (Segui i loro ordini.)

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Why do you need to question me?"|846|0
units.english: "Why do you need to question me?"
units.italian: "Perché dovete interrogarmi?"

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	(Close the hatch and flee.)|847|0
units.english: (Close the hatch and flee.)
units.italian: (Chiudi il portello e fuggi.)

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Because we wish to question you on the nature of your work for Albert Foster. Now please, step off your ship and come with us."|850|0
units.english: "Because we wish to question you on the nature of your work for Albert Foster. Now please, step off your ship and come with us."
units.italian: "Perché vogliamo interrogarti sulla natura del tuo lavoro per Albert Foster. Ora, per favore, scendi dalla nave e vieni con noi."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	(Follow their orders.)|852|0
units.english: (Follow their orders.)
units.italian: (Segui i loro ordini.)

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	(Close the hatch and flee.)|853|0
units.english: (Close the hatch and flee.)
units.italian: (Chiudi il portello e fuggi.)

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	You follow the officers to a building located on the eastern edge of the spaceport. You are led to a small, dimly lit room on the second floor that contains nothing but two chairs and a table. You are told to sit in one of the chairs and wait.|857|0
units.english: You follow the officers to a building located on the eastern edge of the spaceport. You are led to a small, dimly lit room on the second floor that contains nothing but two chairs and a table. You are told to sit in one of the chairs and wait.
units.italian: Segui gli ufficiali in un edificio sul bordo orientale dello spazioporto. Ti conducono in una stanza piccola e poco illuminata al secondo piano, che non contiene altro che due sedie e un tavolo. Ti dicono di sederti su una delle sedie e aspettare.

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	You attempt to close the hatch, but a strong tingling sensation radiates from your abdomen. As you drop to the floor convulsing, you hold your eyes open long enough to glimpse a stun gun in one officer's hand.|861|0
units.english: You attempt to close the hatch, but a strong tingling sensation radiates from your abdomen. As you drop to the floor convulsing, you hold your eyes open long enough to glimpse a stun gun in one officer's hand.
units.italian: Provi a chiudere il portello, ma una forte sensazione di formicolio ti si irradia dall'addome. Mentre cadi a terra in preda alle convulsioni, tieni gli occhi aperti abbastanza da intravedere una pistola stordente nella mano di un ufficiale.

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	You wake up, slumped in a chair, in a dimly lit room. Across the table is another chair, empty. As you twist about, examining the rest of the room, the lingering soreness in your abdomen reminds you that even though you are alone for the moment, attempting to leave is likely unwise.|863|0
units.english: You wake up, slumped in a chair, in a dimly lit room. Across the table is another chair, empty. As you twist about, examining the rest of the room, the lingering soreness in your abdomen reminds you that even though you are alone for the moment, attempting to leave is likely unwise.
units.italian: Ti risvegli, accasciato su una sedia, in una stanza poco illuminata. Dall'altra parte del tavolo c'è un'altra sedia, vuota. Mentre ti muovi per esaminare il resto della stanza, il dolore che ti resta all'addome ti ricorda che, anche se per ora sei solo, tentare di andarsene non è saggio.

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	(Wait.)|867|0
units.english: (Wait.)
units.italian: (Aspetta.)

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	Ten minutes pass in silence until a figure enters the room. In the dim light, you discern a tall, dark woman wearing what looks like a Deep Security uniform. Some of its badges, pins, and striping are unfamiliar to you.|869|0
units.english: Ten minutes pass in silence until a figure enters the room. In the dim light, you discern a tall, dark woman wearing what looks like a Deep Security uniform. Some of its badges, pins, and striping are unfamiliar to you.
units.italian: Passano dieci minuti in silenzio, finché una figura entra nella stanza. Nella luce fioca distingui una donna alta e bruna, che indossa quella che sembra un'uniforme della Sicurezza del Deep. Alcuni dei suoi distintivi, spille e strisce non ti sono familiari.

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"I hope my men didn't have to struggle too much to get you here."|870|0
units.english: "I hope my men didn't have to struggle too much to get you here."
units.italian: "Spero che i miei uomini non abbiano dovuto faticare troppo per portarti qui."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Don't worry, it was just fine."|872|0
units.english: "Don't worry, it was just fine."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti, è andato tutto bene."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"It wasn't the warmest welcome I've ever received."|873|0
units.english: "It wasn't the warmest welcome I've ever received."
units.italian: "Non è stata l'accoglienza più calorosa che abbia mai ricevuto."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	The woman chuckles slightly. "No need to be sarcastic with me. Now, you know why you're here."|875|0
units.english: The woman chuckles slightly. "No need to be sarcastic with me. Now, you know why you're here."
units.italian: La donna ridacchia appena. "Non serve essere sarcastico con me. Ora, sai perché sei qui."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"I do?"|877|0
units.english: "I do?"
units.italian: "Davvero?"

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"I didn't commit any crimes, so you have no right to detain me."|879|0
units.english: "I didn't commit any crimes, so you have no right to detain me."
units.italian: "Non ho commesso alcun crimine, quindi non avete il diritto di trattenermi."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Indeed, no crimes were committed during your work for Albert Foster, but we still have the right to detain you to keep the Deep safe. Cause us no trouble during this little meeting, answer my questions, and you will be on your way in a few minutes' time.|881|0
units.english: "Indeed, no crimes were committed during your work for Albert Foster, but we still have the right to detain you to keep the Deep safe. Cause us no trouble during this little meeting, answer my questions, and you will be on your way in a few minutes' time.
units.italian: "È vero, nessun crimine è stato commesso durante il tuo lavoro per Albert Foster, ma abbiamo comunque il diritto di trattenerti per tenere al sicuro il Deep. Non crearci problemi durante questo piccolo incontro, rispondi alle mie domande, e fra qualche minuto sarai libero di andartene.

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Well if you don't then let me jog your memory: You took a small chip of wood from a historical church on Midgard - nothing criminal, mind you - and returned it to Vinci, where I assume you handed it over to the 'archaeologist' Albert Foster." The tone of her voice as she says "archaeologist," clearly conveys her disdain for his title. "Later you returned to Midgard with Albert Foster in tow, prompting us to run you out of the Deep.|885|0
units.english: "Well if you don't then let me jog your memory: You took a small chip of wood from a historical church on Midgard - nothing criminal, mind you - and returned it to Vinci, where I assume you handed it over to the 'archaeologist' Albert Foster." The tone of her voice as she says "archaeologist," clearly conveys her disdain for his title. "Later you returned to Midgard with Albert Foster in tow, prompting us to run you out of the Deep.
units.italian: "Beh, se non lo sai, lascia che ti rinfreschi la memoria: hai preso una piccola scheggia di legno da una chiesa storica su Midgard (niente di criminale, sia chiaro) e l'hai riportata su Vinci, dove suppongo tu l'abbia consegnata all'archeologo Albert Foster." Il tono con cui dice "archeologo," comunica chiaramente il suo disprezzo per quel titolo. "Più tardi sei tornato su Midgard con Albert Foster al seguito, il che ci ha indotti a cacciarti dal Deep.

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"My first question to you: what exactly were you doing with Albert Foster?"|888|0
units.english: "My first question to you: what exactly were you doing with Albert Foster?"
units.italian: "La mia prima domanda: che cosa stavi facendo esattamente con Albert Foster?"

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"You can't interrogate me. I'm a citizen of the Deep."|891|0
units.english: "You can't interrogate me. I'm a citizen of the Deep."
units.italian: "Non puoi interrogarmi. Sono un cittadino del Deep."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"We were scanning Midgard with gravitational field mapping equipment and spotted an artificial singularity before we fled."|895|0
units.english: "We were scanning Midgard with gravitational field mapping equipment and spotted an artificial singularity before we fled."
units.italian: "Stavamo scansionando Midgard con apparecchiature per la mappatura del campo gravitazionale e abbiamo individuato una singolarità artificiale prima di fuggire."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"He told me he was researching the Deep and he needed help conducting his research."|897|0
units.english: "He told me he was researching the Deep and he needed help conducting his research."
units.italian: "Mi ha detto che stava facendo ricerche sul Deep e che aveva bisogno di aiuto per condurle."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	She frowns. "That does not give you immunity from our investigation.|902|0
units.english: She frowns. "That does not give you immunity from our investigation.
units.italian: Lei aggrotta la fronte. "Questo non ti dà immunità dalla nostra indagine.

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Now again: what exactly were you doing with Albert Foster?"|903|0
units.english: "Now again: what exactly were you doing with Albert Foster?"
units.italian: "E ora di nuovo: che cosa stavi facendo esattamente con Albert Foster?"

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"And why do you think he needed someone else to do the work for him?"|907|0
units.english: "And why do you think he needed someone else to do the work for him?"
units.italian: "E perché pensi che avesse bisogno di qualcun altro per fargli il lavoro?"

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Because he wanted something illegal done."|909|0
units.english: "Because he wanted something illegal done."
units.italian: "Perché voleva che fosse fatto qualcosa di illegale."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Because he isn't allowed in the Deep."|910|0
units.english: "Because he isn't allowed in the Deep."
units.italian: "Perché non gli è permesso entrare nel Deep."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"I already told you that you didn't commit a crime. The reason is that Foster has caused the Deep plenty of trouble in the past, so we don't particularly enjoy his presence. Now, did Albert make any discoveries due to your assistance?"|913|0
units.english: "I already told you that you didn't commit a crime. The reason is that Foster has caused the Deep plenty of trouble in the past, so we don't particularly enjoy his presence. Now, did Albert make any discoveries due to your assistance?"
units.italian: "Ti ho già detto che non hai commesso alcun crimine. Il motivo è che in passato Foster ha creato parecchi problemi al Deep, quindi la sua presenza non ci è particolarmente gradita. Ora, Albert ha fatto qualche scoperta grazie al tuo aiuto?"

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Precisely. Now, did Albert make any discoveries due to your assistance?"|917|0
units.english: "Precisely. Now, did Albert make any discoveries due to your assistance?"
units.italian: "Esattamente. Ora, Albert ha fatto qualche scoperta grazie al tuo aiuto?"

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"He discovered that the church on Midgard is far older than should be possible, dating back to at least the early 1700s."|921|0
units.english: "He discovered that the church on Midgard is far older than should be possible, dating back to at least the early 1700s."
units.italian: "Ha scoperto che la chiesa su Midgard è molto più antica di quanto sarebbe possibile, risalendo almeno ai primi anni del 1700."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"We spotted something on Midgard that he called an 'artificial singularity.'"|922|0
units.english: "We spotted something on Midgard that he called an 'artificial singularity.'"
units.italian: "Su Midgard abbiamo individuato qualcosa che lui ha chiamato 'singolarità artificiale'."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Interesting finding, Captain. Is there anything else that he discovered?"|925|0
units.english: "Interesting finding, Captain. Is there anything else that he discovered?"
units.italian: "Scoperta interessante, capitano. Ha scoperto altro?"

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"No."|927|0
units.english: "No."
units.italian: "No."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Yes. We used gravitational mapping equipment on Midgard and we found what looked like an artificial singularity."|928|0
units.english: "Yes. We used gravitational mapping equipment on Midgard and we found what looked like an artificial singularity."
units.italian: "Sì. Su Midgard abbiamo usato apparecchiature per la mappatura gravitazionale e abbiamo trovato quella che sembrava una singolarità artificiale."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	The woman does not respond for a few seconds. When she does begin speaking, you have to lean in to hear her. "Don't lie to me. I can make this experience very uncomfortable for you."|931|0
units.english: The woman does not respond for a few seconds. When she does begin speaking, you have to lean in to hear her. "Don't lie to me. I can make this experience very uncomfortable for you."
units.italian: La donna non risponde per qualche secondo. Quando comincia a parlare, devi sporgerti per sentirla. "Non mentirmi. Posso renderti questa esperienza molto sgradevole."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Alright. We discovered an artificial singularity on Midgard."|933|0
units.english: "Alright. We discovered an artificial singularity on Midgard."
units.italian: "Va bene. Abbiamo scoperto una singolarità artificiale su Midgard."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"See? That wasn't so hard to admit, now was it?"|935|0
units.english: "See? That wasn't so hard to admit, now was it?"
units.italian: "Visto? Non è stato così difficile ammetterlo, vero?"

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	The woman's mouth turns into a sly smile as she leans back in her chair. "Thank you for the information. That is all we needed you for. You will be escorted back outside momentarily. Enjoy the rest of your day, <first> <last>."|943|0
units.english: The woman's mouth turns into a sly smile as she leans back in her chair. "Thank you for the information. That is all we needed you for. You will be escorted back outside momentarily. Enjoy the rest of your day, <first> <last>."
units.italian: La bocca della donna si piega in un sorriso furbesco mentre si appoggia allo schienale. "Grazie per le informazioni. Era tutto ciò che ci serviva da te. Fra poco ti riaccompagneranno fuori. Buona giornata, <first> <last>."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	The woman's mouth turns into a sly smile as she leans back in her chair. "Thank you for the information, Captain. Before I let you go, I'd like to thank you for the work you've done for the Deep. I was interested to hear that the same Captain who helped us pursue Beelzebub also helped Albert Foster. Don't worry, we all make stupid mistakes. We'll scratch this one off your record.|949|0
units.english: The woman's mouth turns into a sly smile as she leans back in her chair. "Thank you for the information, Captain. Before I let you go, I'd like to thank you for the work you've done for the Deep. I was interested to hear that the same Captain who helped us pursue Beelzebub also helped Albert Foster. Don't worry, we all make stupid mistakes. We'll scratch this one off your record.
units.italian: La bocca della donna si piega in un sorriso furbesco mentre si appoggia allo schienale. "Grazie per le informazioni, capitano. Prima di lasciarti andare, voglio ringraziarti per il lavoro che hai fatto per il Deep. Mi ha incuriosito sapere che lo stesso capitano che ci ha aiutati a dare la caccia a Belzebù ha aiutato anche Albert Foster. Non preoccuparti, tutti facciamo stupidi errori. Questo lo cancelleremo dal tuo fascicolo.

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"You clearly mean no harm to the Deep, so I'll give you the privilege of asking me any questions you might have after this encounter."|950|0
units.english: "You clearly mean no harm to the Deep, so I'll give you the privilege of asking me any questions you might have after this encounter."
units.italian: "È chiaro che non vuoi fare del male al Deep, quindi ti concedo il privilegio di farmi tutte le domande che vuoi dopo questo incontro."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|You are escorted by two <planet> security guards to a Corvette occupying a landing pad close to the spaceport's Deep Security complex. Standing below the Corvette is the tall, dark-skinned woman who questioned you on your work for Albert Foster.|954|0
units.english: You are escorted by two <planet> security guards to a Corvette occupying a landing pad close to the spaceport's Deep Security complex. Standing below the Corvette is the tall, dark-skinned woman who questioned you on your work for Albert Foster.
units.italian: Due guardie di sicurezza di <planet> ti scortano fino a una Corvette che occupa una piazzola vicino al complesso della Sicurezza del Deep nello spazioporto. Sotto la Corvette c'è la donna alta e bruna che ti ha interrogato sul tuo lavoro per Albert Foster.

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Good evening, Captain," she looks up to the overcast sky for a moment, "or whatever time of day it might be right now. I've been informed that you proved yourself a great asset to the Navy and Deep Security in tracking down and... almost trapping Beelzebub. Please, come inside my ship for a moment."|955|0
units.english: "Good evening, Captain," she looks up to the overcast sky for a moment, "or whatever time of day it might be right now. I've been informed that you proved yourself a great asset to the Navy and Deep Security in tracking down and... almost trapping Beelzebub. Please, come inside my ship for a moment."
units.italian: "Buonasera, capitano," alza lo sguardo al cielo coperto per un istante, "o qualunque ora sia adesso. Mi hanno detto che sei stato di grande aiuto alla Marina e alla Sicurezza del Deep nel rintracciare e... quasi intrappolare Belzebù. Per favore, entra un momento nella mia nave."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	(Follow her.)|957|0
units.english: (Follow her.)
units.italian: (La segui.)

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Why?"|959|0
units.english: "Why?"
units.italian: "Perché?"

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"You can leave if you wish to, but I'd only be keeping you for a moment."|961|0
units.english: "You can leave if you wish to, but I'd only be keeping you for a moment."
units.italian: "Puoi andartene se vuoi, ma ti tratterrei solo un momento."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	(Enter her ship.)|963|0
units.english: (Enter her ship.)
units.italian: (Entra nella sua nave.)

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	(Leave.)|964|0
units.english: (Leave.)
units.italian: (Esci.)

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	The woman closes the Corvette's hatch, leaving you in the light of dim fluorescent bulbs. This must be quite an old ship to still be using fluorescent bulbs instead of the LED lights that most modern ships use for their interiors.|968|0
units.english: The woman closes the Corvette's hatch, leaving you in the light of dim fluorescent bulbs. This must be quite an old ship to still be using fluorescent bulbs instead of the LED lights that most modern ships use for their interiors.
units.italian: La donna chiude il portello della Corvette, lasciandoti nella luce fioca di lampade fluorescenti. Deve essere una nave piuttosto vecchia, se usa ancora fluorescenti invece dei LED che la maggior parte delle navi moderne ha negli interni.

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"I've asked you onto my ship so that we may have some privacy. You clearly mean no harm to the Deep. For starters, I'm sure you'll be happy to hear that we've scratched your incident with Albert Foster from your record. Additionally, I'm extending you the privilege of asking me any questions you might have relating to our last encounter."|969|0
units.english: "I've asked you onto my ship so that we may have some privacy. You clearly mean no harm to the Deep. For starters, I'm sure you'll be happy to hear that we've scratched your incident with Albert Foster from your record. Additionally, I'm extending you the privilege of asking me any questions you might have relating to our last encounter."
units.italian: "Ti ho invitato sulla mia nave per avere un po' di riservatezza. È chiaro che non vuoi fare del male al Deep. Tanto per cominciare, sono certo che ti farà piacere sapere che abbiamo cancellato dal tuo fascicolo l'incidente con Albert Foster. Inoltre, ti concedo il privilegio di farmi tutte le domande che vuoi sul nostro ultimo incontro."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"When was the Deep really settled?"|974|0
units.english: "When was the Deep really settled?"
units.italian: "Quando è stato davvero colonizzato il Deep?"

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Is there really an artificial singularity on Midgard?"|975|0
units.english: "Is there really an artificial singularity on Midgard?"
units.italian: "Esiste davvero una singolarità artificiale su Midgard?"

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"I don't have any questions."|977|0
units.english: "I don't have any questions."
units.italian: "Non ho domande."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"The exact date has been lost to time, but folklore states that the first humans arrived here in the mid-1300s, before the time of the 'Black Death' plague on ancient Earth. It's not wise to believe in wonder tales, though."|980|0
units.english: "The exact date has been lost to time, but folklore states that the first humans arrived here in the mid-1300s, before the time of the 'Black Death' plague on ancient Earth. It's not wise to believe in wonder tales, though."
units.italian: "La data esatta è andata perduta, ma la tradizione popolare dice che i primi umani arrivarono qui a metà del 1300, prima della peste nera che colpì l'antica Terra. Non è però saggio credere ai racconti di meraviglie."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Were the original humans of the Deep really brought here by aliens?"|982|0
units.english: "Were the original humans of the Deep really brought here by aliens?"
units.italian: "I primi umani del Deep sono stati davvero portati qui dagli alieni?"

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"I don't have any more questions."|983|0
units.english: "I don't have any more questions."
units.italian: "Non ho altre domande."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"That's a question for the people who were originally brought here." The woman flashes another sly smile.|986|0
units.english: "That's a question for the people who were originally brought here." The woman flashes another sly smile.
units.italian: "Questa è una domanda per chi è stato portato qui in origine." La donna sfoggia un altro sorriso furbesco.

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Is there really an artificial singularity on Midgard?"|988|0
units.english: "Is there really an artificial singularity on Midgard?"
units.italian: "Esiste davvero una singolarità artificiale su Midgard?"

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"I don't have any more questions."|989|0
units.english: "I don't have any more questions."
units.italian: "Non ho altre domande."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Those gravitational mapping devices can be so finicky sometimes. I'm sure it was nothing."|992|0
units.english: "Those gravitational mapping devices can be so finicky sometimes. I'm sure it was nothing."
units.italian: "Quei dispositivi per la mappatura gravitazionale a volte sono così capricciosi. Sono sicura che non fosse nulla."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Those gravitational mapping devices can be so finicky sometimes. I'm sure it was nothing."|996|0
units.english: "Those gravitational mapping devices can be so finicky sometimes. I'm sure it was nothing."
units.italian: "Quei dispositivi per la mappatura gravitazionale a volte sono così capricciosi. Sono sicura che non fosse nulla."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"When was the Deep really settled?"|998|0
units.english: "When was the Deep really settled?"
units.italian: "Quando è stato davvero colonizzato il Deep?"

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"I don't have any questions."|999|0
units.english: "I don't have any questions."
units.italian: "Non ho domande."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"The exact date has been lost to time, but folklore states that the first humans arrived here in the mid-1300s, before the time of the 'Black Death' plague on ancient Earth. It's not wise to believe in wonder tales, though."|1002|0
units.english: "The exact date has been lost to time, but folklore states that the first humans arrived here in the mid-1300s, before the time of the 'Black Death' plague on ancient Earth. It's not wise to believe in wonder tales, though."
units.italian: "La data esatta è andata perduta, ma la tradizione popolare dice che i primi umani arrivarono qui a metà del 1300, prima della peste nera che colpì l'antica Terra. Non è però saggio credere ai racconti di meraviglie."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Were the original humans of the Deep really brought here by aliens?"|1004|0
units.english: "Were the original humans of the Deep really brought here by aliens?"
units.italian: "I primi umani del Deep sono stati davvero portati qui dagli alieni?"

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"I don't have any more questions."|1005|0
units.english: "I don't have any more questions."
units.italian: "Non ho altre domande."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"That's a question for the people who were originally brought here." The woman flashes another sly smile.|1008|0
units.english: "That's a question for the people who were originally brought here." The woman flashes another sly smile.
units.italian: "Questa è una domanda per chi è stato portato qui in origine." La donna sfoggia un altro sorriso furbesco.

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"That will be enough questions for now. You will be escorted back outside momentarily. Enjoy the rest of your day, Captain."|1014|0
units.english: "That will be enough questions for now. You will be escorted back outside momentarily. Enjoy the rest of your day, Captain."
units.italian: "Per ora basta domande. Fra poco ti riaccompagneranno fuori. Buona giornata, capitano."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"That will be enough questions for now."|1018|0
units.english: "That will be enough questions for now."
units.italian: "Per ora basta domande."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"If that is all, then this meeting is over. You will be escorted back outside momentarily. Enjoy the rest of your day, Captain."|1025|0
units.english: "If that is all, then this meeting is over. You will be escorted back outside momentarily. Enjoy the rest of your day, Captain."
units.italian: "Se è tutto, allora questo incontro è finito. Fra poco ti riaccompagneranno fuori. Buona giornata, capitano."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	"Very well."|1029|0
units.english: "Very well."
units.italian: "Molto bene."

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	The woman gets up from her chair and stops in the doorway. She turns her head slightly and says in a low voice, "I'll be watching," then leaves. Moments later, the same two men that brought you here step into the room and ask you to follow them. They lead you to an entryway and lock the door as you step out into the spaceport.|1036|0
units.english: The woman gets up from her chair and stops in the doorway. She turns her head slightly and says in a low voice, "I'll be watching," then leaves. Moments later, the same two men that brought you here step into the room and ask you to follow them. They lead you to an entryway and lock the door as you step out into the spaceport.
units.italian: La donna si alza dalla sedia e si ferma sulla soglia. Gira appena la testa e dice a voce bassa: "Ti terrò d'occhio," poi esce. Pochi istanti dopo gli stessi due uomini che ti hanno portato qui entrano nella stanza e ti chiedono di seguirli. Ti accompagnano a un ingresso e chiudono la porta mentre esci nello spazioporto.

units.id: conversation:deep: questioning|	The woman opens the hatch to the ship. "We might meet again in the future. Stay on your best behavior and our next meeting will surely be on good terms. Goodbye, Captain."|1040|0
units.english: The woman opens the hatch to the ship. "We might meet again in the future. Stay on your best behavior and our next meeting will surely be on good terms. Goodbye, Captain."
units.italian: La donna apre il portello della nave. "Potremmo rivederci in futuro. Comportati bene e il nostro prossimo incontro sarà senz'altro cordiale. Addio, capitano."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|name|1047|0
units.english: Research Supplies
units.italian: Materiali per la ricerca

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|description|1048|0
units.english: Fetch research supplies from <stopovers> and return them to <destination> by <date> for "Project Hawking."
units.italian: Recupera i materiali per la ricerca a <stopovers> e riportali su <destination> entro il <date> per il "Progetto Hawking".

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|While walking away from an argument with a local merchant over the price of a basket of fruit (ten credits is far too much for only a dozen pieces of fruit), you spy a group of four scientists moving about, briefly speaking with various captains.|1072|0
units.english: While walking away from an argument with a local merchant over the price of a basket of fruit (ten credits is far too much for only a dozen pieces of fruit), you spy a group of four scientists moving about, briefly speaking with various captains.
units.italian: Mentre ti allontani da una discussione con un mercante locale sul prezzo di un cesto di frutta (dieci crediti sono decisamente troppi per una dozzina di frutti), noti un gruppo di quattro scienziati che si aggira parlando brevemente con vari capitani.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	One of them sees you, and after a brief moment examining the tablet in his hand, leads the group toward you.|1075|0
units.english: One of them sees you, and after a brief moment examining the tablet in his hand, leads the group toward you.
units.italian: Uno di loro ti vede e, dopo un breve esame del tablet che tiene in mano, guida il gruppo verso di te.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	"Hello, Captain," the tall man among the group says. "<first> <last>, is it?" You nod. "Splendid. I'm Garrison, and these are my colleagues Hannah, Pierre, and Laura. We're looking for a captain who would be able to give us a ride to a few planets in the Paradise sector where we will be acquiring supplies for our research. The Deep is currently short on spare transport ships, but did give us permission to hire trustworthy merchant captains so we don't miss our deadline. Would you be able to help?"|1076|0
units.english: "Hello, Captain," the tall man among the group says. "<first> <last>, is it?" You nod. "Splendid. I'm Garrison, and these are my colleagues Hannah, Pierre, and Laura. We're looking for a captain who would be able to give us a ride to a few planets in the Paradise sector where we will be acquiring supplies for our research. The Deep is currently short on spare transport ships, but did give us permission to hire trustworthy merchant captains so we don't miss our deadline. Would you be able to help?"
units.italian: "Salve, capitano," dice l'uomo alto del gruppo. "<first> <last>, giusto?" Annuisci. "Splendido. Sono Garrison, e questi sono i miei colleghi Hannah, Pierre e Laura. Cerchiamo un capitano che possa darci un passaggio su alcuni pianeti del settore Paradise, dove recupereremo i materiali per le nostre ricerche. Al momento il Deep ha poche navi da trasporto libere, ma ci ha dato il permesso di assumere capitani mercantili affidabili per non mancare la scadenza. Potresti aiutarci?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	"I'd be glad to help. Where do you need to go?"|1078|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to help. Where do you need to go?"
units.italian: "Sarò felice di aiutare. Dove devi andare?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	"Sorry, I'm too busy at the moment. You'll need to find a different captain."|1080|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm too busy at the moment. You'll need to find a different captain."
units.italian: "Spiacente, in questo momento ho troppo da fare. Dovrete trovare un altro capitano."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	You recognize them as Garrison, Hannah, Pierre, and Laura, the scientists who asked you to find There Might Be Riots. "<first> <last>, is that you? What a great time to run into you!" Garrison exclaims. "We're looking for a captain who can give us a ride to a few planets in the Paradise sector while we pick up supplies for our research. We'd normally use an official transport from the Deep, but they're having some trouble sparing one at the moment. Instead, we received permission to hire a trustworthy merchant captain to act as our transport. Would you be able to help?"|1084|0
units.english: You recognize them as Garrison, Hannah, Pierre, and Laura, the scientists who asked you to find There Might Be Riots. "<first> <last>, is that you? What a great time to run into you!" Garrison exclaims. "We're looking for a captain who can give us a ride to a few planets in the Paradise sector while we pick up supplies for our research. We'd normally use an official transport from the Deep, but they're having some trouble sparing one at the moment. Instead, we received permission to hire a trustworthy merchant captain to act as our transport. Would you be able to help?"
units.italian: Riconosci Garrison, Hannah, Pierre e Laura, gli scienziati che ti avevano chiesto di trovare i There Might Be Riots. "<first> <last>, sei tu? Che tempismo!" esclama Garrison. "Cerchiamo un capitano che ci porti su alcuni pianeti del settore Paradise mentre raccogliamo materiali per le nostre ricerche. Di solito useremmo un trasporto ufficiale del Deep, ma al momento fanno fatica a liberarne uno. Così abbiamo avuto il permesso di assumere un capitano mercantile affidabile come trasporto. Potresti aiutarci?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	"I'd be glad to help. Where do you need to go?"|1086|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to help. Where do you need to go?"
units.italian: "Sarò felice di aiutare. Dove devi andare?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	"Sorry, I'm too busy at the moment. You'll need to find a different captain."|1087|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm too busy at the moment. You'll need to find a different captain."
units.italian: "Spiacente, in questo momento ho troppo da fare. Dovrete trovare un altro capitano."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	"Thank you, Captain. The planets that we need to go to are..." Garrison turns to the other three scientists. "<stopovers>," Hannah says.|1091|0
units.english: "Thank you, Captain. The planets that we need to go to are..." Garrison turns to the other three scientists. "<stopovers>," Hannah says.
units.italian: "Grazie, capitano. I pianeti dove dobbiamo andare sono..." Garrison si volta verso gli altri tre scienziati. "<stopovers>," dice Hannah.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	"... Thanks. After we've gathered all the supplies, we'll need to be dropped off on <destination>."|1092|0
units.english: "... Thanks. After we've gathered all the supplies, we'll need to be dropped off on <destination>."
units.italian: "... Grazie. Dopo aver raccolto tutti i materiali, dovremo essere lasciati su <destination>."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	You bring the scientists to your ship where they quickly make themselves comfy in the bunk rooms. As you walk to the bridge, you overhear Pierre quietly communicating with what you assume to be the spaceport authorities, "... <last> agreed. I expect Project Hawking to proceed on schedule. We will arrive before <day>." As you prepare for launch, you wonder what you've just signed up for.|1093|0
units.english: You bring the scientists to your ship where they quickly make themselves comfy in the bunk rooms. As you walk to the bridge, you overhear Pierre quietly communicating with what you assume to be the spaceport authorities, "... <last> agreed. I expect Project Hawking to proceed on schedule. We will arrive before <day>." As you prepare for launch, you wonder what you've just signed up for.
units.italian: Porti gli scienziati sulla tua nave, dove si sistemano in fretta nelle cabine. Mentre vai verso la plancia, senti Pierre che parla a voce bassa con quelli che supponi essere le autorità dello spazioporto: "... <last> ha accettato. Mi aspetto che il Progetto Hawking proceda secondo i tempi. Arriveremo prima del <day>." Mentre ti prepari al decollo, ti chiedi a cosa ti sei appena iscritto.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|dialog|1106|0
units.english: You arrive on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the scientists and their supplies has not arrived yet. Better depart and wait for your escorts to enter the system.
units.italian: Arrivi su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con gli scienziati e i loro materiali non è ancora arrivata. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che le scorte entrino nel sistema.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|log|1110|0
units.english: Helped gather materials for "Project Hawking," an energy and weapons research project being conducted by scientists of the Deep. A pirate Quicksilver attacked the building where the supplies were being placed and crash-landed into the ground, triggering an earthquake.
units.italian: Ho aiutato a raccogliere materiali per il "Progetto Hawking", un progetto di ricerca su energia e armi condotto da scienziati del Deep. Un Quicksilver pirata ha attaccato l'edificio dove venivano depositati i materiali, schiantandosi al suolo e provocando un terremoto.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|"Don't go to the spaceport," Garrison says. "We'll be dropping the supplies off elsewhere." He directs you toward the mountains.|1112|0
units.english: "Don't go to the spaceport," Garrison says. "We'll be dropping the supplies off elsewhere." He directs you toward the mountains.
units.italian: "Non andare allo spazioporto," dice Garrison. "Scarichiamo i materiali altrove." Ti indirizza verso le montagne.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	As the peaks loom nearer, Garrison points to a set of four landing pads adjacent to a single building, the entire complex surrounded by trees. The nearest village is easily a few kilometers away.|1115|0
units.english: As the peaks loom nearer, Garrison points to a set of four landing pads adjacent to a single building, the entire complex surrounded by trees. The nearest village is easily a few kilometers away.
units.italian: Mentre le cime si avvicinano, Garrison indica quattro piazzole accanto a un unico edificio, con l'intero complesso circondato dagli alberi. Il villaggio più vicino è a qualche chilometro di distanza.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	As the peaks loom nearer, Garrison points to a set of four landing pads adjacent to a single building, the entire complex surrounded by trees. It is very close to the church whose wood you sampled for Albert Foster, meaning that it is also very close to where his gravitational sensors supposedly identified an "artificial singularity."|1119|0
units.english: As the peaks loom nearer, Garrison points to a set of four landing pads adjacent to a single building, the entire complex surrounded by trees. It is very close to the church whose wood you sampled for Albert Foster, meaning that it is also very close to where his gravitational sensors supposedly identified an "artificial singularity."
units.italian: Mentre le cime si avvicinano, Garrison indica quattro piazzole accanto a un unico edificio, con l'intero complesso circondato dagli alberi. È molto vicino alla chiesa da cui avevi prelevato il legno per Albert Foster, il che significa che è anche molto vicino al punto in cui i suoi sensori gravitazionali avrebbero individuato una "singolarità artificiale".

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	Several dozen forklifts are waiting for your ship on the surface, and your passengers busy themselves by supervising the unloading process. The high fencing around the landing pads prevents you from wandering, but you stretch your legs and enjoy the clear mountain air while you can.|1122|0
units.english: Several dozen forklifts are waiting for your ship on the surface, and your passengers busy themselves by supervising the unloading process. The high fencing around the landing pads prevents you from wandering, but you stretch your legs and enjoy the clear mountain air while you can.
units.italian: Diverse dozzine di carrelli elevatori aspettano la tua nave a terra, e i tuoi passeggeri si occupano di sovrintendere allo scarico. L'alta recinzione intorno alle piazzole ti impedisce di gironzolare, ma ti sgranchisci le gambe e godi dell'aria limpida di montagna finché puoi.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	Your stroll around the launchpads is interrupted by the familiar warning tones emitted by landing spacecraft, and you look up to see a Deep Security Raven, descending rapidly. It lands next to the <ship>, and Lieutenant Paris steps out, looking rather distressed.|1123|0
units.english: Your stroll around the launchpads is interrupted by the familiar warning tones emitted by landing spacecraft, and you look up to see a Deep Security Raven, descending rapidly. It lands next to the <ship>, and Lieutenant Paris steps out, looking rather distressed.
units.italian: La tua passeggiata intorno alle piazzole è interrotta dai consueti segnali di avvertimento emessi da un veicolo in atterraggio: alzi lo sguardo e vedi un Raven della Sicurezza del Deep in rapida discesa. Si posa accanto alla <ship>, e ne scende il tenente Paris, con l'aria piuttosto agitata.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	"Captain! I'm going to need your ship's scanner logs from as far back as when you took this job."|1124|0
units.english: "Captain! I'm going to need your ship's scanner logs from as far back as when you took this job."
units.italian: "Capitano! Mi servono i registri dello scanner della tua nave, a partire da quando hai accettato questo lavoro."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	Hearing the urgency in his voice, you hastily return to your ship's cockpit, copy the scanner logs onto a data chip, and bring it to Paris. He views the logs on a tablet.|1125|0
units.english: Hearing the urgency in his voice, you hastily return to your ship's cockpit, copy the scanner logs onto a data chip, and bring it to Paris. He views the logs on a tablet.
units.italian: Sentendo l'urgenza nella sua voce, torni in fretta nella cabina di pilotaggio, copi i registri dello scanner su un chip dati e lo porti a Paris. Lui li esamina su un tablet.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	"There appear to be three unidentified ships that began following you after each time you retrieved more cargo. Whether their intent is malicious or not, they are clearly interested in this project."|1126|0
units.english: "There appear to be three unidentified ships that began following you after each time you retrieved more cargo. Whether their intent is malicious or not, they are clearly interested in this project."
units.italian: "Sembrano esserci tre navi non identificate che hanno cominciato a seguirti ogni volta che recuperavi altro carico. Che le intenzioni siano ostili o no, sono chiaramente interessate a questo progetto."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	"What are you going to do?"|1128|0
units.english: "What are you going to do?"
units.italian: "Che cosa farai?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	"Do you fear that we're in danger?"|1129|0
units.english: "Do you fear that we're in danger?"
units.italian: "Temi che siamo in pericolo?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	"I have no idea." Paris looks over to the crew that are unloading the cargo. "Hurry up, men!" One of them shouts back, "Only a few more crates left, Sir."|1130|0
units.english: "I have no idea." Paris looks over to the crew that are unloading the cargo. "Hurry up, men!" One of them shouts back, "Only a few more crates left, Sir."
units.italian: "Non ne ho idea." Paris guarda l'equipaggio che sta scaricando il carico. "Sbrigatevi, uomini!" Uno di loro risponde gridando: "Ancora poche casse, signore."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	Paris turns to you and says "I suggest you leave immediately," and then turns to the scientists, "and you four should come with me while we figure out what is happening here. Here may not be safe for you."|1131|0
units.english: Paris turns to you and says "I suggest you leave immediately," and then turns to the scientists, "and you four should come with me while we figure out what is happening here. Here may not be safe for you."
units.italian: Paris si volta verso di te e dice: "Ti suggerisco di partire subito", poi si rivolge agli scienziati: "e voi quattro dovreste venire con me mentre capiamo cosa sta succedendo qui. Qui potreste non essere al sicuro."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	In space, the noise from high-powered atomic engines can only be heard as a dull rumbling, and even then, only aboard the ship they propel. In atmosphere, however, they are deafening. The thunderclap of a high-speed atmospheric re-entry forces everyone to look up. A battle-scarred Quicksilver in pirate colors is racing toward the building. The workers scramble for cover, abandoning their machinery and the cargo.|1132|0
units.english: In space, the noise from high-powered atomic engines can only be heard as a dull rumbling, and even then, only aboard the ship they propel. In atmosphere, however, they are deafening. The thunderclap of a high-speed atmospheric re-entry forces everyone to look up. A battle-scarred Quicksilver in pirate colors is racing toward the building. The workers scramble for cover, abandoning their machinery and the cargo.
units.italian: Nello spazio il rumore dei motori atomici ad alta potenza si sente solo come un cupo brontolio, e anche allora solo a bordo della nave che spingono. In atmosfera, invece, sono assordanti. Il boato di un rientro atmosferico ad alta velocità costringe tutti a guardare in alto. Un Quicksilver segnato dalle battaglie, con i colori dei pirati, sta puntando verso l'edificio. Gli operai corrono a ripararsi, abbandonando macchinari e carico.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	(Run for my ship.)|1134|0
units.english: (Run for my ship.)
units.italian: (Corri verso la mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	(Run for the nearest cover.)|1135|0
units.english: (Run for the nearest cover.)
units.italian: (Corri verso il riparo più vicino.)

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	You sprint toward your ship as fast as you can, but before you can reach it you hear the Quicksilver's cannons roar to life. The projectiles stream right overhead, exploding into the side of the building, sending rubble everywhere and knocking you off your feet.|1138|0
units.english: You sprint toward your ship as fast as you can, but before you can reach it you hear the Quicksilver's cannons roar to life. The projectiles stream right overhead, exploding into the side of the building, sending rubble everywhere and knocking you off your feet.
units.italian: Scatti verso la nave il più veloce possibile, ma prima di raggiungerla senti i cannoni del Quicksilver ruggire. I proiettili passano sopra la tua testa, esplodono contro il fianco dell'edificio, mandano detriti ovunque e ti fanno cadere a terra.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	You duck for cover behind a concrete barrier that divides two landing pads when you hear the Quicksilver's cannons roar to life. The projectiles stream right overhead, exploding into the side of the building, sending rubble everywhere.|1142|0
units.english: You duck for cover behind a concrete barrier that divides two landing pads when you hear the Quicksilver's cannons roar to life. The projectiles stream right overhead, exploding into the side of the building, sending rubble everywhere.
units.italian: Ti butti al riparo dietro una barriera di cemento che divide due piazzole quando senti i cannoni del Quicksilver ruggire. I proiettili passano sopra la tua testa ed esplodono contro il fianco dell'edificio, mandando detriti ovunque.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	As quickly as it appeared, the Quicksilver disappears, shrouded from view by the trees. Even though its engine noise has abated, Paris has to shout for his orders to be heard above the commotion. As you rise to your feet you feel the earth heave, and a few moments later the muffled thud of an explosion drowns out Paris' voice. A dark cloud of smoke is rising up from a half kilometer away, in the direction the Quicksilver flew. Even in daylight you can see light from the fires below, reflected ominously by the airborne soot. A second tremor, somehow larger than the first, catches everyone off guard, knocking you back to the ground.|1145|0
units.english: As quickly as it appeared, the Quicksilver disappears, shrouded from view by the trees. Even though its engine noise has abated, Paris has to shout for his orders to be heard above the commotion. As you rise to your feet you feel the earth heave, and a few moments later the muffled thud of an explosion drowns out Paris' voice. A dark cloud of smoke is rising up from a half kilometer away, in the direction the Quicksilver flew. Even in daylight you can see light from the fires below, reflected ominously by the airborne soot. A second tremor, somehow larger than the first, catches everyone off guard, knocking you back to the ground.
units.italian: Com'era apparso, il Quicksilver sparisce, nascosto alla vista dagli alberi. Anche se il rumore del motore si è attenuato, Paris deve gridare perché i suoi ordini si sentano sopra il trambusto. Mentre ti rialzi senti la terra sollevarsi, e pochi istanti dopo un sordo boato di esplosione copre la voce di Paris. Una nube scura di fumo sale da mezzo chilometro di distanza, nella direzione in cui è volato il Quicksilver. Anche di giorno si vede la luce degli incendi laggiù, riflessa in modo sinistro dalla fuliggine sospesa. Una seconda scossa, in qualche modo più forte della prima, coglie tutti alla sprovvista e ti ributta a terra.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	"Earthquake!"|1147|0
units.english: "Earthquake!"
units.italian: "Terremoto!"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	"What is happening?"|1148|0
units.english: "What is happening?"
units.italian: "Che sta succedendo?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	No one is able to hear you over the low rumble of the shaking ground and the rustling of the forest around the complex. The building, already scarred and torn open by weapons fire, crumbles under the new stresses leaving only a pile of rubble. A minute after the tremor began, the vibrations stop, leaving the air silent; not even the rustle of the leaves or the tweet of a bird can be heard.|1150|0
units.english: No one is able to hear you over the low rumble of the shaking ground and the rustling of the forest around the complex. The building, already scarred and torn open by weapons fire, crumbles under the new stresses leaving only a pile of rubble. A minute after the tremor began, the vibrations stop, leaving the air silent; not even the rustle of the leaves or the tweet of a bird can be heard.
units.italian: Nessuno riesce a sentirti sopra il cupo brontolio del terreno che trema e il fruscio del bosco intorno al complesso. L'edificio, già segnato e squarciato dal fuoco delle armi, crolla sotto le nuove sollecitazioni lasciando solo un mucchio di macerie. Un minuto dopo l'inizio della scossa le vibrazioni cessano, e l'aria resta silenziosa: non si sente nemmeno il fruscio delle foglie o il cinguettio di un uccello.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	Everyone is clearly startled by the experience as they slowly raise themselves from the ground. You spot Garrison helping up Pierre and Hannah. Lieutenant Paris and Laura are in a tight embrace, but quickly release each other when they notice you looking.|1151|0
units.english: Everyone is clearly startled by the experience as they slowly raise themselves from the ground. You spot Garrison helping up Pierre and Hannah. Lieutenant Paris and Laura are in a tight embrace, but quickly release each other when they notice you looking.
units.italian: Tutti sono chiaramente scossi mentre si rialzano lentamente da terra. Vedi Garrison che aiuta Pierre e Hannah a rimettersi in piedi. Il tenente Paris e Laura sono stretti in un abbraccio, ma si staccano in fretta quando si accorgono che li stai guardando.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	A few Deep Security ships begin to land, dropping off medics and cleanup crews to take care of the destroyed building. One of the ships flies in the direction of the fire. Paris says to you, "Captain, I think you should leave. Deep Security will handle the situation here."|1152|0
units.english: A few Deep Security ships begin to land, dropping off medics and cleanup crews to take care of the destroyed building. One of the ships flies in the direction of the fire. Paris says to you, "Captain, I think you should leave. Deep Security will handle the situation here."
units.italian: Alcune navi della Sicurezza del Deep cominciano ad atterrare, sbarcando medici e squadre di sgombero per occuparsi dell'edificio distrutto. Una delle navi vola in direzione dell'incendio. Paris ti dice: "Capitano, credo che dovresti andartene. La Sicurezza del Deep gestirà la situazione qui."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking|	You say goodbye to the scientists, who thank you for helping them, even if much of the cargo was destroyed. You board your ship and fly toward the spaceport. Upon landing, you find that <payment> have been transferred to your account from Deep Security.|1153|0
units.english: You say goodbye to the scientists, who thank you for helping them, even if much of the cargo was destroyed. You board your ship and fly toward the spaceport. Upon landing, you find that <payment> have been transferred to your account from Deep Security.
units.italian: Saluti gli scienziati, che ti ringraziano per l'aiuto, anche se gran parte del carico è andato distrutto. Sali sulla nave e voli verso lo spazioporto. All'atterraggio scopri che la Sicurezza del Deep ha trasferito <payment> sul tuo conto.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|The majority of Carbuncle Station is restricted to normal visitors. The workers here will not even refuel your ship upon request. It's clear that Lovelace Labs, the owners of this station, have secrets stored within the walls of this station.|1171|0
units.english: The majority of Carbuncle Station is restricted to normal visitors. The workers here will not even refuel your ship upon request. It's clear that Lovelace Labs, the owners of this station, have secrets stored within the walls of this station.
units.italian: La maggior parte della Stazione Carbuncle è vietata ai visitatori comuni. Gli operai qui non riforniscono la tua nave nemmeno se lo chiedi. È chiaro che la Lovelace Labs, proprietaria della stazione, tiene dei segreti dentro queste pareti.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	You open your docking doors, only to find the bulkhead doors to the rest of the station blocked by three well-armed security officers. You follow the scientists' lead and approach the guards. They spend several minutes conversing, but eventually a guard activates a toggle on his communicator. A video screen next to the bulkhead blinks on, revealing a woman in a uniform distinctly more embellished than those of the guards before you.|1172|0
units.english: You open your docking doors, only to find the bulkhead doors to the rest of the station blocked by three well-armed security officers. You follow the scientists' lead and approach the guards. They spend several minutes conversing, but eventually a guard activates a toggle on his communicator. A video screen next to the bulkhead blinks on, revealing a woman in a uniform distinctly more embellished than those of the guards before you.
units.italian: Apri i portelli di attracco, per scoprire che le porte stagne verso il resto della stazione sono bloccate da tre agenti di sicurezza ben armati. Segui l'esempio degli scienziati e ti avvicini alle guardie. Parlano per diversi minuti, ma alla fine un agente aziona un interruttore sul comunicatore. Uno schermo video accanto alla paratia si accende, mostrando una donna in un'uniforme decisamente più ornata di quelle delle guardie davanti a te.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	"What brings you here to Carbuncle Station?"|1173|0
units.english: "What brings you here to Carbuncle Station?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vi porta alla Stazione Carbuncle?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	Pierre responds with only two words, "Project Hawking," and the screen momentarily goes blank. When it flickers on again, she is equally succinct and says only, "Admit three."|1174|0
units.english: Pierre responds with only two words, "Project Hawking," and the screen momentarily goes blank. When it flickers on again, she is equally succinct and says only, "Admit three."
units.italian: Pierre risponde con due sole parole, "Progetto Hawking", e lo schermo si spegne per un istante. Quando torna a illuminarsi, lei è altrettanto stringata e dice solo: "Fate passare in tre."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	After a short discussion, Garrison agrees to stay behind with you. Pierre, Hannah, and Laura are led through an awkwardly small opening in the bulkhead door, into the restricted area. Rather than wait in front of the guards, you return to the comfort of your ship with Garrison.|1175|0
units.english: After a short discussion, Garrison agrees to stay behind with you. Pierre, Hannah, and Laura are led through an awkwardly small opening in the bulkhead door, into the restricted area. Rather than wait in front of the guards, you return to the comfort of your ship with Garrison.
units.italian: Dopo una breve discussione, Garrison accetta di restare con te. Pierre, Hannah e Laura vengono condotti attraverso un'apertura scomodamente stretta nella paratia, nella zona riservata. Invece di aspettare davanti alle guardie, torni al comfort della tua nave con Garrison.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	"How should we pass the time while we wait?"|1177|0
units.english: "How should we pass the time while we wait?"
units.italian: "Come passiamo il tempo mentre aspettiamo?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	"How long will it be before they come back?"|1178|0
units.english: "How long will it be before they come back?"
units.italian: "Quanto ci vorrà prima che tornino?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	"It shouldn't take long for them to come back, so we could have a short chat if you want."|1181|0
units.english: "It shouldn't take long for them to come back, so we could have a short chat if you want."
units.italian: "Non dovrebbero metterci molto a tornare, quindi se vuoi possiamo fare quattro chiacchiere."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	"At most ten minutes. In the meantime, we could have a short chat. I find dead air annoyingly awkward."|1185|0
units.english: "At most ten minutes. In the meantime, we could have a short chat. I find dead air annoyingly awkward."
units.italian: "Dieci minuti al massimo. Nel frattempo possiamo fare quattro chiacchiere: il silenzio mi mette a disagio."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	"Do you know what Lovelace Labs keeps in this station?"|1189|0
units.english: "Do you know what Lovelace Labs keeps in this station?"
units.italian: "Sai cosa tiene la Lovelace Labs in questa stazione?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	"What is 'Project Hawking'?"|1190|0
units.english: "What is 'Project Hawking'?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è il 'Progetto Hawking'?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	"I haven't the faintest idea what they keep here. Even if I did, I'm sure I wouldn't be allowed to tell you. The only thing I know for sure they have here are components for the project we're working on."|1193|0
units.english: "I haven't the faintest idea what they keep here. Even if I did, I'm sure I wouldn't be allowed to tell you. The only thing I know for sure they have here are components for the project we're working on."
units.italian: "Non ho la minima idea di cosa tengano qui. E anche se lo sapessi, sono certo che non mi sarebbe permesso dirtelo. L'unica cosa di cui sono sicuro è che qui hanno i componenti per il progetto su cui lavoriamo."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	"Project Hawking?" you ask. Garrison nods.|1194|0
units.english: "Project Hawking?" you ask. Garrison nods.
units.italian: "Progetto Hawking?" chiedi. Garrison annuisce.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	"The exact details of Project Hawking are classified. I'm not able to tell you much aside from the fact that we're doing energy and weapons research. Scientists from the Deep who are highly specialized in a certain field will be asked to work on government projects every so often.|1197|0
units.english: "The exact details of Project Hawking are classified. I'm not able to tell you much aside from the fact that we're doing energy and weapons research. Scientists from the Deep who are highly specialized in a certain field will be asked to work on government projects every so often.
units.italian: "I dettagli esatti del Progetto Hawking sono riservati. Non posso dirti molto, a parte che facciamo ricerca su energia e armi. Gli scienziati del Deep particolarmente specializzati in un certo campo vengono chiamati ogni tanto a lavorare su progetti governativi.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	"In the field of energy engineering, I'm among the best that the Deep has to offer. I worked on the Dwarf Core." Garrison pauses and chuckles to himself before saying, "I also contributed toward the creation of those comically impractical LP576a Battery Packs that I have yet to see a single ship using.|1198|0
units.english: "In the field of energy engineering, I'm among the best that the Deep has to offer. I worked on the Dwarf Core." Garrison pauses and chuckles to himself before saying, "I also contributed toward the creation of those comically impractical LP576a Battery Packs that I have yet to see a single ship using.
units.italian: "Nel campo dell'ingegneria energetica sono tra i migliori che il Deep abbia. Ho lavorato al Dwarf Core." Garrison si ferma e ridacchia tra sé prima di aggiungere: "Ho anche contribuito a creare quei ridicolmente impraticabili Pacchi Batteria LP576a, che non ho ancora visto usare su una sola nave.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	"Anyhow, because of my past work, the Deep approached me to work on this project. The pay was better than what I was getting before so I accepted it. It was a pleasant surprise to meet my partners as well. Hannah graduated in the same undergrad class as me, double majoring in quantum mechanics and ancient history, of all things."|1199|0
units.english: "Anyhow, because of my past work, the Deep approached me to work on this project. The pay was better than what I was getting before so I accepted it. It was a pleasant surprise to meet my partners as well. Hannah graduated in the same undergrad class as me, double majoring in quantum mechanics and ancient history, of all things."
units.italian: "Comunque, grazie al mio lavoro passato il Deep mi ha chiesto di occuparmi di questo progetto. La paga era migliore di quella che avevo prima, così ho accettato. È stata una piacevole sorpresa conoscere anche i miei compagni. Hannah si è laureata nella mia stessa classe, con una doppia specializzazione in meccanica quantistica e storia antica, pensa un po'."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	"What is it that you need from Carbuncle Station that is so secret?"|1201|0
units.english: "What is it that you need from Carbuncle Station that is so secret?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vi serve dalla Stazione Carbuncle di così segreto?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	"What about Pierre and Laura?"|1202|0
units.english: "What about Pierre and Laura?"
units.italian: "E Pierre e Laura?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	"Like I said already, the project is classified. It's not something I would understand, though. It's in Laura's field of expertise. You see, she has a PHD in--"|1205|0
units.english: "Like I said already, the project is classified. It's not something I would understand, though. It's in Laura's field of expertise. You see, she has a PHD in--"
units.italian: "Come ho già detto, il progetto è riservato. Non è roba che capirei io, comunque. È nel campo di Laura. Vedi, lei ha un dottorato in--"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	"Pierre is an older guy, he's been working on laser weaponry for the better part of three decades now. Before this he was working on a separate project, but the Deep asked that he take time away from that to work on Project Hawking while they try to find a replacement for him, since the project needed someone with better knowledge in laser weaponry than the rest of us.|1211|0
units.english: "Pierre is an older guy, he's been working on laser weaponry for the better part of three decades now. Before this he was working on a separate project, but the Deep asked that he take time away from that to work on Project Hawking while they try to find a replacement for him, since the project needed someone with better knowledge in laser weaponry than the rest of us.
units.italian: "Pierre è più anziano: lavora sulle armi laser da quasi tre decenni. Prima di questo seguiva un altro progetto, ma il Deep gli ha chiesto di lasciarlo temporaneamente per lavorare al Progetto Hawking, mentre cercano un sostituto: il progetto aveva bisogno di qualcuno che ne sapesse di armi laser più di noi altri.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	"Pierre is an older guy. He has been working on laser weaponry for the better part of three decades now. If you've ever seen an Electron Beam in action, you have him to thank for that. And a few others, of course, but one of his findings is really what brought the whole project together.|1215|0
units.english: "Pierre is an older guy. He has been working on laser weaponry for the better part of three decades now. If you've ever seen an Electron Beam in action, you have him to thank for that. And a few others, of course, but one of his findings is really what brought the whole project together.
units.italian: "Pierre è più anziano. Lavora sulle armi laser da quasi tre decenni. Se hai mai visto un Raggio di Elettroni in azione, devi ringraziare lui. E qualche altro, certo, ma una delle sue scoperte è stata davvero quella che ha fatto quadrare l'intero progetto.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	"Laura, on the other hand--"|1218|0
units.english: "Laura, on the other hand--"
units.italian: "Laura, invece--"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	Before Garrison can finish speaking, the other three scientists return, helping each other carry a sealed metal box. "We're just going to set this in the back, if you don't mind," Pierre says. The scientists make themselves cozy in the bunk rooms and get ready to depart.|1221|0
units.english: Before Garrison can finish speaking, the other three scientists return, helping each other carry a sealed metal box. "We're just going to set this in the back, if you don't mind," Pierre says. The scientists make themselves cozy in the bunk rooms and get ready to depart.
units.italian: Prima che Garrison possa finire, gli altri tre scienziati tornano, aiutandosi a portare una cassa metallica sigillata. "La mettiamo solo sul retro, se non ti dispiace," dice Pierre. Gli scienziati si sistemano nelle cabine e si preparano a partire.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	A chirping from your ship's radio indicates you have received a message from the station. You open it and are not shocked at its contents:|1222|0
units.english: A chirping from your ship's radio indicates you have received a message from the station. You open it and are not shocked at its contents:
