units.italian: Un cinguettio dalla radio della nave indica che hai ricevuto un messaggio dalla stazione. Lo apri e non resti sorpreso dal contenuto:

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|		Your immediate departure is required.|1224|0
units.english: Your immediate departure is required.
units.italian: È richiesta la vostra partenza immediata.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|					Carbuncle Station Docking Authority|1225|0
units.english: Carbuncle Station Docking Authority
units.italian: Autorità di Attracco della Stazione Carbuncle

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Carbuncle|	You signal to your crew and passengers that takeoff is imminent, and obey the wishes of Lovelace Labs' research station.|1227|0
units.english: You signal to your crew and passengers that takeoff is imminent, and obey the wishes of Lovelace Labs' research station.
units.italian: Segnali all'equipaggio e ai passeggeri che il decollo è imminente, e assecondi i desideri della stazione di ricerca della Lovelace Labs.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|As you approach the massive <planet> spaceport building, Pierre directs you to park on a landing pad on the third story, close to the warehouse section. "We're picking up various materials used in the creation of ships, that we need samples of for testing," Pierre explains.|1246|0
units.english: As you approach the massive <planet> spaceport building, Pierre directs you to park on a landing pad on the third story, close to the warehouse section. "We're picking up various materials used in the creation of ships, that we need samples of for testing," Pierre explains.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini al gigantesco edificio dello spazioporto di <planet>, Pierre ti indica di parcheggiare su una piazzola del terzo livello, vicino alla zona dei magazzini. "Ritiriamo vari materiali usati nella costruzione delle navi, di cui ci servono campioni per i test," spiega Pierre.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|	The scientists speak with the spaceport authorities, who begin loading several tons of alloys into your cargo from an overhead platform. You sit with Pierre as you wait for them to finish.|1247|0
units.english: The scientists speak with the spaceport authorities, who begin loading several tons of alloys into your cargo from an overhead platform. You sit with Pierre as you wait for them to finish.
units.italian: Gli scienziati parlano con le autorità dello spazioporto, che cominciano a caricare diverse tonnellate di leghe nella tua stiva da una piattaforma sopraelevata. Ti siedi con Pierre ad aspettare che finiscano.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|	"That's a lot of different alloys. What are they going to be used for?"|1249|0
units.english: "That's a lot of different alloys. What are they going to be used for?"
units.italian: "Sono un sacco di leghe diverse. A cosa serviranno?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|	"Why did we need to come all the way to Prime to get these materials?"|1250|0
units.english: "Why did we need to come all the way to Prime to get these materials?"
units.italian: "Perché dovevamo venire fin su Prime per prendere questi materiali?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|	Pierre cocks his head to the side as he looks at you. "We're going to destroy them. Short and simple. We need to see how different ship alloys hold up to the technology we're working on.|1253|0
units.english: Pierre cocks his head to the side as he looks at you. "We're going to destroy them. Short and simple. We need to see how different ship alloys hold up to the technology we're working on.
units.italian: Pierre inclina la testa guardandoti. "Le distruggeremo. Semplice e diretto. Dobbiamo vedere come le diverse leghe per navi resistono alla tecnologia su cui lavoriamo.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|	"We could have gotten materials from a shipyard local to the Deep, but Betelgeuse Shipyards gets regular shipments of metals more commonly used by shipyards in the Dirt Belt, so it's really the closest place to get everything we need."|1256|0
units.english: "We could have gotten materials from a shipyard local to the Deep, but Betelgeuse Shipyards gets regular shipments of metals more commonly used by shipyards in the Dirt Belt, so it's really the closest place to get everything we need."
units.italian: "Avremmo potuto prendere i materiali da un cantiere vicino al Deep, ma i Betelgeuse Shipyards ricevono regolarmente metalli più usati dai cantieri della Dirt Belt, quindi è davvero il posto più vicino per avere tutto ciò che ci serve."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|	"Do you enjoy the work you do for the Deep?"|1258|0
units.english: "Do you enjoy the work you do for the Deep?"
units.italian: "Ti piace il lavoro che fai per il Deep?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|	"How long have you been working for the Deep?"|1259|0
units.english: "How long have you been working for the Deep?"
units.italian: "Da quanto tempo lavori per il Deep?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|	"Let me answer that question with a short story of my life." Pierre clears his throat and puffs up his chest a little, as if preparing himself to tell a great epic. He may enjoy talking about himself a little too much...|1262|0
units.english: "Let me answer that question with a short story of my life." Pierre clears his throat and puffs up his chest a little, as if preparing himself to tell a great epic. He may enjoy talking about himself a little too much...
units.italian: "Lascia che risponda con un breve racconto della mia vita." Pierre si schiarisce la voce e gonfia un po' il petto, come se si preparasse a narrare un grande poema epico. Forse gli piace parlare di sé un po' troppo...

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|	"I was born on Windblain in the Regor system. It's a small, quiet world of little galactic importance, but you should give it a visit sometime. My family wasn't the most well off, so I needed to work hard in my studies, which paid off immensely. Thanks to my exceptional grades in university, I was offered a government job even before graduation. I've been working directly for the Deep for the past 35 years and counting, and I've loved every minute of it! My younger sister though... well, let's just say she wasn't so focused on being successful in school and ended up on the wrong side of the law.|1263|0
units.english: "I was born on Windblain in the Regor system. It's a small, quiet world of little galactic importance, but you should give it a visit sometime. My family wasn't the most well off, so I needed to work hard in my studies, which paid off immensely. Thanks to my exceptional grades in university, I was offered a government job even before graduation. I've been working directly for the Deep for the past 35 years and counting, and I've loved every minute of it! My younger sister though... well, let's just say she wasn't so focused on being successful in school and ended up on the wrong side of the law.
units.italian: "Sono nato su Windblain, nel sistema Regor. È un mondo piccolo e tranquillo, di scarsa importanza galattica, ma dovresti visitarlo prima o poi. La mia famiglia non era delle più benestanti, quindi ho dovuto studiare sodo, e i risultati sono stati enormi. Grazie ai voti eccezionali all'università mi hanno offerto un impiego statale ancora prima della laurea. Lavoro direttamente per il Deep da 35 anni e più, e ho amato ogni minuto! Mia sorella minore, però... beh, diciamo solo che non si è concentrata sul successo scolastico ed è finita dalla parte sbagliata della legge.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|	"How about you?"|1264|0
units.english: "How about you?"
units.italian: "E tu, invece?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|	You tell Pierre about your life on <home planet>, and how you saved up your money working at the textile mill from the age of fifteen until you were able to buy a pilot's license and finally leave your home world for the stars.|1266|0
units.english: You tell Pierre about your life on <home planet>, and how you saved up your money working at the textile mill from the age of fifteen until you were able to buy a pilot's license and finally leave your home world for the stars.
units.italian: Racconti a Pierre della tua vita su <home planet>, e di come hai messo da parte i soldi lavorando nella filanda dai quindici anni, finché non hai potuto comprare un brevetto di pilota e lasciare finalmente il tuo mondo natale per le stelle.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|	You tell Pierre about your life on <home planet>, and how you graduated with high enough grades to apply for the Deep's starship loan program.|1269|0
units.english: You tell Pierre about your life on <home planet>, and how you graduated with high enough grades to apply for the Deep's starship loan program.
units.italian: Racconti a Pierre della tua vita su <home planet>, e di come ti sei diplomato con voti abbastanza alti da poterti candidare al programma di prestiti per navi stellari del Deep.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|	You tell Pierre about your life on <home planet>, and how you've always dreamed of becoming a starship captain, and finally got your wish when you were given a pilot's license on your eighteenth birthday.|1272|0
units.english: You tell Pierre about your life on <home planet>, and how you've always dreamed of becoming a starship captain, and finally got your wish when you were given a pilot's license on your eighteenth birthday.
units.italian: Racconti a Pierre della tua vita su <home planet>, e di come hai sempre sognato di diventare capitano di nave stellare, e del giorno in cui, per il tuo diciottesimo compleanno, il sogno si è avverato con un brevetto di pilota.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|	You tell Pierre about your life moving around the galaxy, and how you worked on a Syndicate factory world for five years before you took a loan and began your life as a merchant captain.|1275|0
units.english: You tell Pierre about your life moving around the galaxy, and how you worked on a Syndicate factory world for five years before you took a loan and began your life as a merchant captain.
units.italian: Racconti a Pierre della tua vita in giro per la galassia, e di come hai lavorato cinque anni su un mondo industriale del Sindacato prima di prendere un prestito e cominciare la vita di capitano mercantile.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|	Making sure to not bring up <home planet> or the Hai by name, you tell Pierre about your life, and how you did your best at a travel agency to get to the stars as soon as you could.|1278|0
units.english: Making sure to not bring up <home planet> or the Hai by name, you tell Pierre about your life, and how you did your best at a travel agency to get to the stars as soon as you could.
units.italian: Facendo attenzione a non nominare <home planet> né gli Hai, racconti a Pierre della tua vita, e di come hai fatto del tuo meglio in un'agenzia di viaggi per arrivare alle stelle appena possibile.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|	"We aren't too different then," Pierre remarks. "We both worked hard to get where we are today. Thanks for sharing, <first>."|1282|0
units.english: "We aren't too different then," Pierre remarks. "We both worked hard to get where we are today. Thanks for sharing, <first>."
units.italian: "Allora non siamo poi così diversi," osserva Pierre. "Entrambi abbiamo lavorato sodo per arrivare dove siamo. Grazie per avermelo raccontato, <first>."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|	"So you're from the Deep too," Pierre grins. "That loan program's tough - well done. Back in my university days, we helped build some of the subsystems for those loaned ships in an applied engineering class. You have to admire the Deep's meritocracy. Thanks for sharing, <first>."|1286|0
units.english: "So you're from the Deep too," Pierre grins. "That loan program's tough - well done. Back in my university days, we helped build some of the subsystems for those loaned ships in an applied engineering class. You have to admire the Deep's meritocracy. Thanks for sharing, <first>."
units.italian: "Quindi anche tu vieni dal Deep," sorride Pierre. "Quel programma di prestiti è duro, complimenti. Ai miei tempi all'università abbiamo contribuito a costruire alcuni sottosistemi per quelle navi, in un corso di ingegneria applicata. Bisogna ammirare la meritocrazia del Deep. Grazie per avermelo raccontato, <first>."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|	"So you're from the Paradise Worlds," Pierre remarks. "Most people from there choose to settle down and take up their parents' businesses. Very few go out on their own as a merchant. Thanks for sharing, <first>."|1289|0
units.english: "So you're from the Paradise Worlds," Pierre remarks. "Most people from there choose to settle down and take up their parents' businesses. Very few go out on their own as a merchant. Thanks for sharing, <first>."
units.italian: "Quindi vieni dai Mondi Paradisiaci," osserva Pierre. "La maggior parte della gente di là preferisce sistemarsi e rilevare l'attività dei genitori. Pochissimi si mettono in proprio come mercanti. Grazie per avermelo raccontato, <first>."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Prime|	"The cargo is all in, Captain!" Garrison yells down from the platform above. "We're ready when you are!"|1293|0
units.english: "The cargo is all in, Captain!" Garrison yells down from the platform above. "We're ready when you are!"
units.italian: "Il carico è tutto a bordo, capitano!" grida Garrison dalla piattaforma sopra di te. "Siamo pronti quando vuoi!"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Vinci|"It might take a while to get a hold of the electronics we need," Pierre says after you land. "Just stick around the spaceport while we're gone."|1312|0
units.english: "It might take a while to get a hold of the electronics we need," Pierre says after you land. "Just stick around the spaceport while we're gone."
units.italian: "Potrebbe volerci un po' per procurarci l'elettronica che serve," dice Pierre dopo l'atterraggio. "Resta pure in giro per lo spazioporto mentre siamo via."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Vinci|	"You guys can handle it, right?" Hannah asks. "I haven't been to Vinci in years. I want to see the virtual reality activities they have in the spaceport arcade now."|1313|0
units.english: "You guys can handle it, right?" Hannah asks. "I haven't been to Vinci in years. I want to see the virtual reality activities they have in the spaceport arcade now."
units.italian: "Voi tre potete cavarvela, vero?" chiede Hannah. "Non vengo su Vinci da anni. Voglio vedere le attività di realtà virtuale che hanno adesso nella sala giochi dello spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Vinci|	The other three scientists agree that they can make do without her, and she immediately runs off in the direction of the spaceport arcade. When you find her, she is busy playing a VR table tennis game against an AI hologram. By the look of things she is an amazing player, and the score is currently tied.|1314|0
units.english: The other three scientists agree that they can make do without her, and she immediately runs off in the direction of the spaceport arcade. When you find her, she is busy playing a VR table tennis game against an AI hologram. By the look of things she is an amazing player, and the score is currently tied.
units.italian: Gli altri tre scienziati concordano che possono fare a meno di lei, e Hannah corre subito verso la sala giochi dello spazioporto. Quando la trovi, sta giocando a tennis da tavolo in realtà virtuale contro un ologramma con intelligenza artificiale. A giudicare dalle apparenze è una giocatrice formidabile, e il punteggio è in parità.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Vinci|	"You're doing great! Do you play table tennis often?"|1316|0
units.english: "You're doing great! Do you play table tennis often?"
units.italian: "Stai andando benissimo! Giochi spesso a tennis da tavolo?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Vinci|	"You can do it!"|1317|0
units.english: "You can do it!"
units.italian: "Ce la puoi fare!"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Vinci|	Hannah slams the virtual ball with her paddle, causing it to bounce off the table, fly right past her opponent, and disintegrate into thin air.|1319|0
units.english: Hannah slams the virtual ball with her paddle, causing it to bounce off the table, fly right past her opponent, and disintegrate into thin air.
units.italian: Hannah colpisce la pallina virtuale con la racchetta: rimbalza sul tavolo, supera l'avversario e si dissolve nel nulla.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Vinci|	"I did pretty good, didn't I? It's my first time playing table tennis, too."|1320|0
units.english: "I did pretty good, didn't I? It's my first time playing table tennis, too."
units.italian: "Me la sono cavata bene, no? Ed è la prima volta che gioco a tennis da tavolo."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Vinci|	"How did you do that good for your first time?"|1321|0
units.english: "How did you do that good for your first time?"
units.italian: "Come hai fatto a giocare così bene la prima volta?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Vinci|	"I'm just a quick learner. Always have been. In university I would do work for my history courses while sitting through lectures on quantum mechanics. Got straight A's in both classes without a problem."|1322|0
units.english: "I'm just a quick learner. Always have been. In university I would do work for my history courses while sitting through lectures on quantum mechanics. Got straight A's in both classes without a problem."
units.italian: "Imparo in fretta, tutto qui. È sempre stato così. All'università facevo i compiti di storia durante le lezioni di meccanica quantistica. Il massimo dei voti in entrambe le materie, senza problemi."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Vinci|	"That's a strange combination of classes."|1324|0
units.english: "That's a strange combination of classes."
units.italian: "È una combinazione strana di materie."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Vinci|	"What did you learn in ancient history?"|1325|0
units.english: "What did you learn in ancient history?"
units.italian: "Che cosa hai imparato di storia antica?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Vinci|	"That's what everyone else told me, too. It was fun though, and a lot of what I learned in ancient history was just as interesting as what I learned in quantum mechanics."|1328|0
units.english: "That's what everyone else told me, too. It was fun though, and a lot of what I learned in ancient history was just as interesting as what I learned in quantum mechanics."
units.italian: "È quello che mi dicevano tutti, infatti. Però è stato divertente, e molto di ciò che ho imparato di storia antica era interessante quanto la meccanica quantistica."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Vinci|	"What did you learn in ancient history?" you ask.|1329|0
units.english: "What did you learn in ancient history?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che cosa hai imparato di storia antica?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Vinci|	"I could spend weeks on end talking about what I learned in those classes. The most interesting thing I learned has to be my ancestry. Most of my ancestors came from a place on Earth called Scandinavia, and my last name means 'garden' in an ancient language.|1332|0
units.english: "I could spend weeks on end talking about what I learned in those classes. The most interesting thing I learned has to be my ancestry. Most of my ancestors came from a place on Earth called Scandinavia, and my last name means 'garden' in an ancient language.
units.italian: "Potrei passare settimane a parlare di ciò che ho imparato in quei corsi. La cosa più interessante è stata la mia ascendenza. La maggior parte dei miei antenati veniva da un luogo della Terra chiamato Scandinavia, e il mio cognome significa 'giardino' in una lingua antica.

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Vinci|	"It's interesting to know where my ancestors lived over a thousand years ago when humanity was still stuck on Earth. It's amazing that the hyperdrive was invented when it was too, because we could have easily wiped ourselves out if we hadn't. Life still isn't perfect across the galaxy, but it's still far better on average than it was on Earth alone."|1333|0
units.english: "It's interesting to know where my ancestors lived over a thousand years ago when humanity was still stuck on Earth. It's amazing that the hyperdrive was invented when it was too, because we could have easily wiped ourselves out if we hadn't. Life still isn't perfect across the galaxy, but it's still far better on average than it was on Earth alone."
units.italian: "È interessante sapere dove vivevano i miei antenati più di mille anni fa, quando l'umanità era ancora bloccata sulla Terra. Ed è incredibile che l'iperguida sia stata inventata proprio allora: se non fosse successo, avremmo potuto distruggerci facilmente. La vita nella galassia non è perfetta, ma in media è molto meglio di com'era sulla sola Terra."

units.id: mission:Deep: Project Hawking: Vinci|	Hannah looks like she is ready to endlessly blather on about Earth before the hyperdrive was invented, but you are saved by Laura. "We got the electronics we need loaded onto your ship, Captain. Garrison and Pierre are waiting for us there."|1334|0
units.english: Hannah looks like she is ready to endlessly blather on about Earth before the hyperdrive was invented, but you are saved by Laura. "We got the electronics we need loaded onto your ship, Captain. Garrison and Pierre are waiting for us there."
units.italian: Hannah sembra pronta a blaterare all'infinito della Terra prima dell'invenzione dell'iperguida, ma Laura ti salva. "Abbiamo caricato sulla tua nave l'elettronica che serve, capitano. Garrison e Pierre ci aspettano là."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|name|1341|0
units.english: Fetching keystones
units.italian: Recuperare le chiavi di volta

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|description|1342|0
units.english: Buy 10 quantum keystones from Hai space and return them to <destination>, where Ivan and his team will research them and their link to the spatial anomaly in Terminus.
units.italian: Compra 10 chiavi di volta quantistiche nello spazio Hai e riportale su <destination>, dove Ivan e la sua squadra le studieranno, insieme al loro legame con l'anomalia spaziale in Terminus.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|While wandering through the spaceport, you are approached by a man you instantly recognize as Ivan, the scientist whose drone you recovered data from in Terminus, thanks to his comically thick glasses. He mentions that he heard how helpful you have been to others within the Deep.|1355|0
units.english: While wandering through the spaceport, you are approached by a man you instantly recognize as Ivan, the scientist whose drone you recovered data from in Terminus, thanks to his comically thick glasses. He mentions that he heard how helpful you have been to others within the Deep.
units.italian: Mentre giri per lo spazioporto, ti si avvicina un uomo che riconosci subito come Ivan, lo scienziato del cui drone avevi recuperato i dati in Terminus, grazie ai suoi occhiali comicamente spessi. Dice di aver sentito quanto sei stato utile ad altri nel Deep.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|	"I was hoping you would continue assisting us in our research on the spatial anomaly in Terminus. Thanks to the data you retrieved, we have deduced that the anomaly is in fact some sort of wormhole, but it is far too unstable to support sending anything through it."|1356|0
units.english: "I was hoping you would continue assisting us in our research on the spatial anomaly in Terminus. Thanks to the data you retrieved, we have deduced that the anomaly is in fact some sort of wormhole, but it is far too unstable to support sending anything through it."
units.italian: "Speravo che avresti continuato ad aiutarci nella ricerca sull'anomalia spaziale in Terminus. Grazie ai dati che hai recuperato abbiamo dedotto che l'anomalia è in realtà una sorta di cunicolo spaziale, ma è troppo instabile per farci passare qualcosa."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|	Ivan looks around then leans in to whisper to you. "I must ask you, do you know of the Hai?" You nod. "Splendid!" He jumps up, nearly knocking his own glasses off his face. "Then you will be able to help. One of the scientists on my team grew up in their territory, and suggested that the so-called 'quantum keystones' which they sell might have something to do with the wormhole. He recalls hearing some Hai folktales of these stones making travel between the stars easier, and since the Hai once lived close to where the wormhole is, there may be a relation. Given that it would be immensely difficult to stabilize the wormhole with our current knowledge, it may be that these stones will make access into the wormhole easier. Would you kindly retrieve ten of them for us, so that we may be able to discover if these legends are true?"|1357|0
units.english: Ivan looks around then leans in to whisper to you. "I must ask you, do you know of the Hai?" You nod. "Splendid!" He jumps up, nearly knocking his own glasses off his face. "Then you will be able to help. One of the scientists on my team grew up in their territory, and suggested that the so-called 'quantum keystones' which they sell might have something to do with the wormhole. He recalls hearing some Hai folktales of these stones making travel between the stars easier, and since the Hai once lived close to where the wormhole is, there may be a relation. Given that it would be immensely difficult to stabilize the wormhole with our current knowledge, it may be that these stones will make access into the wormhole easier. Would you kindly retrieve ten of them for us, so that we may be able to discover if these legends are true?"
units.italian: Ivan si guarda intorno e poi si avvicina per sussurrarti: "Devo chiedertelo: conosci gli Hai?" Annuisci. "Splendido!" Salta su quasi facendosi cadere gli occhiali. "Allora potrai aiutarci. Uno degli scienziati della mia squadra è cresciuto nel loro territorio e ha suggerito che le cosiddette 'chiavi di volta quantistiche' che vendono potrebbero avere a che fare con il cunicolo. Ricorda di aver sentito racconti popolari Hai su queste pietre che rendono più facile viaggiare fra le stelle, e dato che gli Hai vivevano un tempo vicino al punto in cui si trova il cunicolo, potrebbe esserci un legame. Considerato che con le nostre conoscenze sarebbe difficilissimo stabilizzare il cunicolo, forse queste pietre ne renderanno più facile l'accesso. Vorresti procurarcene dieci, così da poter scoprire se queste leggende sono vere?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|	"I would be glad to help."|1361|0
units.english: "I would be glad to help."
units.italian: "Sarò felice di aiutare."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|	"Sorry, but Hai space is too far for me."|1362|0
units.english: "Sorry, but Hai space is too far for me."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma lo spazio Hai è troppo lontano per me."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|	"Thank you again, Captain!" he says very enthusiastically. "I'd have traveled myself, but I must confess we are low on funds and will not receive more unless we make some sort of discovery. We will be able to pay for half the cost of the stones once you return."|1365|0
units.english: "Thank you again, Captain!" he says very enthusiastically. "I'd have traveled myself, but I must confess we are low on funds and will not receive more unless we make some sort of discovery. We will be able to pay for half the cost of the stones once you return."
units.italian: "Grazie ancora, capitano!" dice con grande entusiasmo. "Ci sarei andato io, ma devo confessare che siamo a corto di fondi e non ne riceveremo altri finché non faremo qualche scoperta. Potremo pagarti metà del costo delle pietre quando torni."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|	"I already know what is on the other side of the wormhole. In fact, installing a single quantum keystone is enough to enter into the spatial anomaly."|1370|0
units.english: "I already know what is on the other side of the wormhole. In fact, installing a single quantum keystone is enough to enter into the spatial anomaly."
units.italian: "So già cosa c'è dall'altra parte del cunicolo. Anzi: installare una sola chiave di volta quantistica basta per entrare nell'anomalia spaziale."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|	"Sorry, but Hai space is too far for me right now."|1371|0
units.english: "Sorry, but Hai space is too far for me right now."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma in questo momento lo spazio Hai è troppo lontano per me."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|	Ivan looks like he is about to fall over with joy after you mention having entered the wormhole. "Really? Please, tell me what you found!"|1375|0
units.english: Ivan looks like he is about to fall over with joy after you mention having entered the wormhole. "Really? Please, tell me what you found!"
units.italian: Ivan sembra sul punto di cadere all'indietro dalla gioia quando accenni di essere entrato nel cunicolo. "Davvero? Ti prego, dimmi cosa hai trovato!"

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|	You tell Ivan all that you saw on the other side of the wormhole, and how you found strange-looking humans who communicate in song and sign language that attacked you after you wouldn't submit to a blood test. You also mention the other oddities of the region of space, including the strange alien creatures in Nenia that are able to survive in the vacuum of space, as well as the large number of wormholes that allow traversal throughout the region.|1380|0
units.english: You tell Ivan all that you saw on the other side of the wormhole, and how you found strange-looking humans who communicate in song and sign language that attacked you after you wouldn't submit to a blood test. You also mention the other oddities of the region of space, including the strange alien creatures in Nenia that are able to survive in the vacuum of space, as well as the large number of wormholes that allow traversal throughout the region.
units.italian: Racconti a Ivan tutto ciò che hai visto dall'altra parte del cunicolo, e di come hai trovato strani umani che comunicano cantando e con il linguaggio dei segni, e che ti hanno attaccato dopo che ti sei rifiutato di sottoporsi a un esame del sangue. Accenni anche alle altre stranezze di quella regione di spazio, comprese le strane creature aliene di Nenia capaci di sopravvivere nel vuoto, e il gran numero di cunicoli che permettono di attraversarla.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|	(Reveal the existence of the Remnant.)|1385|0
units.english: (Reveal the existence of the Remnant.)
units.italian: (Rivela l'esistenza dei Remnant.)

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|	(Don't reveal the existence of the Remnant.)|1386|0
units.english: (Don't reveal the existence of the Remnant.)
units.italian: (Non rivelare l'esistenza dei Remnant.)

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|	You tell Ivan about how the region of space beyond the wormhole is known as the "Ember Waste" and that it is inhabited by a group of friendly humans who fled there during the Alpha Wars. These humans have advanced independently from the rest of humanity for centuries. You mention their strange culture, sharing what you can remember about the songs the Remnant people sang.|1390|0
units.english: You tell Ivan about how the region of space beyond the wormhole is known as the "Ember Waste" and that it is inhabited by a group of friendly humans who fled there during the Alpha Wars. These humans have advanced independently from the rest of humanity for centuries. You mention their strange culture, sharing what you can remember about the songs the Remnant people sang.
units.italian: Racconti a Ivan che la regione di spazio oltre il cunicolo è nota come la "Distesa di Braci" ed è abitata da un gruppo di umani amichevoli fuggiti lì durante le Guerre Alfa. Questi umani si sono sviluppati in modo indipendente dal resto dell'umanità per secoli. Accenni alla loro strana cultura, condividendo ciò che ricordi delle canzoni che cantava il popolo Remnant.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|	You also mention the other oddities of the Ember Waste, including the strange alien creatures in Nenia that are able to survive in the vacuum of space, as well as the large number of wormholes that allow traversal throughout the region.|1391|0
units.english: You also mention the other oddities of the Ember Waste, including the strange alien creatures in Nenia that are able to survive in the vacuum of space, as well as the large number of wormholes that allow traversal throughout the region.
units.italian: Accenni anche alle altre stranezze della Distesa di Braci, comprese le strane creature aliene di Nenia capaci di sopravvivere nel vuoto, e il gran numero di cunicoli che permettono di attraversare la regione.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|	You tell Ivan about the region of space beyond the wormhole and its vast loneliness. You describe the ever-present red glow, similar to the color of the wormhole. You also mention the strange alien creatures in Nenia that are able to survive in the vacuum of space, as well as the large number of wormholes that allow traversal throughout the region.|1397|0
units.english: You tell Ivan about the region of space beyond the wormhole and its vast loneliness. You describe the ever-present red glow, similar to the color of the wormhole. You also mention the strange alien creatures in Nenia that are able to survive in the vacuum of space, as well as the large number of wormholes that allow traversal throughout the region.
units.italian: Racconti a Ivan della regione di spazio oltre il cunicolo e della sua immensa solitudine. Descrivi il bagliore rosso sempre presente, simile al colore del cunicolo. Accenni anche alle strane creature aliene di Nenia capaci di sopravvivere nel vuoto, e al gran numero di cunicoli che permettono di attraversare la regione.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|	"This is very interesting, and would turn out to be an amazing discovery if true. Please, bring us the quantum keystones so that we might try to understand the properties which allow entry into the wormhole's threshold. Later we will learn more about this region that you describe. Oh, before I forget: we can pay you for half of the cost of the keystones."|1400|0
units.english: "This is very interesting, and would turn out to be an amazing discovery if true. Please, bring us the quantum keystones so that we might try to understand the properties which allow entry into the wormhole's threshold. Later we will learn more about this region that you describe. Oh, before I forget: we can pay you for half of the cost of the keystones."
units.italian: "È molto interessante, e sarebbe una scoperta straordinaria se fosse vero. Ti prego, portaci le chiavi di volta quantistiche, così potremo cercare di capire le proprietà che permettono di entrare nella soglia del cunicolo. Più avanti studieremo meglio la regione che descrivi. Oh, prima che me ne dimentichi: possiamo pagarti metà del costo delle chiavi."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|	"I would be glad to help."|1402|0
units.english: "I would be glad to help."
units.italian: "Sarò felice di aiutare."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|	"Sorry, I don't want to help with this."|1404|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't want to help with this."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non voglio aiutare in questo."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|dialog|1407|0
units.english: You do not have the 10 quantum keystones that Ivan asked you to purchase in Hai space. You should return here after obtaining them.
units.italian: Non hai le 10 chiavi di volta quantistiche che Ivan ti ha chiesto di comprare nello spazio Hai. Dovresti tornare qui dopo averle ottenute.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|log|1412|0
units.english: Ran into the scientists who are investigating the anomaly in Terminus. Gave them ten quantum keystones from Hai space to examine.
units.italian: Ho incontrato gli scienziati che studiano l'anomalia in Terminus. Ho dato loro dieci chiavi di volta quantistiche dallo spazio Hai da esaminare.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|Upon returning to <planet>, you learn that Ivan has left for his research lab on Valhalla, but his research assistant, Rayna, is waiting to retrieve the keystones. She hands you <payment>, enough to pay for half of the cost of the stones.|1416|0
units.english: Upon returning to <planet>, you learn that Ivan has left for his research lab on Valhalla, but his research assistant, Rayna, is waiting to retrieve the keystones. She hands you <payment>, enough to pay for half of the cost of the stones.
units.italian: Al ritorno su <planet> scopri che Ivan è partito per il suo laboratorio di ricerca su Valhalla, ma la sua assistente, Rayna, è in attesa di ritirare le chiavi. Ti consegna <payment>, abbastanza per metà del costo delle pietre.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|Upon returning to <planet>, you learn that Ivan has left for his research lab on Valhalla, but instead you find that Rayna is waiting to retrieve the keystones. She hands you <payment>, enough to pay for half of the cost of the stones.|1420|0
units.english: Upon returning to <planet>, you learn that Ivan has left for his research lab on Valhalla, but instead you find that Rayna is waiting to retrieve the keystones. She hands you <payment>, enough to pay for half of the cost of the stones.
units.italian: Al ritorno su <planet> scopri che Ivan è partito per il suo laboratorio di ricerca su Valhalla, ma al suo posto trovi Rayna, in attesa di ritirare le chiavi. Ti consegna <payment>, abbastanza per metà del costo delle pietre.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 0|	"Thank you for buying these keystones for us. It may take us a month or two to fully study them. We'll contact you when we're in need of your assistance again."|1423|0
units.english: "Thank you for buying these keystones for us. It may take us a month or two to fully study them. We'll contact you when we're in need of your assistance again."
units.italian: "Grazie per aver comprato queste chiavi per noi. Ci vorrà un mese o due per studiarle a fondo. Ti contatteremo quando avremo di nuovo bisogno del tuo aiuto."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Keystone Research|name|1431|0
units.english: Travel to <planet>
units.italian: Raggiungi <planet>

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Keystone Research|description|1432|0
units.english: Meet up with Ivan on <destination> to learn about his research on the quantum keystones you brought him.
units.italian: Incontra Ivan su <destination> per sapere delle sue ricerche sulle chiavi di volta quantistiche che gli hai portato.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Keystone Research|You receive a message from Ivan, the scientist working on the spatial anomaly in Terminus. "Captain, we have finished studying the quantum keystones, and they do in fact allow access through the wormhole. Please meet with me on <destination> if you wish to continue helping us with our research."|1442|0
units.english: You receive a message from Ivan, the scientist working on the spatial anomaly in Terminus. "Captain, we have finished studying the quantum keystones, and they do in fact allow access through the wormhole. Please meet with me on <destination> if you wish to continue helping us with our research."
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio da Ivan, lo scienziato che lavora all'anomalia spaziale in Terminus. "Capitano, abbiamo finito di studiare le chiavi di volta quantistiche, e in effetti permettono l'accesso al cunicolo. Incontrami su <destination> se vuoi continuare ad aiutarci nelle nostre ricerche."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 1|name|1448|0
units.english: Exploring the Unknown
units.italian: Esplorare l'ignoto

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 1|description|1449|0
units.english: Explore the region of space beyond the Terminus wormhole. Return to <destination> after exploring everything you can reach.
units.italian: Esplora la regione di spazio oltre il cunicolo di Terminus. Torna su <destination> dopo aver esplorato tutto ciò che riesci a raggiungere.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 1|dialog|1466|0
units.english: This region of space appears to be inhabited. You should attempt to find out more about the beings living here.
units.italian: Questa regione di spazio sembra abitata. Dovresti cercare di scoprire di più sugli esseri che ci vivono.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 1|This system is full of strange, space-dwelling creatures that appear to be eating asteroids. The sight of their mouthparts chewing rock into dust is sure to be a recurring nightmare for any captain who visits this system. You make a note to avoid flying too close, in case they mistake your ship for their next meal.|1470|0
units.english: This system is full of strange, space-dwelling creatures that appear to be eating asteroids. The sight of their mouthparts chewing rock into dust is sure to be a recurring nightmare for any captain who visits this system. You make a note to avoid flying too close, in case they mistake your ship for their next meal.
units.italian: Questo sistema è pieno di strane creature che vivono nello spazio e che sembrano mangiare asteroidi. La vista delle loro bocche che masticano roccia riducendola in polvere sarà di certo un incubo ricorrente per ogni capitano che visita questo sistema. Ti segni mentalmente di evitare di volare troppo vicino, nel caso scambino la tua nave per il prossimo pasto.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 1|	With these strange creatures so close to the wormhole, one can only wonder what lies deeper in this region of space.|1471|0
units.english: With these strange creatures so close to the wormhole, one can only wonder what lies deeper in this region of space.
units.italian: Con queste strane creature così vicine al cunicolo, viene da chiedersi cosa si trovi più in profondità in questa regione di spazio.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 1|dialog|1473|0
units.english: You have landed on <planet>, but you have not explored enough of the space beyond the wormhole. Return to the wormhole and continue exploring the region for anything of interest.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma non hai esplorato abbastanza lo spazio oltre il cunicolo. Torna al cunicolo e continua a esplorare la regione in cerca di qualcosa di interessante.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 2|name|1482|0
units.english: Analyze Wormholes
units.italian: Analizzare i cunicoli

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 2|description|1483|0
units.english: Ivan and his team are interested in studying the wormholes beyond the one in Terminus. Return to the strange region of space and travel through the wormholes that create a loop while carrying the scanning equipment.
units.italian: Ivan e la sua squadra vogliono studiare i cunicoli oltre quello di Terminus. Torna nella strana regione di spazio e attraversa i cunicoli che formano un circuito, portando con te le apparecchiature di scansione.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 2|blocked|1490|0
units.english: You've returned to <planet>, but Ivan informs you that you'll need <capacity> available for this next mission. Return when you have the available space.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma Ivan ti informa che per questa prossima missione ti serve <capacity> libera. Torna quando avrai lo spazio necessario.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 2|dialog|1506|0
units.english: You've returned to <planet>, but you haven't traveled through all the wormholes yet. Return to the strange region of space and travel through the loop of wormholes.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non hai ancora attraversato tutti i cunicoli. Torna nella strana regione di spazio e percorri il circuito dei cunicoli.

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|label|1514|0
units.english: on first mission
units.italian: on first mission

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|You contact Ivan after you land and he sends you directions to his research lab, located on the outskirts of the city. "Quite the distance from my office, but we work with what we have," he comments. When you arrive, you hardly have time to greet Ivan, Rayna, and the others before Ivan begins discussing what they have learned from the quantum keystones.|1515|0
units.english: You contact Ivan after you land and he sends you directions to his research lab, located on the outskirts of the city. "Quite the distance from my office, but we work with what we have," he comments. When you arrive, you hardly have time to greet Ivan, Rayna, and the others before Ivan begins discussing what they have learned from the quantum keystones.
units.italian: Contatti Ivan dopo l'atterraggio e lui ti manda le indicazioni per il suo laboratorio di ricerca, in periferia della città. "È parecchio lontano dal mio ufficio, ma ci arrangiamo con quello che abbiamo," commenta. Quando arrivi, hai appena il tempo di salutare Ivan, Rayna e gli altri che Ivan comincia a parlare di ciò che hanno imparato dalle chiavi di volta quantistiche.

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|label|1519|0
units.english: knew before
units.italian: knew before

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	"As you mentioned before, a single keystone is sufficient to enter the wormhole," Ivan says. "We've determined that there is a stabilization effect, either on the ship or the wormhole, that allows matter to cross the threshold. However, we'll need much more time and data to fully understand the true mechanism.|1520|0
units.english: "As you mentioned before, a single keystone is sufficient to enter the wormhole," Ivan says. "We've determined that there is a stabilization effect, either on the ship or the wormhole, that allows matter to cross the threshold. However, we'll need much more time and data to fully understand the true mechanism.
units.italian: "Come avevi detto, una sola chiave basta per entrare nel cunicolo," dice Ivan. "Abbiamo stabilito che c'è un effetto di stabilizzazione, sulla nave o sul cunicolo, che permette alla materia di attraversare la soglia. Però ci serviranno molto più tempo e molti più dati per capire fino in fondo il meccanismo reale.

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	"Last time, you mentioned that there were alien creatures able to survive the vacuum of space, correct?"|1523|0
units.english: "Last time, you mentioned that there were alien creatures able to survive the vacuum of space, correct?"
units.italian: "L'ultima volta hai detto che c'erano creature aliene capaci di sopravvivere nel vuoto, giusto?"

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	You nod.|1524|0
units.english: You nod.
units.italian: Annuisci.

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	"Right. Well, it would be extremely interesting if we were to learn more about these alien creatures.|1525|0
units.english: "Right. Well, it would be extremely interesting if we were to learn more about these alien creatures.
units.italian: "Bene. Sarebbe estremamente interessante saperne di più su queste creature aliene.

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	"Last time, you mentioned that there were humans living in this space, the... the 'Remainder?'"|1529|0
units.english: "Last time, you mentioned that there were humans living in this space, the... the 'Remainder?'"
units.italian: "L'ultima volta hai detto che in questo spazio vivono degli umani, i... i 'Restanti'?"

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	"Remnant," you say.|1530|0
units.english: "Remnant," you say.
units.italian: "Remnant," dici.

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	"Right, that was it. Well, it would be extremely interesting if we were to learn more about this people.|1531|0
units.english: "Right, that was it. Well, it would be extremely interesting if we were to learn more about this people.
units.italian: "Giusto, ecco. Sarebbe estremamente interessante sapere di più su questo popolo.

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|label|1534|0
units.english: didn't know before
units.italian: didn't know before

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	"We've analyzed the keystones, and surprisingly they do allow entry into the wormhole in Terminus," Ivan explains. "It would appear that the stones stabilize the wormhole as the ship passes through it, or maybe it is stabilizing the ship in some way and not the wormhole. We'll need much more time to fully understand the true mechanism that is at play here. Whatever the case is, one stone is required for each ship to pass through the wormhole.|1535|0
units.english: "We've analyzed the keystones, and surprisingly they do allow entry into the wormhole in Terminus," Ivan explains. "It would appear that the stones stabilize the wormhole as the ship passes through it, or maybe it is stabilizing the ship in some way and not the wormhole. We'll need much more time to fully understand the true mechanism that is at play here. Whatever the case is, one stone is required for each ship to pass through the wormhole.
units.italian: "Abbiamo analizzato le chiavi, e sorprendentemente permettono davvero di entrare nel cunicolo di Terminus," spiega Ivan. "Sembra che le pietre stabilizzino il cunicolo mentre la nave lo attraversa, o forse stabilizzino in qualche modo la nave e non il cunicolo. Ci servirà molto più tempo per capire fino in fondo il meccanismo in gioco. In ogni caso, serve una pietra per ogni nave che attraversa il cunicolo.

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	"We sent a single drone through the wormhole to test that it was passable, and programmed it to return immediately in case the region beyond is hostile or dangerous. Would you be willing to explore the region for us? You may want to install a ramscoop, as we are unsure if there will be anywhere for your ship to refuel."|1536|0
units.english: "We sent a single drone through the wormhole to test that it was passable, and programmed it to return immediately in case the region beyond is hostile or dangerous. Would you be willing to explore the region for us? You may want to install a ramscoop, as we are unsure if there will be anywhere for your ship to refuel."
units.italian: "Abbiamo mandato un solo drone attraverso il cunicolo per verificare che fosse attraversabile, e l'abbiamo programmato per tornare subito se la regione oltre fosse ostile o pericolosa. Saresti disposto a esplorarla per noi? Ti conviene installare un collettore a ioni, perché non sappiamo se da quelle parti potrai rifornire la nave."

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|label|1540|0
units.english: know now
units.italian: know now

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	"Actually, I already explored the region beyond the wormhole while you were researching."|1542|0
units.english: "Actually, I already explored the region beyond the wormhole while you were researching."
units.italian: "In realtà ho già esplorato la regione oltre il cunicolo mentre voi facevate ricerca."

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	"Sorry, I don't want to work for you anymore."|1544|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't want to work for you anymore."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non voglio più lavorare per voi."

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|label|1547|0
units.english: on second mission
units.italian: on second mission

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|When you return, Ivan and the rest of the scientists wait eagerly for you to explain what you discovered.|1548|0
units.english: When you return, Ivan and the rest of the scientists wait eagerly for you to explain what you discovered.
units.italian: Al tuo ritorno, Ivan e gli altri scienziati ti aspettano impazienti di sentirti raccontare cosa hai scoperto.

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	You begin by recounting your experience with the strange space-dwelling creatures you found in the Nenia system. Ivan's eyes go wide when you mention the ease with which they fed on asteroids, and how they seemed to effortlessly escape from the gravity of local gas giants. You also mention that there are more strange wormholes like the one that you passed through to enter the region of space, including a series of wormholes that create a loop between multiple systems.|1551|0
units.english: You begin by recounting your experience with the strange space-dwelling creatures you found in the Nenia system. Ivan's eyes go wide when you mention the ease with which they fed on asteroids, and how they seemed to effortlessly escape from the gravity of local gas giants. You also mention that there are more strange wormholes like the one that you passed through to enter the region of space, including a series of wormholes that create a loop between multiple systems.
units.italian: Cominci raccontando l'esperienza con le strane creature spaziali che hai trovato nel sistema Nenia. Gli occhi di Ivan si spalancano quando racconti con quanta facilità si nutrivano di asteroidi e di come sembravano sfuggire senza sforzo alla gravità dei giganti gassosi locali. Accenni anche che esistono altri cunicoli strani come quello che hai attraversato per entrare nella regione, compresa una serie di cunicoli che formano un circuito fra più sistemi.

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	You then tell them about the strange-looking humans who communicate in song and sign language that attacked you after you wouldn't submit to a blood test.|1556|0
units.english: You then tell them about the strange-looking humans who communicate in song and sign language that attacked you after you wouldn't submit to a blood test.
units.italian: Poi racconti degli umani dall'aspetto strano che comunicano cantando e con il linguaggio dei segni, e che ti hanno attaccato dopo che ti sei rifiutato di sottoporsi a un esame del sangue.

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	(Reveal the existence of the Remnant.)|1561|0
units.english: (Reveal the existence of the Remnant.)
units.italian: (Rivela l'esistenza dei Remnant.)

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	(Don't reveal the existence of the Remnant.)|1562|0
units.english: (Don't reveal the existence of the Remnant.)
units.italian: (Non rivelare l'esistenza dei Remnant.)

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	You then tell them about the Remnant, a group of friendly humans who fled human space during the Alpha Wars and have advanced independently of humanity for centuries, and how they call the region of space the "Ember Waste."|1566|0
units.english: You then tell them about the Remnant, a group of friendly humans who fled human space during the Alpha Wars and have advanced independently of humanity for centuries, and how they call the region of space the "Ember Waste."
units.italian: Poi racconti dei Remnant, un gruppo di umani amichevoli fuggiti dallo spazio umano durante le Guerre Alfa e progrediti in modo indipendente per secoli, e di come chiamano quella regione di spazio la "Distesa di Braci".

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	The group of scientists looks captivated the entire time, almost like kindergarten children listening to a fairy tale. When you finish talking, they immediately chatter among themselves, seeming to be most interested in the alien creatures which inhabit the region. They seem to agree that they need to learn more about these aliens.|1572|0
units.english: The group of scientists looks captivated the entire time, almost like kindergarten children listening to a fairy tale. When you finish talking, they immediately chatter among themselves, seeming to be most interested in the alien creatures which inhabit the region. They seem to agree that they need to learn more about these aliens.
units.italian: Il gruppo di scienziati resta rapito per tutto il racconto, quasi come bambini dell'asilo che ascoltano una favola. Quando finisci, si mettono subito a chiacchierare tra loro, e sembrano interessati soprattutto alle creature aliene che abitano la regione. Concordano che devono saperne di più su questi alieni.

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	"We can seek to learn more about these alien creatures later," Ivan says.|1573|0
units.english: "We can seek to learn more about these alien creatures later," Ivan says.
units.italian: "Potremo saperne di più su queste creature aliene più avanti," dice Ivan.

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	The group of scientists looks captivated the entire time, almost like kindergarten children listening to a fairy tale. When you finish talking, they immediately chatter among themselves, seeming to be most interested in the human beings which inhabit the region. They seem to agree that they need to learn more about these humans, and more specifically about the technology which they have developed.|1577|0
units.english: The group of scientists looks captivated the entire time, almost like kindergarten children listening to a fairy tale. When you finish talking, they immediately chatter among themselves, seeming to be most interested in the human beings which inhabit the region. They seem to agree that they need to learn more about these humans, and more specifically about the technology which they have developed.
units.italian: Il gruppo di scienziati resta rapito per tutto il racconto, quasi come bambini dell'asilo che ascoltano una favola. Quando finisci, si mettono subito a chiacchierare tra loro, e sembrano interessati soprattutto agli esseri umani che abitano la regione. Concordano che devono saperne di più su questi umani, e più precisamente sulla tecnologia che hanno sviluppato.

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	"We can seek to learn more about this group of humans later," Ivan says.|1578|0
units.english: "We can seek to learn more about this group of humans later," Ivan says.
units.italian: "Potremo saperne di più su questo gruppo di umani più avanti," dice Ivan.

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	"But, first and foremost, we should continue our work on understanding these wormholes. You mentioned a strange series of wormholes. Their behavior is definitely noteworthy. Could you return to this region of space while carrying a suite of astronomic instruments? If you travel through these wormholes, we may learn more about what makes them tick."|1581|0
units.english: "But, first and foremost, we should continue our work on understanding these wormholes. You mentioned a strange series of wormholes. Their behavior is definitely noteworthy. Could you return to this region of space while carrying a suite of astronomic instruments? If you travel through these wormholes, we may learn more about what makes them tick."
units.italian: "Ma prima di tutto dovremmo continuare a studiare questi cunicoli. Hai parlato di una strana serie di cunicoli: il loro comportamento merita di sicuro attenzione. Potresti tornare in quella regione di spazio portando una serie di strumenti astronomici? Se li attraversi, potremmo scoprire di più su come funzionano."

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	"Okay, I'm willing to do it."|1583|0
units.english: "Okay, I'm willing to do it."
units.italian: "Va bene, sono disposto a farlo."

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	"Sorry, but I didn't agree to help you beyond that first job. Goodbye."|1584|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I didn't agree to help you beyond that first job. Goodbye."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non avevo accettato di aiutarvi oltre il primo incarico. Addio."

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	"Wonderful! We'll get the instruments loaded onto your ship immediately."|1586|0
units.english: "Wonderful! We'll get the instruments loaded onto your ship immediately."
units.italian: "Meraviglioso! Facciamo caricare subito gli strumenti sulla tua nave."

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|label|1589|0
units.english: still don't know
units.italian: still don't know

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	"I'm always willing to go on an adventure."|1591|0
units.english: "I'm always willing to go on an adventure."
units.italian: "Sono sempre disposto a partire per un'avventura."

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	"This sounds too risky. You're going to need to find someone else to go exploring."|1592|0
units.english: "This sounds too risky. You're going to need to find someone else to go exploring."
units.italian: "Mi sembra troppo rischioso. Dovrete trovare qualcun altro che vada a esplorare."

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant|	"Splendid! We will give you a single quantum keystone in order to travel through the wormhole. Return here once you have finished exploring."|1594|0
units.english: "Splendid! We will give you a single quantum keystone in order to travel through the wormhole. Return here once you have finished exploring."
units.italian: "Splendido! Ti daremo una sola chiave di volta quantistica per attraversare il cunicolo. Torna qui quando hai finito di esplorare."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 3: Secret|name|1601|0
units.english: Analyze Alien Creatures
units.italian: Analizzare le creature aliene

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 3: Secret|description|1602|0
units.english: Scan the "outfits" of the alien creatures in Nenia, then return to the scientists on <destination> with the detailed scanner logs.
units.italian: Scansiona gli "equipaggiamenti" delle creature aliene in Nenia, poi torna dagli scienziati su <destination> con i registri dettagliati dello scanner.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 3: Secret|dialog|1623|0
units.english: You have finished scanning the alien creatures in the system. You may now return to <destination> with the scanner logs.
units.italian: Hai finito di scansionare le creature aliene nel sistema. Ora puoi tornare su <destination> con i registri dello scanner.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 3: Secret|dialog|1626|0
units.english: You show your scanner logs to Ivan, but he shakes his head. "This isn't enough. There should be more creatures for you to scan in <waypoints>. Make sure you're using an outfit scanner as well."
units.italian: Mostri i registri dello scanner a Ivan, ma lui scuote la testa. "Non basta. Dovrebbero esserci altre creature da scansionare in <waypoints>. Assicurati di usare anche uno scanner per equipaggiamenti."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 3: Secret|log|1630|0
units.english: Scanned alien creatures beyond the wormhole in Terminus and handed the scan logs over to Ivan and his team.
units.italian: Ho scansionato le creature aliene oltre il cunicolo in Terminus e consegnato i registri a Ivan e alla sua squadra.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 3: Secret|dialog|1631|0
units.english: The team is visibly excited when you return with the scanner logs. "Give us a few weeks to look these over," Ivan says. "Then we will contact you about what we want you to do next."
units.italian: La squadra è visibilmente entusiasta quando torni con i registri. "Dacci qualche settimana per esaminarli," dice Ivan. "Poi ti contatteremo su cosa vogliamo farti fare dopo."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 3: Revealed|name|1637|0
units.english: Analyze Remnant Ships
units.italian: Analizzare le navi Remnant

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 3: Revealed|description|1638|0
units.english: Scan the outfits of the Remnant ships in Arculus, then return to the scientists on <destination> with the detailed scanner logs.
units.italian: Scansiona gli equipaggiamenti delle navi Remnant in Arculus, poi torna dagli scienziati su <destination> con i registri dettagliati dello scanner.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 3: Revealed|dialog|1659|0
units.english: You have finished scanning the Remnant ships in the system, and they don't seem to have taken too kindly to that. You may now return to <destination> with the scanner logs.
units.italian: Hai finito di scansionare le navi Remnant nel sistema, e non sembrano averla presa bene. Ora puoi tornare su <destination> con i registri dello scanner.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 3: Revealed|dialog|1662|0
units.english: You show your scanner logs to Ivan, but he shakes his head. "This isn't enough. There should be more ships for you to scan in <waypoints>. Make sure you're using an outfit scanner as well."
units.italian: Mostri i registri dello scanner a Ivan, ma lui scuote la testa. "Non basta. Dovrebbero esserci altre navi da scansionare in <waypoints>. Assicurati di usare anche uno scanner per equipaggiamenti."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 3: Revealed|log|1666|0
units.english: Scanned Remnant ships beyond the wormhole in Terminus and handed the scan logs over to Ivan and his team.
units.italian: Ho scansionato le navi Remnant oltre il cunicolo in Terminus e consegnato i registri a Ivan e alla sua squadra.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant 3: Revealed|dialog|1667|0
units.english: The team is visibly excited when you return with the scanner logs, but become more somber when you mention that the ships became hostile when you scanned them. "Give us a few weeks to look these over," Ivan says. "Then we will contact you about what we want you to do next. By then, should we return, hopefully those ships won't be too upset anymore."
units.italian: La squadra è visibilmente entusiasta quando torni con i registri, ma si fa più seria quando racconti che le navi sono diventate ostili mentre le scansionavi. "Dacci qualche settimana per esaminarli," dice Ivan. "Poi ti contatteremo su cosa vogliamo farti fare dopo. A quel punto, se torneremo, speriamo che quelle navi non siano più tanto irritate."

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant 3|The team of scientists is already waiting in the spaceport when you arrive. They remove the equipment from your ship and immediately begin analyzing the results after returning to the lab.|1688|0
units.english: The team of scientists is already waiting in the spaceport when you arrive. They remove the equipment from your ship and immediately begin analyzing the results after returning to the lab.
units.italian: La squadra di scienziati è già ad aspettarti nello spazioporto quando arrivi. Scaricano le apparecchiature dalla nave e, tornati in laboratorio, cominciano subito ad analizzare i risultati.

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant 3|	"At first glance, this series of wormholes seems no different than the one that is used to enter this region of space, but it will require some time for us to go over all the data the sensors collected," Ivan explains to you.|1689|0
units.english: "At first glance, this series of wormholes seems no different than the one that is used to enter this region of space, but it will require some time for us to go over all the data the sensors collected," Ivan explains to you.
units.italian: "A prima vista questa serie di cunicoli non sembra diversa da quella che si usa per entrare in questa regione di spazio, ma ci vorrà un po' per esaminare tutti i dati raccolti dai sensori," ti spiega Ivan.

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant 3|	"While you wait, though, I have another job you could do. You mentioned something about strange alien creatures beyond the wormhole that seemed to be able to survive in the vacuum of space. Would you be able to return there and scan them for us? These alien creatures won't have 'outfits' for the scanners to pick up, but a typical outfits scanner is still likely to give us the most information."|1692|0
units.english: "While you wait, though, I have another job you could do. You mentioned something about strange alien creatures beyond the wormhole that seemed to be able to survive in the vacuum of space. Would you be able to return there and scan them for us? These alien creatures won't have 'outfits' for the scanners to pick up, but a typical outfits scanner is still likely to give us the most information."
units.italian: "Mentre aspetti, però, avrei un altro lavoro per te. Hai accennato a strane creature aliene oltre il cunicolo, capaci di sopravvivere nel vuoto. Potresti tornare là e scansionarle per noi? Queste creature non hanno 'equipaggiamenti' che gli scanner possano rilevare, ma uno scanner per equipaggiamenti è comunque quello che probabilmente ci darà più informazioni."

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant 3|	"While you wait, though, I have another job you could do. You mentioned something about a group of humans, or at least human-like beings, beyond the wormhole. Would you be able to return there and scan their ships for us? I'd be interested in seeing what an outfits scanner returns. You need not contact them, simply find a couple of ships and scan them so that we might learn more about their capabilities."|1696|0
units.english: "While you wait, though, I have another job you could do. You mentioned something about a group of humans, or at least human-like beings, beyond the wormhole. Would you be able to return there and scan their ships for us? I'd be interested in seeing what an outfits scanner returns. You need not contact them, simply find a couple of ships and scan them so that we might learn more about their capabilities."
units.italian: "Mentre aspetti, però, avrei un altro lavoro per te. Hai accennato a un gruppo di umani, o almeno di esseri umanoidi, oltre il cunicolo. Potresti tornare là e scansionare le loro navi per noi? Mi interessa vedere cosa restituisce uno scanner per equipaggiamenti. Non devi contattarli: trova un paio di navi e scansionale, così potremo capire meglio di cosa sono capaci."

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant 3|	"Sounds like a good plan. I'll be back as soon as I can."|1699|0
units.english: "Sounds like a good plan. I'll be back as soon as I can."
units.italian: "Mi sembra un buon piano. Tornerò il prima possibile."

units.id: conversation:deep: remnant 3|	"Sorry, but I'm not comfortable with this idea. You'll need to find someone else."|1701|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not comfortable with this idea. You'll need to find someone else."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma l'idea non mi convince. Dovrete trovare qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant Research|You receive a message from Ivan after you land. "Thanks for all your help recently. We brought our findings to the Deep government, but given their sensitive nature the Deep is taking its time deciding whether to fund further research. In the meantime, I've transferred <payment> of my own funds to your account. I have no doubt the Deep will approve further funding for our project in the future, so I've simply written this off as a business expense. I'll contact you once we continue our research beyond the wormhole. Thanks again!"|1720|0
units.english: You receive a message from Ivan after you land. "Thanks for all your help recently. We brought our findings to the Deep government, but given their sensitive nature the Deep is taking its time deciding whether to fund further research. In the meantime, I've transferred <payment> of my own funds to your account. I have no doubt the Deep will approve further funding for our project in the future, so I've simply written this off as a business expense. I'll contact you once we continue our research beyond the wormhole. Thanks again!"
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio da Ivan dopo l'atterraggio. "Grazie per tutto l'aiuto di questi giorni. Abbiamo portato le nostre scoperte al governo del Deep, ma vista la loro natura delicata il Deep sta prendendosi tempo per decidere se finanziare altre ricerche. Nel frattempo ho trasferito sul tuo conto <payment> dei miei fondi. Non ho dubbi che in futuro il Deep approverà nuovi finanziamenti per il nostro progetto, quindi l'ho semplicemente messo tra le spese aziendali. Ti contatterò quando riprenderemo le ricerche oltre il cunicolo. Grazie ancora!"

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Continue Research|name|1754|0
units.english: Travel to <planet>
units.italian: Raggiungi <planet>

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Continue Research|description|1755|0
units.english: Meet up with Ivan on <destination> to continue helping with research on the Ember Waste.
units.italian: Incontra Ivan su <destination> per continuare ad aiutare con la ricerca sulla Distesa di Braci.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Continue Research|You receive a message from Ivan, the Deep scientist who you helped to discover the Remnant in the Ember Waste. "Captain <last>, it's been so long. The Deep has finally finished reviewing our research in the Ember Waste, and we've been approved for further funding! Please meet us on <destination> if you wish to assist us again. Your help would be appreciated, but we will make progress even if you're unable to help."|1768|0
units.english: You receive a message from Ivan, the Deep scientist who you helped to discover the Remnant in the Ember Waste. "Captain <last>, it's been so long. The Deep has finally finished reviewing our research in the Ember Waste, and we've been approved for further funding! Please meet us on <destination> if you wish to assist us again. Your help would be appreciated, but we will make progress even if you're unable to help."
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio da Ivan, lo scienziato del Deep che hai aiutato a scoprire i Remnant nella Distesa di Braci. "Capitano <last>, quanto tempo. Il Deep ha finalmente finito di esaminare le nostre ricerche nella Distesa di Braci, e abbiamo ottenuto nuovi finanziamenti! Incontraci su <destination> se vuoi aiutarci ancora. Il tuo aiuto sarà gradito, ma andremo avanti anche se non potrai."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Continue Research|	(Accept.)|1770|0
units.english: (Accept.)
units.italian: (Accetta.)

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Continue Research|	(Decline.)|1772|0
units.english: (Decline.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta.)

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|name|1779|0
units.english: Fetching Engines
units.italian: Recuperare i motori

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|description|1780|0
units.english: Acquire "Forge-Class" thruster and steering engines from the Remnant and bring them to <destination>.
units.italian: Procurati propulsori e motori di manovra "Classe Forgia" dai Remnant e portali su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|Thanks to the new funding grants from the Deep, the team has moved their research lab into a more advanced facility closer to the spaceport. "This new location will make transferring cargo from your ship to the lab much easier, something we expect to do a lot of in the next few months. It's also much closer to my office, which will make life much easier," Ivan adds. "A careful study of the outfit scans you collected has indicated that the Remnant technology uses unprecedented advancements and improvements that haven't been seen in any human technology before.|1788|0
units.english: Thanks to the new funding grants from the Deep, the team has moved their research lab into a more advanced facility closer to the spaceport. "This new location will make transferring cargo from your ship to the lab much easier, something we expect to do a lot of in the next few months. It's also much closer to my office, which will make life much easier," Ivan adds. "A careful study of the outfit scans you collected has indicated that the Remnant technology uses unprecedented advancements and improvements that haven't been seen in any human technology before.
units.italian: Grazie ai nuovi finanziamenti del Deep, la squadra ha spostato il laboratorio in una struttura più avanzata, più vicina allo spazioporto. "Questa nuova sede renderà molto più facile trasferire il carico dalla tua nave al laboratorio, cosa che prevediamo di fare spesso nei prossimi mesi. Ed è anche molto più vicina al mio ufficio, il che mi semplificherà la vita," aggiunge Ivan. "Uno studio attento delle scansioni degli equipaggiamenti che hai raccolto indica che la tecnologia Remnant si basa su progressi e miglioramenti senza precedenti, mai visti in nessuna tecnologia umana.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|	"Even though the Remnant have attacked you, we are very interested in what additional secrets their technology may hold. Are you willing to steal some of their technology and bring it to us for analysis?"|1792|0
units.english: "Even though the Remnant have attacked you, we are very interested in what additional secrets their technology may hold. Are you willing to steal some of their technology and bring it to us for analysis?"
units.italian: "Anche se i Remnant ti hanno attaccato, siamo molto interessati agli altri segreti che la loro tecnologia potrebbe nascondere. Sei disposto a sottrarre un po' della loro tecnologia e a portarcela per analizzarla?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|	"Is this really necessary?"|1794|0
units.english: "Is this really necessary?"
units.italian: "È davvero necessario?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|	"I'd be more than happy to help."|1795|0
units.english: "I'd be more than happy to help."
units.italian: "Sarò più che felice di aiutare."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|	"Sorry, but I'm not interested in working for you anymore."|1797|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not interested in working for you anymore."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non ho più intenzione di lavorare per voi."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|	"If they aren't willing to be friendly and simply sell you their technology then I'm afraid that this is the only way that we can obtain it. You don't have to destroy their ships if you don't want to, we simply need you to disable a few and take some of their outfits."|1800|0
units.english: "If they aren't willing to be friendly and simply sell you their technology then I'm afraid that this is the only way that we can obtain it. You don't have to destroy their ships if you don't want to, we simply need you to disable a few and take some of their outfits."
units.italian: "Se non sono disposti a essere amichevoli e a vendere semplicemente la loro tecnologia, temo che questa sia l'unica maniera di ottenerla. Non devi distruggere le loro navi, se non vuoi: ci basta che tu ne renda inoffensive un paio e prenda alcuni dei loro equipaggiamenti."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|	"Alright, I'll do it."|1802|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll do it."
units.italian: "Va bene, lo farò."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|	"Sorry, but I'm not going to attack human beings for the sake of science."|1804|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not going to attack human beings for the sake of science."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non attaccherò degli esseri umani in nome della scienza."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|	"You told us that these humans were friendly... well, until you scanned their ships, that is. Do they allow you to purchase their technology?"|1808|0
units.english: "You told us that these humans were friendly... well, until you scanned their ships, that is. Do they allow you to purchase their technology?"
units.italian: "Ci avevi detto che questi umani erano amichevoli... beh, fino a quando non hai scansionato le loro navi. Ti permettono di acquistare la loro tecnologia?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|	"No," you respond. "They haven't given me a license to buy any of their outfits or ships."|1811|0
units.english: "No," you respond. "They haven't given me a license to buy any of their outfits or ships."
units.italian: "No," rispondi. "Non mi hanno dato la licenza per comprare i loro equipaggiamenti o le loro navi."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|	The scientists ponder this for a moment. Eventually, Rayna speaks up. "Maybe if you assist them in some way they may welcome you into their society. I can imagine that they are a little wary after all those years on their own. Try doing jobs for them or see if anyone in their spaceports needs something from you."|1812|0
