units.english: The scientists ponder this for a moment. Eventually, Rayna speaks up. "Maybe if you assist them in some way they may welcome you into their society. I can imagine that they are a little wary after all those years on their own. Try doing jobs for them or see if anyone in their spaceports needs something from you."
units.italian: Gli scienziati ci riflettono un momento. Alla fine Rayna prende la parola. "Forse, se li aiuti in qualche modo, potrebbero accoglierti nella loro società. Immagino che dopo tutti quegli anni da soli siano un po' diffidenti. Prova a fare dei lavori per loro, o vedi se qualcuno nei loro spazioporti ha bisogno di qualcosa da te."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|	"You could also plunder their technology if they won't sell it to you," Ivan chimes in. "Without killing them, of course," he adds.|1813|0
units.english: "You could also plunder their technology if they won't sell it to you," Ivan chimes in. "Without killing them, of course," he adds.
units.italian: "Potresti anche saccheggiare la loro tecnologia, se non te la vendono," interviene Ivan. "Senza ucciderli, naturalmente," aggiunge.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|	"I'll see if I can try to get my hands on what you need."|1815|0
units.english: "I'll see if I can try to get my hands on what you need."
units.italian: "Vedrò se riesco a procurarmi quello che vi serve."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|	"Sorry, but I'm not interested in doing that kind of work for you."|1817|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not interested in doing that kind of work for you."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non mi interessa fare quel tipo di lavoro per voi."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|	"Yes," you respond. "I had to do a few odd jobs for them, but they eventually allowed me to purchase their outfits and ships."|1821|0
units.english: "Yes," you respond. "I had to do a few odd jobs for them, but they eventually allowed me to purchase their outfits and ships."
units.italian: "Sì," rispondi. "Ho dovuto fare qualche lavoretto per loro, ma alla fine mi hanno permesso di acquistare equipaggiamenti e navi."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|	"Then all you need to do is buy whatever we ask you to and bring it back here. Are you interested?"|1822|0
units.english: "Then all you need to do is buy whatever we ask you to and bring it back here. Are you interested?"
units.italian: "Allora devi solo comprare ciò che ti chiediamo e portarlo qui. Ti interessa?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|	"I'd be glad to help."|1824|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to help."
units.italian: "Sarò lieto di aiutare."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|	"Sorry, but I don't want to spend money for your research."|1825|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I don't want to spend money for your research."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non voglio spendere soldi per le vostre ricerche."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|	"Great!" Ivan exclaims. "Right now we'd be interested in studying their engines. Please bring us one Forge-Class Thruster and one Forge-Class Steering. They shouldn't be too hard to get."|1829|0
units.english: "Great!" Ivan exclaims. "Right now we'd be interested in studying their engines. Please bring us one Forge-Class Thruster and one Forge-Class Steering. They shouldn't be too hard to get."
units.italian: "Ottimo!" esclama Ivan. "Adesso ci interessa studiare i loro motori. Portaci un propulsore Classe Forgia e un motore di manovra Classe Forgia. Non dovrebbe essere difficile procurarli."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Engines|dialog|1833|0
units.english: You have landed on <planet>, but you do not have both a Forge-Class Thruster and Forge-Class Steering. Return to <planet> once you have obtained both engines.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma non hai sia un propulsore sia un motore di manovra Classe Forgia. Torna su <planet> quando avrai ottenuto entrambi.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Generators|name|1842|0
units.english: Fetching a Generator
units.italian: Recuperare un generatore

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Generators|description|1843|0
units.english: Acquire a Millennium Cell generator from the Remnant and bring it to <destination>.
units.italian: Procurati un generatore Millennium Cell dai Remnant e portalo su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Generators|An unloading crew quickly removes the engines from your ship and transports them to Ivan's research lab. You are escorted into a lobby where one of the administrative staff pays you <payment> in exchange for the engines. He asks you to wait, indicating that Ivan or one of the other scientists should be out to meet you shortly. After about three hours of waiting, Ivan enters the room.|1851|0
units.english: An unloading crew quickly removes the engines from your ship and transports them to Ivan's research lab. You are escorted into a lobby where one of the administrative staff pays you <payment> in exchange for the engines. He asks you to wait, indicating that Ivan or one of the other scientists should be out to meet you shortly. After about three hours of waiting, Ivan enters the room.
units.italian: Una squadra di scarico rimuove in fretta i motori dalla tua nave e li trasporta al laboratorio di Ivan. Ti accompagnano in una hall dove uno del personale amministrativo ti paga <payment> in cambio dei motori. Ti chiede di aspettare, dicendo che Ivan o uno degli altri scienziati verrà a cercarti a breve. Dopo circa tre ore di attesa, Ivan entra nella stanza.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Generators|	"These engines, they are fantastic! The scans made them seem similar to human ion engines, but surprisingly they can outperform even atomic engines! The thrust-to-mass ratio is great, and they have somehow avoided the immense heat generation that our engines emit. They do have some downsides, but it's still amazing that such an isolated group of humans could make technological leaps beyond even what the Deep has accomplished.|1852|0
units.english: "These engines, they are fantastic! The scans made them seem similar to human ion engines, but surprisingly they can outperform even atomic engines! The thrust-to-mass ratio is great, and they have somehow avoided the immense heat generation that our engines emit. They do have some downsides, but it's still amazing that such an isolated group of humans could make technological leaps beyond even what the Deep has accomplished.
units.italian: "Questi motori sono fantastici! Dalle scansioni sembravano simili ai motori a ioni umani, ma sorprendentemente superano persino i motori atomici! Il rapporto spinta-massa è eccellente, e in qualche modo evitano l'enorme calore che producono i nostri motori. Hanno qualche difetto, ma resta incredibile che un gruppo di umani così isolato abbia potuto fare passi tecnologici oltre ciò che ha fatto il Deep.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Generators|	"We've decided that the next Remnant technology we'd like to examine is their power generation. Could you bring us one of their Millennium Cells?"|1853|0
units.english: "We've decided that the next Remnant technology we'd like to examine is their power generation. Could you bring us one of their Millennium Cells?"
units.italian: "Abbiamo deciso che la prossima tecnologia Remnant da esaminare sarà la produzione di energia. Potresti portarci una delle loro Millennium Cell?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Generators|	"Sure. I'll be back in no time at all."|1855|0
units.english: "Sure. I'll be back in no time at all."
units.italian: "Certo. Torno in un batter d'occhio."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Generators|	"Sorry, but I'm no longer interested in working for you."|1857|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm no longer interested in working for you."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non mi interessa più lavorare per voi."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Generators|dialog|1861|0
units.english: You have landed on <planet>, but you do not have a Millennium Cell. Return to <planet> once you have obtained the generator.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma non hai una Millennium Cell. Torna su <planet> quando avrai ottenuto il generatore.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Inhibitor Cannon|name|1869|0
units.english: Fetching a Cannon
units.italian: Recuperare un cannone

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Inhibitor Cannon|description|1870|0
units.english: Acquire an Inhibitor Cannon from the Remnant and bring the weapon to <destination>.
units.italian: Procurati un Cannone Inibitore dai Remnant e portalo su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Inhibitor Cannon|Again, the Remnant technology is removed from your ship and transported to the research lab. You wander into the waiting area and are paid <payment>. After several hours, the scientists come to you with their initial findings.|1878|0
units.english: Again, the Remnant technology is removed from your ship and transported to the research lab. You wander into the waiting area and are paid <payment>. After several hours, the scientists come to you with their initial findings.
units.italian: Anche stavolta la tecnologia Remnant viene rimossa dalla nave e trasportata al laboratorio. Ti accomodi nella sala d'attesa e ricevi <payment>. Dopo diverse ore gli scienziati vengono da te con i primi risultati.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Inhibitor Cannon|	"This Millennium Cell is little more than a radiothermal generator. Not exactly the best kind of generator if you're looking for lots of power - our Fusion Reactors are far better at that - but for a radiothermal generator, it produces remarkably little heat. We'll have to take it apart to find out how they are manipulating the decay heat so effectively, but preparing for that will take some time.|1879|0
units.english: "This Millennium Cell is little more than a radiothermal generator. Not exactly the best kind of generator if you're looking for lots of power - our Fusion Reactors are far better at that - but for a radiothermal generator, it produces remarkably little heat. We'll have to take it apart to find out how they are manipulating the decay heat so effectively, but preparing for that will take some time.
units.italian: "Questa Millennium Cell è poco più di un generatore radiotermico. Non è il miglior tipo di generatore se cerchi tanta potenza (i nostri Reattori a Fusione sono molto meglio), ma per essere un radiotermico produce pochissimo calore. Dovremo smontarla per capire come gestiscono così bene il calore di decadimento, ma preparare tutto richiederà tempo.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Inhibitor Cannon|	"I suppose by now you've seen the Remnant ships in combat more than a few times. The outfit scans showed one of their primary weapons is a modified Particle Cannon, but we'd need to see the actual weapon in order to understand how the modification works. Would you retrieve an Inhibitor Cannon for us?"|1880|0
units.english: "I suppose by now you've seen the Remnant ships in combat more than a few times. The outfit scans showed one of their primary weapons is a modified Particle Cannon, but we'd need to see the actual weapon in order to understand how the modification works. Would you retrieve an Inhibitor Cannon for us?"
units.italian: "Suppongo che ormai tu abbia visto le navi Remnant in combattimento più di qualche volta. Le scansioni degli equipaggiamenti mostrano che una delle loro armi principali è un Cannone di Particelle modificato, ma dovremmo vedere l'arma vera per capire come funziona la modifica. Potresti recuperarci un Cannone Inibitore?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Inhibitor Cannon|	"I'd be glad to."|1882|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to."
units.italian: "Volentieri."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Inhibitor Cannon|	"Sorry, but I'm no longer interested in working for you."|1884|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm no longer interested in working for you."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non mi interessa più lavorare per voi."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant: Inhibitor Cannon|dialog|1888|0
units.english: You have landed on <planet>, but you do not have an Inhibitor Cannon. Return to <planet> once you have the weapon.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma non hai un Cannone Inibitore. Torna su <planet> quando avrai l'arma.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant Surveillance|name|1896|0
units.english: Remnant Surveillance
units.italian: Sorveglianza dei Remnant

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant Surveillance|description|1897|0
units.english: Land on each of the Remnant worlds (<stopovers>) and place a number of sensor cubes. Then return to <destination> once you are done.
units.italian: Atterra su ciascuno dei mondi Remnant (<stopovers>) e colloca un certo numero di cubi sensore. Poi torna su <destination> quando hai finito.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant Surveillance|log|1907|0
units.english: Delivered various pieces of Remnant technology to the Deep to be examined. Ivan's project has drawn the attention of the Deep, and the Inhibitor Cannon was taken away by Deep Security before it could be researched.
units.italian: Ho consegnato al Deep varie componenti di tecnologia Remnant da esaminare. Il progetto di Ivan ha attirato l'attenzione del Deep, e il Cannone Inibitore è stato portato via dalla Sicurezza del Deep prima che potesse essere studiato.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant Surveillance|Instead of sending the Inhibitor Cannon to Ivan's lab, the unloading crew transfers it to a waiting Deep Security ship, which immediately departs when its cargo bay doors close. Unlike the previous crews that met you upon landing, they are all in military garb. When you meet Ivan at his lab, he explains that the Deep was especially interested in the Remnant technology after reading his previous reports, and that his team would need to study it in a "more secure location."|1909|0
units.english: Instead of sending the Inhibitor Cannon to Ivan's lab, the unloading crew transfers it to a waiting Deep Security ship, which immediately departs when its cargo bay doors close. Unlike the previous crews that met you upon landing, they are all in military garb. When you meet Ivan at his lab, he explains that the Deep was especially interested in the Remnant technology after reading his previous reports, and that his team would need to study it in a "more secure location."
units.italian: Invece di mandare il Cannone Inibitore al laboratorio di Ivan, la squadra di scarico lo trasferisce su una nave della Sicurezza del Deep in attesa, che parte subito dopo aver chiuso i portelloni della stiva. A differenza delle squadre precedenti, sono tutti in uniforme militare. Quando incontri Ivan al laboratorio, ti spiega che il Deep si è interessato particolarmente alla tecnologia Remnant dopo aver letto i suoi rapporti precedenti, e che la sua squadra dovrà studiarla in una "sede più sicura".

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant Surveillance|	Ivan hands you <payment>. "Thank you for all the help, Captain <last>. You've done a lot for humanity in these past few months. It may take us years to fully understand the technology you have brought us, but rest assured that once we do understand it, the galaxy will be a better place. I'll see you later, Captain. Stay safe."|1912|0
units.english: Ivan hands you <payment>. "Thank you for all the help, Captain <last>. You've done a lot for humanity in these past few months. It may take us years to fully understand the technology you have brought us, but rest assured that once we do understand it, the galaxy will be a better place. I'll see you later, Captain. Stay safe."
units.italian: Ivan ti consegna <payment>. "Grazie per tutto l'aiuto, capitano <last>. In questi mesi hai fatto molto per l'umanità. Potrebbero volerci anni per capire fino in fondo la tecnologia che ci hai portato, ma stai pur certo che, una volta compresa, la galassia sarà un posto migliore. Ci vediamo, capitano. Stai al sicuro."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant Surveillance|	Ivan hands you <payment>. "Thank you for all the help, Captain <last>, but I have one last thing to ask." Ivan reaches into his pocket and retrieves six objects that you recognize as sensor cubes. "Would you bring two of these to each of the Remnant worlds? We've been learning a great deal from the study of the Remnant outfits, but aside from your scanning logs we have very little information on the Remnant ships. If you were to place these near their spaceports, they would be able to scan any nearby ships, which would be most helpful."|1916|0
units.english: Ivan hands you <payment>. "Thank you for all the help, Captain <last>, but I have one last thing to ask." Ivan reaches into his pocket and retrieves six objects that you recognize as sensor cubes. "Would you bring two of these to each of the Remnant worlds? We've been learning a great deal from the study of the Remnant outfits, but aside from your scanning logs we have very little information on the Remnant ships. If you were to place these near their spaceports, they would be able to scan any nearby ships, which would be most helpful."
units.italian: Ivan ti consegna <payment>. "Grazie per tutto l'aiuto, capitano <last>, ma ho un'ultima cosa da chiederti." Ivan fruga in tasca e tira fuori sei oggetti che riconosci come cubi sensore. "Potresti portarne due su ciascuno dei mondi Remnant? Stiamo imparando molto studiando gli equipaggiamenti Remnant, ma a parte i tuoi registri di scansione abbiamo pochissime informazioni sulle navi Remnant. Se li collocassi vicino ai loro spazioporti, potrebbero scansionare le navi nei paraggi, e ci sarebbe di grande aiuto."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant Surveillance|	"You can count on me, Ivan."|1918|0
units.english: "You can count on me, Ivan."
units.italian: "Puoi contare su di me, Ivan."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant Surveillance|	"Sorry, but this doesn't seem like the right thing to do. You'll need to find someone else to do this for you."|1919|0
units.english: "Sorry, but this doesn't seem like the right thing to do. You'll need to find someone else to do this for you."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non mi sembra la cosa giusta da fare. Dovrete trovare qualcun altro per questo."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant Surveillance|	"Thank you, Captain. Return here once you have finished, and I'll ensure you are well compensated for the journey."|1922|0
units.english: "Thank you, Captain. Return here once you have finished, and I'll ensure you are well compensated for the journey."
units.italian: "Grazie, capitano. Torna qui quando hai finito, e mi assicurerò che il viaggio sia ben pagato."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant Surveillance|dialog|1926|0
units.english: You have landed on <planet>, but you have not placed two cubes on all the Remnant worlds. Return to the Ember Waste and make sure you have placed surveillance devices on <stopovers>.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma non hai collocato due cubi su tutti i mondi Remnant. Torna nella Distesa di Braci e assicurati di aver piazzato i dispositivi di sorveglianza su <stopovers>.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant Surveillance|log|1929|0
units.english: Secretly placed sensor cubes near the spaceport of each Remnant planet. Ivan hopes to use the data gathered from these cubes to learn more about Remnant ships.
units.italian: Ho collocato di nascosto dei cubi sensore vicino allo spazioporto di ogni pianeta Remnant. Ivan spera di usare i dati raccolti da questi cubi per saperne di più sulle navi Remnant.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant Surveillance|When you return to <planet>, you are unable to find Ivan. Instead, Rayna waves you down and hands you a credits chip worth <payment>.|1931|0
units.english: When you return to <planet>, you are unable to find Ivan. Instead, Rayna waves you down and hands you a credits chip worth <payment>.
units.italian: Quando torni su <planet> non riesci a trovare Ivan. È Rayna a farti cenno e a consegnarti un chip di credito del valore di <payment>.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant Surveillance|	"Ivan told me to give this to you, Captain. Thanks again for helping us out so much. We couldn't have done it without you."|1932|0
units.english: "Ivan told me to give this to you, Captain. Thanks again for helping us out so much. We couldn't have done it without you."
units.italian: "Ivan mi ha detto di darti questo, capitano. Grazie ancora per tutto l'aiuto. Senza di te non ce l'avremmo fatta."

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant Surveillance - Viminal|You try to make an effort to not be seen as you decide where to place the cubes. You place one outside of the spaceport dome, burying it in the snow so it is difficult to find. The other you tuck into a dark corner of the spaceport, and as soon as you let it go it blends in surprisingly well with its surroundings.|1944|0
units.english: You try to make an effort to not be seen as you decide where to place the cubes. You place one outside of the spaceport dome, burying it in the snow so it is difficult to find. The other you tuck into a dark corner of the spaceport, and as soon as you let it go it blends in surprisingly well with its surroundings.
units.italian: Cerchi di non farti vedere mentre decidi dove collocare i cubi. Ne metti uno fuori dalla cupola dello spazioporto, seppellendolo nella neve perché sia difficile da trovare. L'altro lo infili in un angolo buio dello spazioporto, e appena lo lasci andare si mimetizza sorprendentemente bene con l'ambiente.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant Surveillance - Caelian|You place the first of the cubes at the entrance of a now-abandoned underground settlement, in a dark area where it will not be seen. Unable to find a good spot for the second, you decide to leave it in a ditch and cover it in sand. Although you are unable to see anyone, you feel that you are being watched. As the only non-Remnant you are not exactly inconspicuous, but no one approaches you as you return to your ship.|1955|0
units.english: You place the first of the cubes at the entrance of a now-abandoned underground settlement, in a dark area where it will not be seen. Unable to find a good spot for the second, you decide to leave it in a ditch and cover it in sand. Although you are unable to see anyone, you feel that you are being watched. As the only non-Remnant you are not exactly inconspicuous, but no one approaches you as you return to your ship.
units.italian: Collochi il primo cubo all'ingresso di un insediamento sotterraneo ormai abbandonato, in una zona buia dove non si vedrà. Non trovando un buon posto per il secondo, decidi di lasciarlo in un fosso coprendolo di sabbia. Anche se non vedi nessuno, senti di essere osservato. Come unico non-Remnant non passi certo inosservato, ma nessuno ti avvicina mentre torni alla nave.

units.id: mission:Deep: Remnant Surveillance - Aventine|As you walk through the oldest part of the town, you spot an alleyway that has plenty of nooks in which a cube can be concealed. You decide to place the other one far outside of town, near the top of the valley where the spaceport can still be seen.|1966|0
units.english: As you walk through the oldest part of the town, you spot an alleyway that has plenty of nooks in which a cube can be concealed. You decide to place the other one far outside of town, near the top of the valley where the spaceport can still be seen.
units.italian: Mentre attraversi la parte più antica della città, noti un vicolo pieno di nicchie in cui nascondere un cubo. L'altro decidi di collocarlo lontano dalla città, vicino alla cima della valle, dove lo spazioporto è ancora visibile.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|name|1997|0
units.english: Locate Missing Scientists
units.italian: Localizzare gli scienziati scomparsi

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|description|1998|0
units.english: A Star Queen transporting prominent Deep scientists has gone missing. It was last seen near the Betelgeuse system in the Far North. Find its whereabouts and return it to <destination> if possible.
units.italian: Una Star Queen che trasportava eminenti scienziati del Deep è scomparsa. È stata vista l'ultima volta vicino al sistema Betelgeuse, nel Far North. Scopri dove si trova e, se possibile, riportala su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|While watching a local sports game on the telescreen of a spaceport restaurant called "The <origin> Sif," your name is called from the entrance. You turn your head and spot Lieutenant Paris waving at you to come outside. You pay for your meal and walk outside.|2012|0
units.english: While watching a local sports game on the telescreen of a spaceport restaurant called "The <origin> Sif," your name is called from the entrance. You turn your head and spot Lieutenant Paris waving at you to come outside. You pay for your meal and walk outside.
units.italian: Mentre guardi una partita locale sul teleschermo di un ristorante dello spazioporto chiamato "Il Sif di <origin>", il tuo nome viene chiamato dall'ingresso. Ti volti e vedi il tenente Paris che ti fa cenno di uscire. Paghi il conto ed esci.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|	"Hello Captain. Do you have a moment to talk?"|2013|0
units.english: "Hello Captain. Do you have a moment to talk?"
units.italian: "Salve, capitano. Hai un momento per parlare?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|	"I do. What do you need?"|2015|0
units.english: "I do. What do you need?"
units.italian: "Sì. Di cosa hai bisogno?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|	"Sorry, but I'm busy right now."|2017|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm busy right now."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma in questo momento sono occupato."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|	"This isn't a situation that can wait, Captain. You are needed immediately."|2019|0
units.english: "This isn't a situation that can wait, Captain. You are needed immediately."
units.italian: "Questa situazione non può aspettare, capitano. Sei necessario subito."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|	"What is it?"|2021|0
units.english: "What is it?"
units.italian: "Di che si tratta?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|	"I can't help you. You're going to need to find someone else."|2022|0
units.english: "I can't help you. You're going to need to find someone else."
units.italian: "Non posso aiutarvi. Dovrete trovare qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|	"A number of scientists have been kidnapped during a venture to the Far North. Their intent was to research the Wolf-Rayet star in the Gorvi system. Due to this system's proximity to the anarchist worlds, very little research has been conducted on it. Pierre, Hannah, and... and Laura were all aboard the Star Queen which contained the scientists. Since you know them I only thought it fair that you should know about the situation.|2026|0
units.english: "A number of scientists have been kidnapped during a venture to the Far North. Their intent was to research the Wolf-Rayet star in the Gorvi system. Due to this system's proximity to the anarchist worlds, very little research has been conducted on it. Pierre, Hannah, and... and Laura were all aboard the Star Queen which contained the scientists. Since you know them I only thought it fair that you should know about the situation.
units.italian: "Diversi scienziati sono stati rapiti durante una spedizione nel Far North. Volevano studiare la stella Wolf-Rayet del sistema Gorvi. Dato che questo sistema è vicino ai mondi anarchici, finora vi si è fatta pochissima ricerca. Pierre, Hannah e... e Laura erano tutti a bordo della Star Queen che trasportava gli scienziati. Dato che li conosci, mi è sembrato giusto che sapessi della situazione.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|	"It was yesterday that we were informed of the kidnapping. The Star Queen and its escorts were preparing to refuel on Prime in the Betelgeuse system when a large pirate fleet entered the system. The Star Queen's escorts were swiftly destroyed, and she was captured. We lost all communications with the vessel after that. Would you be willing to help us locate the Star Queen while we prepare a rescue force?"|2027|0
units.english: "It was yesterday that we were informed of the kidnapping. The Star Queen and its escorts were preparing to refuel on Prime in the Betelgeuse system when a large pirate fleet entered the system. The Star Queen's escorts were swiftly destroyed, and she was captured. We lost all communications with the vessel after that. Would you be willing to help us locate the Star Queen while we prepare a rescue force?"
units.italian: "Ci hanno informato del rapimento ieri. La Star Queen e le sue scorte si preparavano a rifornirsi su Prime, nel sistema Betelgeuse, quando una grande flotta pirata è entrata nel sistema. Le scorte sono state distrutte in fretta e la nave è stata catturata. Dopo di che abbiamo perso ogni comunicazione. Saresti disposto ad aiutarci a localizzare la Star Queen mentre prepariamo una forza di soccorso?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|	"I would be glad to help. I'll prepare my ship immediately."|2029|0
units.english: "I would be glad to help. I'll prepare my ship immediately."
units.italian: "Sarò felice di aiutare. Preparo subito la nave."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|	"Why can't you locate it yourself?"|2031|0
units.english: "Why can't you locate it yourself?"
units.italian: "Perché non potete localizzarla da soli?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|	"Given the importance of the scientists aboard the Star Queen, we took great care in providing them with some of the strongest warships we had. The loss of these ships and their crew is a major blow to Deep Security's combat capabilities. We are recoiling from the impact of this loss while we assemble a proper rescue fleet and are unable to spare any ships for a scout fleet at this moment.|2033|0
units.english: "Given the importance of the scientists aboard the Star Queen, we took great care in providing them with some of the strongest warships we had. The loss of these ships and their crew is a major blow to Deep Security's combat capabilities. We are recoiling from the impact of this loss while we assemble a proper rescue fleet and are unable to spare any ships for a scout fleet at this moment.
units.italian: "Data l'importanza degli scienziati a bordo della Star Queen, avevamo fornito loro alcune delle navi da guerra più potenti che avevamo. La perdita di queste navi e dei loro equipaggi è un colpo durissimo alle capacità di combattimento della Sicurezza del Deep. Stiamo ancora assorbendo il colpo mentre mettiamo insieme una vera flotta di soccorso, e al momento non possiamo distogliere navi per una squadra di ricognizione.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|	"In a situation like this, every minute matters, and if someone like you can find the Star Queen quickly then that means that there is a higher chance everyone can come out of this alive."|2034|0
units.english: "In a situation like this, every minute matters, and if someone like you can find the Star Queen quickly then that means that there is a higher chance everyone can come out of this alive."
units.italian: "In una situazione così ogni minuto conta, e se qualcuno come te può trovare la Star Queen in fretta, allora ci sono più possibilità che tutti ne escano vivi."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|	"Okay, I'm willing to help."|2036|0
units.english: "Okay, I'm willing to help."
units.italian: "Va bene, sono disposto ad aiutare."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|	"Sorry, but this doesn't sound worth it to me."|2038|0
units.english: "Sorry, but this doesn't sound worth it to me."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non mi sembra che ne valga la pena."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|dialog|2042|0
units.english: Upon entering Betelgeuse, you fail to see any trace of the Star Queen. The pirates must have captured it and escaped to a nearby system.
units.italian: Entrando in Betelgeuse non trovi alcuna traccia della Star Queen. I pirati devono averla catturata e essere fuggiti in un sistema vicino.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|dialog|2046|0
units.english: As you enter Arneb, your scanners pick up the Star Queen landing on Haven. Unfortunately, there are also a large number of pirate vessels headed in your direction. You should report back to Paris on <destination> for further instruction.
units.italian: Entrando in Arneb i tuoi scanner rilevano la Star Queen che atterra su Haven. Purtroppo ci sono anche molte navi pirata dirette verso di te. Dovresti tornare a riferire a Paris su <destination> per ulteriori istruzioni.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0|dialog|2048|0
units.english: You have landed on Valhalla, but you have not located the Star Queen! Find it somewhere in the Far North.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su Valhalla, ma non hai localizzato la Star Queen! Trovala da qualche parte nel Far North.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0: Prime|The Star Queen is not in this system, so you attempt to find somebody who may have some information. After visiting several shops, you find a merchant who was clearing cargo through customs as the Star Queen departed. According to her, a large pirate fleet jumped in, eviscerated the escorts with weapons she had never seen before, and escaped north towards Rigel with the hostage Star Queen. You can only hope the trail is not already cold.|2063|0
units.english: The Star Queen is not in this system, so you attempt to find somebody who may have some information. After visiting several shops, you find a merchant who was clearing cargo through customs as the Star Queen departed. According to her, a large pirate fleet jumped in, eviscerated the escorts with weapons she had never seen before, and escaped north towards Rigel with the hostage Star Queen. You can only hope the trail is not already cold.
units.italian: La Star Queen non è in questo sistema, quindi cerchi qualcuno che possa avere informazioni. Dopo aver visitato diversi negozi trovi una mercantessa che stava sdoganando il carico quando la Star Queen è partita. Secondo lei, una grande flotta pirata è saltata dentro, ha squarciato le scorte con armi che non aveva mai visto, ed è fuggita verso nord in direzione di Rigel con la Star Queen come ostaggio. Non ti resta che sperare che la pista non si sia già raffreddata.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0: Farpoint|After speaking with a Navy officer for a few minutes, you find out that the Star Queen came through here over a week ago, escorted by several large pirate ships. The Navy did not want to risk the lives of those on the ship by engaging the pirate fleet, so they let it continue north.|2077|0
units.english: After speaking with a Navy officer for a few minutes, you find out that the Star Queen came through here over a week ago, escorted by several large pirate ships. The Navy did not want to risk the lives of those on the ship by engaging the pirate fleet, so they let it continue north.
units.italian: Dopo aver parlato qualche minuto con un ufficiale della Marina, scopri che la Star Queen è passata di qui più di una settimana fa, scortata da diverse grandi navi pirata. La Marina non ha voluto rischiare la vita di chi era a bordo attaccando la flotta pirata, quindi l'ha lasciata proseguire verso nord.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0: Farpoint|	You spot preparations for a rescue mission, but upon inquiring, learn that the recent destruction of a number of Navy capital ships in the days preceding the Star Queen's abduction resulted in an order to wait for additional reinforcements before any Navy ships are allowed to leave station.|2078|0
units.english: You spot preparations for a rescue mission, but upon inquiring, learn that the recent destruction of a number of Navy capital ships in the days preceding the Star Queen's abduction resulted in an order to wait for additional reinforcements before any Navy ships are allowed to leave station.
units.italian: Noti i preparativi per una missione di soccorso, ma chiedendo scopri che la recente distruzione di diverse capitali della Marina nei giorni precedenti al rapimento della Star Queen ha portato all'ordine di attendere altri rinforzi prima che qualsiasi nave della Marina possa lasciare la stazione.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0: Farpoint|	The Navy officer ends by hinting that the Star Queen is likely to be in Alnilam or Arneb, as those systems are the farthest from anyone looking to find or rescue the ship.|2079|0
units.english: The Navy officer ends by hinting that the Star Queen is likely to be in Alnilam or Arneb, as those systems are the farthest from anyone looking to find or rescue the ship.
units.italian: L'ufficiale della Marina chiude suggerendo che la Star Queen sia probabilmente in Alnilam o in Arneb, dato che quei sistemi sono i più lontani da chiunque cerchi di trovarla o salvarla.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 0: Haven|You spend a few hours scanning the surface of the planet in an attempt to find the Star Queen, but nothing comes up. It will likely require military-grade scanners in order to find the ship, which the Deep Security rescue fleet will undoubtedly have.|2112|0
units.english: You spend a few hours scanning the surface of the planet in an attempt to find the Star Queen, but nothing comes up. It will likely require military-grade scanners in order to find the ship, which the Deep Security rescue fleet will undoubtedly have.
units.italian: Passi qualche ora a scansionare la superficie del pianeta cercando la Star Queen, ma non emerge nulla. Per trovarla serviranno probabilmente scanner di livello militare, che la flotta di soccorso della Sicurezza del Deep avrà di sicuro.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1|name|2139|0
units.english: Secure the Scientists
units.italian: Mettere in salvo gli scienziati

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1|description|2140|0
units.english: Escort the <npc> to <destination> to retrieve the Star Queen. Escorts will be waiting for you on Memory in the Zosma system and Farpoint in the Alnitak system.
units.italian: Scorta la <npc> fino a <destination> per recuperare la Star Queen. Le scorte ti aspetteranno su Memory, nel sistema Zosma, e su Farpoint, nel sistema Alnitak.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1|log|2149|0
units.english: Located the Deep Star Queen that was kidnapped by pirates while en route to Gorvi. Deep Security has finished gathering their rescue fleet and will soon be making the trip to rescue the scientists.
units.italian: Ho localizzato la Star Queen del Deep, rapita dai pirati mentre era diretta a Gorvi. La Sicurezza del Deep ha finito di radunare la flotta di soccorso e partirà presto per salvare gli scienziati.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1|log|2150|0
units.english: Paris is a high ranking guard in Deep Security, equivalent to an admiral in the Republic Navy. While most of Deep Security is designed to keep the Deep safe internally and repel any pirates that might try to make their way into the region, Paris is in charge of Deep Security's external affairs, defending the Deep's interests outside its own borders.
units.italian: Paris è un alto ufficiale della Sicurezza del Deep, equivalente a un ammiraglio della Marina della Repubblica. Mentre la maggior parte della Sicurezza del Deep è pensata per proteggere l'interno del Deep e respingere i pirati che tentano di entrarvi, Paris è responsabile degli affari esterni: difende gli interessi del Deep fuori dai suoi confini.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1|You return to Valhalla and find Lieutenant Paris with a large group of men and women in Deep Security uniforms. As you approach them, the Lieutenant stops speaking to the group after noticing you. "Captain <last>! Have you located the Star Queen?"|2152|0
units.english: You return to Valhalla and find Lieutenant Paris with a large group of men and women in Deep Security uniforms. As you approach them, the Lieutenant stops speaking to the group after noticing you. "Captain <last>! Have you located the Star Queen?"
units.italian: Torni su Valhalla e trovi il tenente Paris con un folto gruppo di uomini e donne in uniforme della Sicurezza del Deep. Mentre ti avvicini, il tenente smette di parlare al gruppo dopo averti notato. "Capitano <last>! Hai localizzato la Star Queen?"

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1|	"Yes, it is located on <destination>, but is heavily defended."|2154|0
units.english: "Yes, it is located on <destination>, but is heavily defended."
units.italian: "Sì, si trova su <destination>, ma è pesantemente difesa."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1|	You mention the multiple heavy warships that you saw in the system, and the fact that there are likely many more waiting on Haven.|2158|0
units.english: You mention the multiple heavy warships that you saw in the system, and the fact that there are likely many more waiting on Haven.
units.italian: Accenni alle numerose navi da guerra pesanti che hai visto nel sistema, e al fatto che probabilmente ce ne sono molte altre su Haven.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1|	You mention the multiple heavy warships that you saw in the system, and the fact that there are likely many more waiting on Haven. You also relay the merchant's claim that the pirates were using weapons she had never seen before.|2162|0
units.english: You mention the multiple heavy warships that you saw in the system, and the fact that there are likely many more waiting on Haven. You also relay the merchant's claim that the pirates were using weapons she had never seen before.
units.italian: Accenni alle numerose navi da guerra pesanti che hai visto nel sistema, e al fatto che probabilmente ce ne sono molte altre su Haven. Riferisci anche quanto detto dalla mercantessa, e cioè che i pirati usavano armi che non aveva mai visto.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1|	After hearing this news, many of the faces in the group turn grim as they realize that they will need to fight to retrieve the Star Queen. Paris ponders this information for a moment, then turns back to the group. "Guards, ready your ships!" The group responds with a collective "Sir, yes sir!" before running off to their ships.|2165|0
units.english: After hearing this news, many of the faces in the group turn grim as they realize that they will need to fight to retrieve the Star Queen. Paris ponders this information for a moment, then turns back to the group. "Guards, ready your ships!" The group responds with a collective "Sir, yes sir!" before running off to their ships.
units.italian: Sentita la notizia, molti volti del gruppo si fanno cupi: capiscono che dovranno combattere per recuperare la Star Queen. Paris riflette un momento, poi si rivolge di nuovo al gruppo. "Guardie, preparate le navi!" Il gruppo risponde all'unisono: "Sissignore!" e corre verso le navi.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1|	Before leaving for his own ship, he walks up to you and hands you <payment>.|2166|0
units.english: Before leaving for his own ship, he walks up to you and hands you <payment>.
units.italian: Prima di andare alla sua nave, si avvicina e ti consegna <payment>.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1|	"Thank you for locating the Star Queen. Now, Captain <last>, would you be willing to help us? If the Star Queen is as heavily defended as you say it is, we are going to need every ship we can get."|2167|0
units.english: "Thank you for locating the Star Queen. Now, Captain <last>, would you be willing to help us? If the Star Queen is as heavily defended as you say it is, we are going to need every ship we can get."
units.italian: "Grazie per aver localizzato la Star Queen. Ora, capitano <last>, saresti disposto ad aiutarci? Se la Star Queen è difesa pesantemente come dici, ci servirà ogni nave disponibile."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1|	"I'd be glad to."|2169|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to."
units.italian: "Volentieri."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1|	"I would rather let the professionals handle things. Good luck."|2170|0
units.english: "I would rather let the professionals handle things. Good luck."
units.italian: "Preferisco lasciare che se ne occupino i professionisti. Buona fortuna."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1|	"Thank you so much. The plan is to rendezvous with a number of warships on Memory and then head to Alnitak. My superiors received word from the admiral on Farpoint that there are a number of Navy ships at the ready to avenge their fallen comrades, so I expect we'll pick up some help there when we refuel. After the fleet is mustered, we go to Arneb." He smiles tensely, adding, "Just make sure that the <npc> makes it onto the planet. She'll be carrying the landing crew, along with myself."|2173|0
units.english: "Thank you so much. The plan is to rendezvous with a number of warships on Memory and then head to Alnitak. My superiors received word from the admiral on Farpoint that there are a number of Navy ships at the ready to avenge their fallen comrades, so I expect we'll pick up some help there when we refuel. After the fleet is mustered, we go to Arneb." He smiles tensely, adding, "Just make sure that the <npc> makes it onto the planet. She'll be carrying the landing crew, along with myself."
units.italian: "Grazie mille. Il piano è di dare appuntamento a diverse navi da guerra su Memory e poi dirigerci su Alnitak. I miei superiori hanno saputo dall'ammiraglio su Farpoint che ci sono alcune navi della Marina pronte a vendicare i commilitoni caduti, quindi conto di raccogliere altro aiuto là quando riforniremo. Radunata la flotta, andiamo in Arneb." Sorride teso e aggiunge: "Assicurati solo che la <npc> arrivi sul pianeta. Porterà la squadra d'assalto, insieme a me."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1|	The communications device on his belt rings, and he quickly responds, giving orders to the fleet that will be joining you on the mission. Before you can return to your ship, he says, "Good luck, Captain, and may we all make it out of this alive. We'll meet you in orbit."|2174|0
units.english: The communications device on his belt rings, and he quickly responds, giving orders to the fleet that will be joining you on the mission. Before you can return to your ship, he says, "Good luck, Captain, and may we all make it out of this alive. We'll meet you in orbit."
units.italian: Il dispositivo di comunicazione alla sua cintura squilla, e lui risponde subito, dando ordini alla flotta che si unirà a voi nella missione. Prima che tu possa tornare alla nave, dice: "Buona fortuna, capitano, e che ne usciamo tutti vivi. Ci vediamo in orbita."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1|dialog|2183|0
units.english: You have landed on Haven, but you left the <npc> behind! Wait for the <npc> to enter the system before landing.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su Haven, ma hai lasciato indietro la <npc>! Aspetta che la <npc> entri nel sistema prima di atterrare.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1: Recruit Escorts|name|2221|0
units.english: Deep Security escorts on <planet>
units.italian: Scorte della Sicurezza del Deep su <planet>

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1: Recruit Escorts|description|2222|0
units.english: Lieutenant Paris mentioned an escort squadron of Deep Security ships was preparing to join you on your mission. Meet up with them on <destination>, if you want to.
units.italian: Il tenente Paris ha accennato a uno squadrone di scorta della Sicurezza del Deep pronto a unirsi alla tua missione. Incontralo su <destination>, se vuoi.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1: Escorts|As you land, you notice a group of Deep Security warships - three Aeries and their fighter squadrons - loading munitions just outside of the spaceport. Before you can make it into the spaceport, one of the pilots waves you over for a brief conversation: aside from a few trivial items left on their preflight checklist, the warships are ready to launch and join in on the rescue mission.|2245|0
units.english: As you land, you notice a group of Deep Security warships - three Aeries and their fighter squadrons - loading munitions just outside of the spaceport. Before you can make it into the spaceport, one of the pilots waves you over for a brief conversation: aside from a few trivial items left on their preflight checklist, the warships are ready to launch and join in on the rescue mission.
units.italian: Mentre atterri, noti un gruppo di navi da guerra della Sicurezza del Deep (tre Aerie con i loro squadroni di caccia) che caricano munizioni appena fuori dallo spazioporto. Prima che tu riesca a entrare nello spazioporto, uno dei piloti ti fa cenno di avvicinarti per una breve conversazione: a parte qualche sciocchezza rimasta nella lista pre-volo, le navi sono pronte a partire e a unirsi alla missione di soccorso.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1: Recruit Reinforcements|name|2262|0
units.english: Republic Navy escorts on <planet>
units.italian: Scorte della Marina della Repubblica su <planet>

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1: Recruit Reinforcements|description|2263|0
units.english: Lieutenant Paris mentioned that some Navy officers were interested in avenging the loss of their comrades. Meet up with them on <destination>, if you want to.
units.italian: Il tenente Paris ha detto che alcuni ufficiali della Marina volevano vendicare i commilitoni caduti. Incontrali su <destination>, se vuoi.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 1: Reinforcements|While refueling at the Farpoint Navy base, you are approached by two Navy officers who recognize you as Captain <last>. They tell you that Lieutenant Paris contacted them a few days ago, indicating that the rescue fleet was en route and would be reaching the Alnitak system shortly. They inform you that they have requisitioned two Cruisers to assist in the Star Queen's retrieval, and depart for their ships.|2286|0
units.english: While refueling at the Farpoint Navy base, you are approached by two Navy officers who recognize you as Captain <last>. They tell you that Lieutenant Paris contacted them a few days ago, indicating that the rescue fleet was en route and would be reaching the Alnitak system shortly. They inform you that they have requisitioned two Cruisers to assist in the Star Queen's retrieval, and depart for their ships.
units.italian: Mentre fai rifornimento alla base della Marina su Farpoint, ti si avvicinano due ufficiali della Marina che ti riconoscono come capitano <last>. Ti dicono che il tenente Paris li ha contattati alcuni giorni fa, indicando che la flotta di soccorso era in viaggio e avrebbe raggiunto il sistema Alnitak a breve. Ti informano di aver requisito due Incrociatori per aiutare nel recupero della Star Queen, e si avviano verso le loro navi.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 2|name|2315|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 2|description|2316|0
units.english: Now that you have secured the Star Queen, escort it safely to <destination>.
units.italian: Ora che hai messo al sicuro la Star Queen, scortala fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 2|The remaining fleet quickly enters the atmosphere of Haven and begins scanning the surface. After roughly an hour of flying, you receive a transmission that the Star Queen has been found, along with its coordinates.|2324|0
units.english: The remaining fleet quickly enters the atmosphere of Haven and begins scanning the surface. After roughly an hour of flying, you receive a transmission that the Star Queen has been found, along with its coordinates.
units.italian: La flotta rimasta entra in fretta nell'atmosfera di Haven e comincia a scansionare la superficie. Dopo circa un'ora di volo ricevi una trasmissione: la Star Queen è stata trovata, e arrivano le sue coordinate.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 2|	You watch from afar as the Mule lands outside a hangar in some sort of pirate facility. The Mule immediately unloads what looks to be at least four dozen armed soldiers who quickly surround and breach the hangar. "Lieutenant, they have alien technology in here," one of the soldiers says over the radio. "Some of it is from the Hai, but some of it I've never seen before."|2325|0
units.english: You watch from afar as the Mule lands outside a hangar in some sort of pirate facility. The Mule immediately unloads what looks to be at least four dozen armed soldiers who quickly surround and breach the hangar. "Lieutenant, they have alien technology in here," one of the soldiers says over the radio. "Some of it is from the Hai, but some of it I've never seen before."
units.italian: Osservi da lontano il Mule che atterra fuori da un hangar, in una specie di installazione pirata. Il Mule sbarca subito quella che sembra essere almeno una quarantina di soldati armati, che circondano rapidamente l'hangar e lo sfondano. "Tenente, qui hanno tecnologia aliena," dice uno dei soldati alla radio. "Una parte viene dagli Hai, ma dell'altra non ho mai visto niente di simile."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 2|	"Plant explosives on any alien technology you find. We don't have the capabilities to take it all back with us. It's better off destroyed."|2326|0
units.english: "Plant explosives on any alien technology you find. We don't have the capabilities to take it all back with us. It's better off destroyed."
units.italian: "Piazzate esplosivi su tutta la tecnologia aliena che trovate. Non abbiamo i mezzi per portarcela tutta via. Meglio distruggerla."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 2|	After fifteen minutes, the hangar doors slide open to reveal the Star Queen, still intact. You hear chatter over the radio saying that most of the crew and scientists are still inside.|2327|0
units.english: After fifteen minutes, the hangar doors slide open to reveal the Star Queen, still intact. You hear chatter over the radio saying that most of the crew and scientists are still inside.
units.italian: Dopo quindici minuti le porte dell'hangar si aprono scorrendo e rivelano la Star Queen, ancora intatta. Alla radio senti dire che la maggior parte dell'equipaggio e degli scienziati è ancora a bordo.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 2|	"Good job, everyone," you hear Lieutenant Paris say over the comms. "Now we just need to make it back to <destination> in one piece." Just as he says that, a bright light pierces the sky, obliterating the Mule while its shields are down. Soldiers begin scrambling into the Star Queen, which quickly takes off into space along with the rest of the fleet. You turn your repulsor engines to full and begin flying up into space behind them as multiple explosions come from the facility behind you.|2328|0
units.english: "Good job, everyone," you hear Lieutenant Paris say over the comms. "Now we just need to make it back to <destination> in one piece." Just as he says that, a bright light pierces the sky, obliterating the Mule while its shields are down. Soldiers begin scrambling into the Star Queen, which quickly takes off into space along with the rest of the fleet. You turn your repulsor engines to full and begin flying up into space behind them as multiple explosions come from the facility behind you.
units.italian: "Bel lavoro, ragazzi," senti dire dal tenente Paris via radio. "Ora dobbiamo solo tornare su <destination> tutti interi." Proprio mentre lo dice, una luce intensa squarcia il cielo e oblitera il Mule mentre i suoi scudi sono abbassati. I soldati si precipitano dentro la Star Queen, che decolla subito verso lo spazio insieme al resto della flotta. Dai il massimo ai motori repulsori e cominci a salire dietro di loro mentre dall'installazione alle tue spalle arrivano esplosioni multiple.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 2|dialog|2332|0
units.english: As your engines roar, you notice a large pirate ship looming over the planet. Even from the underside, it is undeniably a Bactrian, but how a pirate could ever attain one is a mystery.
units.italian: Mentre i motori ruggiscono, noti una grande nave pirata incombere sul pianeta. Anche vista da sotto è innegabilmente una Bactrian, ma come un pirata possa essersene procurata una resta un mistero.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 2|dialog|2333|0
units.english: You receive a transmission from Lieutenant Paris. "I have a sneaking suspicion that Beelzebub may be behind this. I suggest we jump out of here immediately and make it back to the Deep alive before taking on that Bactrian."
units.italian: Ricevi una trasmissione dal tenente Paris. "Ho il sospetto che dietro tutto questo ci sia Belzebù. Suggerisco di saltare via subito e di tornare nel Deep vivi, prima di affrontare quella Bactrian."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 2|dialog|2341|0
units.english: You have landed on Valhalla, but you left the <npc> behind! Wait for it to enter the system before landing.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su Valhalla, ma hai lasciato indietro la <npc>! Aspetta che entri nel sistema prima di atterrare.

units.id: ship:Bactrian|"Bondir" Atomic Thruster|2367|0
units.english: "Bondir" Atomic Thruster
units.italian: "Bondir" Atomic Thruster

units.id: ship:Bactrian|"Bufaer" Atomic Steering|2368|0
units.english: "Bufaer" Atomic Steering
units.italian: "Bufaer" Atomic Steering

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 2: Pirate Bactrian|After the Bactrian is eliminated, you receive a transmission from an unknown source. It suddenly opens on its own and an electronically distorted voice begins speaking to you.|2397|0
units.english: After the Bactrian is eliminated, you receive a transmission from an unknown source. It suddenly opens on its own and an electronically distorted voice begins speaking to you.
units.italian: Dopo che la Bactrian è stata eliminata, ricevi una trasmissione da una fonte sconosciuta. Si apre da sola di colpo e una voce distorta elettronicamente comincia a parlarti.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 2: Pirate Bactrian|	"Well done, Captain. Well done at being a thorn in my side. You will pay for this. One day."|2398|0
units.english: "Well done, Captain. Well done at being a thorn in my side. You will pay for this. One day."
units.italian: "Ben fatto, capitano. Ben fatto a essere una spina nel mio fianco. Me la pagherai. Un giorno."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 2: Pirate Bactrian|The transmission cuts out as abruptly as it had started.|2399|0
units.english: The transmission cuts out as abruptly as it had started.
units.italian: La trasmissione si interrompe bruscamente com'era cominciata.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|name|2423|0
units.english: Take down the Devil
units.italian: Abbattere il Diavolo

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|description|2424|0
units.english: You have returned the scientists, but the pirates still have a Bactrian. Eliminate it and return to <destination>.
units.italian: Hai riportato indietro gli scienziati, ma i pirati hanno ancora una Bactrian. Eliminala e torna su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|log|2434|0
units.english: Escorted the rescued Star Queen back to the Deep. Some of the crew didn't make it. The pirates still have a Bactrian, and the Deep wants it destroyed.
units.italian: Ho scortato nel Deep la Star Queen salvata. Parte dell'equipaggio non ce l'ha fatta. I pirati hanno ancora una Bactrian, e il Deep vuole che sia distrutta.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|As you land near the Star Queen, you can see its passengers being escorted off. Hannah comes running off the ship in tears over to Garrison, who must have arrived as soon as he heard the news. A medical team is examining each passenger while a Deep Security officer asks questions and jots down the responses. Sadly, you also notice a number of body bags next to the ship, likely from scientists or crew that were found dead on the ship.|2436|0
units.english: As you land near the Star Queen, you can see its passengers being escorted off. Hannah comes running off the ship in tears over to Garrison, who must have arrived as soon as he heard the news. A medical team is examining each passenger while a Deep Security officer asks questions and jots down the responses. Sadly, you also notice a number of body bags next to the ship, likely from scientists or crew that were found dead on the ship.
units.italian: Mentre atterri vicino alla Star Queen, vedi i passeggeri che vengono fatti scendere. Hannah corre giù dalla nave in lacrime verso Garrison, che deve essere arrivato appena saputa la notizia. Una squadra medica visita ogni passeggero mentre un ufficiale della Sicurezza del Deep fa domande e annota le risposte. Purtroppo noti anche diversi sacchi per cadaveri accanto alla nave: probabilmente scienziati o membri dell'equipaggio trovati morti a bordo.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|	Lieutenant Paris is waiting for you outside of your ship, and hands you another <payment> when you walk up to him. "Thanks for all the help, Captain <last>. We couldn't have done it without you."|2437|0
units.english: Lieutenant Paris is waiting for you outside of your ship, and hands you another <payment> when you walk up to him. "Thanks for all the help, Captain <last>. We couldn't have done it without you."
units.italian: Il tenente Paris ti aspetta fuori dalla nave e, quando gli vai incontro, ti consegna altri <payment>. "Grazie per tutto l'aiuto, capitano <last>. Senza di te non ce l'avremmo fatta."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|	Paris looks back to the Star Queen, and you can overhear one of the Deep Security officers listing off names. "Sarah Reevs, Nicole Faye, Pierre Joules, Laura Paris..." the list goes on for slightly over a dozen total names. "The surviving crew tells us that only a few were killed initially, either during boarding or by being thrown out the airlock on the way to Haven. Most of the others were either killed or dragged off after they had reached their destination at a facility of some sort, its purpose unidentifiable to the crew."|2438|0
units.english: Paris looks back to the Star Queen, and you can overhear one of the Deep Security officers listing off names. "Sarah Reevs, Nicole Faye, Pierre Joules, Laura Paris..." the list goes on for slightly over a dozen total names. "The surviving crew tells us that only a few were killed initially, either during boarding or by being thrown out the airlock on the way to Haven. Most of the others were either killed or dragged off after they had reached their destination at a facility of some sort, its purpose unidentifiable to the crew."
units.italian: Paris si volta verso la Star Queen, e senti uno degli ufficiali della Sicurezza del Deep che elenca nomi. "Sarah Reevs, Nicole Faye, Pierre Joules, Laura Paris..." la lista continua per poco più di una dozzina di nomi. "L'equipaggio sopravvissuto dice che solo pochi sono stati uccisi sul momento, durante l'abbordaggio o gettati fuori dal portello nello spazio verso Haven. La maggior parte degli altri è stata uccisa o portata via dopo l'arrivo a una specie di installazione, il cui scopo l'equipaggio non è riuscito a capire."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|	When you look back to Lieutenant Paris, you notice that he is holding back tears. Laura Paris was one of the scientists who died.|2439|0
units.english: When you look back to Lieutenant Paris, you notice that he is holding back tears. Laura Paris was one of the scientists who died.
units.italian: Quando torni a guardare il tenente Paris, ti accorgi che trattiene le lacrime. Laura Paris era una degli scienziati morti.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|	He talks to you in a rather strained voice. "I want you to return to Arneb and take out every single one of those pirates that are left. Especially the Bactrian. We try to keep Bactrians out of unworthy hands, so whenever a pirate gets one we make sure we destroy it immediately. Seeing as how we're going to be busy here for a while, you need to be the one who destroys it."|2440|0
units.english: He talks to you in a rather strained voice. "I want you to return to Arneb and take out every single one of those pirates that are left. Especially the Bactrian. We try to keep Bactrians out of unworthy hands, so whenever a pirate gets one we make sure we destroy it immediately. Seeing as how we're going to be busy here for a while, you need to be the one who destroys it."
units.italian: Ti parla con la voce piuttosto tesa. "Voglio che tu torni in Arneb e elimini ogni singolo pirata rimasto. Soprattutto la Bactrian. Cerchiamo di tenere le Bactrian fuori da mani indegne, e ogni volta che un pirata ne mette le mani su una ci assicuriamo di distruggerla subito. Dato che qui saremo occupati per un po', devi essere tu a distruggerla."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|	"I'll make sure it gets done, Lieutenant."|2442|0
units.english: "I'll make sure it gets done, Lieutenant."
units.italian: "Farò in modo che sia fatto, tenente."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|	"I'm sorry, but I don't have the power to defeat that Bactrian. You're going to need to do it yourself."|2444|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I don't have the power to defeat that Bactrian. You're going to need to do it yourself."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non ho la potenza per abbattere quella Bactrian. Dovrete occuparvene voi."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|	"I see... Good luck on your travels, Captain <last>." Lieutenant Paris starts walking over to the Star Queen, leaving you alone next to your ship.|2446|0
units.english: "I see... Good luck on your travels, Captain <last>." Lieutenant Paris starts walking over to the Star Queen, leaving you alone next to your ship.
units.italian: "Capisco... Buona fortuna nei tuoi viaggi, capitano <last>." Il tenente Paris si avvia verso la Star Queen, lasciandoti solo accanto alla nave.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|	"Thank you, <first>." Lieutenant Paris starts walking over to the Star Queen, leaving you alone next to your ship.|2450|0
units.english: "Thank you, <first>." Lieutenant Paris starts walking over to the Star Queen, leaving you alone next to your ship.
units.italian: "Grazie, <first>." Il tenente Paris si avvia verso la Star Queen, lasciandoti solo accanto alla nave.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|After the Bactrian is eliminated, you receive a transmission from an unknown source. It suddenly opens on its own and an electronically distorted voice begins speaking to you.|2459|0
units.english: After the Bactrian is eliminated, you receive a transmission from an unknown source. It suddenly opens on its own and an electronically distorted voice begins speaking to you.
units.italian: Dopo che la Bactrian è stata eliminata, ricevi una trasmissione da una fonte sconosciuta. Si apre da sola di colpo e una voce distorta elettronicamente comincia a parlarti.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|	"Well done, Captain. Well done at being a thorn in my side. You will pay for this. One day."|2460|0
units.english: "Well done, Captain. Well done at being a thorn in my side. You will pay for this. One day."
units.italian: "Ben fatto, capitano. Ben fatto a essere una spina nel mio fianco. Me la pagherai. Un giorno."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|The transmission cuts out as abruptly as it had started.|2461|0
units.english: The transmission cuts out as abruptly as it had started.
units.italian: La trasmissione si interrompe bruscamente com'era cominciata.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|dialog|2465|0
units.english: You landed on Valhalla, but you didn't kill the Bactrian! Return to Arneb and make sure that the Bactrian is destroyed and forever out of pirate hands.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su Valhalla, ma non hai ucciso la Bactrian! Torna in Arneb e assicurati che la Bactrian sia distrutta e per sempre fuori dalle mani dei pirati.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|log|2471|0
units.english: Destroyed the pirate Bactrian that was attempting to prevent the rescue of the Star Queen and was given a city-ship license by Paris.
units.italian: Ho distrutto la Bactrian pirata che cercava di impedire il salvataggio della Star Queen, e Paris mi ha dato una licenza per navi-città.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|log|2472|0
units.english: Deep Security suspect that Beelzebub was behind the kidnapping of a Star Queen full of Deep scientists. In the attempt to rescue the scientists, a pirate owned Bactrian known as the "Cosmic Devil" was destroyed, although it would appear that either Beelzebub was not on the ship, or escaped the ship before it was destroyed.
units.italian: La Sicurezza del Deep sospetta che Belzebù sia dietro il rapimento di una Star Queen piena di scienziati del Deep. Nel tentativo di salvare gli scienziati è stata distrutta una Bactrian pirata nota come "Diavolo Cosmico", anche se sembra che Belzebù non fosse a bordo, o che sia fuggito prima della distruzione.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|When you return to Valhalla, the Star Queen is no longer on the landing pad and the spaceport seems to be running normally. Shortly after landing, you find Lieutenant Paris at the same restaurant in which he first found you. Before saying a word to you, he hands you a license.|2474|0
units.english: When you return to Valhalla, the Star Queen is no longer on the landing pad and the spaceport seems to be running normally. Shortly after landing, you find Lieutenant Paris at the same restaurant in which he first found you. Before saying a word to you, he hands you a license.
units.italian: Quando torni su Valhalla, la Star Queen non è più sulla piazzola e lo spazioporto sembra funzionare normalmente. Poco dopo l'atterraggio trovi il tenente Paris nello stesso ristorante in cui ti aveva trovato la prima volta. Prima di dirti una parola, ti consegna una licenza.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|	"Thank you. I've said it before, but there's really no way I can thank you enough."|2475|0
units.english: "Thank you. I've said it before, but there's really no way I can thank you enough."
units.italian: "Grazie. L'ho già detto, ma non c'è modo di ringraziarti abbastanza."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|	You look down at the license that Paris just handed you and notice that it's a city-ship license, one that will allow you to purchase the Bactrian. "I think it's only fair that you be able to purchase one after having to fight one to the death, and the government of the Deep agrees. It's really the least I... we could do for you."|2476|0
units.english: You look down at the license that Paris just handed you and notice that it's a city-ship license, one that will allow you to purchase the Bactrian. "I think it's only fair that you be able to purchase one after having to fight one to the death, and the government of the Deep agrees. It's really the least I... we could do for you."
units.italian: Guardi la licenza che Paris ti ha appena consegnato e noti che è una licenza per navi-città, quella che ti permetterà di acquistare una Bactrian. "Mi sembra giusto che tu possa comprarne una dopo averne dovuta combattere una fino alla morte, e il governo del Deep è d'accordo. È davvero il minimo che io... che noi potessimo fare per te."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|	"Thank you so much! I'll make sure that this gets put to good use."|2478|0
units.english: "Thank you so much! I'll make sure that this gets put to good use."
units.italian: "Grazie mille! Farò in modo che venga usata bene."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|	"Really? You shouldn't have."|2479|0
units.english: "Really? You shouldn't have."
units.italian: "Davvero? Non dovevate."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3A|	"It's yours to keep. I hope you have good luck with your travels, and have fun using the Bactrian. It's a mighty fine ship to fly." Lieutenant Paris pays his bill and leaves, as you ponder the possibilities that await.|2481|0
units.english: "It's yours to keep. I hope you have good luck with your travels, and have fun using the Bactrian. It's a mighty fine ship to fly." Lieutenant Paris pays his bill and leaves, as you ponder the possibilities that await.
units.italian: "È tua. Spero che i tuoi viaggi siano fortunati, e divertiti con la Bactrian: è una nave splendida da pilotare." Il tenente Paris paga il conto ed esce, mentre rifletti sulle possibilità che ti attendono.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3B|log|2497|0
units.english: Escorted the rescued Star Queen back to the Deep. Some of the crew didn't make it. Destroyed the pirate Bactrian that was attempting to prevent the rescue of the Star Queen and was given a city-ship license by Paris.
units.italian: Ho scortato nel Deep la Star Queen salvata. Parte dell'equipaggio non ce l'ha fatta. Ho distrutto la Bactrian pirata che cercava di impedire il salvataggio della Star Queen, e Paris mi ha dato una licenza per navi-città.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3B|log|2498|0
units.english: Deep Security suspect that Beelzebub was behind the kidnapping of a Star Queen full of Deep scientists. In the attempt to rescue the scientists, a pirate owned Bactrian known as the "Cosmic Devil" was destroyed, although it would appear that either Beelzebub was not on the ship, or escaped the ship before it was destroyed.
units.italian: La Sicurezza del Deep sospetta che Belzebù sia dietro il rapimento di una Star Queen piena di scienziati del Deep. Nel tentativo di salvare gli scienziati è stata distrutta una Bactrian pirata nota come "Diavolo Cosmico", anche se sembra che Belzebù non fosse a bordo, o che sia fuggito prima della distruzione.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3B|As you land near the Star Queen, you can see its passengers being escorted off. Hannah comes running off the ship in tears over to Garrison, who must have arrived as soon as he heard the news. A medical team is examining each passenger while a Deep Security officer asks questions and jots down the responses. Sadly, you also notice a number of body bags next to the ship, likely from scientists or crew that were found dead on the ship.|2500|0
units.english: As you land near the Star Queen, you can see its passengers being escorted off. Hannah comes running off the ship in tears over to Garrison, who must have arrived as soon as he heard the news. A medical team is examining each passenger while a Deep Security officer asks questions and jots down the responses. Sadly, you also notice a number of body bags next to the ship, likely from scientists or crew that were found dead on the ship.
units.italian: Mentre atterri vicino alla Star Queen, vedi i passeggeri che vengono fatti scendere. Hannah corre giù dalla nave in lacrime verso Garrison, che deve essere arrivato appena saputa la notizia. Una squadra medica visita ogni passeggero mentre un ufficiale della Sicurezza del Deep fa domande e annota le risposte. Purtroppo noti anche diversi sacchi per cadaveri accanto alla nave: probabilmente scienziati o membri dell'equipaggio trovati morti a bordo.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3B|	Lieutenant Paris is waiting for you outside of your ship, and hands you another <payment> when you walk up to him. "Thanks for all the help, Captain <last>. We couldn't have done it without you."|2501|0
units.english: Lieutenant Paris is waiting for you outside of your ship, and hands you another <payment> when you walk up to him. "Thanks for all the help, Captain <last>. We couldn't have done it without you."
units.italian: Il tenente Paris ti aspetta fuori dalla nave e, quando gli vai incontro, ti consegna altri <payment>. "Grazie per tutto l'aiuto, capitano <last>. Senza di te non ce l'avremmo fatta."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3B|	Paris looks back to the Star Queen, and you can overhear one of the Deep Security officers listing off names. "Sarah Reevs, Nicole Faye, Pierre Joules, Laura Paris..." the list goes on for slightly over a dozen total names. "The surviving crew tells us that only a few were killed initially, either during boarding or by being thrown out the airlock on the way to Haven. Most of the others were either killed or dragged off after they had reached their destination at a facility of some sort, its purpose unidentifiable to the crew."|2502|0
units.english: Paris looks back to the Star Queen, and you can overhear one of the Deep Security officers listing off names. "Sarah Reevs, Nicole Faye, Pierre Joules, Laura Paris..." the list goes on for slightly over a dozen total names. "The surviving crew tells us that only a few were killed initially, either during boarding or by being thrown out the airlock on the way to Haven. Most of the others were either killed or dragged off after they had reached their destination at a facility of some sort, its purpose unidentifiable to the crew."
units.italian: Paris si volta verso la Star Queen, e senti uno degli ufficiali della Sicurezza del Deep che elenca nomi. "Sarah Reevs, Nicole Faye, Pierre Joules, Laura Paris..." la lista continua per poco più di una dozzina di nomi. "L'equipaggio sopravvissuto dice che solo pochi sono stati uccisi sul momento, durante l'abbordaggio o gettati fuori dal portello nello spazio verso Haven. La maggior parte degli altri è stata uccisa o portata via dopo l'arrivo a una specie di installazione, il cui scopo l'equipaggio non è riuscito a capire."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3B|	When you look back to Lieutenant Paris, you notice that he is holding back tears. Laura Paris was one of the scientists who died.|2503|0
units.english: When you look back to Lieutenant Paris, you notice that he is holding back tears. Laura Paris was one of the scientists who died.
units.italian: Quando torni a guardare il tenente Paris, ti accorgi che trattiene le lacrime. Laura Paris era una degli scienziati morti.

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3B|	He turns to you and hands you a license, then says in a rather strained voice. "Thank you. I've said it before, but there's really no way I can thank you enough."|2504|0
units.english: He turns to you and hands you a license, then says in a rather strained voice. "Thank you. I've said it before, but there's really no way I can thank you enough."
units.italian: Si volta verso di te, ti consegna una licenza e dice con la voce piuttosto tesa: "Grazie. L'ho già detto, ma non c'è modo di ringraziarti abbastanza."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3B|	You look down at the license that Paris just handed you and notice that it's a city-ship license, one that will allow you to purchase the Bactrian. "I think it's only fair that you be able to purchase one after having to fight one to the death, and the government of the Deep agrees. It's really the least I... we could do for you."|2505|0
units.english: You look down at the license that Paris just handed you and notice that it's a city-ship license, one that will allow you to purchase the Bactrian. "I think it's only fair that you be able to purchase one after having to fight one to the death, and the government of the Deep agrees. It's really the least I... we could do for you."
units.italian: Guardi la licenza che Paris ti ha appena consegnato e noti che è una licenza per navi-città, quella che ti permetterà di acquistare una Bactrian. "Mi sembra giusto che tu possa comprarne una dopo averne dovuta combattere una fino alla morte, e il governo del Deep è d'accordo. È davvero il minimo che io... che noi potessimo fare per te."
