units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3B|	"Thank you so much! I'll make sure that this gets put to good use."|2507|0
units.english: "Thank you so much! I'll make sure that this gets put to good use."
units.italian: "Grazie mille! Farò in modo che venga usata bene."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3B|	"Really? You shouldn't have."|2508|0
units.english: "Really? You shouldn't have."
units.italian: "Davvero? Non dovevate."

units.id: mission:Deep: Scientist Rescue 3B|	"It's yours to keep. I hope you have good luck with your travels, and have fun using the Bactrian. It's a mighty fine ship to fly." Lieutenant Paris starts walking over to the Star Queen, leaving you alone to ponder the possibilities that await.|2510|0
units.english: "It's yours to keep. I hope you have good luck with your travels, and have fun using the Bactrian. It's a mighty fine ship to fly." Lieutenant Paris starts walking over to the Star Queen, leaving you alone to ponder the possibilities that await.
units.italian: "È tua. Spero che i tuoi viaggi siano fortunati, e divertiti con la Bactrian: è una nave splendida da pilotare." Il tenente Paris si avvia verso la Star Queen, lasciandoti solo a riflettere sulle possibilità che ti attendono.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|name|2523|0
units.english: Stone of our Fathers
units.italian: La pietra dei padri

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|description|2524|0
units.english: Travel to <destination>, and drop Skaldgar off at the home he abandoned long ago.
units.italian: Raggiungi <destination> e lascia Skaldgar nella casa che aveva abbandonato tanto tempo fa.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|Helheim's spaceport has all the constant hustle and bustle of a boomtown. It's dirty, lively, and packed with workers. As you walk through the spaceport, an aged man in a worn and weathered roustabout jacket waves his arm toward you and approaches you.|2533|0
units.english: Helheim's spaceport has all the constant hustle and bustle of a boomtown. It's dirty, lively, and packed with workers. As you walk through the spaceport, an aged man in a worn and weathered roustabout jacket waves his arm toward you and approaches you.
units.italian: Lo spazioporto di Helheim ha il viavai incessante di una città in piena corsa all'oro. È sporco, vivace e pieno zeppo di operai. Mentre lo attraversi, un uomo anziano in una giacca da manovale logora e consumata ti fa cenno con il braccio e ti si avvicina.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|	"You've got the look of one who knows a ship inside and out," he says. "Name's Skaldgar, ain't much for ships; earth, soil, and rock are my domain. But I do got a need to travel." He pauses as a wistful look briefly passes over his face. "I left, you see, decades ago. No goodbye. No note. Just... left. Living with others, taking care of others, hard on a man like me. I like solitude, peace, and work. But now my bones are brittle: the radiation, earth-rot as we call it, has taken hold and my time is running out. And I find, I don't want to be alone anymore."|2534|0
units.english: "You've got the look of one who knows a ship inside and out," he says. "Name's Skaldgar, ain't much for ships; earth, soil, and rock are my domain. But I do got a need to travel." He pauses as a wistful look briefly passes over his face. "I left, you see, decades ago. No goodbye. No note. Just... left. Living with others, taking care of others, hard on a man like me. I like solitude, peace, and work. But now my bones are brittle: the radiation, earth-rot as we call it, has taken hold and my time is running out. And I find, I don't want to be alone anymore."
units.italian: "Hai l'aria di uno che conosce una nave da cima a fondo," dice. "Mi chiamo Skaldgar, e di navi non me ne intendo: terra, suolo e roccia sono il mio regno. Però ho bisogno di viaggiare." Si ferma mentre un'espressione malinconica gli attraversa il volto. "Me ne sono andato, sai, decenni fa. Senza un addio. Senza un biglietto. Solo... andato. Vivere con gli altri, prendersi cura degli altri: roba dura per uno come me. A me piacciono la solitudine, la pace e il lavoro. Ma adesso le ossa sono fragili: le radiazioni, la marciaterra come la chiamiamo noi, hanno preso il sopravvento e il tempo stringe. E mi ritrovo a non voler più stare da solo."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|	He stops and frowns. "Look at me, rambling like an ol' man. Ser, Captain, I'd like to pay you <payment> to take me home, to <destination>."|2535|0
units.english: He stops and frowns. "Look at me, rambling like an ol' man. Ser, Captain, I'd like to pay you <payment> to take me home, to <destination>."
units.italian: Si ferma e aggrotta la fronte. "Guardami, che blatero come un vecchio. Ser, capitano, vorrei pagarti <payment> per portarmi a casa, su <destination>."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|	"If you have coin, I have room."|2538|0
units.english: "If you have coin, I have room."
units.italian: "Se hai moneta, ho spazio."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|	"I guess I can take a small detour."|2539|0
units.english: "I guess I can take a small detour."
units.italian: "Suppongo di poter fare una piccola deviazione."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|	"Why are you calling me 'ser'?"|2540|0
units.english: "Why are you calling me 'ser'?"
units.italian: "Perché mi chiami 'ser'?"

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|	"Does 'ser' just apply to men?"|2544|0
units.english: "Does 'ser' just apply to men?"
units.italian: "'Ser' vale solo per gli uomini?"

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|	"Is 'ser' different from 'sir'?"|2549|0
units.english: "Is 'ser' different from 'sir'?"
units.italian: "'Ser' è diverso da 'sir'?"

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|	(Shake my head. I have better things to do than bus old men around.)|2554|0
units.english: (Shake my head. I have better things to do than bus old men around.)
units.italian: (Scuoto la testa. Ho di meglio da fare che scarrozzare vecchietti in giro.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|	He nods, grunts, and heads to your ship with a small knapsack cradled under his arm, clearly ready to travel to <planet> at a moment's notice.|2560|0
units.english: He nods, grunts, and heads to your ship with a small knapsack cradled under his arm, clearly ready to travel to <planet> at a moment's notice.
units.italian: Annuisce, grugnisce e si avvia verso la tua nave con un piccolo zaino stretto sotto il braccio, chiaramente pronto a partire per <planet> da un momento all'altro.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|	"You're not from around here, are ya? Ser's just what decent folk call each other in the Deep. Sign of respect and the like. Though I am hearing it less and less these days. Old ways being forgotten, but ain't that the way of things?"|2566|0
units.english: "You're not from around here, are ya? Ser's just what decent folk call each other in the Deep. Sign of respect and the like. Though I am hearing it less and less these days. Old ways being forgotten, but ain't that the way of things?"
units.italian: "Non sei di queste parti, eh? 'Ser' è semplicemente come si chiamano tra loro le persone perbene nel Deep. Un segno di rispetto e roba simile. Anche se, ultimamente, lo sento sempre meno. Le vecchie usanze si dimenticano, ma non è forse così che vanno le cose?"

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|	He pauses for a moment as if reflecting on this, then says, "Well, what do you say? <payment> for transportation to <planet>?"|2567|0
units.english: He pauses for a moment as if reflecting on this, then says, "Well, what do you say? <payment> for transportation to <planet>?"
units.italian: Si ferma un momento come a rifletterci, poi dice: "Beh, che ne dici? <payment> per un passaggio fino a <planet>?"

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|label|2570|0
units.english: ser 2
units.italian: ser 2

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|	The old man narrows his eyes at you and his mouth falls slightly open like he's trying to make sense of a puzzle. Finally he says, "What's the bits between a fella's legs gotta do with anything? I already said, 'Ser' is just what decent folk call each other; ain't nothing more to it. Don't matter if you're a guy, gal, or anything else. Hel, I reckon I'd even call an elf 'Ser' if they done me a good turn.|2573|0
units.english: The old man narrows his eyes at you and his mouth falls slightly open like he's trying to make sense of a puzzle. Finally he says, "What's the bits between a fella's legs gotta do with anything? I already said, 'Ser' is just what decent folk call each other; ain't nothing more to it. Don't matter if you're a guy, gal, or anything else. Hel, I reckon I'd even call an elf 'Ser' if they done me a good turn.
units.italian: Il vecchio socchiude gli occhi e la bocca gli si apre appena, come se stesse cercando di risolvere un rebus. Alla fine dice: "Che c'entra quel che uno ha tra le gambe? L'ho già detto: 'Ser' è solo come si chiamano tra loro le persone perbene, non c'è altro. Non importa se sei un uomo, una donna o altro. Per Hel, credo che chiamerei 'Ser' persino un elfo, se mi facesse un favore.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|label|2576|0
units.english: ser 3
units.italian: ser 3

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|	The old man gives you a gruff nod and says, "Ah, I see. Can be confusing for a newcomer, I s'pose. What's 'tween a fella's legs gots nothing to do with it. Just like I said before, 'Ser' is just what decent folk call each other; ain't nothing more to it. Don't matter if you're a guy, gal, or anything else. Hel, I reckon I'd even call an elf 'Ser' if they done me a good turn.|2579|0
units.english: The old man gives you a gruff nod and says, "Ah, I see. Can be confusing for a newcomer, I s'pose. What's 'tween a fella's legs gots nothing to do with it. Just like I said before, 'Ser' is just what decent folk call each other; ain't nothing more to it. Don't matter if you're a guy, gal, or anything else. Hel, I reckon I'd even call an elf 'Ser' if they done me a good turn.
units.italian: Il vecchio ti fa un cenno burbero e dice: "Ah, capisco. Per uno appena arrivato può confondere, suppongo. Quel che uno ha tra le gambe non c'entra nulla. Come dicevo prima, 'Ser' è solo come si chiamano tra loro le persone perbene: non c'è altro. Non importa se sei un uomo, una donna o altro. Per Hel, credo che chiamerei 'Ser' persino un elfo, se mi facesse un favore.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|label|2581|0
units.english: back to the point
units.italian: back to the point

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|	"Now, I'd like to know whether you can take me to <planet>."|2582|0
units.english: "Now, I'd like to know whether you can take me to <planet>."
units.italian: "Ora, vorrei sapere se puoi portarmi su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|	With a disappointed look on his face, he nods once and slides back into the endless sea of people.|2589|0
units.english: With a disappointed look on his face, he nods once and slides back into the endless sea of people.
units.italian: Con un'espressione delusa annuisce una volta e si lascia scivolare di nuovo nel mare infinito di persone.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|dialog|2593|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but your escort carrying Skaldgar has not arrived! Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la tua scorta che porta Skaldgar non è ancora arrivata! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che le scorte raggiungano questo sistema.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|dialog|2598|0
units.english: Skaldgar is as clean as you've seen him: scrubbed, shaved and wearing clothes that are respectable, if a few decades out of style. His eyes glisten, and he turns to you.
units.italian: Skaldgar è più pulito di quanto tu l'abbia mai visto: lavato, rasato e con vestiti rispettabili, anche se fuori moda da qualche decennio. Gli luccicano gli occhi, e si volta verso di te.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|	"I've made a lot of mistakes in my life. Comin' home, even if I'm hated - or worse, forgotten - ain't one of them. Thank ya kindly for the passage."|2599|0
units.english: "I've made a lot of mistakes in my life. Comin' home, even if I'm hated - or worse, forgotten - ain't one of them. Thank ya kindly for the passage."
units.italian: "Ho fatto molti errori nella mia vita. Tornare a casa, anche se sono odiato o peggio dimenticato, non è uno di quelli. Grazie di cuore per il passaggio."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 1|	You wish the old codger a joyful homecoming, and watch as he disappears into the sleepy spaceport.|2600|0
units.english: You wish the old codger a joyful homecoming, and watch as he disappears into the sleepy spaceport.
units.italian: Auguri al vecchio brontolone un buon ritorno a casa, e lo guardi sparire nello spazioporto sonnolento.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 2|name|2607|0
units.english: Stone of our Fathers
units.italian: La pietra dei padri

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 2|description|2608|0
units.english: Return Skaldgar to <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta Skaldgar su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 2|In the nearly abandoned spaceport of Norn, a scruffy and slow-moving figure shuffles toward you. "Captain <first>! Good to see you, friend. It's Skaldgar; ya gave me a ride here some time ago," he calls out as he approaches you.|2617|0
units.english: In the nearly abandoned spaceport of Norn, a scruffy and slow-moving figure shuffles toward you. "Captain <first>! Good to see you, friend. It's Skaldgar; ya gave me a ride here some time ago," he calls out as he approaches you.
units.italian: Nello spazioporto quasi abbandonato di Norn, una figura trasandata e lenta ti si avvicina strascicando i piedi. "Capitano <first>! Che bello vederti, amico. Sono Skaldgar; mi hai dato un passaggio qui tempo fa," ti grida avvicinandosi.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 2|	"Got a nephew who works at the port, let me know he saw you comin' in." He claps you on the back. "Things have been mostly good, hard though, the family - some are glad to see me, to remember me, and others..." he pauses. "Well, some mistakes you just can't take back."|2618|0
units.english: "Got a nephew who works at the port, let me know he saw you comin' in." He claps you on the back. "Things have been mostly good, hard though, the family - some are glad to see me, to remember me, and others..." he pauses. "Well, some mistakes you just can't take back."
units.italian: "Ho un nipote che lavora al porto: mi ha fatto sapere che ti ha visto arrivare." Ti dà una pacca sulla schiena. "Le cose sono andate per lo più bene, anche se dure, con la famiglia: alcuni sono contenti di vedermi, di ricordarmi, altri..." si ferma. "Beh, certi errori non puoi cancellarli."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 2|	He looks away briefly, and then nods at his packed bag. "It was good to come back here one last time. But the soil, the work calls to me. I'm only good at one thing in this world, and I intend to do it to the very end. So, I was wonderin', could ya take me back to <planet>?"|2619|0
units.english: He looks away briefly, and then nods at his packed bag. "It was good to come back here one last time. But the soil, the work calls to me. I'm only good at one thing in this world, and I intend to do it to the very end. So, I was wonderin', could ya take me back to <planet>?"
units.italian: Distoglie lo sguardo per un attimo, poi accenna con il capo alla borsa già pronta. "È stato bello tornare qui un'ultima volta. Ma il suolo, il lavoro mi chiamano. Sono bravo in una sola cosa in questo mondo, e ho intenzione di farla fino alla fine. Quindi mi chiedevo: potresti riportarmi su <planet>?"

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 2|	(Nod. Skaldgar and his hard-earned money are more than welcome aboard my ship.)|2621|0
units.english: (Nod. Skaldgar and his hard-earned money are more than welcome aboard my ship.)
units.italian: (Annuisci. Skaldgar e i suoi soldi guadagnati con fatica sono più che benvenuti sulla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 2|	"No thanks. I have better things to do than bus old men around."|2623|0
units.english: "No thanks. I have better things to do than bus old men around."
units.italian: "No grazie. Ho di meglio da fare che scarrozzare vecchietti in giro."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 2|	Skaldgar glares at you briefly then shrugs. "S'pose you do. S'pose you do." He turns and wanders away.|2624|0
units.english: Skaldgar glares at you briefly then shrugs. "S'pose you do. S'pose you do." He turns and wanders away.
units.italian: Skaldgar ti lancia un'occhiataccia, poi alza le spalle. "Suppongo di sì. Suppongo di sì." Si volta e si allontana.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 2|	Skaldgar rewards you with a genuine, if uneven, smile and then picks up his pack to board your ship.|2627|0
units.english: Skaldgar rewards you with a genuine, if uneven, smile and then picks up his pack to board your ship.
units.italian: Skaldgar ti regala un sorriso sincero, anche se storto, poi prende la borsa e sale sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 2|dialog|2630|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but your escort with Skaldgar has not arrived! Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la tua scorta con Skaldgar non è arrivata! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che le scorte raggiungano questo sistema.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 2|dialog|2634|0
units.english: Helheim's hustle and bustle threatens to overwhelm the senses, yet Skaldgar, for all his age and illness, seems to have a skip in his step as he saunters out of your ship and into the teeming masses.
units.italian: Il viavai di Helheim rischia di travolgere i sensi, eppure Skaldgar, con tutta la sua età e la sua malattia, sembra procedere a balzelli mentre scende dalla nave e si tuffa nella folla brulicante.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 2|	Just as he is about to be swept up in the current of humanity, Skaldgar turns and gives you one last wave, and then is gone.|2635|0
units.english: Just as he is about to be swept up in the current of humanity, Skaldgar turns and gives you one last wave, and then is gone.
units.italian: Proprio quando sta per essere inghiottito dalla corrente dell'umanità, Skaldgar si volta e ti saluta un'ultima volta, poi sparisce.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 3|name|2642|0
units.english: Stone of our Fathers
units.italian: La pietra dei padri

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 3|description|2643|0
units.english: Take Skaldgar's stone back to his family on <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta la pietra di Skaldgar alla sua famiglia su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 3|As always, Helheim is packed to the brim with transient workers coming and going, with dreams of either getting rich or getting out. A youngish looking man in a dirty roustabout jacket waves at you and approaches.|2651|0
units.english: As always, Helheim is packed to the brim with transient workers coming and going, with dreams of either getting rich or getting out. A youngish looking man in a dirty roustabout jacket waves at you and approaches.
units.italian: Come sempre, Helheim è pieno zeppo di operai di passaggio che vanno e vengono, con il sogno di arricchirsi o di andarsene. Un uomo dall'aria giovane, in una giacca da manovale sporca, ti fa cenno e si avvicina.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 3|	"Yer that Cap'n that Skaldgar always went on about, aren'tcha?" The young man attempts to imitate Skaldgar with a deep and ponderous voice, "Him that knows the currents of space like we know our stone, and the like." The man grins sheepishly, "Ol' Skaldgar always had a way with words, he did."|2652|0
units.english: "Yer that Cap'n that Skaldgar always went on about, aren'tcha?" The young man attempts to imitate Skaldgar with a deep and ponderous voice, "Him that knows the currents of space like we know our stone, and the like." The man grins sheepishly, "Ol' Skaldgar always had a way with words, he did."
units.italian: "Tu sei quel capitano di cui Skaldgar parlava sempre, vero?" Il giovane prova a imitare Skaldgar con una voce profonda e solenne: "Quello che conosce le correnti dello spazio come noi conosciamo la nostra pietra, e roba simile." L'uomo sorride con aria imbarazzata: "Il vecchio Skaldgar sapeva parlare, questo è certo."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 3|	The young man then looks down, somberly, and pulls from his pocket a small, well-worn stone with some strange markings on it and holds it out to you.|2653|0
units.english: The young man then looks down, somberly, and pulls from his pocket a small, well-worn stone with some strange markings on it and holds it out to you.
units.italian: Poi il giovane abbassa lo sguardo, serio, tira fuori dalla tasca una piccola pietra consumata con strani segni incisi e te la porge.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 3|	"He wanted," he begins haltingly, "he wanted you, only you, to take this back to his folk on Norn." He swallows. "It's the old ways, it is. This, it needs to be returned, and not by a stranger." The young man then shrugs. "Best to let'cha know, I ain't have no money to pay you. This would be a favor for the ol' man."|2654|0
units.english: "He wanted," he begins haltingly, "he wanted you, only you, to take this back to his folk on Norn." He swallows. "It's the old ways, it is. This, it needs to be returned, and not by a stranger." The young man then shrugs. "Best to let'cha know, I ain't have no money to pay you. This would be a favor for the ol' man."
units.italian: "Voleva," comincia esitando, "voleva che fossi tu, solo tu, a riportarla ai suoi su Norn." Deglutisce. "Sono le vecchie usanze, è così. Questa va restituita, e non da un estraneo." Poi alza le spalle. "Meglio dirtelo subito: non ho soldi per pagarti. Questo sarebbe un favore al vecchio."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 3|	(Reach out and accept the stone.)|2656|0
units.english: (Reach out and accept the stone.)
units.italian: (Allunga la mano e accetta la pietra.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 3|	"Nope. Not going to do it. I run a ship, not a charity."|2658|0
units.english: "Nope. Not going to do it. I run a ship, not a charity."
units.italian: "No. Non lo farò. Guido una nave, non un'opera di beneficenza."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 3|	The young man nods knowingly. "Guess Skaldgar was wrong about you, but I understand. We all gotta eat." He turns and slides back into the endless crowd.|2659|0
units.english: The young man nods knowingly. "Guess Skaldgar was wrong about you, but I understand. We all gotta eat." He turns and slides back into the endless crowd.
units.italian: Il giovane annuisce, consapevole. "Evidentemente Skaldgar si sbagliava sul tuo conto, ma capisco. Tutti dobbiamo mangiare." Si volta e si lascia inghiottire dalla folla infinita.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 3|	You're surprised at how cool the smooth stone feels in your palm.|2662|0
units.english: You're surprised at how cool the smooth stone feels in your palm.
units.italian: Ti sorprende quanto sia fredda e liscia la pietra nel palmo della mano.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 3|	He smiles sadly. "Skaldgar always had a nose for good folks. Anyways, he told me he had a nephew named Helm who worked at the Norn spaceport. Find 'im and he can get'cha and this stone where it needs to go." The young man then looks you in the eye and gives a slow respectful nod, "For Ol' Skaldgar, may he be findin' ore in hel."|2663|0
units.english: He smiles sadly. "Skaldgar always had a nose for good folks. Anyways, he told me he had a nephew named Helm who worked at the Norn spaceport. Find 'im and he can get'cha and this stone where it needs to go." The young man then looks you in the eye and gives a slow respectful nod, "For Ol' Skaldgar, may he be findin' ore in hel."
units.italian: Sorride con tristezza. "Skaldgar sapeva sempre fiutare le brave persone. Comunque, mi ha detto che aveva un nipote di nome Helm che lavora allo spazioporto di Norn. Trovalo, e lui porterà te e questa pietra dove devono andare." Poi ti guarda negli occhi e accenna lentamente, con rispetto: "Per il vecchio Skaldgar, che possa trovare minerale all'inferno."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 3|	And with that, the man disappears into the crowd.|2664|0
units.english: And with that, the man disappears into the crowd.
units.italian: E detto questo, l'uomo sparisce nella folla.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 3|dialog|2667|0
units.english: It turns out there is no need to search for Helm, as he is waiting for you when you land.
units.italian: A quanto pare non serve cercare Helm: ti sta aspettando quando atterri.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 3|	"I figured for you to be returning, it would either be with Skaldgar or with" - he pauses - "news." He looks around. "And I don't see Skaldgar."|2668|0
units.english: "I figured for you to be returning, it would either be with Skaldgar or with" - he pauses - "news." He looks around. "And I don't see Skaldgar."
units.italian: "Immaginavo che, se fossi tornato, sarebbe stato o con Skaldgar o con" - si ferma - "notizie." Si guarda intorno. "E Skaldgar non lo vedo."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 3|	You show him the odd stone you'd been given, and Helm stiffens then nods. "As I figured. Best we meet in the spaceport to discuss what comes next."|2669|0
units.english: You show him the odd stone you'd been given, and Helm stiffens then nods. "As I figured. Best we meet in the spaceport to discuss what comes next."
units.italian: Gli mostri la strana pietra che ti è stata affidata, e Helm si irrigidisce, poi annuisce. "Come immaginavo. Meglio incontrarci allo spazioporto per parlare di cosa fare adesso."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|name|2674|0
units.english: Stone of our Fathers
units.italian: La pietra dei padri

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|description|2675|0
units.english: Take Skaldgar's stone back to his Family-Cairn on <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta la pietra di Skaldgar al suo Family-Cairn su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|Helm meets you in the nearly deserted spaceport bar. "Ma always had a soft spot for Uncle Skaldgar. Even after he ran off 35 years ago, she still spoke fondly of him. He always sent the family money, he was good like that. Not as good, though, in sending his love."|2683|0
units.english: Helm meets you in the nearly deserted spaceport bar. "Ma always had a soft spot for Uncle Skaldgar. Even after he ran off 35 years ago, she still spoke fondly of him. He always sent the family money, he was good like that. Not as good, though, in sending his love."
units.italian: Helm ti aspetta nel bar quasi deserto dello spazioporto. "La mamma ha sempre avuto un debole per lo zio Skaldgar. Anche dopo che se n'è andato 35 anni fa, ne parlava sempre con affetto. Mandava sempre soldi alla famiglia, in questo era bravo. Non altrettanto bravo, però, a mandare il suo affetto."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Helm sighs, "This is going to be tough, but as bearer of the Stone, you are going to need to present it to his son. His family lives on a drifting algae island to the south of here. Are you willing to accompany me?"|2684|0
units.english: Helm sighs, "This is going to be tough, but as bearer of the Stone, you are going to need to present it to his son. His family lives on a drifting algae island to the south of here. Are you willing to accompany me?"
units.italian: Helm sospira: "Sarà dura, ma come portatore della Pietra dovrai presentarla a suo figlio. La sua famiglia vive su un'isola di alghe alla deriva, a sud di qui. Sei disposto ad accompagnarmi?"

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	"I've come this far. I might as well finish it."|2686|0
units.english: "I've come this far. I might as well finish it."
units.italian: "Sono arrivato fin qui. Tanto vale finire."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	"Absolutely, I want to see this through."|2688|0
units.english: "Absolutely, I want to see this through."
units.italian: "Assolutamente, voglio vedere come va a finire."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	"No, This is as far as I go. I got the stone to you, and it's your problem now."|2690|0
units.english: "No, This is as far as I go. I got the stone to you, and it's your problem now."
units.italian: "No. Fin qui arrivo. Ti ho portato la pietra, e adesso è un problema tuo."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Helm nods, knowingly, "Fair enough, star-traveler. I will handle it from here."|2693|0
units.english: Helm nods, knowingly, "Fair enough, star-traveler. I will handle it from here."
units.italian: Helm annuisce, consapevole: "Giusto, viaggiatore delle stelle. Da qui me ne occupo io."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Helm smiles when you agree to accompany him. "This is right," he says.|2696|0
units.english: Helm smiles when you agree to accompany him. "This is right," he says.
units.italian: Helm sorride quando accetti di accompagnarlo. "Così è giusto," dice.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	After making a few preparations, he leads you out to the harbor, where you climb aboard a small ocean-going craft that you assume belongs to him. He works on the controls for a bit and then sits down across from you as the ship veers out into the open ocean.|2697|0
units.english: After making a few preparations, he leads you out to the harbor, where you climb aboard a small ocean-going craft that you assume belongs to him. He works on the controls for a bit and then sits down across from you as the ship veers out into the open ocean.
units.italian: Dopo qualche preparativo ti conduce al porto, dove sali su una piccola imbarcazione d'altura che supponi essere sua. Lavora un po' sui comandi, poi si siede di fronte a te mentre la barca punta verso il mare aperto.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	"It's an old custom," he says, nodding toward the stone in your hand. "Goes back to the founding of The Deep, the first settlers. On a person's 16th birthday they are given a stone to carry with them through their lives. On special, or momentous occasions, they are to carve a few runes into it, a few cherished memories chiseled into hard stone."|2698|0
units.english: "It's an old custom," he says, nodding toward the stone in your hand. "Goes back to the founding of The Deep, the first settlers. On a person's 16th birthday they are given a stone to carry with them through their lives. On special, or momentous occasions, they are to carve a few runes into it, a few cherished memories chiseled into hard stone."
units.italian: "È un'usanza antica," dice, accennando alla pietra che hai in mano. "Risale alla fondazione del Deep, ai primi coloni. Al sedicesimo compleanno si riceve una pietra da portare con sé per tutta la vita. Nelle occasioni speciali, o memorabili, ci si incide qualche runa: qualche ricordo caro cesellato nella pietra dura."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Helm pauses as a flock of jabbering sea-birds passes near the ship, indicating a nearby island, and then continues. "And then when that person dies, that stone is returned by the closest family member to the Family-Cairn."|2699|0
units.english: Helm pauses as a flock of jabbering sea-birds passes near the ship, indicating a nearby island, and then continues. "And then when that person dies, that stone is returned by the closest family member to the Family-Cairn."
units.italian: Helm si ferma mentre uno stormo di uccelli marini ciarlieri passa vicino alla barca, segno di un'isola vicina, poi continua. "E quando quella persona muore, la pietra viene riportata al Family-Cairn dal familiare più stretto."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Helm looks up and his eyes scan the horizon. "We're almost there; gather your things." Helm stands and returns to the ship's controls.|2700|0
units.english: Helm looks up and his eyes scan the horizon. "We're almost there; gather your things." Helm stands and returns to the ship's controls.
units.italian: Helm alza lo sguardo e scruta l'orizzonte. "Ci siamo quasi, prendi le tue cose." Si alza e torna ai comandi.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	"But why do I have to be the one to bring the stone to his son?"|2702|0
units.english: "But why do I have to be the one to bring the stone to his son?"
units.italian: "Ma perché devo essere io a portare la pietra a suo figlio?"

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	"Where do the stones come from?"|2704|0
units.english: "Where do the stones come from?"
units.italian: "Da dove vengono le pietre?"

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Helm shrugs as he maneuvers the ship into dock. "It is the old way. To make certain the stone is not lost, mishandled, or acquired by enemies. If the family is not near when its owner passes, it is given to a trusted friend who becomes its bearer. That task is too important and too sacred to be given to a stranger or courier. For you to take it all the way to his son, so that he may return it to earth, is right."|2707|0
units.english: Helm shrugs as he maneuvers the ship into dock. "It is the old way. To make certain the stone is not lost, mishandled, or acquired by enemies. If the family is not near when its owner passes, it is given to a trusted friend who becomes its bearer. That task is too important and too sacred to be given to a stranger or courier. For you to take it all the way to his son, so that he may return it to earth, is right."
units.italian: Helm alza le spalle mentre manovra la barca verso la banchina. "È la vecchia usanza. Serve a essere certi che la pietra non vada perduta, maltrattata o presa da nemici. Se la famiglia non è vicina quando il proprietario muore, la pietra si affida a un amico fidato, che ne diventa il portatore. È un compito troppo importante e troppo sacro per darlo a un estraneo o a un corriere. Che sia tu a portarla fino a suo figlio, perché lui possa restituirla alla terra, è giusto."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Helm shrugs as he maneuvers the ship into dock. "Wherever makes the most sense at the time a stone is given. If I recall correctly Skaldgar's stone was given to him by his mother, my grandmother, from an old mine Skaldgar had been exploring on the mainland. Even at 16 he loved the earth."|2710|0
units.english: Helm shrugs as he maneuvers the ship into dock. "Wherever makes the most sense at the time a stone is given. If I recall correctly Skaldgar's stone was given to him by his mother, my grandmother, from an old mine Skaldgar had been exploring on the mainland. Even at 16 he loved the earth."
units.italian: Helm alza le spalle mentre manovra la barca verso la banchina. "Da dove ha più senso al momento in cui la pietra viene data. Se ben ricordo, la pietra di Skaldgar gli è stata data da sua madre, mia nonna, presa da una vecchia miniera che Skaldgar aveva esplorato sulla terraferma. Già a sedici anni amava la terra."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Helm ties up the ship at a makeshift dock and you follow him toward a dour gray building not far away. You realize this entire algae island, as small as it is, must belong to a single individual or family.|2712|0
units.english: Helm ties up the ship at a makeshift dock and you follow him toward a dour gray building not far away. You realize this entire algae island, as small as it is, must belong to a single individual or family.
units.italian: Helm ormeggia la barca a una banchina di fortuna e lo segui verso un edificio grigio e severo poco lontano. Capisci che tutta questa isola di alghe, per piccola che sia, deve appartenere a un solo individuo o a una sola famiglia.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	When you arrive at the hardy and sea-stained wooden door, Helm knocks thunderously upon it and calls out, "Thorleif, open up!"|2713|0
units.english: When you arrive at the hardy and sea-stained wooden door, Helm knocks thunderously upon it and calls out, "Thorleif, open up!"
units.italian: Arrivati alla porta di legno robusta e macchiata dal mare, Helm bussa fragorosamente e grida: "Thorleif, apri!"

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	After a brief wait the door opens ponderously, revealing a large, red-bearded, middle aged man who looks like a younger and much healthier Skaldgar. You realize that you must be standing before the man's son. A wide and open grin forms on his face when he sees Helm, and he gives the man a warm embrace. "Ah cousin! It's been too long, what brings you to my humble home?"|2714|0
units.english: After a brief wait the door opens ponderously, revealing a large, red-bearded, middle aged man who looks like a younger and much healthier Skaldgar. You realize that you must be standing before the man's son. A wide and open grin forms on his face when he sees Helm, and he gives the man a warm embrace. "Ah cousin! It's been too long, what brings you to my humble home?"
units.italian: Dopo una breve attesa la porta si apre con lentezza, rivelando un uomo corpulento, con la barba rossa e di mezza età, che somiglia a uno Skaldgar più giovane e molto più in salute. Capisci di trovarti davanti al figlio. Un largo sorriso gli si apre sul volto quando vede Helm, e gli dà un abbraccio caloroso. "Ah, cugino! Ne è passato di tempo, cosa ti porta nella mia umile casa?"

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Thorleif then notices you and frowns. "And who have you brought with you?"|2715|0
units.english: Thorleif then notices you and frowns. "And who have you brought with you?"
units.italian: Poi Thorleif nota te e aggrotta la fronte. "E chi hai portato con te?"

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	(Answer for myself.)|2717|0
units.english: (Answer for myself.)
units.italian: (Rispondi per me.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	(Let Helm answer for me.)|2718|0
units.english: (Let Helm answer for me.)
units.italian: (Lascia rispondere Helm.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	You smile somberly at Thorleif. "I was a friend of Skaldgar. I gave him a ride a few times, and, most recently, was entrusted with his stone."|2720|0
units.english: You smile somberly at Thorleif. "I was a friend of Skaldgar. I gave him a ride a few times, and, most recently, was entrusted with his stone."
units.italian: Sorridi con gravità a Thorleif. "Ero un amico di Skaldgar. Gli ho dato un passaggio un paio di volte e, da ultimo, mi è stata affidata la sua pietra."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Helm puts a hand on Thorleif's shoulder. "This here is <first>, they've come a long way to see you, and to bring you Skaldgar's stone."|2723|0
units.english: Helm puts a hand on Thorleif's shoulder. "This here is <first>, they've come a long way to see you, and to bring you Skaldgar's stone."
units.italian: Helm mette una mano sulla spalla di Thorleif. "Lui è <first>: ha fatto molta strada per vederti e per portarti la pietra di Skaldgar."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Thorleif tenses up. "Never speak that name!" His eyes narrow. "Helm, I want nothing to do with that stone, this person," Thorleif says, gesturing toward you, "or whatever else that old man wanted or cared about."|2725|0
units.english: Thorleif tenses up. "Never speak that name!" His eyes narrow. "Helm, I want nothing to do with that stone, this person," Thorleif says, gesturing toward you, "or whatever else that old man wanted or cared about."
units.italian: Thorleif si irrigidisce. "Non pronunciare mai quel nome!" Socchiude gli occhi. "Helm, non voglio avere niente a che fare con quella pietra, con questa persona," dice indicando te, "né con qualunque altra cosa che quel vecchio volesse o a cui tenesse."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Thorleif glances toward the horizon as he clenches and unclenches his fists, taking a few slow breaths, regaining his composure. "I realize you have traveled far and would not be able to get back to the mainland before night. So you may stay in the guest quarters, and leave first thing in the morning. I will have no one say that Thorleif was inhospitable."|2726|0
units.english: Thorleif glances toward the horizon as he clenches and unclenches his fists, taking a few slow breaths, regaining his composure. "I realize you have traveled far and would not be able to get back to the mainland before night. So you may stay in the guest quarters, and leave first thing in the morning. I will have no one say that Thorleif was inhospitable."
units.italian: Thorleif guarda verso l'orizzonte mentre stringe e apre i pugni, fa qualche respiro lento e recupera la calma. "Capisco che tu abbia viaggiato molto e che non potresti tornare sulla terraferma prima di notte. Puoi restare nelle stanze degli ospiti e partire di primo mattino. Non voglio che si dica che Thorleif è stato scortese."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	(Keep quiet and follow Helm towards the guest rooms.)|2728|0
units.english: (Keep quiet and follow Helm towards the guest rooms.)
units.italian: (Resta zitto e segui Helm verso le stanze degli ospiti.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	(Try to say something on Skaldgar's behalf.)|2730|0
units.english: (Try to say something on Skaldgar's behalf.)
units.italian: (Prova a dire qualcosa in difesa di Skaldgar.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	"Wait," you say before Thorleif can stomp off. "I do not, could not, know all that has happened here, that has gone on between you and your father. But I know that every time I met him he clearly regretted whatever happened, and constantly spoke of his mistakes. He's gone now, mistakes and all, and this stone... I don't think it represents forgiveness, but maybe acceptance of who he was, and that now he is gone."|2731|0
units.english: "Wait," you say before Thorleif can stomp off. "I do not, could not, know all that has happened here, that has gone on between you and your father. But I know that every time I met him he clearly regretted whatever happened, and constantly spoke of his mistakes. He's gone now, mistakes and all, and this stone... I don't think it represents forgiveness, but maybe acceptance of who he was, and that now he is gone."
units.italian: "Aspetta," dici prima che Thorleif possa andarsene battendo i piedi. "Non so, e non potrei sapere, tutto quello che è successo qui, quello che c'è stato tra te e tuo padre. Ma so che ogni volta che l'ho incontrato mostrava chiaramente di pentirsi di quel che era accaduto, e parlava continuamente dei suoi errori. Ora non c'è più, con tutti i suoi errori, e questa pietra... non credo che rappresenti il perdono, ma forse l'accettazione di chi era, e del fatto che adesso se n'è andato."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Thorleif turns to you, his face flashing red, and speaks through clenched teeth, "I have no father. I have no memories of such a man, and I will make no effort to remember someone who didn't stick around long enough to know me. Now, go to your rooms and leave me be!"|2732|0
units.english: Thorleif turns to you, his face flashing red, and speaks through clenched teeth, "I have no father. I have no memories of such a man, and I will make no effort to remember someone who didn't stick around long enough to know me. Now, go to your rooms and leave me be!"
units.italian: Thorleif si volta verso di te, il viso che si fa rosso, e parla a denti stretti: "Io non ho un padre. Non ho ricordi di un uomo simile, e non farò alcuno sforzo per ricordare qualcuno che non è rimasto abbastanza da conoscermi. Ora vai nelle tue stanze e lasciami in pace!"

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	You quietly follow Helm to two small, sparsely decorated rooms, clearly intended for guest use. Helm clears his throat, "This may surprise you, but that actually went better than I thought it would."|2734|0
units.english: You quietly follow Helm to two small, sparsely decorated rooms, clearly intended for guest use. Helm clears his throat, "This may surprise you, but that actually went better than I thought it would."
units.italian: Segui in silenzio Helm in due stanze piccole e sobriamente arredate, chiaramente destinate agli ospiti. Helm si schiarisce la voce: "Ti sorprenderà, ma è andata meglio di quanto pensassi."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Helm then turns his attention to a small window and the darkening horizon beyond it. "Dark clouds are gathering, I fear we may be here longer than a single night."|2735|0
units.english: Helm then turns his attention to a small window and the darkening horizon beyond it. "Dark clouds are gathering, I fear we may be here longer than a single night."
units.italian: Poi Helm rivolge l'attenzione a una piccola finestra e all'orizzonte che si fa scuro. "Si addensano nubi scure, temo che resteremo qui più di una notte."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	(Head off to bed as the first rains begin to patter against the roof.)|2737|0
units.english: (Head off to bed as the first rains begin to patter against the roof.)
units.italian: (Vai a letto mentre le prime piogge cominciano a tamburellare sul tetto.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	You awake to the riotous din of hard rain crashing against the building. As Helm predicted, a powerful storm blew in during the night, the floating island besieged by savage weather. By midmorning, the walls are starting to creak as howling forces of nature bash against it unceasingly.|2738|0
units.english: You awake to the riotous din of hard rain crashing against the building. As Helm predicted, a powerful storm blew in during the night, the floating island besieged by savage weather. By midmorning, the walls are starting to creak as howling forces of nature bash against it unceasingly.
units.italian: Ti svegli nel frastuono di una pioggia violenta che sbatte contro l'edificio. Come aveva previsto Helm, durante la notte è arrivata una tempesta potente, e l'isola galleggiante è sotto assedio di un tempo selvaggio. Verso metà mattina le pareti cominciano a scricchiolare mentre forze della natura ululanti le percuotono senza sosta.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	You hear a door open and struggle to close, followed by the sound of heavy sloshing footsteps. Thorleif, soaked to the bone, stands before you and Helm in the main room. "It's a Fimbulhrithr," Thorleif exclaims, "One of the worst I've yet seen. If we do not act quickly it could well flatten everything on this isle. Will you help me?"|2739|0
units.english: You hear a door open and struggle to close, followed by the sound of heavy sloshing footsteps. Thorleif, soaked to the bone, stands before you and Helm in the main room. "It's a Fimbulhrithr," Thorleif exclaims, "One of the worst I've yet seen. If we do not act quickly it could well flatten everything on this isle. Will you help me?"
units.italian: Senti una porta aprirsi e lottare per richiudersi, poi il rumore di passi pesanti che sguazzano. Thorleif, fradicio fino alle ossa, compare davanti a te e a Helm nella stanza principale. "È un Fimbulhrithr," esclama Thorleif. "Uno dei peggiori che abbia mai visto. Se non agiamo in fretta potrebbe radere al suolo tutto quello che c'è sull'isola. Mi aiuterai?"

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	(Offer to help Thorleif.)|2741|0
units.english: (Offer to help Thorleif.)
units.italian: (Offriti di aiutare Thorleif.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	"No, I've done enough for this family already. Especially for free!"|2743|0
units.english: "No, I've done enough for this family already. Especially for free!"
units.italian: "No, ho già fatto abbastanza per questa famiglia. E gratis, per di più!"

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Thorleif growls, "Knew better than to trust a friend of that useless old man. I gave you a place to sleep, and now you won't lift a hand to save it? I should have expected no less!" Thorleif and Helm hurry off to tend to the island during the storm, leaving you idle inside.|2744|0
units.english: Thorleif growls, "Knew better than to trust a friend of that useless old man. I gave you a place to sleep, and now you won't lift a hand to save it? I should have expected no less!" Thorleif and Helm hurry off to tend to the island during the storm, leaving you idle inside.
units.italian: Thorleif ringhia: "Dovevo saperlo che non ci si può fidare di un amico di quel vecchio inutile. Ti ho dato un posto dove dormire, e ora non alzi un dito per salvarlo? Non mi aspettavo di meglio!" Thorleif e Helm corrono a occuparsi dell'isola durante la tempesta, lasciandoti inoperoso dentro casa.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Thorleif and Helm heroically use the island's metal rudder and rudimentary engine to steer it away from the storm and to calmer, safer seas. However, with only the two of them many of the out-buildings are destroyed, along with a few of the small watercraft Thorleif used to fish and work on.|2745|0
units.english: Thorleif and Helm heroically use the island's metal rudder and rudimentary engine to steer it away from the storm and to calmer, safer seas. However, with only the two of them many of the out-buildings are destroyed, along with a few of the small watercraft Thorleif used to fish and work on.
units.italian: Thorleif e Helm usano eroicamente il timone metallico e il motore rudimentale dell'isola per allontanarla dalla tempesta e portarla verso mari più calmi e sicuri. Però, essendo solo in due, molti annessi vengono distrutti, insieme ad alcune delle piccole imbarcazioni che Thorleif usava per pescare e lavorare.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	You get the impression that this is an expensive and major loss for Thorleif. The moment the winds are calm, he demands Helm take you back to the mainland and your ship. "This Captain," Thorleif says, his voice oozing with disgust, "is just as lucky as my so-called father. I want him gone."|2746|0
units.english: You get the impression that this is an expensive and major loss for Thorleif. The moment the winds are calm, he demands Helm take you back to the mainland and your ship. "This Captain," Thorleif says, his voice oozing with disgust, "is just as lucky as my so-called father. I want him gone."
units.italian: Hai l'impressione che per Thorleif sia una perdita grave e costosa. Appena i venti si calmano pretende che Helm ti riporti sulla terraferma, alla tua nave. "Questo capitano," dice Thorleif, con la voce che trasuda disgusto, "è fortunato quanto il mio cosiddetto padre. Lo voglio via."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	For most of the trip back to your ship, Helm says nothing. He has been cool to you ever since you refused to help save the island. Finally, as you are preparing to disembark from his ship, he stops you. "You've done Skaldgar no favors here. I'd appreciate it if we don't see from you again."|2747|0
units.english: For most of the trip back to your ship, Helm says nothing. He has been cool to you ever since you refused to help save the island. Finally, as you are preparing to disembark from his ship, he stops you. "You've done Skaldgar no favors here. I'd appreciate it if we don't see from you again."
units.italian: Per quasi tutto il viaggio di ritorno alla tua nave, Helm non dice nulla. È freddo con te da quando hai rifiutato di aiutare a salvare l'isola. Alla fine, mentre ti prepari a sbarcare, ti ferma. "Qui non hai fatto alcun favore a Skaldgar. Ti sarei grato se non ci facessimo più vedere."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Helm holds up his hand showing off the stone in his palm. "I took it while you were napping. Skaldgar made a mistake with you, and I will at least see the stone properly tended. Goodbye." Helm indicates toward the exit and waits for you to depart before casting off again in his ship.|2748|0
units.english: Helm holds up his hand showing off the stone in his palm. "I took it while you were napping. Skaldgar made a mistake with you, and I will at least see the stone properly tended. Goodbye." Helm indicates toward the exit and waits for you to depart before casting off again in his ship.
units.italian: Helm alza la mano e mostra la pietra nel palmo. "L'ho presa mentre dormivi. Skaldgar si è sbagliato su di te, e almeno io farò in modo che la pietra sia trattata come si deve. Addio." Helm indica l'uscita e aspetta che te ne vada prima di mollare gli ormeggi.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Thorleif nods and takes you and Helm outside into the storm, or Fimbulhrithr. Thorleif and Helm work the island's metal rudder and rudimentary engine to steer the island away from the storm, while you are given the task of tying everything down that is liable to fly away.|2751|0
units.english: Thorleif nods and takes you and Helm outside into the storm, or Fimbulhrithr. Thorleif and Helm work the island's metal rudder and rudimentary engine to steer the island away from the storm, while you are given the task of tying everything down that is liable to fly away.
units.italian: Thorleif annuisce e porta te e Helm fuori, nella tempesta, il Fimbulhrithr. Thorleif e Helm azionano il timone metallico e il motore rudimentale per allontanare l'isola dalla tempesta, mentre a te tocca il compito di legare tutto ciò che rischia di volare via.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	With the storm comes unnatural darkness, and the sky is filled with debris and fish and all manner of items that do not belong in it. You hurry as fast as you can, saving as much as possible.|2752|0
units.english: With the storm comes unnatural darkness, and the sky is filled with debris and fish and all manner of items that do not belong in it. You hurry as fast as you can, saving as much as possible.
units.italian: Con la tempesta arriva un buio innaturale, e il cielo si riempie di detriti, pesci e ogni sorta di cose che non dovrebbero starci. Ti muovi più in fretta che puoi, salvando il più possibile.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	After hours of hard work, the storm begins to subside, and the sea and sky begin to calm. An exhausted Thorleif and Helm stagger over to you, and Thorleif surveys his small island. "Without your help I would have lost much of what stands intact. It was a lucky thing you came when you did."|2753|0
units.english: After hours of hard work, the storm begins to subside, and the sea and sky begin to calm. An exhausted Thorleif and Helm stagger over to you, and Thorleif surveys his small island. "Without your help I would have lost much of what stands intact. It was a lucky thing you came when you did."
units.italian: Dopo ore di duro lavoro la tempesta comincia a calare, e mare e cielo si placano. Thorleif e Helm, esausti, ti si avvicinano barcollando, e Thorleif si guarda intorno sulla sua piccola isola. "Senza il tuo aiuto avrei perso molto di ciò che è rimasto intatto. È stata una fortuna che tu sia arrivato proprio ora."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	With that, he turns and heads back to the main dwelling, with you and Helm in tired tow.|2754|0
units.english: With that, he turns and heads back to the main dwelling, with you and Helm in tired tow.
units.italian: Detto questo si volta e torna all'edificio principale, con te e Helm che lo seguite stanchi.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	(Wash up and warm up in the main room around the fire.)|2756|0
units.english: (Wash up and warm up in the main room around the fire.)
units.italian: (Lavati e riscaldati nella stanza principale, vicino al fuoco.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	You spend the evening warming yourself by a roaring fire, telling Helm and Thorleif tales of your exploits in space and many of the wonders you've seen.|2757|0
units.english: You spend the evening warming yourself by a roaring fire, telling Helm and Thorleif tales of your exploits in space and many of the wonders you've seen.
units.italian: Passi la serata a scaldarti accanto a un fuoco scoppiettante, raccontando a Helm e Thorleif le tue imprese nello spazio e molte delle meraviglie che hai visto.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	In turn, they tell you about the sea beasts, leviathans, and krakens that they have met on the ocean currents of Norn. Of lost isles filled with forgotten treasure or strange people, or stories even, about the ancient elves who once aided their ancestors and are said to be around still.|2758|0
units.english: In turn, they tell you about the sea beasts, leviathans, and krakens that they have met on the ocean currents of Norn. Of lost isles filled with forgotten treasure or strange people, or stories even, about the ancient elves who once aided their ancestors and are said to be around still.
units.italian: A loro volta ti parlano delle bestie marine, dei leviatani e dei kraken che hanno incontrato sulle correnti di Norn. Di isole perdute colme di tesori dimenticati o di genti strane, e persino di storie sugli antichi elfi che un tempo aiutarono i loro antenati e che si dice vivano ancora.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	(Ask about the elves.)|2760|0
units.english: (Ask about the elves.)
units.italian: (Chiedi degli elfi.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	(Ask about lost treasure.)|2761|0
units.english: (Ask about lost treasure.)
units.italian: (Chiedi dei tesori perduti.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	The idea of Elves, or Alfar as they call them, intrigues you, and you ask what they know of them.|2763|0
units.english: The idea of Elves, or Alfar as they call them, intrigues you, and you ask what they know of them.
units.italian: L'idea degli elfi, o Alfar come li chiamano loro, ti incuriosisce, e chiedi cosa ne sanno.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	"The Alfar," Thorleif begins, "are said to have been a great help to us in the early days. Some say they spared us from plagues and protected us from monsters. Many still offer sacrifices and prayers to them, so that they remember us and know that we are friends and allies still."|2764|0
units.english: "The Alfar," Thorleif begins, "are said to have been a great help to us in the early days. Some say they spared us from plagues and protected us from monsters. Many still offer sacrifices and prayers to them, so that they remember us and know that we are friends and allies still."
units.italian: "Gli Alfar," comincia Thorleif, "si dice che ci siano stati di grande aiuto nei primi tempi. Alcuni dicono che ci risparmiarono le pestilenze e ci protessero dai mostri. Molti ancora offrono loro sacrifici e preghiere, perché si ricordino di noi e sappiano che siamo ancora amici e alleati."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Thorleif shrugs. "This may be true, and good at that, but others think the Alfar, for all their apparent good works, cannot be trusted. Their minds are unknowable and filled with mischief, and their aims are not ours. This is the belief that our family holds to. They should be respected, but also feared. We must look to each other for support and strength, and trust not in the deeds of strangers."|2765|0
units.english: Thorleif shrugs. "This may be true, and good at that, but others think the Alfar, for all their apparent good works, cannot be trusted. Their minds are unknowable and filled with mischief, and their aims are not ours. This is the belief that our family holds to. They should be respected, but also feared. We must look to each other for support and strength, and trust not in the deeds of strangers."
units.italian: Thorleif alza le spalle. "Può essere vero, e sarebbe un bene, ma altri pensano che degli Alfar, con tutte le loro apparenti buone opere, non ci si possa fidare. Le loro menti sono inconoscibili e piene di malizia, e i loro fini non sono i nostri. È questa la convinzione della nostra famiglia. Vanno rispettati, ma anche temuti. Dobbiamo cercare sostegno e forza gli uni negli altri, e non fidarci delle opere degli estranei."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	You could always use a little extra money, and this trip, while engaging, has certainly not made you any richer, so you ask about hidden treasures. Helm and Thorleif both grin at this and glance at each other knowingly. They launch into tales of the riches of lost civilizations, or forgotten pirate hoards, or even early human kingdoms. It's easy to lose things on a fog-covered ocean world with floating islands, all too easy.|2768|0
units.english: You could always use a little extra money, and this trip, while engaging, has certainly not made you any richer, so you ask about hidden treasures. Helm and Thorleif both grin at this and glance at each other knowingly. They launch into tales of the riches of lost civilizations, or forgotten pirate hoards, or even early human kingdoms. It's easy to lose things on a fog-covered ocean world with floating islands, all too easy.
units.italian: Un po' di soldi in più non guastano mai, e questo viaggio, per quanto avvincente, non ti ha certo arricchito: così chiedi dei tesori nascosti. Helm e Thorleif sorridono entrambi e si scambiano uno sguardo d'intesa. Si lanciano in racconti sulle ricchezze di civiltà perdute, su tesori pirata dimenticati o persino su antichi regni umani. Su un mondo oceanico avvolto dalla nebbia e pieno di isole galleggianti è facile perdere le cose, fin troppo facile.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	When they are done regaling you with tales, they mention to you that maybe some other time they'll take you out into the deep ocean and perhaps you'll find what you're looking for. They smile wolfishly at that, and you think they might be putting you on. "Have you ever found treasure out here?" you ask.|2769|0
units.english: When they are done regaling you with tales, they mention to you that maybe some other time they'll take you out into the deep ocean and perhaps you'll find what you're looking for. They smile wolfishly at that, and you think they might be putting you on. "Have you ever found treasure out here?" you ask.
units.italian: Quando hanno finito di deliziarti con i loro racconti, ti dicono che magari un'altra volta ti porteranno nel mare aperto e forse troverai quel che cerchi. Sorridono con aria da lupi, e pensi che ti stiano prendendo in giro. "Avete mai trovato un tesoro, qua fuori?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Thorleif shrugs. "Coming here... from Alfheim long ago, our antecedents felt that the world itself was the real treasure. We have no need to go chasing dreams in the abyss."|2770|0
units.english: Thorleif shrugs. "Coming here... from Alfheim long ago, our antecedents felt that the world itself was the real treasure. We have no need to go chasing dreams in the abyss."
units.italian: Thorleif alza le spalle. "Venendo qui, molto tempo fa da Alfheim, i nostri antenati sentivano che il mondo stesso fosse il vero tesoro. Non abbiamo bisogno di inseguire sogni nell'abisso."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	As the conversation winds down and the hour grows late Helm excuses himself to bed, for he, like the rest of you, is dog tired after the day's events. You stand too, feeling your own need for sleep.|2772|0
units.english: As the conversation winds down and the hour grows late Helm excuses himself to bed, for he, like the rest of you, is dog tired after the day's events. You stand too, feeling your own need for sleep.
units.italian: Mentre la conversazione si esaurisce e l'ora si fa tarda, Helm si congeda per andare a letto: come tutti voi, è stanco morto dopo gli eventi della giornata. Ti alzi anche tu, sentendo il bisogno di dormire.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	"<first>," Thorleif says without looking up from the fire. "I've been thinking. I can never forgive my father for what he did. Leaving me and mom like that. But I can, I think, make peace with it. I can accept the stone." He looks up and smiles, "You brought some luck with you, and a man should never argue with luck."|2773|0
units.english: "<first>," Thorleif says without looking up from the fire. "I've been thinking. I can never forgive my father for what he did. Leaving me and mom like that. But I can, I think, make peace with it. I can accept the stone." He looks up and smiles, "You brought some luck with you, and a man should never argue with luck."
units.italian: "<first>," dice Thorleif senza alzare lo sguardo dal fuoco. "Ho riflettuto. Non potrò mai perdonare mio padre per quello che ha fatto. Andarsene così, lasciando me e mia madre. Però credo di poter fare pace con tutto questo. Posso accettare la pietra." Alza lo sguardo e sorride: "Hai portato un po' di fortuna con te, e un uomo non dovrebbe mai discutere con la fortuna."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	He stands up. "We'll talk in the morning."|2774|0
units.english: He stands up. "We'll talk in the morning."
units.italian: Si alza in piedi. "Ne parliamo domattina."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	(Head to bed for some well deserved sleep.)|2776|0
units.english: (Head to bed for some well deserved sleep.)
units.italian: (Vai a letto, ti meriti un po' di sonno.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	The day is bright and the sky is clear, the storm long forgotten as you prepare your things. Both men meet you in the main room. Thorleif opens up his hand to accept the stone, which you gladly place into it. He smiles and looks it over, tracing his finger along its chiseled runes.|2777|0
units.english: The day is bright and the sky is clear, the storm long forgotten as you prepare your things. Both men meet you in the main room. Thorleif opens up his hand to accept the stone, which you gladly place into it. He smiles and looks it over, tracing his finger along its chiseled runes.
units.italian: La giornata è luminosa e il cielo sereno, la tempesta ormai dimenticata mentre prepari le tue cose. Entrambi gli uomini ti aspettano nella stanza principale. Thorleif apre la mano per ricevere la pietra, e tu gliela posi volentieri. Sorride e la esamina, passando il dito sulle rune incise.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	"Thank you, <first>." You nod, happy to be done with this mission and free to fly the space lanes once more.|2778|0
units.english: "Thank you, <first>." You nod, happy to be done with this mission and free to fly the space lanes once more.
units.italian: "Grazie, <first>." Annuisci, contento di aver finito questa missione e di essere di nuovo libero di percorrere le rotte spaziali.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	"Just more thing," Thorleif adds with a sly grin. "I'll need a captain willing to ferry me to Alfheim. That's where my family's cairn is located."|2779|0
units.english: "Just more thing," Thorleif adds with a sly grin. "I'll need a captain willing to ferry me to Alfheim. That's where my family's cairn is located."
units.italian: "Un'ultima cosa," aggiunge Thorleif con un sorriso furbesco. "Mi servirà un capitano disposto a portarmi su Alfheim. È là che si trova il cairn della mia famiglia."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Before you know it, the three of you are on Helm's boat and heading for the spaceport.|2780|0
units.english: Before you know it, the three of you are on Helm's boat and heading for the spaceport.
units.italian: Prima che tu te ne accorga, siete tutti e tre sulla barca di Helm e andate verso lo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	"Alfheim," Thorleif says idly, "you know of it? The name means the home of the Alfar, or elves as you call them. I've never been there, only heard of it. It'll be strange to visit the world of my ancestors."|2781|0
units.english: "Alfheim," Thorleif says idly, "you know of it? The name means the home of the Alfar, or elves as you call them. I've never been there, only heard of it. It'll be strange to visit the world of my ancestors."
units.italian: "Alfheim," dice Thorleif con nonchalance. "La conosci? Il nome significa casa degli Alfar, o elfi come li chiamate voi. Non ci sono mai stato, ne ho solo sentito parlare. Sarà strano visitare il mondo dei miei antenati."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Helm stays behind as you and Thorleif load your gear onto your ship.|2782|0
units.english: Helm stays behind as you and Thorleif load your gear onto your ship.
units.italian: Helm resta indietro mentre tu e Thorleif caricate l'attrezzatura sulla nave.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	You're not sure exactly how you got mixed up into all this, and yet, it all feels right to you. Like you are where you should be, doing what you should do. This adventure may not involve intergalactic wars or the secrets of the ancients, but sometimes it really is just about people. People like Skaldgar and Thorleif and Helm.|2783|0
units.english: You're not sure exactly how you got mixed up into all this, and yet, it all feels right to you. Like you are where you should be, doing what you should do. This adventure may not involve intergalactic wars or the secrets of the ancients, but sometimes it really is just about people. People like Skaldgar and Thorleif and Helm.
units.italian: Non sai bene come ti sia trovato invischiato in tutto questo, eppure ti sembra giusto. Come se fossi dove devi essere, a fare ciò che devi fare. Questa avventura non riguarda guerre intergalattiche o segreti degli antichi, ma a volte si tratta davvero solo di persone. Persone come Skaldgar, Thorleif e Helm.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|The journey to Alfheim was interesting, if uneventful. Thorleif had never been in space before, and every jump left him quite ill. At the same time, however, he found so much wonder in it: seeing the dark void and bright stars with his own eyes; watching the tiny worlds recede into the distance. You could, through his eyes, experience the wild adventure of space anew.|2787|0
units.english: The journey to Alfheim was interesting, if uneventful. Thorleif had never been in space before, and every jump left him quite ill. At the same time, however, he found so much wonder in it: seeing the dark void and bright stars with his own eyes; watching the tiny worlds recede into the distance. You could, through his eyes, experience the wild adventure of space anew.
units.italian: Il viaggio verso Alfheim è stato interessante, anche se tranquillo. Thorleif non era mai stato nello spazio, e ogni salto lo lasciava molto male. Allo stesso tempo, però, ci trovava tanta meraviglia: vedere il vuoto scuro e le stelle luminose con i propri occhi, guardare i mondi rimpicciolirsi in lontananza. Attraverso i suoi occhi hai potuto rivivere l'avventura selvaggia dello spazio come fosse la prima volta.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Throughout the trip, he told you stories of his family: They were called the Hlewagast and originally settled as some of the first colonists on Alfheim in the early history of The Deep. How they had been explorers and adventurers before taking land here to settle down on and work. How his great grandparents had decided to leave Alfheim, dismayed by the rampant pillaging of resources and looking once more for adventure, and how they had come to Norn. Seeking the waves, and the storms, and the solitude.|2788|0
units.english: Throughout the trip, he told you stories of his family: They were called the Hlewagast and originally settled as some of the first colonists on Alfheim in the early history of The Deep. How they had been explorers and adventurers before taking land here to settle down on and work. How his great grandparents had decided to leave Alfheim, dismayed by the rampant pillaging of resources and looking once more for adventure, and how they had come to Norn. Seeking the waves, and the storms, and the solitude.
units.italian: Durante il viaggio ti racconta storie della sua famiglia: si chiamavano Hlewagast e furono tra i primi coloni di Alfheim, nella storia antica del Deep. Erano stati esploratori e avventurieri prima di prendere terra qui per stabilirsi e lavorare. I suoi bisnonni avevano deciso di lasciare Alfheim, sdegnati dal saccheggio sfrenato delle risorse e in cerca di nuove avventure, ed erano arrivati su Norn. In cerca delle onde, delle tempeste e della solitudine.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Through all of this, you got a better feel for Thorleif, Skaldgard and his people, and are almost sorry when your ship approaches Alfheim.|2789|0
units.english: Through all of this, you got a better feel for Thorleif, Skaldgard and his people, and are almost sorry when your ship approaches Alfheim.
units.italian: Grazie a tutto questo hai capito meglio Thorleif, Skaldgar e la sua gente, e quasi ti dispiace quando la nave si avvicina ad Alfheim.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	On landing, you are surprised by how much Alfheim reminds you of Helheim. Though the environment and ecology of the worlds are remarkably different, both are primarily used for resource extraction, and thus filled with boomtown employees and migrants looking for work, chasing dreams, and trying to make their way in the world.|2790|0
units.english: On landing, you are surprised by how much Alfheim reminds you of Helheim. Though the environment and ecology of the worlds are remarkably different, both are primarily used for resource extraction, and thus filled with boomtown employees and migrants looking for work, chasing dreams, and trying to make their way in the world.
units.italian: All'atterraggio ti sorprende quanto Alfheim ti ricordi Helheim. Anche se ambiente ed ecologia dei due mondi sono molto diversi, entrambi sono usati soprattutto per l'estrazione di risorse, e quindi pieni di dipendenti delle città in espansione e di migranti in cerca di lavoro, che inseguono sogni e cercano di farsi strada nel mondo.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|	Thorleif points to the spaceport. "Let's see if we can find a guide in there. There's a village we'll need to find, assuming it even exists anymore and hasn't been abandoned or destroyed to make room for a new oil rig."|2791|0
units.english: Thorleif points to the spaceport. "Let's see if we can find a guide in there. There's a village we'll need to find, assuming it even exists anymore and hasn't been abandoned or destroyed to make room for a new oil rig."
units.italian: Thorleif indica lo spazioporto. "Vediamo se riusciamo a trovare una guida là dentro. Dobbiamo trovare un villaggio, ammesso che esista ancora e non sia stato abbandonato o distrutto per far posto a una nuova piattaforma petrolifera."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 4|dialog|2793|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but your escort carrying Thorleif and Helm has not arrived! Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la tua scorta con Thorleif e Helm non è arrivata! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che le scorte raggiungano questo sistema.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|name|2798|0
units.english: Stone of our Fathers
units.italian: La pietra dei padri

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|description|2799|0
units.english: Take Ragnhild and Thorleif back to <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta Ragnhild e Thorleif su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|Thorleif is clearly uncomfortable being in a place so jam-packed with people. You help him keep his bearings and work your way to a young woman managing a visitor kiosk in the Spaceport.|2807|0
units.english: Thorleif is clearly uncomfortable being in a place so jam-packed with people. You help him keep his bearings and work your way to a young woman managing a visitor kiosk in the Spaceport.
units.italian: Thorleif è chiaramente a disagio in un posto così stipato di gente. Lo aiuti a orientarsi e vi fate strada fino a una giovane donna che gestisce un chiosco per i visitatori nello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	The woman looks up with a tired, practiced smile. "Welcome to Alfheim. Are you looking for work, or looking for a specific rig site? Please be aware that proof of employment is required before I can give you any details on company rigs."|2808|0
units.english: The woman looks up with a tired, practiced smile. "Welcome to Alfheim. Are you looking for work, or looking for a specific rig site? Please be aware that proof of employment is required before I can give you any details on company rigs."
units.italian: La donna alza lo sguardo con un sorriso stanco e di mestiere. "Benvenuti ad Alfheim. Cercate lavoro, o una piattaforma in particolare? Vi avverto che serve una prova di assunzione prima che possa darvi informazioni sulle piattaforme aziendali."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	Thorleif shakes his head. "Lady, no. We're not... anyone's employees, nor do we need work here. I am looking for a village, hamlet really, called Grimssalr. It's where my folk come from."|2809|0
units.english: Thorleif shakes his head. "Lady, no. We're not... anyone's employees, nor do we need work here. I am looking for a village, hamlet really, called Grimssalr. It's where my folk come from."
units.italian: Thorleif scuote la testa. "Signora, no. Non siamo... dipendenti di nessuno, né cerchiamo lavoro qui. Sto cercando un villaggio, anzi un casale, di nome Grimssalr. È da lì che viene la mia gente."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	The woman frowns for a second then seems to break from a trance as real warmth washes over her face. "I am sorry, it's just been so long since I've dealt with people who weren't looking for work. Alfheim, well, it is what it used to be, but only just more so now." She shrugs, "I know of Grimssalr though. I'm actually from Lindsvoll, in the same valley."|2810|0
units.english: The woman frowns for a second then seems to break from a trance as real warmth washes over her face. "I am sorry, it's just been so long since I've dealt with people who weren't looking for work. Alfheim, well, it is what it used to be, but only just more so now." She shrugs, "I know of Grimssalr though. I'm actually from Lindsvoll, in the same valley."
units.italian: La donna aggrotta la fronte per un istante, poi sembra uscire da una trance e sul suo viso si diffonde un calore sincero. "Scusatemi, è solo che è tanto tempo che non parlo con persone che non cercano lavoro. Alfheim, beh, è quello che era, solo molto di più adesso." Alza le spalle: "Però Grimssalr la conosco. Io vengo da Lindsvoll, nella stessa valle."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	"So can you tell us where it is?" Thorleif asks earnestly. The woman smiles shyly at Thorleif. "Tell you? How about I take you there?"|2811|0
units.english: "So can you tell us where it is?" Thorleif asks earnestly. The woman smiles shyly at Thorleif. "Tell you? How about I take you there?"
units.italian: "Allora puoi dirci dove si trova?" chiede Thorleif con sincerità. La donna gli sorride timidamente. "Dirvelo? Che ne dite se vi ci porto io?"

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	(Invite her onboard.)|2813|0
units.english: (Invite her onboard.)
units.italian: (Invitala a bordo.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	(Reject the offer.)|2815|0
units.english: (Reject the offer.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta l'offerta.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	You start to say that it isn't necessary for her to accompany you, when Thorleif cuts you off. "That sounds great!"|2816|0
units.english: You start to say that it isn't necessary for her to accompany you, when Thorleif cuts you off. "That sounds great!"
