units.italian: Cominci a dire che non è necessario che lei vi accompagni, ma Thorleif ti interrompe. "Mi sembra ottimo!"

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	She smiles broadly at Thorleif and nods.|2817|0
units.english: She smiles broadly at Thorleif and nods.
units.italian: Lei sorride apertamente a Thorleif e annuisce.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	(Sigh and shake my head.)|2819|0
units.english: (Sigh and shake my head.)
units.italian: (Sospiro e scuoto la testa.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	She immediately abandons her kiosk and shrugs. "I didn't care much for that job anyways."|2821|0
units.english: She immediately abandons her kiosk and shrugs. "I didn't care much for that job anyways."
units.italian: Abbandona subito il suo chiosco e alza le spalle. "Comunque quel lavoro non mi piaceva granché."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	You and Thorleif follow her to a local transit hovercraft, where she and Thorleif quickly sit together. You find yourself sitting alone.|2822|0
units.english: You and Thorleif follow her to a local transit hovercraft, where she and Thorleif quickly sit together. You find yourself sitting alone.
units.italian: Tu e Thorleif la seguite fino a un hovercraft del trasporto locale, dove lei e Thorleif si siedono subito vicini. Ti ritrovi a sedere da solo.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	For the next three hours, it sounds as if they are in deep conversation, while you drift in and out of sleep watching as oil fields give way to rainforests and then rainforests shrink before great wooded mountains.|2823|0
units.english: For the next three hours, it sounds as if they are in deep conversation, while you drift in and out of sleep watching as oil fields give way to rainforests and then rainforests shrink before great wooded mountains.
units.italian: Per le tre ore successive ti sembra che siano immersi in una conversazione profonda, mentre tu scivoli dentro e fuori dal sonno guardando i campi petroliferi cedere il posto alla foresta pluviale, e poi la foresta ritrarsi davanti a grandi montagne boscose.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	At some point you feel Thorleif shaking your shoulder. "We're here."|2824|0
units.english: At some point you feel Thorleif shaking your shoulder. "We're here."
units.italian: A un certo punto senti Thorleif che ti scuote la spalla. "Siamo arrivati."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	(Rise from my seat.)|2826|0
units.english: (Rise from my seat.)
units.italian: (Alzati dal tuo sedile.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	The town of Grimssalr is nestled along the foothills of the towering Ettin mountains in western Alfheim. Town is perhaps too generous a word; it is instead more like a couple dozen houses filled with old people long abandoned by their children seeking wealth and adventure elsewhere.|2827|0
units.english: The town of Grimssalr is nestled along the foothills of the towering Ettin mountains in western Alfheim. Town is perhaps too generous a word; it is instead more like a couple dozen houses filled with old people long abandoned by their children seeking wealth and adventure elsewhere.
units.italian: Il paese di Grimssalr è incastonato ai piedi delle imponenti montagne Ettin, nell'Alfheim occidentale. Paese è forse una parola troppo generosa: è piuttosto un paio di dozzine di case piene di vecchi, lasciati da tempo da figli in cerca di ricchezza e avventura altrove.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	The woman, who you've learned is named Ragnhild, introduces Thorleif to some of the folks here, and before long they have found ways to connect their ancient genealogies together and everyone is suddenly treated as family. Before you know it, you are eating their meager yet hearty fare, swapping stories of adventures, and listening to legends about the old times.|2828|0
units.english: The woman, who you've learned is named Ragnhild, introduces Thorleif to some of the folks here, and before long they have found ways to connect their ancient genealogies together and everyone is suddenly treated as family. Before you know it, you are eating their meager yet hearty fare, swapping stories of adventures, and listening to legends about the old times.
units.italian: La donna, che hai scoperto chiamarsi Ragnhild, presenta Thorleif ad alcuni degli abitanti, e in poco tempo hanno trovato il modo di intrecciare le loro antiche genealogie e tutti vengono trattati all'improvviso come famiglia. Prima che tu te ne accorga, stai mangiando il loro cibo scarso ma sostanzioso, scambiando racconti di avventure e ascoltando leggende sui tempi antichi.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	As the sun begins to set, Thorleif approaches you, "It is time," he says. "The journey to the cairn is only a short hike from here. I would like you to accompany me. I think Skaldgar would have wanted that."|2829|0
units.english: As the sun begins to set, Thorleif approaches you, "It is time," he says. "The journey to the cairn is only a short hike from here. I would like you to accompany me. I think Skaldgar would have wanted that."
units.italian: Quando il sole comincia a tramontare, Thorleif ti si avvicina. "È il momento," dice. "Il cammino fino al cairn è solo una breve escursione da qui. Vorrei che mi accompagnassi. Credo che Skaldgar l'avrebbe voluto."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	(Accompany Thorleif.)|2831|0
units.english: (Accompany Thorleif.)
units.italian: (Accompagna Thorleif.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	"It's best that you do this alone."|2833|0
units.english: "It's best that you do this alone."
units.italian: "È meglio che tu lo faccia da solo."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	Thorleif frowns. "I cannot. It does not feel right. It is only because of you that I am here at all. I need you by my side to finish this. For me, and for him."|2834|0
units.english: Thorleif frowns. "I cannot. It does not feel right. It is only because of you that I am here at all. I need you by my side to finish this. For me, and for him."
units.italian: Thorleif aggrotta la fronte. "Non posso. Non mi sembra giusto. Se sono qui è solo per merito tuo. Ho bisogno di te al mio fianco per finire questo. Per me, e per lui."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	(Accompany Thorleif.)|2836|0
units.english: (Accompany Thorleif.)
units.italian: (Accompagna Thorleif.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	"I am sorry. But I will not go."|2838|0
units.english: "I am sorry. But I will not go."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace. Ma io non ci vado."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	Thorleif's face reddens and he abruptly turns from you. He has no words left to argue with and leaves you to wait in the village.|2839|0
units.english: Thorleif's face reddens and he abruptly turns from you. He has no words left to argue with and leaves you to wait in the village.
units.italian: Il viso di Thorleif si fa rosso e lui si volta di colpo dall'altra parte. Non ha più parole per discutere e ti lascia ad aspettare nel villaggio.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	A short time later he returns, his eyes wet and red.|2840|0
units.english: A short time later he returns, his eyes wet and red.
units.italian: Poco dopo torna, con gli occhi lucidi e rossi.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	"I have made my peace, I have read the runes of his life and returned his stone to the Family-Cairn of Hlewagast. He had few happy moments, and the only recent ones involved us both. He is gone now, and we remain." Thorleif wipes tears from his eyes. "Let us rest, and eat, and drink for a time. Skaldgar would have liked that, too."|2841|0
units.english: "I have made my peace, I have read the runes of his life and returned his stone to the Family-Cairn of Hlewagast. He had few happy moments, and the only recent ones involved us both. He is gone now, and we remain." Thorleif wipes tears from his eyes. "Let us rest, and eat, and drink for a time. Skaldgar would have liked that, too."
units.italian: "Ho fatto la mia pace, ho letto le rune della sua vita e ho riportato la sua pietra al Family-Cairn degli Hlewagast. Ha avuto pochi momenti felici, e quelli recenti ci hanno visti insieme. Adesso non c'è più, e noi restiamo." Thorleif si asciuga le lacrime dagli occhi. "Riposiamo, mangiamo e beviamo un po'. Anche a Skaldgar sarebbe piaciuto."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|label|2843|0
units.english: follow cairn
units.italian: follow cairn

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	You follow Thorleif up a mostly overgrown trail for about half an hour before finally stepping out into a wide open plain. The wind is cool and refreshing, and the grass blows with a steadiness that is somehow reassuring. There is something special and timeless about this meadow.|2844|0
units.english: You follow Thorleif up a mostly overgrown trail for about half an hour before finally stepping out into a wide open plain. The wind is cool and refreshing, and the grass blows with a steadiness that is somehow reassuring. There is something special and timeless about this meadow.
units.italian: Segui Thorleif su un sentiero per lo più invaso dalla vegetazione per circa mezz'ora, prima di sbucare finalmente in una pianura aperta e vasta. Il vento è fresco e ristoratore, e l'erba ondeggia con una costanza che in qualche modo rassicura. C'è qualcosa di speciale e senza tempo in questo prato.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	You notice over two dozen columns of stone arranged in a circle around a much more massive and impressive structure - a wall cut from some sort of metal you don't recognize. It is covered with letters and images that are unfamiliar to you.|2845|0
units.english: You notice over two dozen columns of stone arranged in a circle around a much more massive and impressive structure - a wall cut from some sort of metal you don't recognize. It is covered with letters and images that are unfamiliar to you.
units.italian: Noti più di due dozzine di colonne di pietra disposte in cerchio intorno a una struttura molto più massiccia e imponente: una parete ricavata da una specie di metallo che non riconosci. È coperta di lettere e immagini che non ti dicono nulla.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	"That is an Elf-Stone. It is why we built our Family-Cairns here. Such stones can be found on most worlds in The Deep. Indestructible, and left by the Alfar for some unknowable reason. Some, like this one, have been mostly forgotten. Others though, are important places of celebration and even worship."|2846|0
units.english: "That is an Elf-Stone. It is why we built our Family-Cairns here. Such stones can be found on most worlds in The Deep. Indestructible, and left by the Alfar for some unknowable reason. Some, like this one, have been mostly forgotten. Others though, are important places of celebration and even worship."
units.italian: "Quella è una Pietra-Elfica. È per questo che abbiamo costruito qui i nostri Family-Cairn. Pietre simili si trovano su quasi tutti i mondi del Deep. Indistruttibili, e lasciate dagli Alfar per ragioni che nessuno conosce. Alcune, come questa, sono quasi dimenticate. Altre invece sono luoghi importanti di festa e persino di culto."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	He points at a smallish cairn next to the Elf-Stone. "This, though, is what we're here for."|2847|0
units.english: He points at a smallish cairn next to the Elf-Stone. "This, though, is what we're here for."
units.italian: Indica un cairn piuttosto piccolo accanto alla Pietra-Elfica. "Ecco, invece, quello per cui siamo qui."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	You eye the worn and weather-beaten cairn with a faded name plate that has 'Hlewagast' carved into its base.|2848|0
units.english: You eye the worn and weather-beaten cairn with a faded name plate that has 'Hlewagast' carved into its base.
units.italian: Osservi il cairn consumato e battuto dalle intemperie, con una targhetta sbiadita che porta 'Hlewagast' inciso alla base.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	Thorleif approaches the cairn.|2849|0
units.english: Thorleif approaches the cairn.
units.italian: Thorleif si avvicina al cairn.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	Thorleif holds up the stone of his father in his palm and begins to read the runes carved upon it.|2850|0
units.english: Thorleif holds up the stone of his father in his palm and begins to read the runes carved upon it.
units.italian: Thorleif solleva sul palmo la pietra di suo padre e comincia a leggere le rune incise sopra.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	"The day my mother gave me this stone and said she was proud of me."|2851|0
units.english: "The day my mother gave me this stone and said she was proud of me."
units.italian: "Il giorno in cui mia madre mi ha dato questa pietra e mi ha detto che era fiera di me."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	"The day my son Thorleif was born."|2852|0
units.english: "The day my son Thorleif was born."
units.italian: "Il giorno in cui è nato mio figlio Thorleif."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	"The day I struck the mother lode on Helheim."|2853|0
units.english: "The day I struck the mother lode on Helheim."
units.italian: "Il giorno in cui ho trovato il grande filone su Helheim."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	"The day I met <first>, who helped me find my family again."|2854|0
units.english: "The day I met <first>, who helped me find my family again."
units.italian: "Il giorno in cui ho conosciuto <first>, che mi ha aiutato a ritrovare la mia famiglia."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	"The day I saw my son again, even though he would not see me."|2855|0
units.english: "The day I saw my son again, even though he would not see me."
units.italian: "Il giorno in cui ho rivisto mio figlio, anche se lui non voleva vedere me."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	Thorleif sniffs, takes a moment to write down something he saw on the stone, and then walks forward and places it upon the cairn, at home now with hundreds of other stones each with their own handful of memories.|2856|0
units.english: Thorleif sniffs, takes a moment to write down something he saw on the stone, and then walks forward and places it upon the cairn, at home now with hundreds of other stones each with their own handful of memories.
units.italian: Thorleif tira su col naso, si prende un momento per annotare qualcosa che ha visto sulla pietra, poi si fa avanti e la depone sul cairn, ormai a casa insieme a centinaia di altre pietre, ognuna con la sua manciata di ricordi.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	"He had not so many good memories, I think," Thorleif said quietly. "I realize now that mine too are quite few. Perhaps that, if nothing else, is a lesson he can teach me. For that I thank you, father."|2857|0
units.english: "He had not so many good memories, I think," Thorleif said quietly. "I realize now that mine too are quite few. Perhaps that, if nothing else, is a lesson he can teach me. For that I thank you, father."
units.italian: "Non aveva molti bei ricordi, credo," disse Thorleif piano. "Mi rendo conto ora che anche i miei sono pochi. Forse questa, se non altro, è una lezione che può insegnarmi. Per questo ti ringrazio, padre."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	With that, Thorleif turns from the cairn with teary eyes. "It is done. Let us head back."|2858|0
units.english: With that, Thorleif turns from the cairn with teary eyes. "It is done. Let us head back."
units.italian: Detto questo, Thorleif si allontana dal cairn con gli occhi pieni di lacrime. "È fatto. Torniamo indietro."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	(Follow Thorleif back to the village.)|2860|0
units.english: (Follow Thorleif back to the village.)
units.italian: (Segui Thorleif fino al villaggio.)

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	The two of you trudge back to the small hamlet of Grimssalr, with its people happy at having guests and long lost relatives, and to Ragnhild, happy to spend more time with Thorlief, where you feast and talk and laugh and remember.|2861|0
units.english: The two of you trudge back to the small hamlet of Grimssalr, with its people happy at having guests and long lost relatives, and to Ragnhild, happy to spend more time with Thorlief, where you feast and talk and laugh and remember.
units.italian: Voi due tornate a fatica nel piccolo borgo di Grimssalr, tra gente felice di avere ospiti e parenti ritrovati, e da Ragnhild, felice di passare altro tempo con Thorleif, dove si mangia, si parla, si ride e si ricorda.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|label|2862|0
units.english: drink and be merry
units.italian: drink and be merry

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	You enjoy yourself well into the evening before Thorleif approaches you. It's time to head back.|2863|0
units.english: You enjoy yourself well into the evening before Thorleif approaches you. It's time to head back.
units.italian: Ti godi la serata fin quasi a notte inoltrata, prima che Thorleif ti si avvicini. È ora di tornare.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	"This place," Thorleif begins, "this world, it feels like it has forgotten its soul. Industry and greed have taken hold, and the old happy places like Grimssalr are dying. It is good my family left here all those years ago. Norn is, and has been, a good place to be."|2864|0
units.english: "This place," Thorleif begins, "this world, it feels like it has forgotten its soul. Industry and greed have taken hold, and the old happy places like Grimssalr are dying. It is good my family left here all those years ago. Norn is, and has been, a good place to be."
units.italian: "Questo posto," comincia Thorleif, "questo mondo, sembra aver dimenticato la propria anima. L'industria e l'ingordigia hanno preso il sopravvento, e i vecchi luoghi felici come Grimssalr stanno morendo. È un bene che la mia famiglia sia partita tanti anni fa. Norn è, ed è stata, un buon posto dove stare."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	Thorleif then nods to Ragnhild. "Which is also why my very new and very dear friend Ragnhild has decided to join us on the return trip to Norn." You look to Ragnhild but somehow you can't feel that you're surprised at the news.|2865|0
units.english: Thorleif then nods to Ragnhild. "Which is also why my very new and very dear friend Ragnhild has decided to join us on the return trip to Norn." You look to Ragnhild but somehow you can't feel that you're surprised at the news.
units.italian: Thorleif fa un cenno a Ragnhild. "Ed è anche per questo che la mia amica nuovissima e carissima Ragnhild ha deciso di unirsi a noi per il viaggio di ritorno su Norn." Guardi Ragnhild, ma in qualche modo non riesci a sentirti sorpreso dalla notizia.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	She smiles brightly. "Best offer I've had in a long time." The three of you board your ship and prepare for the journey home.|2866|0
units.english: She smiles brightly. "Best offer I've had in a long time." The three of you board your ship and prepare for the journey home.
units.italian: Lei sorride luminosa. "L'offerta migliore che ho avuto da molto tempo." Salite tutti e tre sulla nave e vi preparate al viaggio di ritorno.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|dialog|2869|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but your escort with the space reserved for Thorleif and Ragnhild has not arrived! Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la scorta con lo spazio riservato a Thorleif e Ragnhild non è arrivata! Meglio ripartire e aspettare che le scorte raggiungano questo sistema.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|The trip back to Norn was restful.|2875|0
units.english: The trip back to Norn was restful.
units.italian: Il viaggio di ritorno su Norn è stato riposante.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	You spent most of it listening to Ragnhild tell the old stories and legends of Alfheim that she had learned as a child.|2876|0
units.english: You spent most of it listening to Ragnhild tell the old stories and legends of Alfheim that she had learned as a child.
units.italian: Hai passato gran parte del tempo ad ascoltare Ragnhild che raccontava le vecchie storie e leggende di Alfheim, imparate da bambina.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	Stories about alien trees whispering dark secrets, of oil barons destroying sacred sites and being cursed by alien artifacts they were too blinded by greed to see, and even tales of the elves and miracles of the Elf-Stones.|2877|0
units.english: Stories about alien trees whispering dark secrets, of oil barons destroying sacred sites and being cursed by alien artifacts they were too blinded by greed to see, and even tales of the elves and miracles of the Elf-Stones.
units.italian: Storie di alberi alieni che sussurrano segreti oscuri, di baroni del petrolio che distruggono luoghi sacri e vengono maledetti da manufatti alieni che l'ingordigia impediva loro di vedere, e persino racconti degli elfi e dei miracoli delle Pietre-Elfiche.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	Again, as before, you're almost sad when you make it back to Norn. The time for telling stories has ended, and the time for saying goodbye has begun.|2878|0
units.english: Again, as before, you're almost sad when you make it back to Norn. The time for telling stories has ended, and the time for saying goodbye has begun.
units.italian: Ancora una volta, come prima, sei quasi triste quando arrivi su Norn. Il tempo dei racconti è finito, ed è cominciato quello dei saluti.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	Thorleif wraps you in a bear hug. "I thank you for all you have done, <first>. I was so wound up in my own anger and bitterness I couldn't see anything beyond my own pain. But now, I feel like I can live again. Trust that our meeting has been etched into my own stone. I hope someday you come back and visit us. To remember us small folk on a small world so far from places of power and grand events. Remember you'll always have a home here."|2879|0
units.english: Thorleif wraps you in a bear hug. "I thank you for all you have done, <first>. I was so wound up in my own anger and bitterness I couldn't see anything beyond my own pain. But now, I feel like I can live again. Trust that our meeting has been etched into my own stone. I hope someday you come back and visit us. To remember us small folk on a small world so far from places of power and grand events. Remember you'll always have a home here."
units.italian: Thorleif ti stringe in un abbraccio da orso. "Ti ringrazio per tutto quello che hai fatto, <first>. Ero così avvolto nella mia rabbia e nella mia amarezza che non riuscivo a vedere altro oltre il mio dolore. Ma ora sento di poter vivere di nuovo. Sappi che il nostro incontro è stato inciso anche sulla mia pietra. Spero che un giorno tornerai a trovarci. A ricordare noi, gente minuta di un mondo piccolo, così lontano dai luoghi del potere e dai grandi eventi. Ricorda che qui avrai sempre una casa."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	With that Thorleif and Ragnhild make their way off your ship. Thorleif only takes a few steps out into the quiet Norn spaceport before stopping suddenly and turning back towards you.|2880|0
units.english: With that Thorleif and Ragnhild make their way off your ship. Thorleif only takes a few steps out into the quiet Norn spaceport before stopping suddenly and turning back towards you.
units.italian: Detto questo, Thorleif e Ragnhild scendono dalla tua nave. Thorleif fa solo pochi passi nello spazioporto silenzioso di Norn prima di fermarsi di colpo e voltarsi verso di te.

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	"I almost forgot. The old man, well, he had quite a bit of money saved up. I don't think he hardly spent anything on himself. Anyways, I've decided to split the inheritance with you. After taxes, your half comes out to around 500,000 even."|2881|0
units.english: "I almost forgot. The old man, well, he had quite a bit of money saved up. I don't think he hardly spent anything on himself. Anyways, I've decided to split the inheritance with you. After taxes, your half comes out to around 500,000 even."
units.italian: "Quasi dimenticavo. Il vecchio, beh, aveva messo da parte parecchi soldi. Credo che non abbia speso quasi nulla per sé. Comunque, ho deciso di dividere l'eredità con te. Tolte le tasse, la tua metà arriva a circa 500.000 giusti."

units.id: mission:Stone of our Fathers 5|	Thorleif shrugs, laughs, and walks with Ragnhild hand in hand out into the foggy mists of Norn.|2882|0
units.english: Thorleif shrugs, laughs, and walks with Ragnhild hand in hand out into the foggy mists of Norn.
units.italian: Thorleif alza le spalle, ride, e si allontana con Ragnhild mano nella mano, dentro le nebbie di Norn.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|name|2887|0
units.english: Home for Skadenga
units.italian: Una casa per gli Skadenga

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|description|2888|0
units.english: Search for the Setstokkr on <stopovers>, and then return back to <planet>.
units.italian: Cerca il Setstokkr su <stopovers>, poi torna su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|There is a feeling of deep melancholy in the nearly deserted spaceport. A few plaques adorn the walls, proudly boasting of earlier times when Nifel was a place of relevance in the galactic community. Most are old images of researchers and doctors and their miracle cures.|2897|0
units.english: There is a feeling of deep melancholy in the nearly deserted spaceport. A few plaques adorn the walls, proudly boasting of earlier times when Nifel was a place of relevance in the galactic community. Most are old images of researchers and doctors and their miracle cures.
units.italian: C'è un senso di profonda malinconia nello spazioporto quasi deserto. Alcune targhe adornano le pareti, vantandosi con orgoglio di tempi passati in cui Nifel era un luogo importante per la comunità galattica. Per lo più sono vecchie immagini di ricercatori e medici con le loro cure miracolose.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	But now this place is a ghost-town, and you walk its empty halls unsure of why you even bothered to explore it in the first place.|2898|0
units.english: But now this place is a ghost-town, and you walk its empty halls unsure of why you even bothered to explore it in the first place.
units.italian: Ma ora questo posto è una città fantasma, e percorri i suoi corridoi vuoti senza sapere perché ti sia preso la briga di esplorarlo.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	You turn a corner and find a woman standing near a booth with blown up images of ice-covered scenery. She waves at you excitedly.|2899|0
units.english: You turn a corner and find a woman standing near a booth with blown up images of ice-covered scenery. She waves at you excitedly.
units.italian: Giri l'angolo e trovi una donna in piedi accanto a un chiosco con immagini ingrandite di paesaggi coperti di ghiaccio. Ti saluta agitando la mano con entusiasmo.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Hello, ser! I hope you've been enjoying your stay in our state of the art spaceport! But why stay cooped up in here, when you could be out there?" She gestures toward the windows.|2900|0
units.english: "Hello, ser! I hope you've been enjoying your stay in our state of the art spaceport! But why stay cooped up in here, when you could be out there?" She gestures toward the windows.
units.italian: "Salve, ser! Spero che ti stia godendo il soggiorno nel nostro spazioporto all'avanguardia! Ma perché restare chiuso qui dentro, quando potresti essere là fuori?" Indica i finestroni con un gesto.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Explore the breath-taking Glaesisvellir ice-plains, or the boiling Slidr river. We'll even take you to the Hrimbrimr valley where the famous Rigellian cure was discovered!|2901|0
units.english: "Explore the breath-taking Glaesisvellir ice-plains, or the boiling Slidr river. We'll even take you to the Hrimbrimr valley where the famous Rigellian cure was discovered!
units.italian: "Esplora le mozzafiato pianure di ghiaccio di Glaesisvellir, o il ribollente fiume Slidr. Ti portiamo persino nella valle Hrimbrimr, dove è stata scoperta la famosa cura rigelliana!

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"So ser," she continues, "what do you say? Should I sign you up for the VIP Winter-Wonder Excursion Package for a special time limited-only offer of 2,000 credits?"|2902|0
units.english: "So ser," she continues, "what do you say? Should I sign you up for the VIP Winter-Wonder Excursion Package for a special time limited-only offer of 2,000 credits?"
units.italian: "Allora, ser," continua, "che ne dici? Ti iscrivo al Pacchetto Escursione Meraviglia d'Inverno VIP, con un'offerta speciale valida solo per poco tempo a 2.000 crediti?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Sure, I'd love to see more of this world."|2904|0
units.english: "Sure, I'd love to see more of this world."
units.italian: "Certo, mi piacerebbe vedere di più di questo mondo."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"No, uh, thanks. Freezing to death in the frigid tundra doesn't sound like a good time to me."|2906|0
units.english: "No, uh, thanks. Freezing to death in the frigid tundra doesn't sound like a good time to me."
units.italian: "No, ehm, grazie. Morire assiderato nella tundra gelida non mi sembra un bel programma."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The woman frowns, but nods knowingly. "I am afraid, ser, most seem to think the way you do. Still, if you ever run into anyone out there who might be interested, let them know. We could really use the work." With that, she turns and walks briskly back to her booth.|2907|0
units.english: The woman frowns, but nods knowingly. "I am afraid, ser, most seem to think the way you do. Still, if you ever run into anyone out there who might be interested, let them know. We could really use the work." With that, she turns and walks briskly back to her booth.
units.italian: La donna aggrotta la fronte, ma annuisce con aria saputa. "Temo, ser, che ai più venga da pensarla come te. Comunque, se mai ti capitasse di incontrare qualcuno laggiù che potrebbe essere interessato, faglielo sapere. Il lavoro ci servirebbe davvero." Detto questo, si volta e torna a passo svelto al suo chiosco.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The woman's face lights up, and you get the sense that she isn't used to hearing "yes" very often. "Oh, that is wonderful ser, just wonderful!"|2912|0
units.english: The woman's face lights up, and you get the sense that she isn't used to hearing "yes" very often. "Oh, that is wonderful ser, just wonderful!"
units.italian: Il viso della donna si illumina, e hai la sensazione che non senta spesso un "sì". "Oh, è meraviglioso, ser, davvero meraviglioso!"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	She puts her finger to her ear and says, "Hjlod, we have a customer! Get the crawler warmed up!" The woman then drops her hand and waves to you. "Right this way, ser! And might I add - you will not be disappointed." She chatters excitedly about the cultural, artistic and scientific merits of the trip as she leads you toward a large pressure hatch.|2913|0
units.english: She puts her finger to her ear and says, "Hjlod, we have a customer! Get the crawler warmed up!" The woman then drops her hand and waves to you. "Right this way, ser! And might I add - you will not be disappointed." She chatters excitedly about the cultural, artistic and scientific merits of the trip as she leads you toward a large pressure hatch.
units.italian: Si porta un dito all'orecchio e dice: "Hjlod, abbiamo un cliente! Scalda il cingolato!" Poi abbassa la mano e ti fa cenno. "Da questa parte, ser! E mi permetto di aggiungere: non resterai deluso." Continua a chiacchierare eccitata dei pregi culturali, artistici e scientifici della gita mentre ti guida verso un grosso portello a pressione.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	She hits a switch and the hatch opens; she then escorts you into a frigid maintenance dock. A loud, ugly vehicle is whirring at the center of a mess of broken and discarded parts. "There she is!" The woman is nearly shouting as she speaks over the mechanical hum. "We call her Brunhilda, the Queen of the Ice, a most.. durable vehicle, capable of giving you an authentic ice-explorer experience!"|2914|0
units.english: She hits a switch and the hatch opens; she then escorts you into a frigid maintenance dock. A loud, ugly vehicle is whirring at the center of a mess of broken and discarded parts. "There she is!" The woman is nearly shouting as she speaks over the mechanical hum. "We call her Brunhilda, the Queen of the Ice, a most.. durable vehicle, capable of giving you an authentic ice-explorer experience!"
units.italian: Aziona un interruttore e il portello si apre; poi ti accompagna in un deposito di manutenzione gelido. Un veicolo rumoroso e brutto ronza al centro di un ammasso di pezzi rotti e scartati. "Eccola qua!" La donna quasi grida per sovrastare il ronzio meccanico. "La chiamiamo Brunhilda, la Regina del Ghiaccio, un veicolo molto.. resistente, capace di regalarti un'autentica esperienza da esploratore dei ghiacci!"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The Ice-Crawler, Brunhilda, looks less than dependable to you. It appears to be a run-down, mishmash of parts and jury-rigged technology forced onto a three century old Ice-Crawler, probably used by the original colonists.|2915|0
units.english: The Ice-Crawler, Brunhilda, looks less than dependable to you. It appears to be a run-down, mishmash of parts and jury-rigged technology forced onto a three century old Ice-Crawler, probably used by the original colonists.
units.italian: Il cingolato del ghiaccio, Brunhilda, non ti sembra affatto affidabile. Ti appare come un ammasso sgangherato di pezzi e tecnologia arrangiata alla bell'e meglio, montato su un cingolato vecchio di tre secoli, probabilmente usato dai coloni originali.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Are you sure this thing is safe?"|2917|0
units.english: "Are you sure this thing is safe?"
units.italian: "Sei certa che sia sicuro?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"How old is this thing?!"|2918|0
units.english: "How old is this thing?!"
units.italian: "Quanti anni ha questa cosa?!"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The woman hesitates. "Don't you worry! Why, that Ice-Crawler is the safest place in all of Nifel! Those other accidents were flukes, and what happened to her sister Ice-Crawler, Gudrun, was entirely unforeseeable."|2920|0
units.english: The woman hesitates. "Don't you worry! Why, that Ice-Crawler is the safest place in all of Nifel! Those other accidents were flukes, and what happened to her sister Ice-Crawler, Gudrun, was entirely unforeseeable."
units.italian: La donna esita. "Non preoccuparti! Ma va, quel cingolato è il posto più sicuro di tutto Nifel! Gli altri incidenti sono stati casi isolati, e quello che è successo a sua sorella, il cingolato Gudrun, era del tutto imprevedibile."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Well, you know the old saying, 'They don't build 'em like they used to'? It's your lucky day because that is when this was built! Part of the excitement of the tour is riding in an authentic four hundred year old colonial Ice-Crawler."|2923|0
units.english: "Well, you know the old saying, 'They don't build 'em like they used to'? It's your lucky day because that is when this was built! Part of the excitement of the tour is riding in an authentic four hundred year old colonial Ice-Crawler."
units.italian: "Beh, conosci il detto 'non li fanno più come una volta'? Oggi è il tuo giorno fortunato, perché è proprio di quell'epoca che risale questo mezzo! Parte del brivido della gita è viaggiare su un autentico cingolato coloniale di quattrocento anni."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The woman pulls out a small touchscreen. "For very standard liability reasons, I need you to quickly put your digital signature right here. You, or your estate, can't sue us if you're injured or die on the excursion. Furthermore there is no expectation of rescue should you get lost out there, or the Ice-Crawler breaks down." She gives you a small forced smile. "Not that it ever would happen, and like I said, this is a very standard waiver in the tourist trade. I wouldn't think too much about it."|2925|0
units.english: The woman pulls out a small touchscreen. "For very standard liability reasons, I need you to quickly put your digital signature right here. You, or your estate, can't sue us if you're injured or die on the excursion. Furthermore there is no expectation of rescue should you get lost out there, or the Ice-Crawler breaks down." She gives you a small forced smile. "Not that it ever would happen, and like I said, this is a very standard waiver in the tourist trade. I wouldn't think too much about it."
units.italian: La donna tira fuori un piccolo schermo tattile. "Per ragioni di responsabilità del tutto standard, mi serve la tua firma digitale qui. Tu non potrai citarci in giudizio se ti ferisci o muori durante l'escursione, e nemmeno i tuoi eredi. Inoltre non c'è alcuna aspettativa di soccorso se ti perdi là fuori o se il cingolato si guasta." Ti rivolge un piccolo sorriso forzato. "Non che possa mai succedere, e come dicevo, è una liberatoria del tutto standard nel settore turistico. Non ci penserei troppo."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	She holds up the touchscreen for you to sign.|2926|0
units.english: She holds up the touchscreen for you to sign.
units.italian: Ti porge lo schermo tattile perché tu firmi.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Key my signature.)|2928|0
units.english: (Key my signature.)
units.italian: (Scrivi la tua firma.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"I've changed my mind. I am going to pass on this excursion."|2930|0
units.english: "I've changed my mind. I am going to pass on this excursion."
units.italian: "Ho cambiato idea. Questa escursione la salto."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The woman's face, red with the cold, looks crest-fallen, but unsurprised, like she was half expecting this outcome. "Brunhilda can be an... intimidating vehicle, it's true. But she is safe ser, I assure you. Either way, I'll take you back to the spaceport."|2931|0
units.english: The woman's face, red with the cold, looks crest-fallen, but unsurprised, like she was half expecting this outcome. "Brunhilda can be an... intimidating vehicle, it's true. But she is safe ser, I assure you. Either way, I'll take you back to the spaceport."
units.italian: Il viso della donna, arrossato dal freddo, si fa deluso ma non sorpreso, come se in parte se l'aspettasse. "Brunhilda può essere un... veicolo intimidatorio, è vero. Ma è sicura, ser, te lo assicuro. In ogni caso, ti riporto allo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	With that, you follow the woman back to the warm and nearly empty spaceport, where she leaves you to return to her forlorn booth.|2932|0
units.english: With that, you follow the woman back to the warm and nearly empty spaceport, where she leaves you to return to her forlorn booth.
units.italian: Detto questo, segui la donna fino allo spazioporto caldo e quasi vuoto, dove ti lascia per tornare al suo chiosco desolato.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	With your signature in hand, the woman's eyes sparkle, and there is a skip in her step as she leads you to the Ice-Crawler. She pulls a lever on the outside of the vehicle that opens a door and releases a ramshackle ramp for you to climb. She indicates that you should walk up the feeble looking ramp. "Hjlod will be your driver and tour-guide for the duration of your excursion. She is waiting for you within. On behalf of Intrepid Ice Adventures Limited, I would like to wish you a happy and safe expedition!"|2935|0
units.english: With your signature in hand, the woman's eyes sparkle, and there is a skip in her step as she leads you to the Ice-Crawler. She pulls a lever on the outside of the vehicle that opens a door and releases a ramshackle ramp for you to climb. She indicates that you should walk up the feeble looking ramp. "Hjlod will be your driver and tour-guide for the duration of your excursion. She is waiting for you within. On behalf of Intrepid Ice Adventures Limited, I would like to wish you a happy and safe expedition!"
units.italian: Con la tua firma in mano, gli occhi della donna brillano, e ha un passo saltellante mentre ti guida al cingolato del ghiaccio. Tira una leva all'esterno del veicolo, che apre una porta e cala una rampa traballante per salire. Ti indica di percorrere la rampa dall'aria fragile. "Hjlod sarà la tua autista e guida per tutta la durata dell'escursione. Ti sta aspettando là dentro. A nome di Intrepid Ice Adventures Limited, ti auguro una spedizione felice e sicura!"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Board the Ice-Crawler.)|2937|0
units.english: (Board the Ice-Crawler.)
units.italian: (Sali sul cingolato del ghiaccio.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The Ice-Crawler, 'Brunhilda,' smells of oil, atmosphere, and perspiration. The confines are tight, with a padded bench area and threadbare seat-belts. There are wires and hard angles everywhere. You're careful not to get tangled in the green, white and blue wires running overhead and into the cockpit. You take a seat and strap in.|2938|0
units.english: The Ice-Crawler, 'Brunhilda,' smells of oil, atmosphere, and perspiration. The confines are tight, with a padded bench area and threadbare seat-belts. There are wires and hard angles everywhere. You're careful not to get tangled in the green, white and blue wires running overhead and into the cockpit. You take a seat and strap in.
units.italian: Il cingolato del ghiaccio, 'Brunhilda', sa di olio, di aria viziata e di sudore. Lo spazio è angusto, con una panca imbottita e cinture di sicurezza consunte. Ci sono fili e spigoli ovunque. Stai attento a non impigliarti nei cavi verdi, bianchi e blu che corrono sopra la testa e finiscono nella cabina di pilotaggio. Ti siedi e ti allacci.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	It is only a little warmer here than it was in the maintenance dock. To your left and right are wide, scratched, and frost-rimmed windows.|2939|0
units.english: It is only a little warmer here than it was in the maintenance dock. To your left and right are wide, scratched, and frost-rimmed windows.
units.italian: Qui fa solo un po' più caldo che nel deposito di manutenzione. Alla tua sinistra e alla tua destra ci sono finestrini ampi, graffiati e bordati di brina.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Velcome. I am called Hjlod." The thickly accented woman looks back from the driver's seat. She has short blonde hair, and her face and arms are covered in long weaving blue tattoos. "I am from here. I have spent whole life traversing this tundra. I know like back of hand." She gives you a lopsided grin and then pats the steering console. "And Brunhilda here, she never let you down."|2940|0
units.english: "Velcome. I am called Hjlod." The thickly accented woman looks back from the driver's seat. She has short blonde hair, and her face and arms are covered in long weaving blue tattoos. "I am from here. I have spent whole life traversing this tundra. I know like back of hand." She gives you a lopsided grin and then pats the steering console. "And Brunhilda here, she never let you down."
units.italian: "Benvenuto. Mi chiamo Hjlod." La donna dall'accento marcato si volta dal sedile del conducente. Ha capelli biondi corti, e viso e braccia coperti di lunghi tatuaggi blu intrecciati. "Io sono di qui. Ho passato tutta vita a attraversare questa tundra. Io conosco questa terra come mie tasche." Ti fa sorriso storto, poi dà pacca alla console di guida. "E Brunhilda qui, lei non ti delude mai."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Hjlod turns away from you and starts pulling some levers. "Now," she says, "let's begin."|2941|0
units.english: Hjlod turns away from you and starts pulling some levers. "Now," she says, "let's begin."
units.italian: Hjlod si volta dall'altra parte e comincia a tirare alcune leve. "Adesso," dice, "cominciamo."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Sit back as the motor hums and the Ice-Crawler lurches to a start.)|2943|0
units.english: (Sit back as the motor hums and the Ice-Crawler lurches to a start.)
units.italian: (Sistemati mentre il motore ronza e il cingolato parte con uno scatto.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	After a few hours of crawling through a bleak, blank wasteland in silence, Hjlod turns the crawler into what looks like a bleaker and blanker wasteland.|2944|0
units.english: After a few hours of crawling through a bleak, blank wasteland in silence, Hjlod turns the crawler into what looks like a bleaker and blanker wasteland.
units.italian: Dopo qualche ora di avanzamento in silenzio attraverso una landa desolata e vuota, Hjlod porta il cingolato in quella che sembra una landa ancora più desolata e più vuota.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"This is famous Glaesisvellir ice-plain. Story say once whole convoy of researcher disappear here. Can drill hole in ice for fishing. There is very good tasting voolly octopus beneath it." Hjlod slows down and looks back at you. "You have question?"|2946|0
units.english: "This is famous Glaesisvellir ice-plain. Story say once whole convoy of researcher disappear here. Can drill hole in ice for fishing. There is very good tasting voolly octopus beneath it." Hjlod slows down and looks back at you. "You have question?"
units.italian: "Questa è famosa pianura di ghiaccio Glaesisvellir. Storia dice che una volta intero convoglio di ricercatori è sparito qui. Si può fare buco nel ghiaccio per pescare. Sotto c'è polpo lanoso, molto buono da mangiare." Hjlod rallenta e si volta verso di te. "Tu hai domande?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"What happened to the researchers?"|2949|0
units.english: "What happened to the researchers?"
units.italian: "Che fine hanno fatto i ricercatori?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Is it safe to drive over the ice?"|2952|0
units.english: "Is it safe to drive over the ice?"
units.italian: "È sicuro guidare sul ghiaccio?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Are there sea-monsters beneath the ice?"|2956|0
units.english: "Are there sea-monsters beneath the ice?"
units.italian: "Ci sono mostri marini sotto il ghiaccio?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Nope. No questions."|2960|0
units.english: "Nope. No questions."
units.italian: "No. Nessuna domanda."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Long time ago. Researcher convoy look for bacterial pharmaceutical. Many researcher convoy in area. Most smart use native pathfinder, like me. This convoy, they not so smart, they say pathfinder waste of money. They go out in ice alone and they never come back."|2964|0
units.english: "Long time ago. Researcher convoy look for bacterial pharmaceutical. Many researcher convoy in area. Most smart use native pathfinder, like me. This convoy, they not so smart, they say pathfinder waste of money. They go out in ice alone and they never come back."
units.italian: "Molto tempo fa. Convoglio di ricercatori cerca farmaco batterico. Molti convogli di ricercatori in zona. Più furbi usano guida locale, come me. Questo convoglio, non tanto furbo, dice che guida è spreco di soldi. Vanno fuori sul ghiaccio da soli e non tornano mai più."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Hjlod shrugs. "Maybe they fall in ice. Maybe they get eaten by Ice-Slug. Maybe avalanche fall on them. Maybe fall on own veapon and die. Nobody ever find them. Tour-guide book say that some night you can see their ghost haunting ice. Tour-guide book dumb."|2965|0
units.english: Hjlod shrugs. "Maybe they fall in ice. Maybe they get eaten by Ice-Slug. Maybe avalanche fall on them. Maybe fall on own veapon and die. Nobody ever find them. Tour-guide book say that some night you can see their ghost haunting ice. Tour-guide book dumb."
units.italian: Hjlod alza spalle. "Forse cadono nel ghiaccio. Forse li mangia Lumaca di Ghiaccio. Forse valanga cade sopra. Forse cadono su propria arma e muoiono. Nessuno li trova mai. Libro guida turistica dice che certe notti si vedono fantasmi che infestano ghiaccio. Libro guida turistica stupido."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Any more question?"|2966|0
units.english: "Any more question?"
units.italian: "Altre domande?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Very safe. Except when not. Ice always frozen, but sometime very thin. I can tell. You cannot. Trust Hjlod and you not drown and get eaten by Ice-Slug."|2971|0
units.english: "Very safe. Except when not. Ice always frozen, but sometime very thin. I can tell. You cannot. Trust Hjlod and you not drown and get eaten by Ice-Slug."
units.italian: "Molto sicuro. Tranne quando non lo è. Ghiaccio sempre congelato, ma a volte molto sottile. Io lo so. Tu no. Fidati di Hjlod e non affoghi e non ti mangia Lumaca di Ghiaccio."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"You have more question?"|2972|0
units.english: "You have more question?"
units.italian: "Tu hai altre domande?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Every world have animal. Some animal big, some small. Voolly octopus, mostly small. Size of this Ice-Crawler, only. Vorst in Glaesisvellir ice-plains is Ice-Slug. They can squeeze through tiniest hole in ice. This take long time, for they are as big as house. They have no teeth, too hard to squeeze through little hole, but they have acid spit. Put hole in Ice-Crawler, easy. They eat many foolish researcher and tourist."|2977|0
units.english: "Every world have animal. Some animal big, some small. Voolly octopus, mostly small. Size of this Ice-Crawler, only. Vorst in Glaesisvellir ice-plains is Ice-Slug. They can squeeze through tiniest hole in ice. This take long time, for they are as big as house. They have no teeth, too hard to squeeze through little hole, but they have acid spit. Put hole in Ice-Crawler, easy. They eat many foolish researcher and tourist."
units.italian: "Ogni mondo ha animale. Alcuni grandi, alcuni piccoli. Polpo lanoso, per lo più piccolo. Grande come questo cingolato, solo. La peggiore nelle pianure di ghiaccio Glaesisvellir è la Lumaca di Ghiaccio. Loro passano per buco più piccolo nel ghiaccio. Ci mettono molto tempo, perché sono grandi come casa. Non hanno denti, troppo difficile passare per buco piccolo, ma hanno sputo acido. Fanno buco nel cingolato, facile. Loro mangiano molti ricercatori stupidi e turisti."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	She smiles at you. "You're not foolish tourist. You are with Hjlod. You are safe."|2978|0
units.english: She smiles at you. "You're not foolish tourist. You are with Hjlod. You are safe."
units.italian: Lei ti sorride. "Tu non turista stupido. Tu con Hjlod. Tu al sicuro."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Any more question?"|2979|0
units.english: "Any more question?"
units.italian: "Altre domande?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|label|2981|0
units.english: no question
units.italian: no question

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Is smart, not to ask question. Hjlod tell you best parts only." Hjlod gives you a quick grin and swivels back into her makeshift cockpit. "Enough ice-plain, now ve go to next stop."|2982|0
units.english: "Is smart, not to ask question. Hjlod tell you best parts only." Hjlod gives you a quick grin and swivels back into her makeshift cockpit. "Enough ice-plain, now ve go to next stop."
units.italian: "È furbo, non fare domande. Hjlod racconta solo parti migliori." Hjlod ti fa un sorriso rapido e ruota di nuovo verso la sua cabina di fortuna. "Basta pianura di ghiaccio, adesso andiamo a prossima tappa."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Look out at the bright Ice-Plains as they slowly disappear into the dull horizon.)|2985|0
units.english: (Look out at the bright Ice-Plains as they slowly disappear into the dull horizon.)
units.italian: (Guarda le luminose Pianure di Ghiaccio mentre spariscono lentamente nell'orizzonte fosco.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The Ice-Crawler plows through snow, hill, mountain, and tundra for another hour or two before a massive and oddly shaped rock passes into view. Hjlod stops the Ice-Crawler so you can look at it.|2986|0
units.english: The Ice-Crawler plows through snow, hill, mountain, and tundra for another hour or two before a massive and oddly shaped rock passes into view. Hjlod stops the Ice-Crawler so you can look at it.
units.italian: Il cingolato avanza tra neve, colline, montagne e tundra per un'altra ora o due, prima che una roccia enorme e di forma strana entri nel tuo campo visivo. Hjlod ferma il cingolato perché tu possa guardarla.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"This is rock," she says matter-of-factly. You look at it for a while and realize there is a face half chiseled into it.|2988|0
units.english: "This is rock," she says matter-of-factly. You look at it for a while and realize there is a face half chiseled into it.
units.italian: "Questa è roccia," dice con tono pratico. La osservi per un po' e ti accorgi che vi è mezzo scolpito un volto.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"You are done looking? Ve are good to move to next stop?" Hjlod asks.|2989|0
units.english: "You are done looking? Ve are good to move to next stop?" Hjlod asks.
units.italian: "Hai finito di guardare? Buoni per andare a prossima tappa?" chiede Hjlod.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Yep, I don't need to look at this rock any longer."|2991|0
units.english: "Yep, I don't need to look at this rock any longer."
units.italian: "Sì, non ho più bisogno di guardare questa roccia."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Wait, is that part of a man's face carved into it? What is so special about this rock?"|2993|0
units.english: "Wait, is that part of a man's face carved into it? What is so special about this rock?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, è una parte di un volto umano quella scolpita lì dentro? Cosa ha di speciale questa roccia?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"That rock is supposed to celebrate man who discover Rigellian cure. He was called Hank, or Henry, or Bill, or something." Hjlod shrugs with evident disdain. "The cure was found here, but back when tundra was melting and Nifel was a little varmer. They say this man discover it and they want to make grand statue for him. But it turn out Nifel not so great place for statue. Beside, no one like statue of liar."|2994|0
units.english: "That rock is supposed to celebrate man who discover Rigellian cure. He was called Hank, or Henry, or Bill, or something." Hjlod shrugs with evident disdain. "The cure was found here, but back when tundra was melting and Nifel was a little varmer. They say this man discover it and they want to make grand statue for him. But it turn out Nifel not so great place for statue. Beside, no one like statue of liar."
units.italian: "Quella roccia dovrebbe celebrare uomo che ha scoperto cura rigelliana. Si chiamava Hank, o Henry, o Bill, o qualcosa." Hjlod alza spalle con evidente disprezzo. "La cura è stata trovata qui, ma allora la tundra si scioglieva e Nifel era un po' più caldo. Dicono che questo uomo l'ha scoperta e vogliono fare grande statua per lui. Ma viene fuori che Nifel non è posto tanto buono per statue. E poi, a nessuno piace statua di bugiardo."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Hjlod turns back to her controls and gets the Ice-Crawler moving forward again. "That is enough about stupid rock and stupider man.|2995|0
units.english: Hjlod turns back to her controls and gets the Ice-Crawler moving forward again. "That is enough about stupid rock and stupider man.
units.italian: Hjlod si volta verso i suoi comandi e rimette in moto il cingolato. "Basta con roccia stupida e uomo più stupido.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|label|2996|0
units.english: river like
units.italian: river like

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Now ve go to river," she tells you. The large, oddly shaped rock falls out of your field of view as the Ice-Crawler turns away from it.|2997|0
units.english: "Now ve go to river," she tells you. The large, oddly shaped rock falls out of your field of view as the Ice-Crawler turns away from it.
units.italian: "Adesso andiamo a fiume," ti dice. La grande roccia di forma strana esce dal tuo campo visivo mentre il cingolato si allontana.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The uneventful journey to the boiling ice river of Slidr is suddenly interrupted when a deep tremor followed by a thunderous boom shakes the Ice-Crawler to its core and causes it to slip on the disturbed ice and snow. Somewhere outside, subsequent rumble starts to build rapidly. After Hjlod regains control of the crawler, she immediately veers away from the noise. "That vas Nifel-quake, and loud noise was avalanche, or landslide, maybe both. This is not good."|2999|0
units.english: The uneventful journey to the boiling ice river of Slidr is suddenly interrupted when a deep tremor followed by a thunderous boom shakes the Ice-Crawler to its core and causes it to slip on the disturbed ice and snow. Somewhere outside, subsequent rumble starts to build rapidly. After Hjlod regains control of the crawler, she immediately veers away from the noise. "That vas Nifel-quake, and loud noise was avalanche, or landslide, maybe both. This is not good."
units.italian: Il viaggio senza eventi verso il fiume di ghiaccio ribollente dello Slidr è interrotto di colpo quando un tremore profondo seguito da un boato fragoroso scuote il cingolato fin nel midollo e lo fa scivolare sul ghiaccio e sulla neve sconvolti. Da qualche parte fuori, un rombo successivo comincia a crescere rapidamente. Dopo che Hjlod riprende il controllo del cingolato, si allontana subito dal rumore. "Quello era Nifel-terremoto, e rumore forte era valanga, o frana, forse entrambi. Questo non è buono."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Despite her calm demeanor, she wields the Ice-Crawler with reckless abandon as she tries to avoid the rumbling snow. The machine protests with creaks and whirrs and pops as it strains to claw itself out of the way faster than it has probably gone for hundreds of years. The closer the rumbling gets, the more difficulty Hjlod seems to have retaining traction.|3000|0
units.english: Despite her calm demeanor, she wields the Ice-Crawler with reckless abandon as she tries to avoid the rumbling snow. The machine protests with creaks and whirrs and pops as it strains to claw itself out of the way faster than it has probably gone for hundreds of years. The closer the rumbling gets, the more difficulty Hjlod seems to have retaining traction.
units.italian: Nonostante la sua calma apparente, manovra il cingolato con imprudenza per cercare di evitare la neve che romba. La macchina protesta con scricchiolii, ronzii e schiocchi mentre si sforza di togliersi di mezzo più velocemente di quanto probabilmente abbia fatto in centinaia di anni. Più il rombo si avvicina, più a Hjlod sembra difficile mantenere l'aderenza.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"I think-" Hjlod starts to say when a mountain of snow crashes into the Ice-Crawler with deafening force. All sense of travelling distance is lost as the snow blots out the windows and the crawler is dragged bumping and twisting over uneven terrain. You and Hjlod hold tight as you're tossed around until, eventually, the crawler grinds up against something reasonably solid and comes suddenly to a rest, partially on its side.|3001|0
units.english: "I think-" Hjlod starts to say when a mountain of snow crashes into the Ice-Crawler with deafening force. All sense of travelling distance is lost as the snow blots out the windows and the crawler is dragged bumping and twisting over uneven terrain. You and Hjlod hold tight as you're tossed around until, eventually, the crawler grinds up against something reasonably solid and comes suddenly to a rest, partially on its side.
units.italian: "Credo-" comincia a dire Hjlod, quando una montagna di neve si abbatte sul cingolato con forza assordante. Ogni senso della distanza percorsa si perde mentre la neve cancella i finestrini e il cingolato viene trascinato, sobbalzando e torcendosi, su un terreno irregolare. Tu e Hjlod vi tenete stretti mentre venite sballottati, finché alla fine il cingolato si incastra contro qualcosa di ragionevolmente solido e si ferma di colpo, in parte su un fianco.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	A few moments later, the rumbling finishes passing you by.|3002|0
units.english: A few moments later, the rumbling finishes passing you by.
units.italian: Pochi istanti dopo, il rombo finisce di passare oltre.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Unbuckle the seatbelt and get up.)|3004|0
units.english: (Unbuckle the seatbelt and get up.)
units.italian: (Slaccia la cintura e alzati.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	By the time you are on your feet, Hjlod has already gathered up numerous supplies and is preparing to open the hatch and dig her way to the surface. She looks at you. "Nothing to vorry about. Happens all time. Vell, not really. First time this happen, but Hjlod not let you die, probably. I can lead us to settlement not far from here."|3005|0
units.english: By the time you are on your feet, Hjlod has already gathered up numerous supplies and is preparing to open the hatch and dig her way to the surface. She looks at you. "Nothing to vorry about. Happens all time. Vell, not really. First time this happen, but Hjlod not let you die, probably. I can lead us to settlement not far from here."
units.italian: Quando sei in piedi, Hjlod ha già radunato numerose provviste e si prepara ad aprire il portello e a scavarsi la strada fino alla superficie. Ti guarda. "Niente di cui preoccuparsi. Succede sempre. Beh, non proprio. Prima volta che succede, ma Hjlod non ti lascia morire, probabilmente. Io posso guidare a insediamento non lontano da qui."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	She tosses you an old, scruffy jacket with a tear along one of its arms. "Valking in cold, good for health. Maybe not as far as ve must go, but you laugh about later. Good story to tell back home."|3006|0
units.english: She tosses you an old, scruffy jacket with a tear along one of its arms. "Valking in cold, good for health. Maybe not as far as ve must go, but you laugh about later. Good story to tell back home."
units.italian: Ti lancia una giacca vecchia e logora, con uno strappo su una manica. "Camminare nel freddo, buono per salute. Forse non fino a dove dobbiamo andare, ma poi tu ridi. Buona storia da raccontare a casa."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Put on the jacket and follow Hjlod out onto the ice.)|3008|0
units.english: (Put on the jacket and follow Hjlod out onto the ice.)
units.italian: (Mettiti la giacca e segui Hjlod sul ghiaccio.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"No way. I am done with this. I am calling my ship, or fixing this Ice-Crawler. Either way, I am not going anywhere."|3010|0
units.english: "No way. I am done with this. I am calling my ship, or fixing this Ice-Crawler. Either way, I am not going anywhere."
units.italian: "Non se ne parla. Ne ho abbastanza. Chiamo la mia nave, o riparo questo cingolato. In un modo o nell'altro, non vado da nessuna parte."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Hjlod shrugs. "You may die, or maybe not. Signals vork strange here at times. Good luck and remember. No refund." With that, Hjlod opens the hatch and disappears in the cold white flurry outside.|3011|0
units.english: Hjlod shrugs. "You may die, or maybe not. Signals vork strange here at times. Good luck and remember. No refund." With that, Hjlod opens the hatch and disappears in the cold white flurry outside.
units.italian: Hjlod alza spalle. "Tu forse muori, forse no. Segnali qui funzionano strano a volte. Buona fortuna e ricorda. Nessun rimborso." Detto questo, Hjlod apre il portello e sparisce nella tormenta bianca e fredda fuori.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Quickly shut the hatch behind her.)|3013|0
units.english: (Quickly shut the hatch behind her.)
units.italian: (Chiudi in fretta il portello dietro di lei.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Alone, you have a decision to make. You can dismantle portions of the Ice-Crawler and use them to strengthen your personal comms to get a signal out to the <ship>. Or, you can try to repair the Ice-Crawler and get it running again - in which case you wouldn't be able to use its parts to boost your comm signal.|3014|0
units.english: Alone, you have a decision to make. You can dismantle portions of the Ice-Crawler and use them to strengthen your personal comms to get a signal out to the <ship>. Or, you can try to repair the Ice-Crawler and get it running again - in which case you wouldn't be able to use its parts to boost your comm signal.
units.italian: Da solo, devi prendere una decisione. Puoi smontare parti del cingolato e usarle per potenziare le tue comunicazioni personali e lanciare un segnale alla <ship>. Oppure puoi provare a riparare il cingolato e rimetterlo in funzione, ma in quel caso non potresti usarne i pezzi per potenziare il segnale.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Cannibalize the Ice-Crawler to communicate.)|3016|0
units.english: (Cannibalize the Ice-Crawler to communicate.)
units.italian: (Saccheggia il cingolato per comunicare.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Try to fix the Ice-Crawler.)|3017|0
units.english: (Try to fix the Ice-Crawler.)
units.italian: (Prova a riparare il cingolato.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	You have much more faith in your ship than some antique vehicle. You spend hours ripping once-vital machinery out of the Ice-Crawler in order to make a signal booster for your comms, eventually cobbling together a functional booster and programming a repeating burst S.O.S. message into it.|3019|0
units.english: You have much more faith in your ship than some antique vehicle. You spend hours ripping once-vital machinery out of the Ice-Crawler in order to make a signal booster for your comms, eventually cobbling together a functional booster and programming a repeating burst S.O.S. message into it.
units.italian: Hai molta più fiducia nella tua nave che in un veicolo d'epoca. Passi ore a strappare dal cingolato macchinari un tempo vitali per costruire un amplificatore di segnale per le tue comunicazioni, finché riesci ad assemblare un amplificatore funzionante e a programmarvi dentro un messaggio S.O.S. ripetuto a raffica.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|You're certain your ship will eventually pick it up. Unfortunately, the damage you've done to the Ice-Crawler has affected its heater, which gives out during your eighth hour of waiting. In the meantime, you put on the jacket Hjlod left you and stuff it with rags and trash in a bid to keep warm.|3020|0
units.english: You're certain your ship will eventually pick it up. Unfortunately, the damage you've done to the Ice-Crawler has affected its heater, which gives out during your eighth hour of waiting. In the meantime, you put on the jacket Hjlod left you and stuff it with rags and trash in a bid to keep warm.
units.italian: Sei certo che la tua nave prima o poi lo captarà. Purtroppo i danni che hai fatto al cingolato hanno compromesso il riscaldamento, che cede durante la tua ottava ora di attesa. Nel frattempo ti metti la giacca lasciata da Hjlod e la riempi di stracci e immondizia nel tentativo di restare al caldo.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Try to ignore the cold and get some sleep.)|3022|0
units.english: (Try to ignore the cold and get some sleep.)
units.italian: (Prova a ignorare il freddo e a dormire un po'.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	As the hours go by, you lose feeling in your hands and feet. There are no rations, and what stale warmth was once here is now gone. Hopefully, you didn't make a mistake waiting here. You know you made a mistake by going on this miserable tour. You just want to be warm again, and you certainly don't want to die here.|3023|0
units.english: As the hours go by, you lose feeling in your hands and feet. There are no rations, and what stale warmth was once here is now gone. Hopefully, you didn't make a mistake waiting here. You know you made a mistake by going on this miserable tour. You just want to be warm again, and you certainly don't want to die here.
units.italian: Con il passare delle ore perdi la sensibilità a mani e piedi. Non ci sono razioni, e quel po' di calore stantio che c'era è ormai svanito. Speri solo di non aver sbagliato ad aspettare qui. Sai di aver fatto un errore a partire per questa gita miserabile. Vuoi solo tornare al caldo, e di certo non vuoi morire qui.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	You begin to fade in and out of consciousness, when suddenly you feel a deep vibration, and hear a low rumble from outside.|3024|0
units.english: You begin to fade in and out of consciousness, when suddenly you feel a deep vibration, and hear a low rumble from outside.
units.italian: Cominci a perdere e riprendere conoscenza, quando all'improvviso senti una vibrazione profonda e un basso rombo provenire da fuori.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	There is no memory of what happens next. But somehow you must have crawled out of that ice buried Ice-Crawler, through the snow, and into the hatch of your ship, because the next thing you do remember is laying in your ship, warming up, and being glad that the ordeal is over.|3025|0
units.english: There is no memory of what happens next. But somehow you must have crawled out of that ice buried Ice-Crawler, through the snow, and into the hatch of your ship, because the next thing you do remember is laying in your ship, warming up, and being glad that the ordeal is over.
units.italian: Non hai memoria di ciò che accade dopo. Ma in qualche modo devi essere strisciato fuori da quel cingolato sepolto nel ghiaccio, attraverso la neve, e dentro il portello della tua nave, perché la cosa successiva che ricordi è giacere nella tua nave, riscaldarti ed essere felice che l'incubo sia finito.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|label|3027|0
units.english: fix me
units.italian: fix me

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	After hours of tinkering with the guts of the machine, you manage to repair most of it, and all it costs you is one bad burn on your arm. Now, what it comes down to is a sequence of wires. If you can plug these in correctly, the Ice-Crawler should start back up.|3028|0
units.english: After hours of tinkering with the guts of the machine, you manage to repair most of it, and all it costs you is one bad burn on your arm. Now, what it comes down to is a sequence of wires. If you can plug these in correctly, the Ice-Crawler should start back up.
units.italian: Dopo ore a trafficare con le viscere della macchina, riesci a ripararne la maggior parte, e ti costa solo una brutta ustione al braccio. Ora tutto si riduce a una sequenza di fili. Se riesci a collegarli nell'ordine giusto, il cingolato dovrebbe ripartire.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(White, green, blue.)|3030|0
units.english: (White, green, blue.)
units.italian: (Bianco, verde, blu.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Green, white, blue.)|3032|0
units.english: (Green, white, blue.)
units.italian: (Verde, bianco, blu.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Blue, green, white.)|3034|0
units.english: (Blue, green, white.)
units.italian: (Blu, verde, bianco.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	You're confident that this is the correct sequence of wires. You plug each one in and start the Ice-Crawler up. The vehicle hums to life.|3037|0
units.english: You're confident that this is the correct sequence of wires. You plug each one in and start the Ice-Crawler up. The vehicle hums to life.
units.italian: Sei sicuro che questa sia la sequenza corretta dei fili. Li colleghi uno per uno e avvii il cingolato. Il veicolo prende vita con un ronzio.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Pump a fist into the air.)|3039|0
units.english: (Pump a fist into the air.)
units.italian: (Alza il pugno in aria.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Cheer.)|3040|0
units.english: (Cheer.)
units.italian: (Esulta.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	In a moment of levity, you pump your fist into the air.|3042|0
units.english: In a moment of levity, you pump your fist into the air.
units.italian: In un momento di euforia, alzi il pugno in aria.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Unfortunately, your fist does not make it very far. The Ice-Crawler, with its criss-crossed wires, has a critical energy build up that results in an instantaneous, completely deadly explosion.|3043|0
units.english: Unfortunately, your fist does not make it very far. The Ice-Crawler, with its criss-crossed wires, has a critical energy build up that results in an instantaneous, completely deadly explosion.
units.italian: Purtroppo il tuo pugno non arriva molto lontano. Il cingolato, con i suoi fili incrociati, ha un accumulo critico di energia che provoca un'esplosione istantanea e del tutto letale.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The Ice-Crawler, your entire body, your fist, and more than a couple hundred tons of snow are all incinerated in a fraction of a second.|3045|0
units.english: The Ice-Crawler, your entire body, your fist, and more than a couple hundred tons of snow are all incinerated in a fraction of a second.
units.italian: Il cingolato, tutto il tuo corpo, il tuo pugno e più di un paio di centinaia di tonnellate di neve vengono inceneriti in una frazione di secondo.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The sense of accomplishment inside you is so overwhelming that you find yourself unable to contain it. A cry of pure joy leaps out of your mouth. Or begins to. Unfortunately, it doesn't get too far, as the Ice-Crawler, with its criss-crossed wires, has a critical energy build up that results in an instantaneous, completely deadly explosion.|3048|0
units.english: The sense of accomplishment inside you is so overwhelming that you find yourself unable to contain it. A cry of pure joy leaps out of your mouth. Or begins to. Unfortunately, it doesn't get too far, as the Ice-Crawler, with its criss-crossed wires, has a critical energy build up that results in an instantaneous, completely deadly explosion.
units.italian: Il senso di soddisfazione dentro di te è così travolgente che non riesci a contenerlo. Un grido di pura gioia ti sfugge dalla bocca. O comincia a sfuggire. Purtroppo non arriva molto lontano, perché il cingolato, con i suoi fili incrociati, ha un accumulo critico di energia che provoca un'esplosione istantanea e del tutto letale.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The Ice-Crawler, your entire body, and more than a couple hundred tons of snow are all incinerated in a fraction of a second.|3050|0
units.english: The Ice-Crawler, your entire body, and more than a couple hundred tons of snow are all incinerated in a fraction of a second.
units.italian: Il cingolato, tutto il tuo corpo e più di un paio di centinaia di tonnellate di neve vengono inceneriti in una frazione di secondo.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|label|3052|0
units.english: great success
units.italian: great success

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	With the final cord in place, you hold your breath as you start the Ice-Crawler. The engine hums to life and you wait a few more cautious seconds for the inevitable explosion... which never comes.|3053|0
units.english: With the final cord in place, you hold your breath as you start the Ice-Crawler. The engine hums to life and you wait a few more cautious seconds for the inevitable explosion... which never comes.
units.italian: Con l'ultimo cavo a posto, trattieni il respiro mentre avvii il cingolato. Il motore ronza e tu aspetti qualche altro secondo con prudenza l'inevitabile esplosione... che non arriva mai.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	You breathe easy. You did it! After a few minutes getting accustomed to the controls you manage to pull the Ice-Crawler out of the snow. What will you do now?|3054|0
units.english: You breathe easy. You did it! After a few minutes getting accustomed to the controls you manage to pull the Ice-Crawler out of the snow. What will you do now?
units.italian: Respiri di sollievo. Ce l'hai fatta! Dopo qualche minuto per abituarti ai comandi riesci a tirare fuori il cingolato dalla neve. E adesso cosa fai?

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Follow Hjlod's tracks.)|3057|0
units.english: (Follow Hjlod's tracks.)
units.italian: (Segui le tracce di Hjlod.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Try and find a way to the spaceport.)|3059|0
units.english: (Try and find a way to the spaceport.)
units.italian: (Prova a trovare la strada per lo spazioporto.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	You've had enough of this expedition. Hjlod said she was fine, and you'll leave it at that. You turn the Ice-Crawler around and make your way back to the spaceport.|3060|0
units.english: You've had enough of this expedition. Hjlod said she was fine, and you'll leave it at that. You turn the Ice-Crawler around and make your way back to the spaceport.
units.italian: Ne hai abbastanza di questa spedizione. Hjlod ha detto che stava bene, e per te la cosa finisce lì. Giri il cingolato e torni verso lo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	It only takes a couple hours, and the controls on the Ice-Crawler are relatively easy. When you pull into the maintenance dock, the sales woman comes to meet you and is dismayed that Hjlod is not with you.|3061|0
units.english: It only takes a couple hours, and the controls on the Ice-Crawler are relatively easy. When you pull into the maintenance dock, the sales woman comes to meet you and is dismayed that Hjlod is not with you.
units.italian: Ti servono solo un paio d'ore, e i comandi del cingolato sono relativamente semplici. Quando entri nel deposito di manutenzione, la venditrice ti viene incontro e si sgomenta nel vedere che Hjlod non è con te.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	She hasn't heard from Hjlod and fears the worst. You hope it all works out as you head back to your ship and as far away from this place as possible.|3062|0
units.english: She hasn't heard from Hjlod and fears the worst. You hope it all works out as you head back to your ship and as far away from this place as possible.
units.italian: Non ha avuto notizie di Hjlod e teme il peggio. Speri che tutto si sistemi mentre torni alla tua nave e il più lontano possibile da questo posto.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|label|3064|0
units.english: follow her
units.italian: follow her

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Hjlod's tracks are clearly visible in the crisp snow, and you're able to follow them for hours. Just as the second sun is setting, the footprints come to an end at a mound of snow.|3065|0
units.english: Hjlod's tracks are clearly visible in the crisp snow, and you're able to follow them for hours. Just as the second sun is setting, the footprints come to an end at a mound of snow.
units.italian: Le tracce di Hjlod sono ben visibili nella neve croccante, e riesci a seguirle per ore. Proprio mentre il secondo sole tramonta, le impronte finiscono contro un mucchio di neve.
