units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	You leave the vehicle and investigate. You find an exhausted, freezing Hjlod and help her back into the Ice-Crawler. She does not have the strength to speak, and you worry without immediate medical attention that she won't make it.|3066|0
units.english: You leave the vehicle and investigate. You find an exhausted, freezing Hjlod and help her back into the Ice-Crawler. She does not have the strength to speak, and you worry without immediate medical attention that she won't make it.
units.italian: Scendi dal veicolo e vai a controllare. Trovi Hjlod esausta e intirizzita e la aiuti a tornare sul cingolato. Non ha la forza di parlare, e temi che senza cure mediche immediate non ce la farà.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	As darkness descends, you see a flickering light in the distance.|3067|0
units.english: As darkness descends, you see a flickering light in the distance.
units.italian: Mentre scende il buio, vedi una luce tremolante in lontananza.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Drive toward the flickering light.)|3069|0
units.english: (Drive toward the flickering light.)
units.italian: (Guida verso la luce tremolante.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Drive back to the spaceport.)|3071|0
units.english: (Drive back to the spaceport.)
units.italian: (Torna allo spazioporto.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	There is no guarantee that the flicker of light is anything more than a waste of time. You turn the Ice-Crawler around and head back toward the spaceport at the fastest speed you dare.|3072|0
units.english: There is no guarantee that the flicker of light is anything more than a waste of time. You turn the Ice-Crawler around and head back toward the spaceport at the fastest speed you dare.
units.italian: Non hai alcuna garanzia che quel tremolio di luce non sia solo una perdita di tempo. Giri il cingolato e torni verso lo spazioporto alla velocità più alta che osi.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Long hours pass and you press on while Hjlod lays unconscious...|3073|0
units.english: Long hours pass and you press on while Hjlod lays unconscious...
units.italian: Passano lunghe ore e tu vai avanti mentre Hjlod giace priva di sensi...

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Finally, in the dead of night you arrive back at the spaceport. Medics swarm your vehicle, and while you learn she'll live, you are also told that she will lose her hands and feet to frostbite. The woman who sold you the excursion thanks you profusely for saving her friend, but still refuses to give you a refund.|3074|0
units.english: Finally, in the dead of night you arrive back at the spaceport. Medics swarm your vehicle, and while you learn she'll live, you are also told that she will lose her hands and feet to frostbite. The woman who sold you the excursion thanks you profusely for saving her friend, but still refuses to give you a refund.
units.italian: Alla fine, nel cuore della notte, arrivi allo spazioporto. I medici si accalcano intorno al tuo veicolo, e mentre scopri che vivrà, ti dicono anche che perderà mani e piedi per i danni da congelamento. La donna che ti ha venduto l'escursione ti ringrazia profusamente per aver salvato la sua amica, ma continua a rifiutarsi di rimborsarti.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Exhausted, you drive toward the flickering light and discover it is emanating from a small village.|3077|0
units.english: Exhausted, you drive toward the flickering light and discover it is emanating from a small village.
units.italian: Esausto, guidi verso la luce tremolante e scopri che proviene da un piccolo villaggio.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Moments after entering what you assume is the village center, people flock toward your idle vehicle. Before you know it, they have the hatch open and have carried Hjlod out.|3078|0
units.english: Moments after entering what you assume is the village center, people flock toward your idle vehicle. Before you know it, they have the hatch open and have carried Hjlod out.
units.italian: Pochi istanti dopo essere entrato in quello che supponi sia il centro del villaggio, la gente accorre verso il tuo veicolo fermo. Prima che tu te ne accorga, hanno aperto il portello e hanno tirato fuori Hjlod.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	A young woman, bearing facial tattoos similar to Hjlod, approaches you and escorts you to a communal bunk house for the night. You're too tired to get a handle on what is going on and decide that it can wait for tomorrow.|3079|0
units.english: A young woman, bearing facial tattoos similar to Hjlod, approaches you and escorts you to a communal bunk house for the night. You're too tired to get a handle on what is going on and decide that it can wait for tomorrow.
units.italian: Una giovane donna, con tatuaggi sul viso simili a quelli di Hjlod, ti si avvicina e ti accompagna a un dormitorio comune per la notte. Sei troppo stanco per capire cosa stia succedendo e decidi che può aspettare domani.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Sleep now, think later.)|3082|0
units.english: (Sleep now, think later.)
units.italian: (Dormi adesso, pensa dopo.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	You throw on the jacket and stuff a few rags in your coat for good measure.|3087|0
units.english: You throw on the jacket and stuff a few rags in your coat for good measure.
units.italian: Ti infili la giacca e ti riempi il cappotto di qualche straccio, per buona misura.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Hjlod nods at you and opens the hatch. "It is only meter to surface."|3088|0
units.english: Hjlod nods at you and opens the hatch. "It is only meter to surface."
units.italian: Hjlod ti fa un cenno e apre il portello. "Solo un metro alla superficie."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	She plunges into the snow and swim-climbs her way up it. You follow her, and though the cold is shocking, you are relieved when you quickly rise above it into the icy clear air above.|3089|0
units.english: She plunges into the snow and swim-climbs her way up it. You follow her, and though the cold is shocking, you are relieved when you quickly rise above it into the icy clear air above.
units.italian: Si tuffa nella neve e se ne risale come nuotando. La segui, e anche se il freddo è scioccante, ti senti sollevato quando emergi presto nell'aria gelida e limpida lassù.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Stay close," she says as she begins to trek through the snow. "Any path but mine is dangerous."|3090|0
units.english: "Stay close," she says as she begins to trek through the snow. "Any path but mine is dangerous."
units.italian: "Stai vicino," dice mentre comincia ad avanzare nella neve. "Qualsiasi sentiero tranne mio è pericoloso."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Walk in Hjlod's footsteps.)|3093|0
units.english: (Walk in Hjlod's footsteps.)
units.italian: (Cammina sulle orme di Hjlod.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Meander around.)|3095|0
units.english: (Meander around.)
units.italian: (Gironzola intorno.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Hjlod abruptly stops and glares at you. "You are fool. You vill certainly die, and you endanger me in process. This is no game, valk only vhere I valk or die."|3096|0
units.english: Hjlod abruptly stops and glares at you. "You are fool. You vill certainly die, and you endanger me in process. This is no game, valk only vhere I valk or die."
units.italian: Hjlod si ferma di colpo e ti lancia un'occhiataccia. "Tu sei stupido. Tu muori di sicuro, e metti in pericolo me. Questo non è gioco, cammina solo dove cammino io o muori."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Walk in Hjlod's footsteps.)|3098|0
units.english: (Walk in Hjlod's footsteps.)
units.italian: (Cammina sulle orme di Hjlod.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Continue to meander.)|3100|0
units.english: (Continue to meander.)
units.italian: (Continua a gironzolare.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	You walk in your looping meandering pattern, stepping where you want, and not paying any attention to the path Hjlod is taking.|3101|0
units.english: You walk in your looping meandering pattern, stepping where you want, and not paying any attention to the path Hjlod is taking.
units.italian: Cammini nel tuo andamento circolare e vagabondo, mettendo i piedi dove vuoi, senza prestare alcuna attenzione al percorso che segue Hjlod.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	You feel righteous vindication as the hours pass and nothing bad happens; proof that Hjlod was just being bossy. She should have no say over what you are doing; it's her fault you're stuck out here stranded on some trash-planet in the blinding cold in the first place.|3102|0
units.english: You feel righteous vindication as the hours pass and nothing bad happens; proof that Hjlod was just being bossy. She should have no say over what you are doing; it's her fault you're stuck out here stranded on some trash-planet in the blinding cold in the first place.
units.italian: Senti una giusta rivalsa con il passare delle ore e senza che accada nulla di brutto; prova che Hjlod stava solo facendo la prepotente. Non dovrebbe avere voce in capitolo su quello che fai; è colpa sua se sei bloccato qui su un pianeta spazzatura nel freddo accecante.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	At that thought you do some anger-stomping, really letting her know that you could care less about her worthless warnings. Which is, of course, when you hear a weird gurgling sizzle. You look down at your feet and see there is not packed snow beneath them, but that a gray-purple blob that has wrapped itself around your leg.|3103|0
units.english: At that thought you do some anger-stomping, really letting her know that you could care less about her worthless warnings. Which is, of course, when you hear a weird gurgling sizzle. You look down at your feet and see there is not packed snow beneath them, but that a gray-purple blob that has wrapped itself around your leg.
units.italian: A quel pensiero fai qualche pestata di rabbia, per farle capire bene che le sue inutili avvertenze ti interessano ben poco. Ed è proprio allora, naturalmente, che senti uno strano sfrigolio gorgogliante. Guardi giù verso i piedi e vedi che sotto non c'è neve compatta, ma una massa grigio-violacea che si è avvolta intorno alla tua gamba.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Try and shake free.)|3105|0
units.english: (Try and shake free.)
units.italian: (Prova a liberarti scuotendoti.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Call out to Hjlod for help.)|3107|0
units.english: (Call out to Hjlod for help.)
units.italian: (Chiama Hjlod in aiuto.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Damn your pride. "Hjlod, help! Something's got my foot!" you cry.|3108|0
units.english: Damn your pride. "Hjlod, help! Something's got my foot!" you cry.
units.italian: Al diavolo l'orgoglio. "Hjlod, aiuto! Qualcosa mi ha preso il piede!" gridi.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Hjlod looks back at you with a dull expression on her face. "Is it purple-gray in color?"|3109|0
units.english: Hjlod looks back at you with a dull expression on her face. "Is it purple-gray in color?"
units.italian: Hjlod si volta verso di te con un'espressione inespressiva. "È di colore grigio-viola?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Yes, yes! Quick, help. I don't know what to do."|3110|0
units.english: "Yes, yes! Quick, help. I don't know what to do."
units.italian: "Sì, sì! Presto, aiuto. Non so cosa fare."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Vhat you do is listen to Hjlod, and not make stompy circles in snow like spoilt child."|3111|0
units.english: "Vhat you do is listen to Hjlod, and not make stompy circles in snow like spoilt child."
units.italian: "Quello che fai è dare ascolto a Hjlod, e non fare cerchi pestando neve come bambino viziato."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Please, Hjlod!" You cry as the last of your boot dissolves away and you feel the slimy slug on your exposed foot.|3112|0
units.english: "Please, Hjlod!" You cry as the last of your boot dissolves away and you feel the slimy slug on your exposed foot.
units.italian: "Ti prego, Hjlod!" Gridi mentre l'ultimo pezzo del tuo stivale si dissolve e senti la lumaca viscida sul piede scoperto.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"It is too late. Ice-Slug has you. Vhat you do now is die. Horribly." Hjlod turns and starts jogging away from you.|3113|0
units.english: "It is too late. Ice-Slug has you. Vhat you do now is die. Horribly." Hjlod turns and starts jogging away from you.
units.italian: "È troppo tardi. Lumaca di Ghiaccio ha te. Quello che fai adesso è morire. Orribilmente." Hjlod si volta e comincia a correre via da te.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Try and pull free.)|3115|0
units.english: (Try and pull free.)
units.italian: (Prova a liberarti tirando.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Despite using all your strength, your leg won't budge. The sizzling noise continues and you are overwhelmed with a sharp horrific burning sensation. Your eyes water and you scream out in pain for help and mercy.|3117|0
units.english: Despite using all your strength, your leg won't budge. The sizzling noise continues and you are overwhelmed with a sharp horrific burning sensation. Your eyes water and you scream out in pain for help and mercy.
units.italian: Nonostante tutta la tua forza, la gamba non si muove. Lo sfrigolio continua e tu vieni travolto da una sensazione di bruciore acuto e atroce. Gli occhi ti si riempiono di lacrime e urli di dolore, chiedendo aiuto e pietà.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	You keep pulling, trying to break free. The air thickens with the scent of your liquified foot, and something gives as you fall forward. You look down to see your leg missing from the knee down. You try to push it out of your mind as you desperately claw forward, trying to escape the gray-purple blob that is forming up behind you.|3118|0
units.english: You keep pulling, trying to break free. The air thickens with the scent of your liquified foot, and something gives as you fall forward. You look down to see your leg missing from the knee down. You try to push it out of your mind as you desperately claw forward, trying to escape the gray-purple blob that is forming up behind you.
units.italian: Tiri ancora, cercando di liberarti. L'aria si fa densa dell'odore del tuo piede liquefatto, e qualcosa cede mentre cadi in avanti. Guardi giù e vedi che la gamba manca dal ginocchio in giù. Cerchi di non pensarci mentre ti trascini disperatamente in avanti, tentando di sfuggire alla massa grigio-violacea che si sta formando dietro di te.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Try as you might, you can't cry out Hjlod's name; instead your screams are savage, hollow noises. You reach for her, you reach for anyone, but it's too late. The Ice-Slug has caught up to you, and you feel its acidic tendrils wrapping around your remaining leg and lower torso. The pain is agonizing as your lower body begins to dissolve.|3119|0
units.english: Try as you might, you can't cry out Hjlod's name; instead your screams are savage, hollow noises. You reach for her, you reach for anyone, but it's too late. The Ice-Slug has caught up to you, and you feel its acidic tendrils wrapping around your remaining leg and lower torso. The pain is agonizing as your lower body begins to dissolve.
units.italian: Per quanto ci provi, non riesci a gridare il nome di Hjlod; i tuoi urli sono suoni feroci e vuoti. Allunghi le mani verso di lei, verso chiunque, ma è troppo tardi. La Lumaca di Ghiaccio ti ha raggiunto, e senti i suoi viticci acidi avvolgersi intorno alla gamba rimasta e alla parte inferiore del busto. Il dolore è straziante mentre la parte bassa del tuo corpo comincia a dissolversi.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	You look up one last desperate time, hoping to see Hjlod coming to rescue you, but all you see is a gray smudge on the horizon, a distant person who has long left you for dead. You are alone now with the Ice-Slug and the pain. You consider briefly your mistakes before you are dissolved and eaten.|3120|0
units.english: You look up one last desperate time, hoping to see Hjlod coming to rescue you, but all you see is a gray smudge on the horizon, a distant person who has long left you for dead. You are alone now with the Ice-Slug and the pain. You consider briefly your mistakes before you are dissolved and eaten.
units.italian: Alzi lo sguardo un'ultima volta, disperato, sperando di vedere Hjlod che arriva a salvarti, ma tutto ciò che vedi è una macchia grigia all'orizzonte, una persona lontana che ti ha lasciato per morto da tempo. Ora sei solo con la Lumaca di Ghiaccio e con il dolore. Consideri brevemente i tuoi errori prima di essere dissolto e mangiato.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The cold, monotonous trudging weighs on you as the hours pass. You're dimly aware of Nifel's two suns as they make their journey across the wide open sky.|3123|0
units.english: The cold, monotonous trudging weighs on you as the hours pass. You're dimly aware of Nifel's two suns as they make their journey across the wide open sky.
units.italian: Il cammino freddo e monotono ti pesa con il passare delle ore. Ti accorgi vagamente dei due soli di Nifel che compiono il loro percorso nel vasto cielo aperto.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Evening and exhaustion approach hand in hand, and as the last sun sets, you're not sure how much farther you can go. "There!" Hjlod breaks the silence of hours as she points at the weak flicker of light in the twilight landscape. "This is good," she admits hoarsely as you both stumble toward the light. "Ve vould have not survived night."|3124|0
units.english: Evening and exhaustion approach hand in hand, and as the last sun sets, you're not sure how much farther you can go. "There!" Hjlod breaks the silence of hours as she points at the weak flicker of light in the twilight landscape. "This is good," she admits hoarsely as you both stumble toward the light. "Ve vould have not survived night."
units.italian: Sera e stanchezza arrivano insieme, e quando l'ultimo sole tramonta non sai quanto ancora potrai andare avanti. "Là!" Hjlod rompe il silenzio di ore indicando il debole tremolio di luce nel paesaggio crepuscolare. "Questo è buono," ammette con voce roca mentre entrambi barcollate verso la luce. "Noi non saremmo sopravvissuti a notte."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The night air grows too cold. You slow as your body begins to shutdown and frostbite gnaws at your hands, feet and exposed arm. The light is still too distant, and you can barely move. You think you see the shadows of humanoid figures against the light. But then you stumble and fall. You crawl for as long as you can. And then nothing.|3125|0
units.english: The night air grows too cold. You slow as your body begins to shutdown and frostbite gnaws at your hands, feet and exposed arm. The light is still too distant, and you can barely move. You think you see the shadows of humanoid figures against the light. But then you stumble and fall. You crawl for as long as you can. And then nothing.
units.italian: L'aria notturna diventa troppo fredda. Rallenti mentre il tuo corpo comincia a spegnersi e il congelamento ti rode mani, piedi e il braccio scoperto. La luce è ancora troppo lontana e riesci a malapena a muoverti. Ti sembra di vedere le ombre di figure umanoidi contro la luce. Ma poi inciampi e cadi. Strisci finché puoi. E poi il nulla.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Wake up.)|3127|0
units.english: (Wake up.)
units.italian: (Svegliati.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|label|3128|0
units.english: village arrival
units.italian: village arrival

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The pale morning light of the first sun filters in through a synthetic window and onto your face. You try to escape back into sleep, but something feels off and groggily you peer out at your surroundings.|3131|0
units.english: The pale morning light of the first sun filters in through a synthetic window and onto your face. You try to escape back into sleep, but something feels off and groggily you peer out at your surroundings.
units.italian: La pallida luce mattutina del primo sole filtra da una finestra sintetica e ti arriva sul viso. Cerchi di tornare a dormire, ma qualcosa non torna e, intontito, scruti ciò che ti circonda.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|label|3133|0
units.english: body aches
units.italian: body aches

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The pale morning light of the first sun filters in through a synthetic window and onto your face. Your body aches and you try to sink back into sleep, but something feels off and you focus on your surroundings.|3134|0
units.english: The pale morning light of the first sun filters in through a synthetic window and onto your face. Your body aches and you try to sink back into sleep, but something feels off and you focus on your surroundings.
units.italian: La pallida luce mattutina del primo sole filtra da una finestra sintetica e ti arriva sul viso. Ti fa male tutto il corpo e cerchi di sprofondare di nuovo nel sonno, ma qualcosa non torna e ti concentri su ciò che ti circonda.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	You're in a half-wooden, half-synthetic barracks, a strange mix of primitive earth-tech and old colonial architecture. That, in and of itself, isn't that alarming. What is, however, is the group of people gathered around your bed quietly staring and pointing at you.|3136|0
units.english: You're in a half-wooden, half-synthetic barracks, a strange mix of primitive earth-tech and old colonial architecture. That, in and of itself, isn't that alarming. What is, however, is the group of people gathered around your bed quietly staring and pointing at you.
units.italian: Sei in una caserma metà di legno e metà sintetica, uno strano mix di tecnologia terrestre primitiva e vecchia architettura coloniale. Di per sé, la cosa non è poi così allarmante. Lo è invece il gruppo di persone radunate intorno al tuo letto, che ti fissano e ti indicano in silenzio.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Excuse me?"|3138|0
units.english: "Excuse me?"
units.italian: "Scusate?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The crowd steps back, and an elderly woman steps forward. Her gray hair is rolled up into tight, elegant braids, and her face and hands are covered in faded, blue tattoos.|3139|0
units.english: The crowd steps back, and an elderly woman steps forward. Her gray hair is rolled up into tight, elegant braids, and her face and hands are covered in faded, blue tattoos.
units.italian: La folla indietreggia, e una donna anziana si fa avanti. I capelli grigi sono raccolti in trecce strette ed eleganti, e il viso e le mani sono coperti di tatuaggi blu sbiaditi.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"We are pleased to call you guest. You have saved our daughter, and more; you will save us all." The elderly woman and everyone behind her kneels before you.|3140|0
units.english: "We are pleased to call you guest. You have saved our daughter, and more; you will save us all." The elderly woman and everyone behind her kneels before you.
units.italian: "Siamo lieti di averti come ospite. Hai salvato nostra figlia, e non solo: salverai tutti noi." La donna anziana e tutti quelli dietro di lei si inginocchiano davanti a te.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Woah, woah, woah! What do you mean 'save us all?'"|3146|0
units.english: "Woah, woah, woah! What do you mean 'save us all?'"
units.italian: "Ehi, ehi, ehi! Che vuol dire 'salvare tutti noi'?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Your daughter? Hjlod? Is she alright?"|3148|0
units.english: "Your daughter? Hjlod? Is she alright?"
units.italian: "Vostra figlia? Hjlod? Sta bene?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The elderly woman smiles warmly. "It is good of you to ask. Thanks to you, Hjlod will be fine. Had you been any later, she would have lost her hands, or worse. But she is recovering now and will join us later."|3149|0
units.english: The elderly woman smiles warmly. "It is good of you to ask. Thanks to you, Hjlod will be fine. Had you been any later, she would have lost her hands, or worse. But she is recovering now and will join us later."
units.italian: La donna anziana sorride con calore. "È gentile da parte tua chiederlo. Grazie a te, Hjlod starà bene. Se fossi arrivato un po' più tardi, avrebbe perso le mani, o peggio. Ma ora si sta riprendendo e ci raggiungerà più tardi."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Woah, woah, woah! What do you mean 'save us all?'"|3151|0
units.english: "Woah, woah, woah! What do you mean 'save us all?'"
units.italian: "Ehi, ehi, ehi! Che vuol dire 'salvare tutti noi'?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The elderly woman opens her palms and spreads them wide. "This is village of Udainsakr. I am Ondurdis, or leader, and we are Skadenga, daughters of Skade, the Troll-Goddess of ice, mountains, and cold."|3153|0
units.english: The elderly woman opens her palms and spreads them wide. "This is village of Udainsakr. I am Ondurdis, or leader, and we are Skadenga, daughters of Skade, the Troll-Goddess of ice, mountains, and cold."
units.italian: La donna anziana apre i palmi e li allarga. "Questo è villaggio di Udainsakr. Io sono Ondurdis, o capo, e noi siamo Skadenga, figlie di Skade, la Dea-Troll del ghiaccio, delle montagne e del freddo."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"For nearly century we have been waiting for person who bore mark of Skade." She points a tattooed hand at the electric burn on your arm you received while repairing the Ice-Crawler. "It seems we have been waiting for you."|3154|0
units.english: "For nearly century we have been waiting for person who bore mark of Skade." She points a tattooed hand at the electric burn on your arm you received while repairing the Ice-Crawler. "It seems we have been waiting for you."
units.italian: "Per quasi un secolo abbiamo aspettato la persona che portava il marchio di Skade." Indica con una mano tatuata l'ustione elettrica sul tuo braccio, quella che ti sei fatto riparando il cingolato. "Sembra che abbiamo aspettato te."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|label|3156|0
units.english: with hjlod
units.italian: with hjlod

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Woah, woah, woah! What do you mean 'save us all?'"|3158|0
units.english: "Woah, woah, woah! What do you mean 'save us all?'"
units.italian: "Ehi, ehi, ehi! Che vuol dire 'salvare tutti noi'?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The elderly woman opens her palms and spreads them wide. "This is village of Udainsakr. I am Ondurdis, or leader, and we are Skadenga, daughters of Skade, the Troll-Goddess of ice, mountains, and cold."|3159|0
units.english: The elderly woman opens her palms and spreads them wide. "This is village of Udainsakr. I am Ondurdis, or leader, and we are Skadenga, daughters of Skade, the Troll-Goddess of ice, mountains, and cold."
units.italian: La donna anziana apre i palmi e li allarga. "Questo è villaggio di Udainsakr. Io sono Ondurdis, o capo, e noi siamo Skadenga, figlie di Skade, la Dea-Troll del ghiaccio, delle montagne e del freddo."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"For nearly century we have been waiting for person who bore mark of Skade." She points a tattooed hand at the ice burn on your arm you received while traveling through the snow. "It seems we have been waiting for you."|3160|0
units.english: "For nearly century we have been waiting for person who bore mark of Skade." She points a tattooed hand at the ice burn on your arm you received while traveling through the snow. "It seems we have been waiting for you."
units.italian: "Per quasi un secolo abbiamo aspettato la persona che portava il marchio di Skade." Indica con una mano tatuata l'ustione da ghiaccio sul tuo braccio, quella che ti sei fatto attraversando la neve. "Sembra che abbiamo aspettato te."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|label|3161|0
units.english: woah after
units.italian: woah after

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"What do you expect me to do?"|3163|0
units.english: "What do you expect me to do?"
units.italian: "Cosa ti aspetti che faccia?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"What do you mean a century? How long have you been here? Why were you waiting for me?"|3165|0
units.english: "What do you mean a century? How long have you been here? Why were you waiting for me?"
units.italian: "Che vuol dire un secolo? Da quanto tempo siete qui? Perché mi stavate aspettando?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The Ondurdis raises an eyebrow. "So you want to know our secrets? We ask much, so I will tell you more than most know. Long ago, the so-called-elves brought the Skadenga to Deep. We had to make penance for some mistakes. Our volva, or seeress, saw that to make amends we must come to Nifel. We did not know why, but when we found the Goddess-Stone, we knew we had made right decision.|3166|0
units.english: The Ondurdis raises an eyebrow. "So you want to know our secrets? We ask much, so I will tell you more than most know. Long ago, the so-called-elves brought the Skadenga to Deep. We had to make penance for some mistakes. Our volva, or seeress, saw that to make amends we must come to Nifel. We did not know why, but when we found the Goddess-Stone, we knew we had made right decision.
units.italian: L'Ondurdis alza un sopracciglio. "Vuoi conoscere i nostri segreti? Chiediamo molto, quindi ti dirò più di quanto sanno gli altri. Molto tempo fa, i cosiddetti elfi portarono gli Skadenga nel Deep. Dovevamo fare penitenza per alcuni errori. La nostra volva, o veggente, vide che per rimediare dovevamo venire su Nifel. Non sapevamo perché, ma quando abbiamo trovato la Pietra della Dea, abbiamo saputo di aver preso decisione giusta.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Since then, we have lived here and acted as guides and pathfinders to others. It was one of our sisters, Eymani, an herbalist, who discovered the cure to Rigellian plague. We thought this was why we had been sent here. Our duty to act as handmaidens of healing.|3167|0
units.english: "Since then, we have lived here and acted as guides and pathfinders to others. It was one of our sisters, Eymani, an herbalist, who discovered the cure to Rigellian plague. We thought this was why we had been sent here. Our duty to act as handmaidens of healing.
units.italian: "Da allora viviamo qui e facciamo da guide e apripista per gli altri. Fu una delle nostre sorelle, Eymani, un'erborista, a scoprire la cura per la peste rigelliana. Pensavamo che fosse per questo che ci avevano mandate qui. Il nostro dovere di ancelle della guarigione.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"With each passing year, Nifel grows colder and outsiders less frequent. Our numbers dwindle as does our usefulness. This is dying world, and we need new home. Eighty years ago one of our holiest sisters had vision. She saw that stranger with mark of Skade would arrive and that stranger would help us find new home."|3169|0
units.english: "With each passing year, Nifel grows colder and outsiders less frequent. Our numbers dwindle as does our usefulness. This is dying world, and we need new home. Eighty years ago one of our holiest sisters had vision. She saw that stranger with mark of Skade would arrive and that stranger would help us find new home."
units.italian: "Con il passare degli anni Nifel diventa più freddo e gli estranei più rari. Il nostro numero diminuisce, come la nostra utilità. Questo è mondo che muore, e ci serve nuova casa. Ottant'anni fa una delle nostre sorelle più sante ebbe una visione. Vide che sarebbe arrivato straniero con marchio di Skade e che quello straniero ci avrebbe aiutato a trovare nuova casa."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The Ondurdis points a boney finger right at you. "First, you must discover which world will be our home. Then you must find us transportation. We will of course pay you in one way or another. Would you do this for us?"|3170|0
units.english: The Ondurdis points a boney finger right at you. "First, you must discover which world will be our home. Then you must find us transportation. We will of course pay you in one way or another. Would you do this for us?"
units.italian: L'Ondurdis punta un dito ossuto dritto su di te. "Prima devi scoprire quale mondo sarà la nostra casa. Poi devi trovarci un trasporto. Naturalmente ti pagheremo, in un modo o nell'altro. Faresti questo per noi?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"I'll do it. I won't let you guys down."|3172|0
units.english: "I'll do it. I won't let you guys down."
units.italian: "Lo farò. Non vi deluderò."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"No. This isn't my problem. I just need to get back to my ship."|3174|0
units.english: "No. This isn't my problem. I just need to get back to my ship."
units.italian: "No. Non è un mio problema. Devo solo tornare alla mia nave."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The Ondurdis bows and steps back. "If that is your wish, then you must not be the one we wait for." With that, she and everyone else leave the barracks.|3175|0
units.english: The Ondurdis bows and steps back. "If that is your wish, then you must not be the one we wait for." With that, she and everyone else leave the barracks.
units.italian: L'Ondurdis si inchina e indietreggia. "Se questo è il tuo desiderio, allora non devi essere quello che aspettiamo." Detto questo, lei e tutti gli altri lasciano la caserma.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	You climb out of your bunk and head to the Ice-Crawler. From there, you head straight back to the spaceport. The trip takes a few hours and you spend some of it pondering the strange course of events - how you went from a life or death struggle against the elements to being some rustic community's savior.|3178|0
units.english: You climb out of your bunk and head to the Ice-Crawler. From there, you head straight back to the spaceport. The trip takes a few hours and you spend some of it pondering the strange course of events - how you went from a life or death struggle against the elements to being some rustic community's savior.
units.italian: Esci dalla cuccetta e ti dirigi al cingolato. Da lì torni dritto allo spazioporto. Il viaggio dura qualche ora, e ne passi una parte a rimuginare sullo strano corso degli eventi: come sei passato da una lotta per la vita contro gli elementi a essere il salvatore di una comunità rustica.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"Oh, well." You say to yourself, "I can't save everyone."|3179|0
units.english: "Oh, well." You say to yourself, "I can't save everyone."
units.italian: "Oh, beh." Ti dici, "non posso salvare tutti."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|label|3181|0
units.english: use shuttle
units.italian: use shuttle

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	You hear the familiar rumble of a shuttle overhead, you climb out of your bunk to go to meet it. From there, you head straight back to the spaceport. The trip is brief, and you have little time to consider all that has transpired since you decided to take the excursion. You worry you may need therapy.|3182|0
units.english: You hear the familiar rumble of a shuttle overhead, you climb out of your bunk to go to meet it. From there, you head straight back to the spaceport. The trip is brief, and you have little time to consider all that has transpired since you decided to take the excursion. You worry you may need therapy.
units.italian: Senti il familiare rombo di una navetta sopra di te e esci dalla cuccetta per andarle incontro. Da lì torni dritto allo spazioporto. Il viaggio è breve, e hai poco tempo per riflettere su tutto ciò che è successo da quando hai deciso di fare l'escursione. Temi che ti servirà una terapia.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The spaceport rises into view, and before you know it you're back safely onboard your ship.|3184|0
units.english: The spaceport rises into view, and before you know it you're back safely onboard your ship.
units.italian: Lo spazioporto appare in vista, e prima che tu te ne accorga sei di nuovo al sicuro sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|label|3186|0
units.english: do it
units.italian: do it

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The Ondurdis smiles. "Thank you." She nods toward the door. "Come with me."|3187|0
units.english: The Ondurdis smiles. "Thank you." She nods toward the door. "Come with me."
units.italian: L'Ondurdis sorride. "Grazie." Fa un cenno verso la porta. "Vieni con me."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	In the light of early day, the village looks stranger than you remember. Carved wooden structures weave flawlessly into sleek fabricated composites in a marriage of ancient with new. Oddly enough, the effect does not clash, but instead gives off an impression of seamless artistry. To the south, there is an open space filled with high-stacked stone cairns. At the center of the space, or holy site, is a giant wall made of an unusual gleaming metal and surrounded by eight ornate wooden pillars. The wall, despite being filled with strange letters and images, is dominated by the single image of a giant humanoid. As you stare into the structure, you feel unnaturally chilly.|3188|0
units.english: In the light of early day, the village looks stranger than you remember. Carved wooden structures weave flawlessly into sleek fabricated composites in a marriage of ancient with new. Oddly enough, the effect does not clash, but instead gives off an impression of seamless artistry. To the south, there is an open space filled with high-stacked stone cairns. At the center of the space, or holy site, is a giant wall made of an unusual gleaming metal and surrounded by eight ornate wooden pillars. The wall, despite being filled with strange letters and images, is dominated by the single image of a giant humanoid. As you stare into the structure, you feel unnaturally chilly.
units.italian: Alla luce del primo mattino il villaggio sembra più strano di come lo ricordi. Strutture di legno intagliato si intrecciano senza sbavature in lucidi compositi fabbricati, in un matrimonio tra antico e nuovo. Stranamente, l'effetto non stona, ma dà l'impressione di un'arte senza cuciture. A sud c'è uno spazio aperto pieno di alti cairn di pietra impilata. Al centro dello spazio, o luogo sacro, si erge un'enorme parete di un metallo lucente inconsueto, circondata da otto ornate colonne di legno. La parete, pur essendo piena di lettere e immagini strane, è dominata dalla sola immagine di un gigantesco umanoide. Mentre fissi la struttura, senti un freddo innaturale.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"That is Goddess-Stone." The Ondurdis gestures toward the large stone-wall. "This is why we settled here. Most worlds in Deep have stones like this upon them. They go by many names; Elf-Stones, God-Stones, Jotun-Stones, and more. Now, at base of wall, those pillars, they are our Setstokkr. They are holy relics of our folk, and guided us here, to this very wall, long ago. Just as they will guide us once more to our new home. There are eight Setstokkr here, but once there was nine."|3189|0
units.english: "That is Goddess-Stone." The Ondurdis gestures toward the large stone-wall. "This is why we settled here. Most worlds in Deep have stones like this upon them. They go by many names; Elf-Stones, God-Stones, Jotun-Stones, and more. Now, at base of wall, those pillars, they are our Setstokkr. They are holy relics of our folk, and guided us here, to this very wall, long ago. Just as they will guide us once more to our new home. There are eight Setstokkr here, but once there was nine."
units.italian: "Quella è la Pietra della Dea." L'Ondurdis indica la grande parete di pietra. "È per questo che ci siamo stabiliti qui. Quasi tutti i mondi del Deep hanno pietre come questa. Hanno molti nomi: Pietre-Elfiche, Pietre-Divine, Pietre-Jotun e altri. Ora, alla base della parete, quelle colonne sono i nostri Setstokkr. Sono reliquie sacre della nostra gente, e molto tempo fa ci hanno guidati qui, fino a questa parete. Come ci guideranno ancora una volta verso la nostra nuova casa. Qui ci sono otto Setstokkr, ma un tempo erano nove."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The Ondurdis turns back to you. "You must find the ninth Setstokkr, the missing pillar. It was dropped in space long ago, and we believe based on where it started it could have only found its way to one of two worlds. It either on Windblain in the Regor system, or Asgard in the Naos system." Offering you a small storage device, the Ondurdis continues, "Setstokkr have... unusual properties. This drive contains information that will allow you to track them. Go to these worlds, see if you can find the Setstokkr, and return to us with news. We are eager to know where Skade will send us."|3190|0
units.english: The Ondurdis turns back to you. "You must find the ninth Setstokkr, the missing pillar. It was dropped in space long ago, and we believe based on where it started it could have only found its way to one of two worlds. It either on Windblain in the Regor system, or Asgard in the Naos system." Offering you a small storage device, the Ondurdis continues, "Setstokkr have... unusual properties. This drive contains information that will allow you to track them. Go to these worlds, see if you can find the Setstokkr, and return to us with news. We are eager to know where Skade will send us."
units.italian: L'Ondurdis si rivolge di nuovo a te. "Devi trovare il nono Setstokkr, la colonna mancante. Fu persa nello spazio molto tempo fa, e crediamo che, in base a dove è partita, possa essere arrivata solo su uno di due mondi. O su Windblain, nel sistema Regor, o su Asgard, nel sistema Naos." Porgendoti un piccolo dispositivo di memoria, l'Ondurdis continua: "I Setstokkr hanno... proprietà inconsuete. Questo disco contiene informazioni che ti permetteranno di rintracciarli. Va' su questi mondi, vedi se riesci a trovare il Setstokkr e torna da noi con notizie. Siamo impazienti di sapere dove Skade ci manderà."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The sky glows and the earth rumbles as a shuttle lands not far from the village. "That shuttle will return you to the spaceport and your ship. May Skade guide you." With that, the Ondurdis leaves you.|3191|0
units.english: The sky glows and the earth rumbles as a shuttle lands not far from the village. "That shuttle will return you to the spaceport and your ship. May Skade guide you." With that, the Ondurdis leaves you.
units.italian: Il cielo si illumina e la terra trema mentre una navetta atterra non lontano dal villaggio. "Quella navetta ti riporterà allo spazioporto e alla tua nave. Che Skade ti guidi." Detto questo, l'Ondurdis ti lascia.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Head to the shuttle.)|3193|0
units.english: (Head to the shuttle.)
units.italian: (Dirigiti alla navetta.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Take a moment to investigate the Goddess-Stone.)|3195|0
units.english: (Take a moment to investigate the Goddess-Stone.)
units.italian: (Prenditi un momento per esaminare la Pietra della Dea.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	You walk toward the park filled with stone cairns, wooden pillars, and the Goddess-Stone.|3196|0
units.english: You walk toward the park filled with stone cairns, wooden pillars, and the Goddess-Stone.
units.italian: Cammini verso il parco pieno di cairn di pietra, colonne di legno e la Pietra della Dea.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	At this distance, you can see that the cairns have name-plates at their bases. Some are so faded and worn you cannot make out the names. Others are easier to read and appear to be family names. Myrlinga, Baning, and Amalung are the few you can read.|3197|0
units.english: At this distance, you can see that the cairns have name-plates at their bases. Some are so faded and worn you cannot make out the names. Others are easier to read and appear to be family names. Myrlinga, Baning, and Amalung are the few you can read.
units.italian: A questa distanza vedi che i cairn hanno targhette con i nomi alla base. Alcune sono così sbiadite e consumate che non riesci a leggere i nomi. Altre sono più leggibili e sembrano cognomi di famiglia. Myrlinga, Baning e Amalung sono i pochi che riesci a leggere.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Beyond the cairns are the well-carved wooden pillars, or Setstokkr as the Ondurdis called them. They are each over 10 meters tall, and all covered entirely in runic script, images, and patterns. A few have unshorn branches that include their own carvings as well, while most are limbless. On one Setstokkr, you notice that a frequent carving within its entwined animals is similar in shape to the burn on your arm.|3198|0
units.english: Beyond the cairns are the well-carved wooden pillars, or Setstokkr as the Ondurdis called them. They are each over 10 meters tall, and all covered entirely in runic script, images, and patterns. A few have unshorn branches that include their own carvings as well, while most are limbless. On one Setstokkr, you notice that a frequent carving within its entwined animals is similar in shape to the burn on your arm.
units.italian: Oltre i cairn ci sono le colonne di legno ben intagliate, o Setstokkr come le ha chiamate l'Ondurdis. Sono alte più di 10 metri e ognuna è interamente coperta di scrittura runica, immagini e motivi. Alcune hanno rami non potati che includono anch'essi le loro incisioni, mentre la maggior parte è senza rami. Su un Setstokkr noti che un'incisione ricorrente tra gli animali intrecciati ha una forma simile all'ustione sul tuo braccio.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Finally, you reach the massive Goddess-Stone itself. You see now almost no part of the wide surface is bare. There are images within images, letters within letters. These exotic letters bear no relationship to the runes found on the Setstokkr. These are truly alien.|3199|0
units.english: Finally, you reach the massive Goddess-Stone itself. You see now almost no part of the wide surface is bare. There are images within images, letters within letters. These exotic letters bear no relationship to the runes found on the Setstokkr. These are truly alien.
units.italian: Infine raggiungi la massiccia Pietra della Dea. Ora vedi che quasi nessuna parte dell'ampia superficie è nuda. Ci sono immagini dentro le immagini, lettere dentro le lettere. Queste lettere esotiche non hanno alcun rapporto con le rune dei Setstokkr. Sono davvero aliene.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	(Head to the shuttle.)|3201|0
units.english: (Head to the shuttle.)
units.italian: (Dirigiti alla navetta.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	A lone figure stands next to the idling shuttle. As you draw closer you recognize Hjlod.|3205|0
units.english: A lone figure stands next to the idling shuttle. As you draw closer you recognize Hjlod.
units.italian: Una figura solitaria aspetta accanto alla navetta al minimo. Quando ti avvicini riconosci Hjlod.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	"I just vant to thank you." Hjlod's gray-blue eyes glitter in the morning light. "I alvays say Hjlod keep tourist safe. But yesterday you save Hjlod. I vill not forgot, know this."|3206|0
units.english: "I just vant to thank you." Hjlod's gray-blue eyes glitter in the morning light. "I alvays say Hjlod keep tourist safe. But yesterday you save Hjlod. I vill not forgot, know this."
units.italian: "Voglio solo ringraziarti." Gli occhi grigio-azzurri di Hjlod brillano nella luce del mattino. "Io dico sempre che Hjlod tiene turisti al sicuro. Ma ieri tu hai salvato Hjlod. Io non dimentico, sappi questo."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|label|3208|0
units.english: three fingers
units.italian: three fingers

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	A lone figure stands next to the idling shuttle. As you draw closer, you recognize Hjlod. "You see," she says, "stick with Hjlod, and you live, probably." She holds up a bandaged, three-fingered hand and shrugs. "Mostly."|3209|0
units.english: A lone figure stands next to the idling shuttle. As you draw closer, you recognize Hjlod. "You see," she says, "stick with Hjlod, and you live, probably." She holds up a bandaged, three-fingered hand and shrugs. "Mostly."
units.italian: Una figura solitaria aspetta accanto alla navetta al minimo. Quando ti avvicini, riconosci Hjlod. "Vedi," dice, "stai con Hjlod, e vivi, probabilmente." Solleva una mano bendata con tre dita e alza le spalle. "Per lo più."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Hjlod offers one of her lopsided grins and then leaves you alone with the shuttle. It is time to go.|3211|0
units.english: Hjlod offers one of her lopsided grins and then leaves you alone with the shuttle. It is time to go.
units.italian: Hjlod ti regala uno dei suoi sorrisi storti e poi ti lascia solo con la navetta. È ora di andare.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|You land on the final world you were asked to visit. Once you're done here, you should return to Nifel.|3215|0
units.english: You land on the final world you were asked to visit. Once you're done here, you should return to Nifel.
units.italian: Atterri sull'ultimo mondo che ti è stato chiesto di visitare. Una volta finito qui, dovresti tornare su Nifel.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	Upon landing, you get a recorded voice message from Hjlod. "<first>, ve're busy evacuating isolated Skadenga communities. Come back in few veeks vhen things settle down."|3221|0
units.english: Upon landing, you get a recorded voice message from Hjlod. "<first>, ve're busy evacuating isolated Skadenga communities. Come back in few veeks vhen things settle down."
units.italian: All'atterraggio ricevi un messaggio vocale registrato da Hjlod. "<first>, noi occupati a evacuare comunità Skadenga isolate. Torna tra poche settimane, quando cose si calmano."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 1|	The message abruptly ends.|3222|0
units.english: The message abruptly ends.
units.italian: Il messaggio si interrompe di colpo.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|In the high-atmosphere of <origin>, your ship's sensors pick up traces of the exotic Setstokkr matter. They pinpoint the material to the southern rim of a sparsely-populated island-continent, in the small coastal settlement of Hrithfjall.|3239|0
units.english: In the high-atmosphere of <origin>, your ship's sensors pick up traces of the exotic Setstokkr matter. They pinpoint the material to the southern rim of a sparsely-populated island-continent, in the small coastal settlement of Hrithfjall.
units.italian: Nell'alta atmosfera di <origin>, i sensori della tua nave captano tracce dell'esotica materia dei Setstokkr. Le localizzano sul bordo meridionale di un continente-isola scarsamente popolato, nel piccolo insediamento costiero di Hrithfjall.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	Your ship lands just outside the settlement, and you leave with your handheld tracker keyed to the Setstokkr material. The trail goes cold once you enter the settlement. The hamlet Hrithfjall is little more than a few dozen wooden structures along a single overgrown road. The buildings themselves are well-crafted and finely designed, but many of them appear to be abandoned. There are no townsfolk about, but you notice recent footprints headed toward the shore, which you follow.|3240|0
units.english: Your ship lands just outside the settlement, and you leave with your handheld tracker keyed to the Setstokkr material. The trail goes cold once you enter the settlement. The hamlet Hrithfjall is little more than a few dozen wooden structures along a single overgrown road. The buildings themselves are well-crafted and finely designed, but many of them appear to be abandoned. There are no townsfolk about, but you notice recent footprints headed toward the shore, which you follow.
units.italian: La tua nave atterra appena fuori dall'insediamento, e scendi con il rilevatore portatile sintonizzato sulla materia dei Setstokkr. La traccia si raffredda appena entri nell'insediamento. Il borgo di Hrithfjall è poco più di qualche dozzina di strutture di legno lungo un'unica strada invasa dalla vegetazione. Gli edifici sono ben costruiti e disegnati con cura, ma molti sembrano abbandonati. Non c'è nessuno in giro, ma noti impronte recenti dirette verso la riva, e le segui.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	The great seas of Windblain churn beneath the chalk-white cliffs and blue-green sky. As you scan the horizon, your eyes catch the glare of reflected light beyond a distant precipice. You head in that direction and find a figure seated at the precipice's edge. An aged man sits cross-legged, looking out into the sea and at a gleaming metal wall towering over the gray waves about a mile out from shore.|3242|0
units.english: The great seas of Windblain churn beneath the chalk-white cliffs and blue-green sky. As you scan the horizon, your eyes catch the glare of reflected light beyond a distant precipice. You head in that direction and find a figure seated at the precipice's edge. An aged man sits cross-legged, looking out into the sea and at a gleaming metal wall towering over the gray waves about a mile out from shore.
units.italian: I grandi mari di Windblain si agitano sotto le scogliere bianche come gesso e il cielo blu-verde. Mentre scruti l'orizzonte, i tuoi occhi catturano il bagliore di luce riflessa oltre un precipizio in lontananza. Ti dirigi da quella parte e trovi una figura seduta sul bordo del precipizio. Un uomo anziano siede a gambe incrociate, guardando il mare e una parete di metallo lucente che torreggia sulle onde grigie a circa un miglio dalla riva.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	The old man speaks without turning and says in a raspy voice, "Hail, stranger. Have you come to pay your respects?"|3243|0
units.english: The old man speaks without turning and says in a raspy voice, "Hail, stranger. Have you come to pay your respects?"
units.italian: Il vecchio parla senza voltarsi e dice con voce roca: "Salve, straniero. Sei venuto a rendere omaggio?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"Pay my respects to what?"|3245|0
units.english: "Pay my respects to what?"
units.italian: "Rendere omaggio a cosa?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"Who are you?"|3246|0
units.english: "Who are you?"
units.italian: "Chi sei?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"Why, the Ran-Stone, of course." The old man points toward the metal tower in the sea. "Few come here any more. Few remember, or care, about the old ways. But the goddess Ran, she is as patient and as terrible as the sea, and like the sea, she has claimed this world.|3248|0
units.english: "Why, the Ran-Stone, of course." The old man points toward the metal tower in the sea. "Few come here any more. Few remember, or care, about the old ways. But the goddess Ran, she is as patient and as terrible as the sea, and like the sea, she has claimed this world.
units.italian: "Ma alla Pietra di Ran, naturalmente." Il vecchio indica la torre di metallo in mare. "Pochi vengono più qui. Pochi ricordano, o si curano, delle vecchie usanze. Ma la dea Ran è paziente e terribile come il mare, e come il mare si è presa questo mondo.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"So why are you here bothering old Aldfrith, if not to look upon the great countenance of divinity?"|3249|0
units.english: "So why are you here bothering old Aldfrith, if not to look upon the great countenance of divinity?"
units.italian: "E allora perché sei qui a importunare il vecchio Aldfrith, se non per guardare il grande volto della divinità?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"I am called Aldfrith. I live in nearby Hrithfjall, though I spent most my life living on the sea and making every port my home." Aldfrith's eyes glaze over for a moment as he speaks.|3252|0
units.english: "I am called Aldfrith. I live in nearby Hrithfjall, though I spent most my life living on the sea and making every port my home." Aldfrith's eyes glaze over for a moment as he speaks.
units.italian: "Mi chiamo Aldfrith. Vivo nella vicina Hrithfjall, anche se ho passato gran parte della vita in mare, facendo di ogni porto la mia casa." Gli occhi di Aldfrith si velano per un istante mentre parla.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"But those days are behind me. Now, I mostly sit, think, and live. On the high seas I saw things... things that cannot be explained, that cannot be understood. So, now I sit here, before the great Ran-Stone, the very countenance of divinity, and reflect upon mystery."|3253|0
units.english: "But those days are behind me. Now, I mostly sit, think, and live. On the high seas I saw things... things that cannot be explained, that cannot be understood. So, now I sit here, before the great Ran-Stone, the very countenance of divinity, and reflect upon mystery."
units.italian: "Ma quei giorni sono alle spalle. Ora per lo più siedo, penso e vivo. In alto mare ho visto cose... cose che non si possono spiegare, che non si possono capire. Così ora siedo qui, davanti alla grande Pietra di Ran, il volto stesso della divinità, e rifletto sul mistero."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"So why are you here, if not to pay respect to Ran?"|3254|0
units.english: "So why are you here, if not to pay respect to Ran?"
units.italian: "Allora perché sei qui, se non per rendere omaggio a Ran?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"I am looking for an ornate wooden pillar covered in carvings that fell from space."|3257|0
units.english: "I am looking for an ornate wooden pillar covered in carvings that fell from space."
units.italian: "Cerco una colonna di legno ornata, coperta di incisioni, caduta dallo spazio."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"Have you seen any old, wooden relics around here?"|3258|0
units.english: "Have you seen any old, wooden relics around here?"
units.italian: "Hai visto reliquie di legno vecchie, da queste parti?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	Aldfrith strokes his white beard for a moment. "The tide brings in all sorts of interesting driftwood. But driftwood from space? That's a tall tale or a deep mystery, that is."|3260|0
units.english: Aldfrith strokes his white beard for a moment. "The tide brings in all sorts of interesting driftwood. But driftwood from space? That's a tall tale or a deep mystery, that is."
units.italian: Aldfrith si accarezza la barba bianca per un momento. "La marea porta ogni sorta di legname interessante. Ma legname dallo spazio? Questa è una frottola o un mistero profondo, ecco cos'è."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	He looks up at you with a bemused smirk. "Nope. Nothing like that here. If you're interested in the driftwood though, that gets used for our boats and homes."|3261|0
units.english: He looks up at you with a bemused smirk. "Nope. Nothing like that here. If you're interested in the driftwood though, that gets used for our boats and homes."
units.italian: Alza lo sguardo su di te con un sorriso beffardo. "No. Niente del genere qui. Se però ti interessa il legname, quello viene usato per le nostre barche e le nostre case."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"Relics, eh?" Aldfrith cackles. "Sailors will always be over-eager to tell a stranger about fantastic treasures in the deep waves."|3264|0
units.english: "Relics, eh?" Aldfrith cackles. "Sailors will always be over-eager to tell a stranger about fantastic treasures in the deep waves."
units.italian: "Reliquie, eh?" Aldfrith ridacchia. "I marinai sono sempre fin troppo impazienti di raccontare a uno straniero di tesori fantastici nelle onde profonde."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	The old man pauses and scratches his head for a moment. "But, alas, I can think of nothing wood-made that would be considered a relic. The salty air and saltier sea don't allow untreated wood to linger long in these parts. Unless it's a boat or a home, your relic is not here."|3265|0
units.english: The old man pauses and scratches his head for a moment. "But, alas, I can think of nothing wood-made that would be considered a relic. The salty air and saltier sea don't allow untreated wood to linger long in these parts. Unless it's a boat or a home, your relic is not here."
units.italian: Il vecchio si ferma e si gratta la testa per un momento. "Ma, ahimè, non mi viene in mente nulla di legno che si possa considerare una reliquia. L'aria salmastra e il mare ancora più salato non lasciano durare a lungo il legno non trattato da queste parti. A meno che non sia una barca o una casa, la tua reliquia non è qui."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	You turn your attention to the great, gleaming metal wall in the sea. Unlike the Goddess-Stone of Nifel, this one has no towering figure upon it. Instead it is more abstract, with fractal swirls and wave-like patterns. As you stare at it, you feel a wildness growing inside your heart that dissipates the moment you look away. You turn, leaving the stone to its wave, and the man to his stone.|3267|0
units.english: You turn your attention to the great, gleaming metal wall in the sea. Unlike the Goddess-Stone of Nifel, this one has no towering figure upon it. Instead it is more abstract, with fractal swirls and wave-like patterns. As you stare at it, you feel a wildness growing inside your heart that dissipates the moment you look away. You turn, leaving the stone to its wave, and the man to his stone.
units.italian: Rivolgi l'attenzione alla grande parete di metallo lucente in mare. A differenza della Pietra della Dea di Nifel, questa non ha alcuna figura torreggiante. È invece più astratta, con spirali frattali e motivi simili a onde. Mentre la fissi, senti crescere nel cuore una selvatichezza che svanisce nel momento in cui distogli lo sguardo. Ti volti, lasciando la pietra alle sue onde e l'uomo alla sua pietra.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	You run your tracker in Hrithfjall once more, but again it fails to lock onto anything. There are faint diffuse traces of the exotic material all around you, but nothing concrete. There is little more you can learn here at the moment, so you head back to your ship.|3268|0
units.english: You run your tracker in Hrithfjall once more, but again it fails to lock onto anything. There are faint diffuse traces of the exotic material all around you, but nothing concrete. There is little more you can learn here at the moment, so you head back to your ship.
units.italian: Passi di nuovo il rilevatore a Hrithfjall, ma ancora una volta non riesce ad agganciare nulla. Ci sono deboli tracce diffuse del materiale esotico tutto intorno a te, ma niente di concreto. Per ora non c'è altro da imparare qui, quindi torni alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|When you enter <planet>'s atmosphere, you receive a message that Hjlod will be waiting for you in the spaceport.|3275|0
units.english: When you enter <planet>'s atmosphere, you receive a message that Hjlod will be waiting for you in the spaceport.
units.italian: Quando entri nell'atmosfera di <planet>, ricevi un messaggio: Hjlod ti aspetterà nello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	Before you have a chance to head into the port however, you are met by a well-dressed administrator and a couple of nondescript guards.|3276|0
units.english: Before you have a chance to head into the port however, you are met by a well-dressed administrator and a couple of nondescript guards.
units.italian: Prima però che tu abbia la possibilità di dirigerti al porto, ti vengono incontro un amministratore in abiti eleganti e un paio di guardie anonime.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"Captain <last>," the administrator says crisply. "You are invited to a meeting in the VIP Conference room. If you would please follow me."|3277|0
units.english: "Captain <last>," the administrator says crisply. "You are invited to a meeting in the VIP Conference room. If you would please follow me."
units.italian: "Capitano <last>," dice l'amministratore con voce secca. "Sei invitato a una riunione nella sala conferenze VIP. Se vuoi seguirmi."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"Pass. Have your bosses send me a letter or something, and I'll be sure to get to it in my own time."|3279|0
units.english: "Pass. Have your bosses send me a letter or something, and I'll be sure to get to it in my own time."
units.italian: "Passo. Fai mandare una lettera ai tuoi capi, o qualcosa del genere, e me ne occuperò quando avrò tempo."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"No, thanks. I'm actually supposed to be meeting someone."|3281|0
units.english: "No, thanks. I'm actually supposed to be meeting someone."
units.italian: "No, grazie. In realtà dovrei incontrare qualcuno."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"Sure thing. Lead the way."|3283|0
units.english: "Sure thing. Lead the way."
units.italian: "Certo. Fa' strada."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	The guards take you by the arms. "I am pleased you are being so agreeable. Consider this a precaution." The administrator promptly turns, and you all follow.|3284|0
units.english: The guards take you by the arms. "I am pleased you are being so agreeable. Consider this a precaution." The administrator promptly turns, and you all follow.
units.italian: Le guardie ti prendono per le braccia. "Sono lieto che tu sia così accomodante. Considerala una precauzione." L'amministratore si volta subito, e voi tutti lo seguite.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	As you try to get around the administrator, his goons grab you. "Respectfully, Captain, this is not an invitation you are at liberty to dismiss."|3287|0
units.english: As you try to get around the administrator, his goons grab you. "Respectfully, Captain, this is not an invitation you are at liberty to dismiss."
units.italian: Mentre cerchi di aggirare l'amministratore, i suoi sgherri ti afferrano. "Con tutto il rispetto, capitano, questo non è un invito che sei libero di rifiutare."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"Ah yes, don't worry. We have the port authority keeping your hill-witch friend busy. You'll likely be done before she is." The administrator nods to his guards, who close in on you.|3290|0
units.english: "Ah yes, don't worry. We have the port authority keeping your hill-witch friend busy. You'll likely be done before she is." The administrator nods to his guards, who close in on you.
units.italian: "Ah, sì, non preoccuparti. Abbiamo l'autorità portuale che tiene occupata la tua amica strega dei colli. Probabilmente avrai finito prima di lei." L'amministratore fa un cenno alle guardie, che ti si stringono intorno.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"Regrettably, this is not an invitation you are at liberty to ignore. So let us be on our way, shall we?"|3291|0
units.english: "Regrettably, this is not an invitation you are at liberty to ignore. So let us be on our way, shall we?"
units.italian: "Purtroppo questo non è un invito che sei libero di ignorare. Quindi mettiamoci in cammino, va bene?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|label|3292|0
units.english: fancy pants
units.italian: fancy pants

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	You are brought to a large research complex just outside the spaceport, and deposited in a high-end, white, minimalistic conference room with two well-dressed and important looking men. "Thank you, Lars. Take the guards and wait for us outside," the man seated across from you says.|3293|0
units.english: You are brought to a large research complex just outside the spaceport, and deposited in a high-end, white, minimalistic conference room with two well-dressed and important looking men. "Thank you, Lars. Take the guards and wait for us outside," the man seated across from you says.
units.italian: Sei portato in un grande complesso di ricerca appena fuori dallo spazioporto, e depositato in una sala conferenze minimalista e bianca, di alto livello, con due uomini ben vestiti e dall'aria importante. "Grazie, Lars. Prendi le guardie e aspettaci fuori," dice l'uomo seduto di fronte a te.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"Of course, sir." The administrator, whose name seems to be Lars, turns and is followed outside by his two goons.|3294|0
units.english: "Of course, sir." The administrator, whose name seems to be Lars, turns and is followed outside by his two goons.
units.italian: "Certo, signore." L'amministratore, il cui nome sembra essere Lars, si volta e viene seguito fuori dalle sue due guardie.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	The man who spoke looks at you with a friendly smile and, without a shred of irony, says, "I am so glad you agreed to meet with us. I realize an accomplished Captain like yourself is in great demand, so we will endeavor to keep this brief."|3295|0
units.english: The man who spoke looks at you with a friendly smile and, without a shred of irony, says, "I am so glad you agreed to meet with us. I realize an accomplished Captain like yourself is in great demand, so we will endeavor to keep this brief."
units.italian: L'uomo che ha parlato ti guarda con un sorriso amichevole e, senza una briciola di ironia, dice: "Sono così lieto che tu abbia accettato di incontrarci. Mi rendo conto che un capitano affermato come te è molto richiesto, quindi cercheremo di essere brevi."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"I am Jakob Forsyth, Vice Planetary-Governor of Nifel and CEO of Nifel-Research Solutions Incorporated, and the man sitting beside me is Henrik Fogel, Deputy Lieutenant-Sub-Director of the Census and Culture Bureau for The Deep. We've been monitoring you ever since you first arrived and became entangled with those sad, backwards, hill-witches." Jakob takes a sip from an elegant glass on the table.|3296|0
units.english: "I am Jakob Forsyth, Vice Planetary-Governor of Nifel and CEO of Nifel-Research Solutions Incorporated, and the man sitting beside me is Henrik Fogel, Deputy Lieutenant-Sub-Director of the Census and Culture Bureau for The Deep. We've been monitoring you ever since you first arrived and became entangled with those sad, backwards, hill-witches." Jakob takes a sip from an elegant glass on the table.
units.italian: "Sono Jakob Forsyth, Vice Governatore Planetario di Nifel e amministratore delegato di Nifel-Research Solutions Incorporated, e l'uomo seduto accanto a me è Henrik Fogel, Vice Sottodirettore Luogotenente dell'Ufficio del Censimento e della Cultura del Deep. Ti osserviamo da quando sei arrivato e ti sei inviluppato con quelle tristi, arretrate streghe dei colli." Jakob sorseggia da un bicchiere elegante sul tavolo.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"If you've been watching me, does that mean you knew about the Ice-Crawler accident and did nothing?"|3298|0
units.english: "If you've been watching me, does that mean you knew about the Ice-Crawler accident and did nothing?"
units.italian: "Se mi state osservando, vuol dire che sapevate dell'incidente del cingolato e non avete fatto nulla?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"Of course I knew." Jakob answers. "It is my business to know. The only people who live here anymore are employees of my firm and those hill-witches." Holding up both hands in a placating gesture, he adds, "And I really am sorry we could not extract you from that avalanche. We don't have the resources allocated to support rescue missions anymore; various services, including emergency ones, are only barely functional. The whole operation on this planet is being shut down, you know. Not enough opportunity to make a profit left here. That's why it will be completely uninhabited within 50 years."|3299|0
units.english: "Of course I knew." Jakob answers. "It is my business to know. The only people who live here anymore are employees of my firm and those hill-witches." Holding up both hands in a placating gesture, he adds, "And I really am sorry we could not extract you from that avalanche. We don't have the resources allocated to support rescue missions anymore; various services, including emergency ones, are only barely functional. The whole operation on this planet is being shut down, you know. Not enough opportunity to make a profit left here. That's why it will be completely uninhabited within 50 years."
units.italian: "Certo che lo sapevo," risponde Jakob. "È il mio mestiere sapere. Le uniche persone che vivono ancora qui sono dipendenti della mia azienda e quelle streghe dei colli." Alzando entrambe le mani in un gesto conciliante, aggiunge: "E mi dispiace davvero che non abbiamo potuto tirarti fuori da quella valanga. Non abbiamo più risorse destinate alle missioni di soccorso: vari servizi, compresi quelli di emergenza, funzionano a malapena. Tutta l'operazione su questo pianeta sta per chiudere, sai. Non resta abbastanza opportunità di profitto. Ecco perché sarà completamente disabitato entro 50 anni."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"You're abandoning an entire planet?"|3301|0
units.english: "You're abandoning an entire planet?"
units.italian: "State abbandonando un intero pianeta?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	He leans forward with a sly look on his face. "Think about it. Why employ a worldwide workforce of 300,000 in the vain hope of discovering new pharmaceutical products on a snowy wasteland? There hasn't been a profitable discovery here in generations. It's a money pit. You run a ship, a business, you understand.|3302|0
units.english: He leans forward with a sly look on his face. "Think about it. Why employ a worldwide workforce of 300,000 in the vain hope of discovering new pharmaceutical products on a snowy wasteland? There hasn't been a profitable discovery here in generations. It's a money pit. You run a ship, a business, you understand.
units.italian: Si sporge in avanti con un'aria maliziosa. "Pensaci. Perché impiegare una forza lavoro mondiale di 300.000 persone nella vana speranza di scoprire nuovi prodotti farmaceutici su una landa innevata? Non c'è stata una scoperta redditizia qui da generazioni. È un pozzo senza fondo. Tu hai una nave, un giro d'affari, puoi capire.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"There is, however, one hiccup." Jakob leans back. "A thorn that has been in our side since our research firm first colonized this world over 600 years ago. Those crazy hill-witches. Sure, early on they had their uses as guides and whatnot. But, they are a cultural dead end, an atavistic blight on our corporate world. You know," he continues with a humorous glint in his eye, "They actually believe that they were brought here during Earth's stone-age by magical space-fairies."|3303|0
units.english: "There is, however, one hiccup." Jakob leans back. "A thorn that has been in our side since our research firm first colonized this world over 600 years ago. Those crazy hill-witches. Sure, early on they had their uses as guides and whatnot. But, they are a cultural dead end, an atavistic blight on our corporate world. You know," he continues with a humorous glint in his eye, "They actually believe that they were brought here during Earth's stone-age by magical space-fairies."
units.italian: "C'è però un intoppo." Jakob si appoggia allo schienale. "Una spina nel fianco da quando la nostra azienda di ricerca ha colonizzato questo mondo, più di 600 anni fa. Quelle pazze streghe dei colli. Certo, all'inizio erano utili come guide e cose simili. Ma sono un vicolo cieco culturale, un flagello atavico sul nostro mondo aziendale. Sai," continua con un guizzo divertito negli occhi, "credono davvero di essere state portate qui durante l'età della pietra terrestre da fate spaziali magiche."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"Now, now." Henrik finally cuts in. "We here in the Deep do value all our resident people and cultures. We are not here to denigrate our citizens, no matter how unusual."|3304|0
units.english: "Now, now." Henrik finally cuts in. "We here in the Deep do value all our resident people and cultures. We are not here to denigrate our citizens, no matter how unusual."
units.italian: "Ora, ora." interviene finalmente Henrik. "Noi qui nel Deep teniamo a tutta la nostra popolazione e alle sue culture. Non siamo qui per denigrare i nostri cittadini, per quanto insoliti."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"But they're leaving. So what's the problem?"|3306|0
units.english: "But they're leaving. So what's the problem?"
units.italian: "Ma se ne stanno andando. Allora qual è il problema?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"I thought folk tales of elves were common in the Deep. What makes the Skadenga so different from the rest of you?"|3308|0
units.english: "I thought folk tales of elves were common in the Deep. What makes the Skadenga so different from the rest of you?"
units.italian: "Pensavo che nel Deep le storie popolari sugli elfi fossero comuni. Cosa rende gli Skadenga così diversi da tutti gli altri?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	Henrik leans back. "Well, you're not wrong. In fact, there's been studies about whether the Skadenga are truly a traditional reflection of the Deep people or an extreme offshoot of what we used to be. Suffice to say, I believe it's the latter, and most modern Deep historians would agree with me.|3309|0
units.english: Henrik leans back. "Well, you're not wrong. In fact, there's been studies about whether the Skadenga are truly a traditional reflection of the Deep people or an extreme offshoot of what we used to be. Suffice to say, I believe it's the latter, and most modern Deep historians would agree with me.
units.italian: Henrik si appoggia allo schienale. "Beh, non sbagli. Ci sono stati persino studi su se gli Skadenga siano davvero un riflesso tradizionale della gente del Deep o un'estrema diramazione di quello che eravamo. Basti dire che credo sia la seconda cosa, e i più moderni storici del Deep sarebbero d'accordo.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"Here's what really makes them different: our popular folk tales are like the childhood stories you heard of, say, the boogeyman. The Skadenga don't just tell them - they formed a religion out of those stories. If you've spoken with them, I'm sure you can tell that it's quite reminiscent of ancient paganism. Certainly they can practice whatever they want, but we're concerned about some of the usual connotations of paganism. We haven't been able to prove any extreme behavior, but their religion gives us reason to suspect it. If they stay culturally isolated from the rest of the Deep, their religion could progress in ways more... harmful. I'll leave it at that."|3310|0
units.english: "Here's what really makes them different: our popular folk tales are like the childhood stories you heard of, say, the boogeyman. The Skadenga don't just tell them - they formed a religion out of those stories. If you've spoken with them, I'm sure you can tell that it's quite reminiscent of ancient paganism. Certainly they can practice whatever they want, but we're concerned about some of the usual connotations of paganism. We haven't been able to prove any extreme behavior, but their religion gives us reason to suspect it. If they stay culturally isolated from the rest of the Deep, their religion could progress in ways more... harmful. I'll leave it at that."
units.italian: "Ecco cosa li rende davvero diversi: le nostre storie popolari sono come le favole dell'infanzia che hai sentito, tipo l'uomo nero. Gli Skadenga non si limitano a raccontarle: con quelle storie hanno creato una religione. Se hai parlato con loro, sono certo che ti sarai accorto che ricorda molto il paganesimo antico.
