Certo, possono praticare quello che vogliono, ma ci preoccupano alcune delle solite implicazioni del paganesimo. Non siamo riusciti a provare nessun comportamento estremo, ma la loro religione ci dà motivo di sospettarlo. Se restano culturalmente isolati dal resto del Deep, la loro religione potrebbe evolvere in modi più... dannosi. Mi fermo qui."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	Henrik clears his throat. "Leaving, yes, but to where? These poor people are in grave need of our help, our public services. Their primitive, superstitious existence is both an embarrassment to the Deep, and a humanitarian crisis that we need to solve."|3313|0
units.english: Henrik clears his throat. "Leaving, yes, but to where? These poor people are in grave need of our help, our public services. Their primitive, superstitious existence is both an embarrassment to the Deep, and a humanitarian crisis that we need to solve."
units.italian: Henrik si schiarisce la voce. "Se ne vanno, sì, ma per andare dove? Questa povera gente ha un disperato bisogno del nostro aiuto, dei nostri servizi pubblici. La loro esistenza primitiva e superstiziosa è insieme un imbarazzo per il Deep e una crisi umanitaria che dobbiamo risolvere."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"The Deep would never forcibly resettle a population. But with your help, we have an opportunity to guide them to a place where they could receive the help they need. We know you recently visited Windblain and Asgard. Sending them to Windblain, a barely inhabited world with no useful public services, would be a huge mistake. These poor wretches would disappear into the uncharted wilds. Asgard, however, has a robust civil service and safety net that would be perfect to help them adapt to our modern culture.|3315|0
units.english: "The Deep would never forcibly resettle a population. But with your help, we have an opportunity to guide them to a place where they could receive the help they need. We know you recently visited Windblain and Asgard. Sending them to Windblain, a barely inhabited world with no useful public services, would be a huge mistake. These poor wretches would disappear into the uncharted wilds. Asgard, however, has a robust civil service and safety net that would be perfect to help them adapt to our modern culture.
units.italian: "Il Deep non trasferirebbe mai con la forza una popolazione. Ma con il tuo aiuto abbiamo l'opportunità di guidarli in un luogo dove potrebbero ricevere l'aiuto di cui hanno bisogno. Sappiamo che di recente hai visitato Windblain e Asgard. Mandarli su Windblain, un mondo quasi disabitato e senza servizi pubblici utili, sarebbe un errore enorme. Quei poveretti sparirebbero nelle terre selvagge inesplorate. Asgard invece ha una solida pubblica amministrazione e una rete di protezione sociale che sarebbero perfette per aiutarli ad adattarsi alla nostra cultura moderna.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"This is why I asked the Vice Planetary-Governor to hold this meeting. The Deep needs you to convince these poor, backwards people that they should live on Asgard." Henrik shrugs. "For all we know, you've already decided to tell them Asgard is the best choice, in which case we're really not asking you to do anything you weren't already planning on doing. We will also help facilitate the move by providing transportation. Furthermore, for your support in this delicate matter, we will transfer 850,000 credits to your account upon their arrival in Asgard. Really, everyone wins this way."|3316|0
units.english: "This is why I asked the Vice Planetary-Governor to hold this meeting. The Deep needs you to convince these poor, backwards people that they should live on Asgard." Henrik shrugs. "For all we know, you've already decided to tell them Asgard is the best choice, in which case we're really not asking you to do anything you weren't already planning on doing. We will also help facilitate the move by providing transportation. Furthermore, for your support in this delicate matter, we will transfer 850,000 credits to your account upon their arrival in Asgard. Really, everyone wins this way."
units.italian: "Ecco perché ho chiesto al Vice Governatore Planetario di tenere questa riunione. Il Deep ha bisogno che tu convinca questa povera, arretrata gente che dovrebbe vivere su Asgard." Henrik alza le spalle. "Per quanto ne sappiamo, hai già deciso di dirgli che Asgard è la scelta migliore, e in quel caso non ti stiamo chiedendo nulla che non avessi già in programma. Aiuteremo anche a facilitare il trasferimento fornendo il trasporto. Inoltre, per il tuo sostegno in questa materia delicata, trasferiremo 850.000 crediti sul tuo conto quando arriveranno su Asgard. Davvero, così vinciamo tutti."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"But the Skadenga-"|3318|0
units.english: "But the Skadenga-"
units.italian: "Ma gli Skadenga-"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"I don't think-"|3319|0
units.english: "I don't think-"
units.italian: "Non credo-"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"That's great news-"|3320|0
units.english: "That's great news-"
units.italian: "È un'ottima notizia-"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	Jakob interrupts you before you have a chance to finish your sentence. "Now, listen, you just think it over. We don't need your answer now. All we need is for you to guide those people to Asgard. If you do that, the Transport Union on Valhalla will have the ships you need. If you don't, well, things might be more difficult for everyone. And remember, we'll pay you in real credits. Not charm bracelets."|3321|0
units.english: Jakob interrupts you before you have a chance to finish your sentence. "Now, listen, you just think it over. We don't need your answer now. All we need is for you to guide those people to Asgard. If you do that, the Transport Union on Valhalla will have the ships you need. If you don't, well, things might be more difficult for everyone. And remember, we'll pay you in real credits. Not charm bracelets."
units.italian: Jakob ti interrompe prima che tu abbia la possibilità di finire la frase. "Ora, ascolta, pensaci. Non ci serve una risposta adesso. Ci serve solo che tu guidi quella gente su Asgard. Se lo fai, l'Unione dei Trasporti su Valhalla avrà le navi che ti servono. Se non lo fai, beh, le cose potrebbero diventare più difficili per tutti. E ricorda, ti paghiamo in crediti veri. Non braccialetti portafortuna."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"Lars!" Jakob calls, and the administrator and his two guards promptly enter the room. "Show Captain <last> back to their ship. Our meeting is concluded."|3322|0
units.english: "Lars!" Jakob calls, and the administrator and his two guards promptly enter the room. "Show Captain <last> back to their ship. Our meeting is concluded."
units.italian: "Lars!" chiama Jakob, e l'amministratore con le sue due guardie entra subito nella stanza. "Accompagna il capitano <last> alla sua nave. La nostra riunione è conclusa."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	"Of course, sir," Lars replies.|3323|0
units.english: "Of course, sir," Lars replies.
units.italian: "Certo, signore," risponde Lars.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 2|	The guards grab you and "escort" you off the premises. With that distraction out of the way, it's time to go meet Hjlod at the spaceport.|3324|0
units.english: The guards grab you and "escort" you off the premises. With that distraction out of the way, it's time to go meet Hjlod at the spaceport.
units.italian: Le guardie ti afferrano e ti "accompagnano" fuori dai locali. Tolta di mezzo quella distrazione, è ora di andare incontro a Hjlod allo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|In the crowded high-atmosphere of Asgard, it is difficult to find any reading that matches that of the exotic Setstokkr material. You do get one anomalous ping from a related material located in the urban center of Helsingor.|3338|0
units.english: In the crowded high-atmosphere of Asgard, it is difficult to find any reading that matches that of the exotic Setstokkr material. You do get one anomalous ping from a related material located in the urban center of Helsingor.
units.italian: Nell'affollata alta atmosfera di Asgard è difficile trovare una lettura che corrisponda a quella dell'esotica materia dei Setstokkr. Ricevi però un ping anomalo da un materiale correlato, situato nel centro urbano di Helsingor.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	Your ship lands in a regional spaceport that serves Helsingor, and your handheld tracker leads you to the heart of the city, where you discover a massive, winding mall. The tracker leads you inside the mall.|3339|0
units.english: Your ship lands in a regional spaceport that serves Helsingor, and your handheld tracker leads you to the heart of the city, where you discover a massive, winding mall. The tracker leads you inside the mall.
units.italian: La tua nave atterra in uno spazioporto regionale che serve Helsingor, e il rilevatore portatile ti guida nel cuore della città, dove scopri un enorme centro commerciale sinuoso. Il rilevatore ti conduce dentro il centro commerciale.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	Once inside, your eyes catch the glint of a vast metallic structure around which the entire mall is built. You can make out unusual pictures and alien letters carved into it. It appears that the shopping mall has been built around Asgard's God-Stone, and that the Stone is being used as an exotic accent wall for the myriad of shops in the structure.|3340|0
units.english: Once inside, your eyes catch the glint of a vast metallic structure around which the entire mall is built. You can make out unusual pictures and alien letters carved into it. It appears that the shopping mall has been built around Asgard's God-Stone, and that the Stone is being used as an exotic accent wall for the myriad of shops in the structure.
units.italian: Una volta dentro, i tuoi occhi catturano il bagliore di una vasta struttura metallica intorno alla quale è costruito l'intero centro commerciale. Riesci a distinguere strane immagini e lettere aliene incise sopra. Sembra che il centro commerciale sia stato costruito intorno alla Pietra-Divina di Asgard, e che la pietra sia usata come parete d'accento esotica per la miriade di negozi della struttura.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	(Follow the tracker.)|3342|0
units.english: (Follow the tracker.)
units.italian: (Segui il rilevatore.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	For a moment you forget the God-Stone and focus on following the tracker. It leads you to a themed restaurant on the top floor called "The Adventurer's Due." The restaurant is filled with exotic artifacts allegedly taken from all corners of known and unknown space.|3343|0
units.english: For a moment you forget the God-Stone and focus on following the tracker. It leads you to a themed restaurant on the top floor called "The Adventurer's Due." The restaurant is filled with exotic artifacts allegedly taken from all corners of known and unknown space.
units.italian: Per un momento dimentichi la Pietra-Divina e ti concentri sul seguire il rilevatore. Ti guida a un ristorante a tema all'ultimo piano, chiamato "Il Conto dell'Avventuriero". Il ristorante è pieno di manufatti esotici presumibilmente presi da ogni angolo dello spazio conosciuto e sconosciuto.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	Your tracker homes in on one case. It contains a rune covered box, with patterns that look similar to those used by the Skadenga. The panel above it reads:|3344|0
units.english: Your tracker homes in on one case. It contains a rune covered box, with patterns that look similar to those used by the Skadenga. The panel above it reads:
units.italian: Il tuo rilevatore si aggancia a una teca. Contiene una scatola coperta di rune, con motivi simili a quelli usati dagli Skadenga. Il pannello sopra recita:

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	'This box once contained the cure to the Rigellian Plague. It belonged to the renowned explorer, adventurer, and researcher Dr. Henry Forsyth. It was donated by the Forsyth Foundation for Academic Honesty.'|3346|0
units.english: 'This box once contained the cure to the Rigellian Plague. It belonged to the renowned explorer, adventurer, and researcher Dr. Henry Forsyth. It was donated by the Forsyth Foundation for Academic Honesty.'
units.italian: 'Questa scatola conteneva un tempo la cura per la Peste Rigelliana. Apparteneva al celebre esploratore, avventuriero e ricercatore dottor Henry Forsyth. È stata donata dalla Fondazione Forsyth per l'Onestà Accademica.'

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	Disappointed, you head back down to the lower levels of the mall and take a seat at a small in-door park at the base of God-Stone. After a moment, a woman wearing a well-pressed pantsuit approaches you.|3348|0
units.english: Disappointed, you head back down to the lower levels of the mall and take a seat at a small in-door park at the base of God-Stone. After a moment, a woman wearing a well-pressed pantsuit approaches you.
units.italian: Deluso, torni ai livelli inferiori del centro commerciale e ti siedi in un piccolo parco interno alla base della Pietra-Divina. Dopo un momento, una donna in tailleur ben stirato ti si avvicina.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	(Offer a non-committal "Hello.")|3350|0
units.english: (Offer a non-committal "Hello.")
units.italian: (Offri un "Salve" di circostanza.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	(Grin and say, "Hey!")|3351|0
units.english: (Grin and say, "Hey!")
units.italian: (Sorridi e di': "Ehi!")

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	(Ignore her.)|3352|0
units.english: (Ignore her.)
units.italian: (Ignala.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	"Hello!" She gives you a professional smile. "It's a beautiful place, isn't it? Not just the mall, but the town of Helsingor itself."|3353|0
units.english: "Hello!" She gives you a professional smile. "It's a beautiful place, isn't it? Not just the mall, but the town of Helsingor itself."
units.italian: "Salve!" Ti rivolge un sorriso professionale. "È un posto bellissimo, vero? Non solo il centro commerciale, ma la città di Helsingor stessa."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	She sits next to you. "You might not realize it, but homes here are incredibly affordable right now. If you're looking for a new place to live, now is the time." She lowers her voice. "But you'll have to act soon. The Helsingor secret is about to get out, and once it does, prices here will skyrocket!|3354|0
units.english: She sits next to you. "You might not realize it, but homes here are incredibly affordable right now. If you're looking for a new place to live, now is the time." She lowers her voice. "But you'll have to act soon. The Helsingor secret is about to get out, and once it does, prices here will skyrocket!
units.italian: Si siede accanto a te. "Forse non te ne rendi conto, ma le case qui sono incredibilmente convenienti in questo momento. Se cerchi un nuovo posto dove vivere, è il momento giusto." Abbassa la voce. "Ma devi muoverti in fretta. Il segreto di Helsingor sta per venire fuori, e quando accadrà i prezzi qui schizzeranno alle stelle!

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	"There are three huge prefabricated housing developments that have just completed construction on the edges of town. I could get you an appointment today if you're interested." She hands you a card. "My name is Carla Von Hausen, and I'd be happy to serve as your real-estate agent." She gives you a sharp, practiced smile that does not quite reach her eyes.|3355|0
units.english: "There are three huge prefabricated housing developments that have just completed construction on the edges of town. I could get you an appointment today if you're interested." She hands you a card. "My name is Carla Von Hausen, and I'd be happy to serve as your real-estate agent." She gives you a sharp, practiced smile that does not quite reach her eyes.
units.italian: "Ci sono tre enormi complessi residenziali prefabbricati appena ultimati ai margini della città. Se ti interessa, posso farti avere un appuntamento oggi stesso." Ti porge un biglietto da visita. "Mi chiamo Carla Von Hausen, e sarei felice di essere la tua agente immobiliare." Ti rivolge un sorriso affilato e di mestiere che non arriva del tutto ai suoi occhi.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	"Beat it, lady."|3357|0
units.english: "Beat it, lady."
units.italian: "Vattene, signora."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	"Thanks, but I am just passing through."|3358|0
units.english: "Thanks, but I am just passing through."
units.italian: "Grazie, ma sono solo di passaggio."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	"My home is among the stars."|3360|0
units.english: "My home is among the stars."
units.italian: "La mia casa è tra le stelle."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	A frown flickers across Carla's face for a brief second before her professional smile reasserts itself. "Trust me, why rent when you can own? Why move a large family to an empty world with poor restaurant selections when you could move them here?"|3362|0
units.english: A frown flickers across Carla's face for a brief second before her professional smile reasserts itself. "Trust me, why rent when you can own? Why move a large family to an empty world with poor restaurant selections when you could move them here?"
units.italian: Un cipiglio attraversa il viso di Carla per un istante, prima che il suo sorriso professionale si ristabilisca. "Fidati, perché pagare l'affitto quando puoi essere proprietario? Perché trasferire una famiglia numerosa su un mondo vuoto con una pessima scelta di ristoranti, quando potresti portarla qui?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	She stands and smooths her suit jacket. "When you change your mind, I'll be here." With that, she's gone, and you are free to turn your attention back to the God-Stone.|3363|0
units.english: She stands and smooths her suit jacket. "When you change your mind, I'll be here." With that, she's gone, and you are free to turn your attention back to the God-Stone.
units.italian: Si alza e si liscia la giacca del tailleur. "Quando cambi idea, sarò qui." Detto questo, sparisce, e sei libero di riportare l'attenzione sulla Pietra-Divina.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	Carla rewards you with a condescending smile. "Ah, darling. You might work in space, but eventually, you'll need a world to call home."|3366|0
units.english: Carla rewards you with a condescending smile. "Ah, darling. You might work in space, but eventually, you'll need a world to call home."
units.italian: Carla ti premia con un sorriso di sufficienza. "Ah, tesoro. Potrai anche lavorare nello spazio, ma prima o poi avrai bisogno di un mondo da chiamare casa."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	She stands and smooths her suit jacket. "When you are ready to make the real-estate leap, you know where to find me." Carla winks at you and then strolls off in the crowds of shoppers. Alone, you turn your attention back to the God-Stone.|3367|0
units.english: She stands and smooths her suit jacket. "When you are ready to make the real-estate leap, you know where to find me." Carla winks at you and then strolls off in the crowds of shoppers. Alone, you turn your attention back to the God-Stone.
units.italian: Si alza e si liscia la giacca del tailleur. "Quando sarai pronto a fare il grande passo immobiliare, sai dove trovarmi." Carla ti fa l'occhiolino e poi si allontana tra la folla di acquirenti. Da solo, riporti l'attenzione sulla Pietra-Divina.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|label|3368|0
units.english: elf stone
units.italian: elf stone

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	The parts of the God-Stone that are exposed at this level are dull and lusterless. You search for a pattern but can make nothing out due to how little of the wall is visible. It's sectioned off, with every shop and restaurant having its own piece. As you stare at it you feel nothing, just an emptiness. You do notice a plaque by a large part of unobstructed wall.|3369|0
units.english: The parts of the God-Stone that are exposed at this level are dull and lusterless. You search for a pattern but can make nothing out due to how little of the wall is visible. It's sectioned off, with every shop and restaurant having its own piece. As you stare at it you feel nothing, just an emptiness. You do notice a plaque by a large part of unobstructed wall.
units.italian: Le parti della Pietra-Divina esposte a questo livello sono opache e senza lucentezza. Cerchi un motivo, ma non riesci a distinguere nulla perché si vede troppo poco della parete. È suddivisa, con ogni negozio e ristorante che ha il suo pezzo. Mentre la fissi non senti nulla, solo un vuoto. Noti però una targa accanto a una grande porzione di parete libera.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	(Read the plaque.)|3371|0
units.english: (Read the plaque.)
units.italian: (Leggi la targa.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	(Return to my ship.)|3372|0
units.english: (Return to my ship.)
units.italian: (Torna alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	The plaque labels the God-Stone as "Colonial Graffiti" and reads:|3374|0
units.english: The plaque labels the God-Stone as "Colonial Graffiti" and reads:
units.italian: La targa definisce la Pietra-Divina "Graffiti Coloniali" e recita:

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	During the Colonization of The Deep in the 23rd Century, the earliest colonists erected large metal slabs and wrote pseudo-letters on them. It is believed that this was done in order to raise the prestige of their early worlds. They would claim the stones were powerful alien artifacts, or that they were made by an earlier population of humans who had arrived on the world thanks to the intercession of fairies.|3376|0
units.english: During the Colonization of The Deep in the 23rd Century, the earliest colonists erected large metal slabs and wrote pseudo-letters on them. It is believed that this was done in order to raise the prestige of their early worlds. They would claim the stones were powerful alien artifacts, or that they were made by an earlier population of humans who had arrived on the world thanks to the intercession of fairies.
units.italian: Durante la Colonizzazione del Deep nel XXIII secolo, i primi coloni eressero grandi lastre di metallo e vi scrissero pseudo-lettere. Si ritiene che lo facessero per accrescere il prestigio dei loro mondi nascenti. Sostenevano che le pietre fossero potenti manufatti alieni, o che fossero state costruite da una popolazione precedente di esseri umani arrivati sul mondo grazie all'intercessione delle fate.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	Either for profit, or out of a longing for home, many local communities promoted these ideas about the origins of these structures. Scientists have determined these structures were once large segments of the metal hulls of the original colony ships. To date, there has been some difficulty in identifying exactly what alloy they were constructed from.|3377|0
units.english: Either for profit, or out of a longing for home, many local communities promoted these ideas about the origins of these structures. Scientists have determined these structures were once large segments of the metal hulls of the original colony ships. To date, there has been some difficulty in identifying exactly what alloy they were constructed from.
units.italian: Che fosse per profitto o per nostalgia di casa, molte comunità locali promossero queste idee sulle origini di tali strutture. Gli scienziati hanno stabilito che queste strutture erano un tempo grandi segmenti degli scafi metallici delle navi coloniali originali. A oggi resta qualche difficoltà nell'identificare esattamente la lega con cui furono costruite.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	Most worlds in the Deep have "Colonial Graffiti," and they are proud reminders of our enterprising colonial origins. They are sometimes known in older texts, and by early communities, as God-Stones and Elf-Stones.|3378|0
units.english: Most worlds in the Deep have "Colonial Graffiti," and they are proud reminders of our enterprising colonial origins. They are sometimes known in older texts, and by early communities, as God-Stones and Elf-Stones.
units.italian: Quasi tutti i mondi del Deep hanno i "Graffiti Coloniali", e sono fieri ricordi delle nostre intraprendenti origini coloniali. A volte sono noti nei testi più antichi, e presso le prime comunità, come Pietre-Divine e Pietre-Elfiche.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	Here at the Helsingor Family-Fun-Shopping-Center, we are committed to celebrating our past! This is why we, in the spirit of graffiti being the cultural touchstone of the day, have renovated this colonial structure into a central communication piece and made it a vital part of our vibrant community!|3380|0
units.english: Here at the Helsingor Family-Fun-Shopping-Center, we are committed to celebrating our past! This is why we, in the spirit of graffiti being the cultural touchstone of the day, have renovated this colonial structure into a central communication piece and made it a vital part of our vibrant community!
units.italian: Qui al Centro Commerciale Divertimento-Famiglia di Helsingor, ci impegniamo a celebrare il nostro passato! Ecco perché, nello spirito dei graffiti che sono il punto di riferimento culturale del giorno, abbiamo ristrutturato questa struttura coloniale per farne un'opera centrale di comunicazione e l'abbiamo resa parte vitale della nostra vivace comunità!

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	You finish reading the plaque, and look at the dull gray metal wall and the inhuman things carved upon it. It looks nothing like a ship's hull.|3382|0
units.english: You finish reading the plaque, and look at the dull gray metal wall and the inhuman things carved upon it. It looks nothing like a ship's hull.
units.italian: Finisci di leggere la targa e guardi la parete di metallo grigio opaco e le cose inumane incise sopra. Non somiglia affatto allo scafo di una nave.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 3|	These people seem disconnected from their past. You wonder if the Skadenga could help them reconnect with it, but worry that the place would change the Skadenga more than they could change it. There is nothing more you can do here. You head back to your ship.|3384|0
units.english: These people seem disconnected from their past. You wonder if the Skadenga could help them reconnect with it, but worry that the place would change the Skadenga more than they could change it. There is nothing more you can do here. You head back to your ship.
units.italian: Questa gente sembra sconnessa dal proprio passato. Ti chiedi se gli Skadenga potrebbero aiutarli a riconnettersi, ma temi che il luogo cambi gli Skadenga più di quanto loro possano cambiarlo. Non c'è altro che tu possa fare qui. Torni alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|name|3392|0
units.english: Transport for Skadenga
units.italian: Trasporto per gli Skadenga

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|description|3393|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> to secure transportation for the Skadenga.
units.italian: Recati su <destination> per assicurare un trasporto agli Skadenga.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|There are no signs of Hjlod when you arrive at the mostly empty spaceport. You spend a few minutes wandering around before you see her heading down the hall toward you. "Sorry to be late, you vould not believe all paper-vork they had for me. I think they aren't happy about Ice-Crawler."|3401|0
units.english: There are no signs of Hjlod when you arrive at the mostly empty spaceport. You spend a few minutes wandering around before you see her heading down the hall toward you. "Sorry to be late, you vould not believe all paper-vork they had for me. I think they aren't happy about Ice-Crawler."
units.italian: Non c'è traccia di Hjlod quando arrivi allo spazioporto quasi vuoto. Giri un po' in cerca di lei prima di vederla che percorre il corridoio verso di te. "Scusa il ritardo, non crederesti a tutta la carta che avevano per me. Credo che non siano contenti del cingolato."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"That's okay. I didn't mind waiting."|3403|0
units.english: "That's okay. I didn't mind waiting."
units.italian: "Va bene. Non mi è pesato aspettare."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"I was abducted by the Vice Planetary-Governor."|3405|0
units.english: "I was abducted by the Vice Planetary-Governor."
units.italian: "Mi ha rapito il Vice Governatore Planetario."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"That is no surprise," Hjlod says nonchalantly. "They alvays do thing like this. It matters not to us."|3406|0
units.english: "That is no surprise," Hjlod says nonchalantly. "They alvays do thing like this. It matters not to us."
units.italian: "Non è sorpresa," dice Hjlod con nonchalance. "Loro fanno sempre cose così. Per noi non conta."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	You ask her if she's worried you've been compromised - that you might be working against the Skadenga's best interests. Hjlod shakes her head. "No. Future is set. Vhat vill, vill be. You are given task to tell us vhere to go, ve go vhere you say. The rest is just noise.|3407|0
units.english: You ask her if she's worried you've been compromised - that you might be working against the Skadenga's best interests. Hjlod shakes her head. "No. Future is set. Vhat vill, vill be. You are given task to tell us vhere to go, ve go vhere you say. The rest is just noise.
units.italian: Le chiedi se teme che tu sia stato compromesso, che tu possa lavorare contro i migliori interessi degli Skadenga. Hjlod scuote la testa. "No. Futuro è scritto. Quello che sarà, sarà. A te dato compito di dirci dove andare, noi andiamo dove tu dici. Il resto è solo rumore.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"Now," Hjlod says, "Tell me about Setstokkr. Did you find it?"|3409|0
units.english: "Now," Hjlod says, "Tell me about Setstokkr. Did you find it?"
units.italian: "Ora," dice Hjlod, "parlami dei Setstokkr. Li hai trovati?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"I found nothing definitive."|3411|0
units.english: "I found nothing definitive."
units.italian: "Non ho trovato nulla di definitivo."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"I think I found traces of it on Windblain."|3413|0
units.english: "I think I found traces of it on Windblain."
units.italian: "Credo di aver trovato tracce su Windblain."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"I found a strange box similar to the Setstokkr on Asgard."|3415|0
units.english: "I found a strange box similar to the Setstokkr on Asgard."
units.italian: "Su Asgard ho trovato una strana scatola simile ai Setstokkr."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"Sounds like herbalist box. Ondurdis had one long before I vas born. Gave it to liar. It not important though, not Setstokkr."|3416|0
units.english: "Sounds like herbalist box. Ondurdis had one long before I vas born. Gave it to liar. It not important though, not Setstokkr."
units.italian: "Sembra scatola di erborista. Ondurdis ne aveva una molto prima che io nascessi. L'ha data a bugiardo. Però non importante, non Setstokkr."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"Sending big piece of vood through space probably not best idea Ondurdis had." Hjlod smirks. "Still, it does not matter so much what you find. Only how you felt. You saw the vorlds. Vhere should ve go?"|3418|0
units.english: "Sending big piece of vood through space probably not best idea Ondurdis had." Hjlod smirks. "Still, it does not matter so much what you find. Only how you felt. You saw the vorlds. Vhere should ve go?"
units.italian: "Mandare grande pezzo di legno attraverso spazio probabilmente non è migliore idea che Ondurdis abbia avuto." Hjlod sogghigna. "Però non conta tanto quello che trovi. Solo come ti sei sentito. Hai visto mondi. Dove dobbiamo andare?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"Windblain."|3420|0
units.english: "Windblain."
units.italian: "Windblain."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"Asgard."|3421|0
units.english: "Asgard."
units.italian: "Asgard."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	You answer, "There is a nearly abandoned village called Hrithfjall next to a coastal God-Stone. Something about that place felt right. I believe that is where the Skadenga should migrate."|3425|0
units.english: You answer, "There is a nearly abandoned village called Hrithfjall next to a coastal God-Stone. Something about that place felt right. I believe that is where the Skadenga should migrate."
units.italian: Rispondi: "C'è un villaggio quasi abbandonato chiamato Hrithfjall, accanto a una Pietra-Divina costiera. Qualcosa in quel posto sembrava giusto. Credo che sia lì che gli Skadenga dovrebbero migrare."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	Hjlod nods. "Hrithfjall sounds like good place. I vill tell Ondurdis.|3426|0
units.english: Hjlod nods. "Hrithfjall sounds like good place. I vill tell Ondurdis.
units.italian: Hjlod annuisce. "Hrithfjall sembra buon posto. Io dico a Ondurdis.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	You answer, "On Asgard, there is a great market built around their God-Stone, and many new homes in need of people to fill them. The people there have lost their way and they need the Skadenga to remind them of who they were."|3431|0
units.english: You answer, "On Asgard, there is a great market built around their God-Stone, and many new homes in need of people to fill them. The people there have lost their way and they need the Skadenga to remind them of who they were."
units.italian: Rispondi: "Su Asgard c'è un grande mercato costruito intorno alla loro Pietra-Divina, e molte case nuove che hanno bisogno di gente per riempirle. La gente di lì ha perso la propria strada e ha bisogno degli Skadenga per ricordarsi chi era."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	Hjlod nods. "The Skadenga have alvays been guides, pathfinders. I vill tell Ondurdis.|3432|0
units.english: Hjlod nods. "The Skadenga have alvays been guides, pathfinders. I vill tell Ondurdis.
units.italian: Hjlod annuisce. "Skadenga sono sempre stati guide, apripista. Io dico a Ondurdis.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"Vhen you were gone, thing, or assembly, vas held. Ondurdis called in all Skadenga from all villages across Nifel. You must find transportation for 2,200 folk. That is what Ondurdis told me to tell you."|3434|0
units.english: "Vhen you were gone, thing, or assembly, vas held. Ondurdis called in all Skadenga from all villages across Nifel. You must find transportation for 2,200 folk. That is what Ondurdis told me to tell you."
units.italian: "Quando tu eri via, è stata tenuta cosa, o assemblea. Ondurdis ha chiamato tutti Skadenga da tutti villaggi di Nifel. Devi trovare trasporto per 2.200 persone. Questo Ondurdis mi ha detto di dirti."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	You frown and ask, "Did she provide money?"|3435|0
units.english: You frown and ask, "Did she provide money?"
units.italian: Aggrotti la fronte e chiedi: "Ha fornito denaro?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	Hjlod shakes her head. "No. Ve could not afford it. You must go to Valhalla and convince head of Transport Union to support us." She squeezes your shoulder. "Thank you for help. For finding us new home. Ve need it. I must report now to Ondurdis. Skade be vith you." She turns and leaves.|3436|0
units.english: Hjlod shakes her head. "No. Ve could not afford it. You must go to Valhalla and convince head of Transport Union to support us." She squeezes your shoulder. "Thank you for help. For finding us new home. Ve need it. I must report now to Ondurdis. Skade be vith you." She turns and leaves.
units.italian: Hjlod scuote la testa. "No. Non potevamo permettercelo. Devi andare su Valhalla e convincere capo dell'Unione dei Trasporti a sostenerci." Ti stringe la spalla. "Grazie per aiuto. Per trovare nuova casa. Noi ne abbiamo bisogno. Adesso devo riferire a Ondurdis. Skade sia con te." Si volta e se ne va.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|Outside your ship, you are met by a representative of the Transport Union. "We have been expecting you, Captain <last>." They escort you to an elevator and up to the penthouse of the tallest building in Valhalla's capital of Himinbjorg.|3440|0
units.english: Outside your ship, you are met by a representative of the Transport Union. "We have been expecting you, Captain <last>." They escort you to an elevator and up to the penthouse of the tallest building in Valhalla's capital of Himinbjorg.
units.italian: Fuori dalla tua nave ti accoglie un rappresentante dell'Unione dei Trasporti. "Ti aspettavamo, capitano <last>." Ti accompagnano a un ascensore e su fino all'attico dell'edificio più alto della capitale di Valhalla, Himinbjorg.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	Three youngish men adorned in trending clothes smile as you enter. "Ah, Captain <last>, what a pleasure to finally meet you. I am Kaiden, and these are my associates Braiden and Grayden. We are executives of the Transport Union. Obviously, we were made aware you would be coming and are looking forward toward creating a lasting and beneficial relationship with you and your... clients.|3442|0
units.english: Three youngish men adorned in trending clothes smile as you enter. "Ah, Captain <last>, what a pleasure to finally meet you. I am Kaiden, and these are my associates Braiden and Grayden. We are executives of the Transport Union. Obviously, we were made aware you would be coming and are looking forward toward creating a lasting and beneficial relationship with you and your... clients.
units.italian: Tre uomini piuttosto giovani, vestiti con abiti alla moda, sorridono quando entri. "Ah, capitano <last>, che piacere incontrarti finalmente. Io sono Kaiden, e loro sono i miei soci Braiden e Grayden. Siamo dirigenti dell'Unione dei Trasporti. Ovviamente eravamo stati avvisati del tuo arrivo e non vediamo l'ora di creare un rapporto duraturo e vantaggioso con te e i tuoi... clienti.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"We've heard that you have this inspiring idea to transport an entire backwater community from one world to another," Kaiden says.|3443|0
units.english: "We've heard that you have this inspiring idea to transport an entire backwater community from one world to another," Kaiden says.
units.italian: "Ci è arrivata voce che hai questa idea ispirata di trasportare un'intera comunità di provincia da un mondo all'altro," dice Kaiden.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"Really inspirational," Braiden chimes in.|3444|0
units.english: "Really inspirational," Braiden chimes in.
units.italian: "Davvero ispirata," interviene Braiden.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"So inspiring," Grayden adds with an opaque hand gesture you think you've seen done by celebrities.|3445|0
units.english: "So inspiring," Grayden adds with an opaque hand gesture you think you've seen done by celebrities.
units.italian: "Così ispirata," aggiunge Grayden con un gesto opaco della mano che credi di aver visto fare dalle celebrità.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"At the Transport Union, we say that 'it's about the people in the transports,' which is why we're humbled and excited to offer you our support in this beautiful and inspiring humanitarian adventure of yours," Kaiden finishes. Braiden and Grayden both clap enthusiastically.|3446|0
units.english: "At the Transport Union, we say that 'it's about the people in the transports,' which is why we're humbled and excited to offer you our support in this beautiful and inspiring humanitarian adventure of yours," Kaiden finishes. Braiden and Grayden both clap enthusiastically.
units.italian: "All'Unione dei Trasporti diciamo che 'la cosa importante sono le persone trasportate', ed è per questo che siamo onorati ed entusiasti di offrirti il nostro sostegno in questa tua bella e ispirata avventura umanitaria," conclude Kaiden. Braiden e Grayden applaudono entrambi con entusiasmo.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	Kaiden waits for the ovation to subside then continues with a knowing smile. "So, tell us humble servants of the people: where to transport these poor souls?"|3447|0
units.english: Kaiden waits for the ovation to subside then continues with a knowing smile. "So, tell us humble servants of the people: where to transport these poor souls?"
units.italian: Kaiden aspetta che l'ovazione si spenga, poi continua con un sorriso saputo. "Allora, dì a noi umili servitori del popolo: dove trasportiamo queste povere anime?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"That's fantastic news! The Skadenga will need transport to Windblain."|3451|0
units.english: "That's fantastic news! The Skadenga will need transport to Windblain."
units.italian: "È una notizia fantastica! Gli Skadenga avranno bisogno di un trasporto per Windblain."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"They need to go to Windblain."|3452|0
units.english: "They need to go to Windblain."
units.italian: "Devono andare su Windblain."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	A hush falls over the room, and both Braiden and Grayden look to Kaiden with confused expressions on their faces.|3453|0
units.english: A hush falls over the room, and both Braiden and Grayden look to Kaiden with confused expressions on their faces.
units.italian: Un silenzio cala nella stanza, e sia Braiden sia Grayden guardano Kaiden con un'espressione confusa.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"Wind. Blain." Kaiden says slowly. "Wiiiindblaaain. Are you sure that is the world these simple people wish to travel to? Maybe you got an invoice mixed up? Perhaps wrote the wrong name down?" Braiden and Grayden both silently nod.|3454|0
units.english: "Wind. Blain." Kaiden says slowly. "Wiiiindblaaain. Are you sure that is the world these simple people wish to travel to? Maybe you got an invoice mixed up? Perhaps wrote the wrong name down?" Braiden and Grayden both silently nod.
units.italian: "Wind. Blain." dice Kaiden lentamente. "Wiiiindblaaain. Sei sicuro che sia il mondo in cui questa gente semplice desidera andare? Magari hai confuso una fattura? O hai scritto il nome sbagliato?" Braiden e Grayden annuiscono entrambi in silenzio.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"Windblain. Yes. I am sure."|3456|0
units.english: "Windblain. Yes. I am sure."
units.italian: "Windblain. Sì. Sono sicuro."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"Did I stutter?"|3457|0
units.english: "Did I stutter?"
units.italian: "Ho forse balbettato?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"That changes things, then." Kaiden turns to Grayden. "Are there even incentives?"|3458|0
units.english: "That changes things, then." Kaiden turns to Grayden. "Are there even incentives?"
units.italian: "Allora questo cambia le cose." Kaiden si volta verso Grayden. "Ci sono almeno degli incentivi?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	Grayden is busy scanning through a tablet. "No re-urbanization kickbacks, no university-study grants, not even a housing development utilization bonus. The entire thing will probably still be a tax write off, but the Census and Culture Bureau won't be happy. Plus, obviously, no finder's fee from them."|3459|0
units.english: Grayden is busy scanning through a tablet. "No re-urbanization kickbacks, no university-study grants, not even a housing development utilization bonus. The entire thing will probably still be a tax write off, but the Census and Culture Bureau won't be happy. Plus, obviously, no finder's fee from them."
units.italian: Grayden sta scorrendo un tablet. "Nessun rimborso per la riurbanizzazione, nessun finanziamento per studi universitari, nemmeno un bonus per l'utilizzo di complessi residenziali. Probabilmente l'intera operazione resterà comunque una detrazione fiscale, ma l'Ufficio del Censimento e della Cultura non sarà contento. E, ovviamente, niente percentuale di intermediazione da parte loro."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	Kaiden then looks to Braiden who shakes his head. "Public Relations for people moving to... Windblain? No one who is anyone lives on Windblain, and no one else cares about those people."|3460|0
units.english: Kaiden then looks to Braiden who shakes his head. "Public Relations for people moving to... Windblain? No one who is anyone lives on Windblain, and no one else cares about those people."
units.italian: Kaiden guarda poi Braiden, che scuote la testa. "Relazioni pubbliche per gente che si trasferisce su... Windblain? Nessuno che conti vive su Windblain, e a nessun altro importa di quella gente."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"Yeah, we're sorry, but this isn't going to work for us." Kaiden puts on a pained face. "This just isn't the kind of project we are willing to take on at the moment." They all stand in near unison. "In the future, try not to waste our time," Kaiden says as the three of them exit the room.|3461|0
units.english: "Yeah, we're sorry, but this isn't going to work for us." Kaiden puts on a pained face. "This just isn't the kind of project we are willing to take on at the moment." They all stand in near unison. "In the future, try not to waste our time," Kaiden says as the three of them exit the room.
units.italian: "Sì, ci dispiace, ma per noi non è fattibile." Kaiden assume un'espressione addolorata. "Semplicemente non è il tipo di progetto che vogliamo prendere in carico adesso." Si alzano tutti quasi all'unisono. "La prossima volta, cerca di non farci perdere tempo," dice Kaiden mentre i tre escono dalla stanza.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	Your escort reappears. "I've been instructed to inform you that there is no one else in the Deep capable of moving the amount of people you want to move. When you're ready to be practical, contact us and we'll be more than happy to help. Now, follow me out of the building." You ride the long elevator down to the lobby and are shown the door. As you leave, another employee follows you out. As he passes you, he quietly says, "Meet me in the spaceport."|3462|0
units.english: Your escort reappears. "I've been instructed to inform you that there is no one else in the Deep capable of moving the amount of people you want to move. When you're ready to be practical, contact us and we'll be more than happy to help. Now, follow me out of the building." You ride the long elevator down to the lobby and are shown the door. As you leave, another employee follows you out. As he passes you, he quietly says, "Meet me in the spaceport."
units.italian: La tua scorta riappare. "Mi è stato detto di informarti che non c'è nessun altro nel Deep capace di spostare la quantità di persone che vuoi spostare. Quando sarai pronto a essere pratico, contattaci e saremo più che felici di aiutarti. Ora seguimi fuori dall'edificio." Scendi con il lungo ascensore fino alla hall e ti viene indicata la porta. Mentre esci, un altro dipendente ti segue. Passandoti accanto, dice piano: "Ci vediamo allo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"That's fantastic news! The Skadenga will need transport to Asgard."|3466|0
units.english: "That's fantastic news! The Skadenga will need transport to Asgard."
units.italian: "È una notizia fantastica! Gli Skadenga avranno bisogno di un trasporto per Asgard."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	"They need to go to Asgard."|3467|0
units.english: "They need to go to Asgard."
units.italian: "Devono andare su Asgard."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	Kaiden beams. "Brilliant. Just brilliant. I was just telling my colleagues here about what a great place Asgard would be for this tribe. The publicity will be huge. The universities will probably want to run various studies. There will be all sorts of government programs and initiatives there to help them accept the proper Deep culture and become productive citizens like the rest of us."|3468|0
units.english: Kaiden beams. "Brilliant. Just brilliant. I was just telling my colleagues here about what a great place Asgard would be for this tribe. The publicity will be huge. The universities will probably want to run various studies. There will be all sorts of government programs and initiatives there to help them accept the proper Deep culture and become productive citizens like the rest of us."
units.italian: Kaiden si illumina. "Geniale. Davvero geniale. Stavo proprio dicendo ai miei colleghi che posto fantastico sarebbe Asgard per questa tribù. La pubblicità sarà enorme. Le università vorranno probabilmente condurre vari studi. Ci saranno ogni sorta di programmi e iniziative governative per aiutarli ad accettare la giusta cultura del Deep e a diventare cittadini produttivi come tutti noi."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	Grayden, Braiden and Kaiden all start shaking each others' hands and congratulating each other on being part of something so inspirational. After their celebration is over, Kaiden turns back to you. "Our transport fleet is at your disposal. They are being refitted at Mani in the Avior system."|3469|0
units.english: Grayden, Braiden and Kaiden all start shaking each others' hands and congratulating each other on being part of something so inspirational. After their celebration is over, Kaiden turns back to you. "Our transport fleet is at your disposal. They are being refitted at Mani in the Avior system."
units.italian: Grayden, Braiden e Kaiden cominciano a stringersi le mani e a congratularsi a vicenda per far parte di qualcosa di così ispirato. Finita la celebrazione, Kaiden si rivolge di nuovo a te. "La nostra flotta di trasporto è a tua disposizione. La stanno riattrezzando su Mani, nel sistema Avior."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 4|	The three stand up in unison. Grayden and Braiden leave, and Kaiden turns from the door. "We are so happy you stopped by today and gave us this opportunity to really give back to the needy communities out in our neighborhood." With that, they are all gone, and your escort returns to lead you out.|3470|0
units.english: The three stand up in unison. Grayden and Braiden leave, and Kaiden turns from the door. "We are so happy you stopped by today and gave us this opportunity to really give back to the needy communities out in our neighborhood." With that, they are all gone, and your escort returns to lead you out.
units.italian: I tre si alzano all'unisono. Grayden e Braiden escono, e Kaiden si volta dalla porta. "Siamo così felici che tu sia passato oggi e ci abbia dato l'opportunità di restituire davvero qualcosa alle comunità bisognose del nostro quartiere." Detto questo, sono tutti spariti, e la tua scorta torna a portarti fuori.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 5|name|3477|0
units.english: Transport for Skadenga
units.italian: Trasporto per gli Skadenga

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 5|description|3478|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> to prepare the Transport Union Fleet.
units.italian: Recati su <destination> per preparare la Flotta dell'Unione dei Trasporti.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 5|Mani is a quiet, empty moon with only a few hubs of human activity. The Deep Security forces, Transport Union, and other semi-governmental fleets are all serviced here.|3487|0
units.english: Mani is a quiet, empty moon with only a few hubs of human activity. The Deep Security forces, Transport Union, and other semi-governmental fleets are all serviced here.
units.italian: Mani è una luna tranquilla e vuota, con solo pochi centri di attività umana. Qui vengono messe in servizio le forze della Sicurezza del Deep, l'Unione dei Trasporti e altre flotte semi-governative.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 5|	A Transport Union executive meets you when you touch down. "It'll take a while for the ships to be ready, Captain <last>. We're primitive-proofing them so that those ice-savages from Nifel don't accidentally kill themselves. I'll send you a message when the ships are ready. It should take about three weeks," the executive explains as he skims through a time table displayed on his tablet.|3488|0
units.english: A Transport Union executive meets you when you touch down. "It'll take a while for the ships to be ready, Captain <last>. We're primitive-proofing them so that those ice-savages from Nifel don't accidentally kill themselves. I'll send you a message when the ships are ready. It should take about three weeks," the executive explains as he skims through a time table displayed on his tablet.
units.italian: Un dirigente dell'Unione dei Trasporti ti accoglie quando atterri. "Ci vorrà un po' prima che le navi siano pronte, capitano <last>. Le stiamo rendendo a prova di primitivi, così quei selvaggi del ghiaccio di Nifel non si ammazzeranno per sbaglio. Ti manderò un messaggio quando le navi saranno pronte. Dovrebbero volerci circa tre settimane," spiega il dirigente scorrendo un orario sul suo tablet.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 5|	"When the ships return covered in hay, feces, and other low-tech trash, it'll take us weeks to get them in a usable state again," he mutters before promptly turning and leaving.|3489|0
units.english: "When the ships return covered in hay, feces, and other low-tech trash, it'll take us weeks to get them in a usable state again," he mutters before promptly turning and leaving.
units.italian: "Quando le navi torneranno coperte di fieno, escrementi e altra spazzatura a bassa tecnologia, ci vorranno settimane per rimetterle in uno stato utilizzabile," borbotta prima di voltarsi e andarsene.

units.id: mission:Mani Refit|name|3499|0
units.english: Mani Refitted
units.italian: Mani riattrezzata

units.id: mission:Mani Refit|description|3502|0
units.english: Head back to <destination> and meet up with the Transport Union's Fleet.
units.italian: Torna su <destination> e raggiungi la Flotta dell'Unione dei Trasporti.

units.id: mission:Mani Refit|Your inbox blinks with a new message from the Transport Union:|3509|0
units.english: Your inbox blinks with a new message from the Transport Union:
units.italian: La tua casella di posta lampeggia con un nuovo messaggio dell'Unione dei Trasporti:

units.id: mission:Mani Refit|	The fleet is ready for its inspirational journey. Please return to Mani.|3511|0
units.english: The fleet is ready for its inspirational journey. Please return to Mani.
units.italian: La flotta è pronta per il suo viaggio ispiratore. Torna su Mani.

units.id: mission:Mani Refit|				Jayden, Mani Administrator, Transport Union|3512|0
units.english: Jayden, Mani Administrator, Transport Union
units.italian: Jayden, amministratore di Mani, Unione dei Trasporti

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 6|name|3519|0
units.english: Transport the Skadenga
units.italian: Trasporta gli Skadenga

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 6|description|3520|0
units.english: Escort a fleet of freighters, refitted for carrying the Skadenga, to <destination>.
units.italian: Escorta una flotta di mercantili, riattrezzati per trasportare gli Skadenga, fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 6|You arrive at the spaceport to see a Union Executive overseeing the final preparations of his fleet. After a moment, the last crew members leave his side and board their ships. He walks over to you. "The fleet is ready to launch. Your mission is to escort them to Nifel, pick up as many as they can hold from there, and drop them off on Asgard. The fleet should be able to head back to Nifel and perform the rest of the resettlement trips from there, but please, try to keep all of them in one piece."|3527|0
units.english: You arrive at the spaceport to see a Union Executive overseeing the final preparations of his fleet. After a moment, the last crew members leave his side and board their ships. He walks over to you. "The fleet is ready to launch. Your mission is to escort them to Nifel, pick up as many as they can hold from there, and drop them off on Asgard. The fleet should be able to head back to Nifel and perform the rest of the resettlement trips from there, but please, try to keep all of them in one piece."
units.italian: Arrivi allo spazioporto e vedi un dirigente dell'Unione che sovrintende agli ultimi preparativi della sua flotta. Dopo un momento, gli ultimi membri dell'equipaggio lo lasciano e salgono sulle loro navi. Lui ti si avvicina. "La flotta è pronta a partire. La tua missione è scortarla su Nifel, prendere a bordo quanti più Skadenga possibile e sbarcarli su Asgard. La flotta dovrebbe riuscire a tornare su Nifel e fare lì il resto dei viaggi di trasferimento, ma ti prego, cerca di tenerli tutti interi."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 6|	"Let's get this over with."|3529|0
units.english: "Let's get this over with."
units.italian: "Togliamoci il pensiero."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 6|	"Don't worry, your ships are in good hands."|3530|0
units.english: "Don't worry, your ships are in good hands."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti, le tue navi sono in buone mani."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 6|	"It's time to take the Skadenga home."|3531|0
units.english: "It's time to take the Skadenga home."
units.italian: "È ora di riportare gli Skadenga a casa."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 6|	The ground you are standing on shakes as the ships begin to launch.|3532|0
units.english: The ground you are standing on shakes as the ships begin to launch.
units.italian: Il terreno sotto di te trema mentre le navi cominciano a partire.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 6|You have reached <planet>, but not all the Transport Union ships have arrived yet. You should take off and wait for them to catch up with you.|3543|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but not all the Transport Union ships have arrived yet. You should take off and wait for them to catch up with you.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma non tutte le navi dell'Unione dei Trasporti sono ancora arrivate. Dovresti ripartire e aspettare che ti raggiungano.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 7|name|3549|0
units.english: Transport the Skadenga
units.italian: Trasporta gli Skadenga

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 7|description|3550|0
units.english: Escort a fleet of freighters, refitted for carrying the Skadenga, to <destination>.
units.italian: Escorta una flotta di mercantili, riattrezzati per trasportare gli Skadenga, fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 7|The fleet touches down just outside the over-crowded village of Udainsakr. The landscape is filled with the gathered Skadenga.|3557|0
units.english: The fleet touches down just outside the over-crowded village of Udainsakr. The landscape is filled with the gathered Skadenga.
units.italian: La flotta atterra appena fuori dal villaggio sovraffollato di Udainsakr. Il paesaggio è pieno di Skadenga radunati.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 7|	The Ondurdis approaches you. "Leaving is difficult, but all winters must come to end." As her people board the ships, she adds, "I will be going on first trip to Asgard, but I must rejoin my folk. Thank you for this, and we shall speak again at our new home."|3558|0
units.english: The Ondurdis approaches you. "Leaving is difficult, but all winters must come to end." As her people board the ships, she adds, "I will be going on first trip to Asgard, but I must rejoin my folk. Thank you for this, and we shall speak again at our new home."
units.italian: L'Ondurdis ti si avvicina. "Partire è difficile, ma tutti gli inverni devono finire." Mentre la sua gente sale sulle navi, aggiunge: "Io andrò nel primo viaggio per Asgard, ma devo riunirmi alla mia gente. Grazie per questo, e ci parleremo ancora nella nostra nuova casa."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 7|You have reached <planet>, but not all the Transport Union ships have arrived yet. You should take off and wait for them to catch up with you.|3569|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but not all the Transport Union ships have arrived yet. You should take off and wait for them to catch up with you.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma non tutte le navi dell'Unione dei Trasporti sono ancora arrivate. Dovresti ripartire e aspettare che ti raggiungano.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 7|For the occasion of the first of the Skadenga arrivals, Helsingor has remade itself into a mad circus. There are impromptu bands playing, random, unplanned parades, teeming crowds of excited neighbors holding up signs welcoming the Skadenga into the 31st century. There is also every kind of emergency and civil personnel available here. Firemen, police, doctors, social workers; all claiming, testing, prodding, and questioning the dazed immigrants. The Ondurdis finds you in the chaos and lets you know she wishes to see the God-Stone.|3574|0
units.english: For the occasion of the first of the Skadenga arrivals, Helsingor has remade itself into a mad circus. There are impromptu bands playing, random, unplanned parades, teeming crowds of excited neighbors holding up signs welcoming the Skadenga into the 31st century. There is also every kind of emergency and civil personnel available here. Firemen, police, doctors, social workers; all claiming, testing, prodding, and questioning the dazed immigrants. The Ondurdis finds you in the chaos and lets you know she wishes to see the God-Stone.
units.italian: Per l'arrivo dei primi Skadenga, Helsingor si è trasformata in un circo impazzito. Ci sono bande improvvisate che suonano, cortei casuali e non programmati, frotte brulicanti di vicini eccitati che alzano cartelli di benvenuto agli Skadenga nel XXXI secolo. C'è anche ogni tipo di personale d'emergenza e civile: vigili del fuoco, poliziotti, medici, assistenti sociali; tutti che reclamano, mettono alla prova, pungolano e interrogano gli immigrati storditi. L'Ondurdis ti trova nel caos e ti fa sapere che vuole vedere la Pietra-Divina.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 7|	Together, you travel to the mall, and you explain to her how the structure was built around it, using it as an accent wall to the various posh establishments within.|3576|0
units.english: Together, you travel to the mall, and you explain to her how the structure was built around it, using it as an accent wall to the various posh establishments within.
units.italian: Insieme andate al centro commerciale, e le spieghi come la struttura sia stata costruita intorno alla pietra, usandola come parete d'accento per i vari locali eleganti all'interno.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 7|	Upon seeing this, the old and overwhelmed matron falls to her knees in tears. "These folk are lost," she says. "We are lost."|3577|0
units.english: Upon seeing this, the old and overwhelmed matron falls to her knees in tears. "These folk are lost," she says. "We are lost."
units.italian: Davanti a questo spettacolo, la vecchia matrona sopraffatta cade in ginocchio in lacrime. "Questa gente è perduta," dice. "Noi siamo perduti."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 7|	The Ondurdis looks at you with her tear-wrecked face and says, "You are instrument of Skade. I saw it. But why? Why this? Why to us?"|3578|0
units.english: The Ondurdis looks at you with her tear-wrecked face and says, "You are instrument of Skade. I saw it. But why? Why this? Why to us?"
units.italian: L'Ondurdis ti guarda con il viso sfigurato dalle lacrime e dice: "Tu sei strumento di Skade. Io l'ho visto. Ma perché? Perché questo? Perché a noi?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 7|	After that, she will say no more to you. She lifts her eyes to the sky and begins to chant wildly. A few Skadenga who have made it this far join her. Various news outlets swarm around them to record the Ondurdis' breakdown.|3579|0
units.english: After that, she will say no more to you. She lifts her eyes to the sky and begins to chant wildly. A few Skadenga who have made it this far join her. Various news outlets swarm around them to record the Ondurdis' breakdown.
units.italian: Dopo di che, non ti dirà più nulla. Alza gli occhi al cielo e comincia a cantilenare in modo selvaggio. Alcuni Skadenga che sono arrivati fin qui si uniscono a lei. Varie emittenti giornalistiche si accalcano intorno a loro per riprendere il crollo dell'Ondurdis.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 7|	You back away slowly and bump into someone. You turn to see the real-estate agent Carla Von Hausen smiling at you. "Well done, Captain <last>. I've been authorized to tell you that my superiors have deposited 850,000 credits into your account, as was agreed upon earlier."|3580|0
units.english: You back away slowly and bump into someone. You turn to see the real-estate agent Carla Von Hausen smiling at you. "Well done, Captain <last>. I've been authorized to tell you that my superiors have deposited 850,000 credits into your account, as was agreed upon earlier."
units.italian: Indietreggi lentamente e urti qualcuno. Ti volti e vedi l'agente immobiliare Carla Von Hausen che ti sorride. "Ben fatto, capitano <last>. Sono stata autorizzata a dirti che i miei superiori hanno depositato 850.000 crediti sul tuo conto, come stabilito in precedenza."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 7|	"Your superiors!?"|3582|0
units.english: "Your superiors!?"
units.italian: "I tuoi superiori!?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 7|	Carla grins. "The Census and Culture Bureau. I am one of their field agents. They are most pleased with how you handled this. Helping the Skadenga reintegrate into our culture is a big win for both the Bureau and the Skadenga.|3583|0
units.english: Carla grins. "The Census and Culture Bureau. I am one of their field agents. They are most pleased with how you handled this. Helping the Skadenga reintegrate into our culture is a big win for both the Bureau and the Skadenga.
units.italian: Carla sogghigna. "L'Ufficio del Censimento e della Cultura. Sono uno dei suoi agenti sul campo. Sono molto soddisfatti di come hai gestito la cosa. Aiutare gli Skadenga a reintegrarsi nella nostra cultura è una grande vittoria sia per l'Ufficio sia per gli Skadenga.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 7|	"Anyways, I just wanted to pass that on. I have lots of work to do, thanks to you." She winks and wanders into the crowd.|3584|0
units.english: "Anyways, I just wanted to pass that on. I have lots of work to do, thanks to you." She winks and wanders into the crowd.
units.italian: "Comunque, volevo solo dirtelo. Ho un sacco di lavoro da fare, grazie a te." Ti fa l'occhiolino e si allontana tra la folla.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 7|	You return to your ship to count your money as you hear the Transport Union ships engage their engines to pick up another load of the Skadenga.|3585|0
units.english: You return to your ship to count your money as you hear the Transport Union ships engage their engines to pick up another load of the Skadenga.
units.italian: Torni alla tua nave a contare i tuoi soldi mentre senti le navi dell'Unione dei Trasporti accendere i motori per caricare un altro gruppo di Skadenga.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 1|name|3595|0
units.english: Check on Hjlod
units.italian: Vedere come sta Hjlod

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 1|description|3596|0
units.english: Fly to <destination> to see what Hjlod and the Skadenga need from you. Make sure to have 52 bunks spare when you land.
units.italian: Vola su <destination> per scoprire di cosa hanno bisogno Hjlod e gli Skadenga. Assicurati di avere 52 cuccette libere quando atterri.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 1|There is a new message in your inbox from Hjlod, one of the Skadenga you helped relocate to <planet>.|3605|0
units.english: There is a new message in your inbox from Hjlod, one of the Skadenga you helped relocate to <planet>.
units.italian: C'è un nuovo messaggio nella tua casella di posta da Hjlod, una degli Skadenga che hai aiutato a trasferirsi su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 1|	"<first>, we need your help. Come to <planet>, and have space for 52 souls."|3606|0
units.english: "<first>, we need your help. Come to <planet>, and have space for 52 souls."
units.italian: "<first>, abbiamo bisogno del tuo aiuto. Vieni su <planet>, e abbi spazio per 52 anime."

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|name|3612|0
units.english: Return the Skadenga
units.italian: Riporta gli Skadenga

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|description|3613|0
units.english: Take the Skadenga refugees back to <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta gli Skadenga profughi su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|blocked|3616|0
units.english: You recall that Hjlod wanted you to have 52 bunks spare for the mission. Return when you have enough room.
units.italian: Ricordi che Hjlod voleva che avessi 52 cuccette libere per la missione. Torna quando avrai abbastanza spazio.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|The Asgard spaceport hums with a thousand indecipherable conversations. It is a landscape overburdened with kinetic humanity. You spend hours wandering through the crowds for a glimpse of Hjlod. Exhausted, you are ready to throw in the towel when you feel a strong hand grab your arm. You turn to see a familiar tattooed face. Her eyes are dark and dull, her hair thin and unkept, her face creased with unhappiness.|3622|0
units.english: The Asgard spaceport hums with a thousand indecipherable conversations. It is a landscape overburdened with kinetic humanity. You spend hours wandering through the crowds for a glimpse of Hjlod. Exhausted, you are ready to throw in the towel when you feel a strong hand grab your arm. You turn to see a familiar tattooed face. Her eyes are dark and dull, her hair thin and unkept, her face creased with unhappiness.
units.italian: Lo spazioporto di Asgard ronza di mille conversazioni indecifrabili. È un paesaggio sovraccarico di umanità in movimento. Passi ore a vagare tra la folla in cerca di un'occhiata di Hjlod. Esausto, sei pronto a gettare la spugna quando senti una mano forte afferrarti il braccio. Ti volti e vedi un viso tatuato che conosci. I suoi occhi sono scuri e spenti, i capelli radi e trascurati, il viso segnato dall'infelicità.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	"Not a vord." Hjlod says as you walk toward a portion of the spaceport that is marked "Closed - Under Construction." She draws you along. It's strange to see her so changed over such a short period of time. It's only been a year since you brought her here.|3623|0
units.english: "Not a vord." Hjlod says as you walk toward a portion of the spaceport that is marked "Closed - Under Construction." She draws you along. It's strange to see her so changed over such a short period of time. It's only been a year since you brought her here.
units.italian: "Nemmeno una parola." dice Hjlod mentre camminate verso una parte dello spazioporto segnata come "Chiuso - Lavori in corso". Ti tira con sé. È strano vederla così cambiata in un periodo così breve. È passato solo un anno da quando l'hai portata qui.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	She ushers you past various barriers meant to keep a compliant public out. Finally, she leads you into a long hallway filled with the detritus of life: empty food containers, dirty blankets, other less savory items. People are also here - dirty, clumped together, wretched-looking.|3624|0
units.english: She ushers you past various barriers meant to keep a compliant public out. Finally, she leads you into a long hallway filled with the detritus of life: empty food containers, dirty blankets, other less savory items. People are also here - dirty, clumped together, wretched-looking.
units.italian: Ti fa passare oltre varie barriere pensate per tenere fuori un pubblico ubbidiente. Alla fine ti conduce in un lungo corridoio pieno di detriti della vita: contenitori di cibo vuoti, coperte sporche, altri oggetti meno gradevoli. Ci sono anche persone: sporche, ammassate insieme, dall'aspetto miserevole.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	Hjlod turns back to you. "It safe to talk novhere. But ve must, so here must do."|3625|0
units.english: Hjlod turns back to you. "It safe to talk novhere. But ve must, so here must do."
units.italian: Hjlod si volta verso di te. "Ormai non è sicuro parlare da nessuna parte. Ma dobbiamo, quindi qui dobbiamo fare."

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	"What do you want from me?"|3627|0
units.english: "What do you want from me?"
units.italian: "Cosa vuoi da me?"

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	"Who are these people?"|3628|0
units.english: "Who are these people?"
units.italian: "Chi sono queste persone?"

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	Hjlod glares at you. "From you? Everything. For that is vhat you took from us.|3630|0
units.english: Hjlod glares at you. "From you? Everything. For that is vhat you took from us.
units.italian: Hjlod ti lancia un'occhiataccia. "Da te? Tutto. Perché è quello che ci hai portato via.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	"I do not know vhy you did it. Vhy you brought us here. If Skade really let us down. Or if you ignored her," she growls. "But it does not matter. All that matters is that ve leave, and that is vhy ve need you."|3631|0
units.english: "I do not know vhy you did it. Vhy you brought us here. If Skade really let us down. Or if you ignored her," she growls. "But it does not matter. All that matters is that ve leave, and that is vhy ve need you."
units.italian: "Non so perché l'hai fatto. Perché ci hai portato qui. Se davvero Skade ci ha abbandonati. O se l'hai ignorata," ringhia. "Ma non importa. L'unica cosa che importa è che ce ne andiamo, ed è per questo che abbiamo bisogno di te."

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	Hjlod laughs and tears run down her cheeks. "Do you not recognize us? Our great savior? Ve are the Skadenga, and this is your handivwork."|3634|0
units.english: Hjlod laughs and tears run down her cheeks. "Do you not recognize us? Our great savior? Ve are the Skadenga, and this is your handivwork."
units.italian: Hjlod ride e le lacrime le scorrono sulle guance. "Non ci riconosci? Il nostro grande salvatore? Noi siamo gli Skadenga, e questa è opera tua."

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	She looks away from you and continues. "The rest are not dead, no. But they have left us. Most are happy; happy to be fed, happy to be entertained, happy to forget who they are, happy to be Skadenga in name, but not in practice. But those here cannot accept that. Ve refuse to become them.|3635|0
units.english: She looks away from you and continues. "The rest are not dead, no. But they have left us. Most are happy; happy to be fed, happy to be entertained, happy to forget who they are, happy to be Skadenga in name, but not in practice. But those here cannot accept that. Ve refuse to become them.
units.italian: Distoglie lo sguardo da te e continua. "Gli altri non sono morti, no. Ma ci hanno lasciati. La maggior parte è felice; felice di essere sfamata, felice di essere intrattenuta, felice di dimenticare chi è, felice di essere Skadenga di nome, ma non di fatto. Chi è qui invece non può accettarlo. Noi ci rifiutiamo di diventare come loro.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	"Ve hide now. From the social workers, from the service providers, from the government. They can still find us, they know ve are here, but vhat they don't know is that ve can leave. That you can take us avay from here."|3636|0
units.english: "Ve hide now. From the social workers, from the service providers, from the government. They can still find us, they know ve are here, but vhat they don't know is that ve can leave. That you can take us avay from here."
units.italian: "Adesso ci nascondiamo. Dagli assistenti sociali, dai fornitori di servizi, dal governo. Possono ancora trovarci, sanno che siamo qui, ma quello che non sanno è che possiamo andarcene. Che tu puoi portarci via da qui."

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	Hjlod takes a deep, calming breath. "I call because you are our only hope. They vill not let us leave. They vill not let us be. They vill steal our souls." She points a shaky finger at you. "Take us back to Nifel. All those who are left. Take us home. Ve know the cold vill get us eventually. But better to live on a dying vorld as Skadenga than to live here as nothing."|3638|0
units.english: Hjlod takes a deep, calming breath. "I call because you are our only hope. They vill not let us leave. They vill not let us be. They vill steal our souls." She points a shaky finger at you. "Take us back to Nifel. All those who are left. Take us home. Ve know the cold vill get us eventually. But better to live on a dying vorld as Skadenga than to live here as nothing."
units.italian: Hjlod fa un respiro profondo e si calma. "Io chiamo perché tu sei nostra unica speranza. Loro non ci lasciano andare. Loro non ci lasciano essere. Loro ci rubano anime." Ti punta un dito tremante. "Portaci su Nifel. Tutti quelli che restano. Portaci a casa. Noi sappiamo che freddo ci prenderà alla fine. Ma meglio vivere su mondo che muore come Skadenga che vivere qui come niente."

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	"I will help you."|3640|0
units.english: "I will help you."
units.italian: "Ti aiuterò."

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	"I need to think about it."|3642|0
units.english: "I need to think about it."
units.italian: "Devo pensarci."

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	Hjlod grimaces. "Once they know you are here, they vill collect us. Come back here in an hour. Any longer than that, and ve vill be gone." She slumps down on the ground as you exit the dark, dirty tunnel where the remaining Skadenga cling to their fleeting identity.|3643|0
units.english: Hjlod grimaces. "Once they know you are here, they vill collect us. Come back here in an hour. Any longer than that, and ve vill be gone." She slumps down on the ground as you exit the dark, dirty tunnel where the remaining Skadenga cling to their fleeting identity.
units.italian: Hjlod fa una smorfia. "Quando sanno che sei qui, vengono a prenderci. Torna qui tra un'ora. Più tardi di così, e noi non ci siamo più." Si accascia al suolo mentre esci dal tunnel buio e sporco dove gli Skadenga rimasti si aggrappano alla loro identità che svanisce.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	Alone, you have a decision to make. You can return to help them escape this world. Or you can find Clara Von Hausen, the Census and Culture Bureau undercover agent, and report to her what is going on. She would probably pay you well for the information.|3644|0
units.english: Alone, you have a decision to make. You can return to help them escape this world. Or you can find Clara Von Hausen, the Census and Culture Bureau undercover agent, and report to her what is going on. She would probably pay you well for the information.
units.italian: Da solo, hai una decisione da prendere. Puoi tornare ad aiutarli a fuggire da questo mondo. Oppure puoi trovare Carla Von Hausen, l'agente sotto copertura dell'Ufficio del Censimento e della Cultura, e riferirle cosa sta succedendo. Probabilmente ti pagherebbe bene per l'informazione.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	(Return to Hjlod and help the Skadenga.)|3646|0
units.english: (Return to Hjlod and help the Skadenga.)
units.italian: (Torna da Hjlod e aiuta gli Skadenga.)

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	(Find Carla.)|3648|0
units.english: (Find Carla.)
units.italian: (Trova Carla.)

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	You leave Hjlod and her gang of stubborn savages behind, and return to the active parts of the thrumming spaceport. Carla's contact information, as an alleged real estate agent, is easy to find, and in a few minutes you have her on call. "Captain <last>, it is a pleasure to hear from you again. What-so-ever can I help you with?" she says with believable cheerfulness.|3649|0
