units.english: You leave Hjlod and her gang of stubborn savages behind, and return to the active parts of the thrumming spaceport. Carla's contact information, as an alleged real estate agent, is easy to find, and in a few minutes you have her on call. "Captain <last>, it is a pleasure to hear from you again. What-so-ever can I help you with?" she says with believable cheerfulness.
units.italian: Lasci Hjlod e la sua banda di selvaggi ostinati, e torni alle parti attive dello spazioporto pulsante. I recapiti di Carla, in qualità di presunta agente immobiliare, sono facili da trovare, e in pochi minuti la hai in linea. "Capitano <last>, è un piacere sentirti di nuovo. In cosa posso esserti utile?" dice con un'allegria credibile.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	You tell her about the Skadenga hiding in the spaceport and their plans to escape to Nifel.|3650|0
units.english: You tell her about the Skadenga hiding in the spaceport and their plans to escape to Nifel.
units.italian: Le racconti degli Skadenga nascosti nello spazioporto e dei loro piani per fuggire su Nifel.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	"Oh dear!" Carla says. "How terrible. Those poor, foolish simpletons would surely suffer on that terrible frozen world. How misguided of them. We are aware that some have struggled to assimilate. It's quite tragic, but we will handle things from here. Hopefully, we can convince them to integrate eventually. It really is for the best. I wish their old leader could have seen that before she died. It would have been easier for everyone.|3651|0
units.english: "Oh dear!" Carla says. "How terrible. Those poor, foolish simpletons would surely suffer on that terrible frozen world. How misguided of them. We are aware that some have struggled to assimilate. It's quite tragic, but we will handle things from here. Hopefully, we can convince them to integrate eventually. It really is for the best. I wish their old leader could have seen that before she died. It would have been easier for everyone.
units.italian: "Oh, cielo!" dice Carla. "Che cosa terribile. Quei poveri, sciocchi semplicioni soffrirebbero di sicuro su quel mondo gelido e terribile. Che idea sbagliata. Sappiamo che alcuni hanno avuto difficoltà ad assimilarsi. È piuttosto tragico, ma da qui in poi ce ne occuperemo noi. Speriamo di riuscire a convincerli, alla fine, a integrarsi. È davvero la cosa migliore. Vorrei che la loro vecchia guida l'avesse capito prima di morire. Sarebbe stato più facile per tutti.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	"As always, we appreciate your valuable contributions. I'll authorize a generous sum of credits to be transferred to your account. I need to get some approvals so it may take a couple of days to come through. Thank you, and buh-bye!"|3652|0
units.english: "As always, we appreciate your valuable contributions. I'll authorize a generous sum of credits to be transferred to your account. I need to get some approvals so it may take a couple of days to come through. Thank you, and buh-bye!"
units.italian: "Come sempre, apprezziamo i tuoi preziosi contributi. Autorizzerò il trasferimento di una generosa somma di crediti sul tuo conto. Devo ottenere alcune approvazioni, quindi potrebbe volerci un paio di giorni. Grazie, e ciao ciao!"

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	You return to Hjlod, who is surprised that you came back at all, and let her know that you going to help them.|3655|0
units.english: You return to Hjlod, who is surprised that you came back at all, and let her know that you going to help them.
units.italian: Torni da Hjlod, che è sorpresa di rivederti, e le fai sapere che li aiuterai.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	Hearing this, the slumped and depressed dredges in the hall stir and rise from their stupor. Hurriedly, some gather items while others race off further into the dark, unused parts of the spaceport.|3657|0
units.english: Hearing this, the slumped and depressed dredges in the hall stir and rise from their stupor. Hurriedly, some gather items while others race off further into the dark, unused parts of the spaceport.
units.italian: Sentendo questo, gli sbandati accasciati e depressi nel corridoio si scuotono e si alzano dal loro torpore. In fretta, alcuni raccolgono le loro cose mentre altri corrono più a fondo nelle parti buie e inutilizzate dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	"Ve have 52 people that need off this vorld right now." Hjlod hesitates a moment, and then adds, "I know how much you like money. Ve have pooled all our savings together and vill pay you <payment> for this job." She grabs a ragged duffle bag and a group gather around her. "The rest vill meet us at your ship. Ve move now."|3658|0
units.english: "Ve have 52 people that need off this vorld right now." Hjlod hesitates a moment, and then adds, "I know how much you like money. Ve have pooled all our savings together and vill pay you <payment> for this job." She grabs a ragged duffle bag and a group gather around her. "The rest vill meet us at your ship. Ve move now."
units.italian: "Abbiamo 52 persone che devono lasciare questo mondo subito." Hjlod esita un momento, poi aggiunge: "So quanto ti piacciono i soldi. Abbiamo messo insieme tutti i nostri risparmi e ti pagheremo <payment> per questo lavoro." Afferra una sacca di tela sdrucita e un gruppo si raduna intorno a lei. "Gli altri ci incontrano alla tua nave. Adesso ci muoviamo."

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	(Follow Hjlod.)|3660|0
units.english: (Follow Hjlod.)
units.italian: (Segui Hjlod.)

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	Once you're back in the operational spaceport, you and your group move quickly, while drawing occasional glances from curious on-lookers. A large group of disheveled Skaldenga are waiting for you when you reach your ship. "Everyone on, quickly!" Hjlod barks at her people.|3661|0
units.english: Once you're back in the operational spaceport, you and your group move quickly, while drawing occasional glances from curious on-lookers. A large group of disheveled Skaldenga are waiting for you when you reach your ship. "Everyone on, quickly!" Hjlod barks at her people.
units.italian: Una volta tornati nello spazioporto in funzione, tu e il tuo gruppo vi muovete in fretta, attirando ogni tanto lo sguardo di curiosi. Un grande gruppo di Skadenga arruffati vi aspetta quando arrivate alla tua nave. "Tutti a bordo, in fretta!" abbaia Hjlod alla sua gente.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	A few moments later, they are all on board. "Asdis, headcount!" Hjlod orders. As you're waiting, two more dirty and gaunt Skadenga show up. Asdis adds them to her count and then addresses Hjlod. "Ondurdis, 48 total."|3662|0
units.english: A few moments later, they are all on board. "Asdis, headcount!" Hjlod orders. As you're waiting, two more dirty and gaunt Skadenga show up. Asdis adds them to her count and then addresses Hjlod. "Ondurdis, 48 total."
units.italian: Pochi istanti dopo sono tutti a bordo. "Asdis, conta!" ordina Hjlod. Mentre aspettate, arrivano altri due Skadenga sporchi e smunti. Asdis li aggiunge al conteggio e poi si rivolge a Hjlod. "Ondurdis, 48 in tutto."

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	Hjlod frowns. "It's Arnson's family isn't it? I told him he vas too far."|3663|0
units.english: Hjlod frowns. "It's Arnson's family isn't it? I told him he vas too far."
units.italian: Hjlod aggrotta la fronte. "È la famiglia di Arnson, vero? Gli avevo detto che era troppo lontano."

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	A commotion boils up from a few terminals down, and you see some civil servants and local police officers heading your way. Asdis is also watching. "They could still be coming."|3664|0
units.english: A commotion boils up from a few terminals down, and you see some civil servants and local police officers heading your way. Asdis is also watching. "They could still be coming."
units.italian: Un trambusto si alza da qualche terminale più in là, e vedi alcuni dipendenti pubblici e agenti della polizia locale dirigersi verso di voi. Anche Asdis li sta guardando. "Potrebbero ancora arrivare."

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	"It's too late for them." Hjlod shuts the hatch. "<first>, if ever ve vere friends. Take off, now."|3665|0
units.english: "It's too late for them." Hjlod shuts the hatch. "<first>, if ever ve vere friends. Take off, now."
units.italian: "Per loro è troppo tardi." Hjlod chiude il portello. "<first>, se mai siamo stati amici. Parti, adesso."

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	(Take off.)|3667|0
units.english: (Take off.)
units.italian: (Parti.)

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	(Power down the ship and open the hatch.)|3669|0
units.english: (Power down the ship and open the hatch.)
units.italian: (Spegni la nave e apri il portello.)

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	You turn off your ship's ignition, pop open the hatch before Hjlod can react, and jump out. Carla Von Hausen, at least two civil service workers, and a squad of police officers arrive within seconds. Carla gives you a tight smile. "Decided to do the right thing in the end? We appreciate it."|3670|0
units.english: You turn off your ship's ignition, pop open the hatch before Hjlod can react, and jump out. Carla Von Hausen, at least two civil service workers, and a squad of police officers arrive within seconds. Carla gives you a tight smile. "Decided to do the right thing in the end? We appreciate it."
units.italian: Spegni l'accensione della nave, apri il portello prima che Hjlod possa reagire e salti giù. Carla Von Hausen, almeno due dipendenti pubblici e una squadra di agenti di polizia arrivano in pochi secondi. Carla ti rivolge un sorriso tirato. "Hai deciso di fare la cosa giusta alla fine? Lo apprezziamo."

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	The police officers enter your ship and start restraining and removing the Skadenga aboard it.|3671|0
units.english: The police officers enter your ship and start restraining and removing the Skadenga aboard it.
units.italian: Gli agenti di polizia entrano nella tua nave e cominciano a trattenere e portare via gli Skadenga a bordo.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	"As always, we appreciate your help and value our continued working relationship. Expect a payment for your aid in the next couple days, after I've gotten it approved." Carla steps back to assess the Skadenga, most of which are sullen and reserved. One, however, is screaming, kicking, and biting.|3672|0
units.english: "As always, we appreciate your help and value our continued working relationship. Expect a payment for your aid in the next couple days, after I've gotten it approved." Carla steps back to assess the Skadenga, most of which are sullen and reserved. One, however, is screaming, kicking, and biting.
units.italian: "Come sempre, apprezziamo il tuo aiuto e teniamo al nostro rapporto di lavoro. Aspettati un pagamento per il tuo aiuto nei prossimi giorni, dopo che l'avrò fatto approvare." Carla fa un passo indietro per valutare gli Skadenga, per la maggior parte cupi e riservati. Uno però urla, scalcia e morde.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	The unruly Skadenga is dragged past you, and spit splashes against your cheek. "I'll kill you, <first>. If ever ve meet again I'll kill you. You've killed me. You've killed me." Hjlod's red and tear-stained face recedes as officers drag her away.|3673|0
units.english: The unruly Skadenga is dragged past you, and spit splashes against your cheek. "I'll kill you, <first>. If ever ve meet again I'll kill you. You've killed me. You've killed me." Hjlod's red and tear-stained face recedes as officers drag her away.
units.italian: Lo Skadenga indisciplinato viene trascinato via davanti a te, e uno sputo ti schizza sulla guancia. "Ti uccido, <first>. Se ci incontriamo ancora, ti uccido. Mi hai ucciso. Mi hai ucciso." Il viso rosso e rigato di lacrime di Hjlod si allontana mentre gli agenti la trascinano via.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	"Misguided girl," Carla says sadly. "We'll take it from here. Have a wonderful day, Captain <last>."|3674|0
units.english: "Misguided girl," Carla says sadly. "We'll take it from here. Have a wonderful day, Captain <last>."
units.italian: "Ragazza fuorviata," dice Carla con tristezza. "Da qui in poi ce ne occupiamo noi. Buona giornata, capitano <last>."

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	You punch it, and your ship burns for the stars. Hjlod visibly relaxes when the thrust kicks in. She closes her tired eyes and slumps to the floor. "Thank Skade," is all she says.|3677|0
units.english: You punch it, and your ship burns for the stars. Hjlod visibly relaxes when the thrust kicks in. She closes her tired eyes and slumps to the floor. "Thank Skade," is all she says.
units.italian: Dai gas, e la tua nave brucia verso le stelle. Hjlod si rilassa visibilmente quando la spinta entra in azione. Chiude gli occhi stanchi e si accascia sul pavimento. "Grazie a Skade," è tutto quello che dice.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|Your ship touches down just outside the abandoned village of Udainskar. Silently, your passengers disembark and drift into the world they once knew and thought never to see again. The village appears to have weathered its abandonment well, and it appears the people here will not have too much trouble picking up where they left off.|3685|0
units.english: Your ship touches down just outside the abandoned village of Udainskar. Silently, your passengers disembark and drift into the world they once knew and thought never to see again. The village appears to have weathered its abandonment well, and it appears the people here will not have too much trouble picking up where they left off.
units.italian: La tua nave atterra appena fuori dal villaggio abbandonato di Udainskar. In silenzio, i tuoi passeggeri sbarcano e si disperdono nel mondo che conoscevano e che pensavano di non rivedere mai più. Il villaggio sembra aver retto bene all'abbandono, e sembra che la gente qui non avrà troppi problemi a riprendere da dove aveva lasciato.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	Hjlod lingers besides your ship for just a moment. "The credits are in hard-drive on your ship's console. I hope it makes you happy.|3686|0
units.english: Hjlod lingers besides your ship for just a moment. "The credits are in hard-drive on your ship's console. I hope it makes you happy.
units.italian: Hjlod si attarda accanto alla tua nave solo un momento. "I crediti sono nel disco rigido sulla console della tua nave. Spero che ti renda felice.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 2|	"I do not know vhy you sent us to that place. But I am happy to be home. So go, and maybe one day I vill not hate to see you again."|3687|0
units.english: "I do not know vhy you sent us to that place. But I am happy to be home. So go, and maybe one day I vill not hate to see you again."
units.italian: "Non so perché ci hai mandati in quel posto. Ma sono felice di essere a casa. Quindi vai, e forse un giorno non odierò rivederti."

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 3|You receive a message from your bank that <payment> have been deposited into your account from the Census and Culture Bureau of The Deep. The following memo is attached:|3709|0
units.english: You receive a message from your bank that <payment> have been deposited into your account from the Census and Culture Bureau of The Deep. The following memo is attached:
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio dalla tua banca: sul tuo conto sono arrivati <payment> dall'Ufficio del Censimento e della Cultura del Deep. È allegato il seguente memo:

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 3|	"For heroic and selfless service to the ideals and prosperity of The Deep."|3710|0
units.english: "For heroic and selfless service to the ideals and prosperity of The Deep."
units.italian: "Per il servizio eroico e disinteressato agli ideali e alla prosperità del Deep."

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 4|A familiar woman is waiting for you outside your ship. Although it's been more than seven years since you've last seen her, you recognize Hjlod instantly. Her eyes are brighter than when last you parted, and she has the same lopsided grin that you remember. "<first>, I saw your ship landing, and thought I vould say hello."|3727|0
units.english: A familiar woman is waiting for you outside your ship. Although it's been more than seven years since you've last seen her, you recognize Hjlod instantly. Her eyes are brighter than when last you parted, and she has the same lopsided grin that you remember. "<first>, I saw your ship landing, and thought I vould say hello."
units.italian: Una donna che conosci ti aspetta fuori dalla nave. Anche se sono passati più di sette anni dall'ultima volta che l'hai vista, riconosci Hjlod all'istante. I suoi occhi sono più luminosi di quando vi siete separati, e ha lo stesso sorriso storto che ricordi. "<first>, ho visto la tua nave atterrare, e ho pensato di venire a salutare."

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 4|	You ask her how she has been, and she tells you that the small community of Skadenga have rebuilt and thrived here. That there has even been a small amount of immigration to their tiny town. That word had gotten out about their desperate escape from Asgard.|3728|0
units.english: You ask her how she has been, and she tells you that the small community of Skadenga have rebuilt and thrived here. That there has even been a small amount of immigration to their tiny town. That word had gotten out about their desperate escape from Asgard.
units.italian: Le chiedi come sta, e ti racconta che la piccola comunità di Skadenga si è ricostruita e prospera qui. Che c'è stata persino una piccola ondata di immigrazione verso la loro cittadina. Che la voce della loro fuga disperata da Asgard si era sparsa.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 4|	She tells you that she forgives your past actions, and hopes you find whatever it is you are looking for among the stars. She even hugs you before she leaves.|3729|0
units.english: She tells you that she forgives your past actions, and hopes you find whatever it is you are looking for among the stars. She even hugs you before she leaves.
units.italian: Ti dice che ti perdona per quello che hai fatto in passato, e spera che tu trovi qualunque cosa stia cercando tra le stelle. Ti abbraccia persino prima di andarsene.

units.id: mission:Skadenga Call 5|You receive a message from the Census and Culture Bureau of the Deep. The Deep Citizen known as Hjlod has died. The cause of death appeared to be related to heavy substance abuse. The Bureau has determined that you are her closest relation and has forwarded you her entire inheritance: <payment>.|3745|0
units.english: You receive a message from the Census and Culture Bureau of the Deep. The Deep Citizen known as Hjlod has died. The cause of death appeared to be related to heavy substance abuse. The Bureau has determined that you are her closest relation and has forwarded you her entire inheritance: <payment>.
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio dall'Ufficio del Censimento e della Cultura del Deep. La cittadina del Deep conosciuta come Hjlod è morta. La causa del decesso sembra legata a un forte abuso di sostanze. L'Ufficio ha stabilito che sei tu il suo parente più stretto e ti ha inoltrato tutta la sua eredità: <payment>.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 8|name|3750|0
units.english: <planet> Mystery Man
units.italian: L'uomo misterioso di <planet>

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 8|description|3751|0
units.english: Travel to <destination>, and meet up with Hroar in the spaceport.
units.italian: Recati su <destination> e incontra Hroar allo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 8|The Transport Union employee is waiting for you near the entrance. He's wearing a wide-brimmed hat, a bulky scarf, a long coat with an up-turned collar, and sunglasses. You worry his over-the-top efforts to look nondescript will only draw more attention.|3758|0
units.english: The Transport Union employee is waiting for you near the entrance. He's wearing a wide-brimmed hat, a bulky scarf, a long coat with an up-turned collar, and sunglasses. You worry his over-the-top efforts to look nondescript will only draw more attention.
units.italian: Il dipendente dell'Unione dei Trasporti ti aspetta vicino all'ingresso. Indossa un cappello a tesa larga, una sciarpa voluminosa, un cappotto lungo con il colletto alzato e occhiali da sole. Temi che i suoi sforzi esagerati per sembrare anonimo attireranno ancora più attenzione.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 8|	"Can't speak long," he says. "It's too dangerous. I can't afford to be seen with you."|3759|0
units.english: "Can't speak long," he says. "It's too dangerous. I can't afford to be seen with you."
units.italian: "Non posso parlare a lungo," dice. "È troppo pericoloso. Non posso permettermi di essere visto con te."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 8|	You ask him what this is all about.|3760|0
units.english: You ask him what this is all about.
units.italian: Gli chiedi di cosa si tratta.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 8|	"I don't agree with what the Union or the Deep are doing. I was raised in a small town where we still respected our past, and I couldn't just sit around and do nothing. So listen: with the Union against you, there's no transport company that will pick up your contract, with one exception. There's a bold renegade mineral baron on <planet>. He hates the Union, and may be willing to do what you ask."|3761|0
units.english: "I don't agree with what the Union or the Deep are doing. I was raised in a small town where we still respected our past, and I couldn't just sit around and do nothing. So listen: with the Union against you, there's no transport company that will pick up your contract, with one exception. There's a bold renegade mineral baron on <planet>. He hates the Union, and may be willing to do what you ask."
units.italian: "Non sono d'accordo con quello che stanno facendo l'Unione o il Deep. Sono cresciuto in una piccola città dove rispettavamo ancora il nostro passato, e non potevo restarmene seduto a non fare nulla. Quindi ascolta: con l'Unione contro di te, non c'è compagnia di trasporti che accetterà il tuo contratto, con una sola eccezione. Su <planet> c'è un audace barone minerario rinnegato. Odia l'Unione, e potrebbe essere disposto a fare quello che chiedi."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 8|	"How do I find him?"|3763|0
units.english: "How do I find him?"
units.italian: "Come lo trovo?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 8|	The Union employee begins moving away from you. "Name's Hroar. You can usually find him in the Red Rock Saloon, inside the Muspel Spaceport."|3764|0
units.english: The Union employee begins moving away from you. "Name's Hroar. You can usually find him in the Red Rock Saloon, inside the Muspel Spaceport."
units.italian: Il dipendente dell'Unione comincia ad allontanarsi. "Si chiama Hroar. Di solito lo trovi al Red Rock Saloon, dentro lo spazioporto di Muspel."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 8|	The disgruntled Union employee then says, quite loudly, "I do not know where the bracelet shop is, please stop asking me!" and hurries away from you.|3765|0
units.english: The disgruntled Union employee then says, quite loudly, "I do not know where the bracelet shop is, please stop asking me!" and hurries away from you.
units.italian: Poi il dipendente scontento dice, a voce piuttosto alta: "Non so dov'è il negozio di bracciali, smetti di chiedermelo!" e si allontana in fretta.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 8|You've arrived at the rusty-hued world that is Muspel. You should head into the spaceport to see if you can find Hroar.|3769|0
units.english: You've arrived at the rusty-hued world that is Muspel. You should head into the spaceport to see if you can find Hroar.
units.italian: Sei arrivato sul mondo dalle tinte rugginose che è Muspel. Dovresti entrare nello spazioporto per vedere se riesci a trovare Hroar.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|The floor of the spaceport is covered in the dirty red dust of hundreds of shuffling feet. Prospectors, miners, drillers, and all their attendant associates are intermixed here, gossiping about the latest finds, accidents, and hauls. Every person, either saturated in red earth or immaculately clean, creates a visual aid to boundaries of class, paycheck, and leadership.|3780|0
units.english: The floor of the spaceport is covered in the dirty red dust of hundreds of shuffling feet. Prospectors, miners, drillers, and all their attendant associates are intermixed here, gossiping about the latest finds, accidents, and hauls. Every person, either saturated in red earth or immaculately clean, creates a visual aid to boundaries of class, paycheck, and leadership.
units.italian: Il pavimento dello spazioporto è coperto della polvere rossa e sporca di centinaia di piedi che si trascinano. Cercatori, minatori, trivellatori e tutti i loro soci si mescolano qui, spettegolando sugli ultimi ritrovamenti, incidenti e carichi. Ogni persona, o satura di terra rossa o immacolatamente pulita, disegna visivamente i confini tra classe, stipendio e potere.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	The Red Rock Saloon is located deep in the trade-craft section of the spaceport, far enough from the tourist areas to discourage anyone but the locals and those with business to enter.|3782|0
units.english: The Red Rock Saloon is located deep in the trade-craft section of the spaceport, far enough from the tourist areas to discourage anyone but the locals and those with business to enter.
units.italian: Il Red Rock Saloon si trova in fondo alla sezione delle navi commerciali dello spazioporto, abbastanza lontano dalle aree turistiche da scoraggiare chiunque tranne gli abitanti del posto e chi ha affari da sbrigare.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	(Enter the Red Rock Saloon.)|3784|0
units.english: (Enter the Red Rock Saloon.)
units.italian: (Entra nel Red Rock Saloon.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	The doors swing open, revealing a dimly lit room filled with rough unsavory people. Piano music is playing on a cheap speaker, and the eyes of the patrons slide to get a good look at you without turning their heads. There is an expectant pause. You get the feeling they are waiting for you to either announce something or leave.|3785|0
units.english: The doors swing open, revealing a dimly lit room filled with rough unsavory people. Piano music is playing on a cheap speaker, and the eyes of the patrons slide to get a good look at you without turning their heads. There is an expectant pause. You get the feeling they are waiting for you to either announce something or leave.
units.italian: Le porte si spalancano, rivelando una stanza in penombra piena di gente rozza e poco raccomandabile. Dalle casse economiche esce musica di pianoforte, e gli occhi degli avventori scivolano verso di te per guardarti bene senza voltare la testa. C'è una pausa di attesa. Hai la sensazione che stiano aspettando che tu annunci qualcosa o te ne vada.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	"I'm looking for Hroar."|3787|0
units.english: "I'm looking for Hroar."
units.italian: "Sto cercando Hroar."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	For a moment nothing happens, and then a gruff voice spirals out from a dark corner. "Back here."|3788|0
units.english: For a moment nothing happens, and then a gruff voice spirals out from a dark corner. "Back here."
units.italian: Per un momento non succede nulla, poi una voce burbera sale da un angolo buio. "Qui dietro."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	You walk to the back of the saloon and find a gruff man in a long reddish-brown jacket seated with his back against the wall, and a bottle of whiskey on his otherwise empty table. "Have a seat," he says.|3790|0
units.english: You walk to the back of the saloon and find a gruff man in a long reddish-brown jacket seated with his back against the wall, and a bottle of whiskey on his otherwise empty table. "Have a seat," he says.
units.italian: Vai in fondo al saloon e trovi un uomo burbero in una lunga giacca rosso-bruna seduto con la schiena al muro, e una bottiglia di whisky sull'unico tavolo per il resto vuoto. "Siediti," dice.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	After you sit, he places a gun on the table. "So the Allen boys think they can send some greenhorn killer to take me out?" Hroar barks a laugh. "Not likely." With his free hand, he takes a swig of his whiskey. "Here's what's going to happen. I am not going to kill you. Only maim you, a bit. And you tell the Allen boys that the next person they send will come back even worse. We had a deal, and I expect them to keep it."|3791|0
units.english: After you sit, he places a gun on the table. "So the Allen boys think they can send some greenhorn killer to take me out?" Hroar barks a laugh. "Not likely." With his free hand, he takes a swig of his whiskey. "Here's what's going to happen. I am not going to kill you. Only maim you, a bit. And you tell the Allen boys that the next person they send will come back even worse. We had a deal, and I expect them to keep it."
units.italian: Dopo che ti sei seduto, posa una pistola sul tavolo. "Quindi i fratelli Allen pensano di mandare qualche pivello assassino a farmi fuori?" Hroar ride di gusto. "Poco probabile." Con la mano libera prende un sorso di whisky. "Ecco come andrà. Non ti uccido. Ti storpiaccio e basta. E tu dici ai fratelli Allen che la prossima persona che mandano tornerà messa anche peggio. Avevamo un accordo, e mi aspetto che lo rispettino."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	"You got the wrong person. I don't even know who the Allen boys are."|3793|0
units.english: "You got the wrong person. I don't even know who the Allen boys are."
units.italian: "Hai preso la persona sbagliata. Non so nemmeno chi siano i fratelli Allen."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	"I was not sent by the Allen whoevers, and if you even touch me, I will burn this entire planet to ash."|3795|0
units.english: "I was not sent by the Allen whoevers, and if you even touch me, I will burn this entire planet to ash."
units.italian: "Non mi ha mandato nessuno degli Allen o come si chiamano, e se solo mi tocchi, riduco questo pianeta in cenere."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	Hroar breaks into uproarious laughter. People sitting the booth over, who were obviously listening, also start laughing. "Don't make threats you can't back up. Or you're gonna be a messenger in a bodybag.|3798|0
units.english: Hroar breaks into uproarious laughter. People sitting the booth over, who were obviously listening, also start laughing. "Don't make threats you can't back up. Or you're gonna be a messenger in a bodybag.
units.italian: Hroar scoppia in una risata fragorosa. Anche le persone al tavolo accanto, che stavano chiaramente ascoltando, cominciano a ridere. "Non fare minacce che non puoi mantenere. O finirai per essere un messaggero in un sacco di plastica.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	"If it wasn't the Allen boys who sent you, who do you work for? The Leshinskis? Mad Mikkel's Gang? Or maybe the Hanovarian?" Hroar pauses. "Nah, not his style. So who?"|3800|0
units.english: "If it wasn't the Allen boys who sent you, who do you work for? The Leshinskis? Mad Mikkel's Gang? Or maybe the Hanovarian?" Hroar pauses. "Nah, not his style. So who?"
units.italian: "Se non ti hanno mandato i fratelli Allen, per chi lavori? I Leshinski? La banda di Mad Mikkel? O magari gli Hanovarian?" Hroar si ferma. "No, non è il suo stile. Allora chi?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|label|3802|0
units.english: buff boi
units.italian: buff boi

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	Hesitation flickers on Hroar's face, and he lifts his hand away from his gun. "No need to be making threats like that. We're all friends here."|3803|0
units.english: Hesitation flickers on Hroar's face, and he lifts his hand away from his gun. "No need to be making threats like that. We're all friends here."
units.italian: Un'esitazione passa sul viso di Hroar, e allontana la mano dalla pistola. "Non c'è bisogno di fare minacce del genere. Qui siamo tutti amici."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	His expression shifts as he changes the subject. "I doubt the Allen boys could afford someone like you, so why exactly are you here?"|3804|0
units.english: His expression shifts as he changes the subject. "I doubt the Allen boys could afford someone like you, so why exactly are you here?"
units.italian: La sua espressione cambia mentre cambia argomento. "Dubito che i fratelli Allen possano permettersi uno come te, quindi perché esattamente sei qui?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	(Explain the situation.)|3807|0
units.english: (Explain the situation.)
units.italian: (Spiega la situazione.)

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	After you finish your explanation, Hroar frowns. "This is some kind of pickle you've gotten yourself into. And humanitarian or not, I ain't a man who is known for working for free. But what you heard is correct: if you need people moved and the Union won't do it, I'm your best bet in the Deep.|3808|0
units.english: After you finish your explanation, Hroar frowns. "This is some kind of pickle you've gotten yourself into. And humanitarian or not, I ain't a man who is known for working for free. But what you heard is correct: if you need people moved and the Union won't do it, I'm your best bet in the Deep.
units.italian: Dopo che hai finito di spiegare, Hroar aggrotta la fronte. "Questo è un bel guaio in cui ti sei cacciato. E umanitario o no, non sono un uomo noto per lavorare gratis. Ma quello che hai sentito è vero: se hai bisogno di spostare gente e l'Unione non lo fa, io sono la tua migliore opzione nel Deep.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	"It would be something to give the Union a black eye like this. And I would generate some good will - I could probably even recoup most the costs in tax-write offs and government grants. But still..." He drifts off, then looks at you hard for a moment. "Tell you what. I'll do it, for free, if you promise to owe me a favor in the future. A favor for a favor. What'dya say?"|3809|0
units.english: "It would be something to give the Union a black eye like this. And I would generate some good will - I could probably even recoup most the costs in tax-write offs and government grants. But still..." He drifts off, then looks at you hard for a moment. "Tell you what. I'll do it, for free, if you promise to owe me a favor in the future. A favor for a favor. What'dya say?"
units.italian: "Sarebbe qualcosa dare all'Unione un occhio nero così. E mi genererebbe un po' di buona volontà: probabilmente potrei persino recuperare quasi tutti i costi con detrazioni fiscali e sovvenzioni statali. Però..." Si interrompe, poi ti guarda fisso per un momento. "Ti dico cosa. Lo faccio, gratis, se prometti di dovermi un favore in futuro. Un favore per un favore. Che ne dici?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	"Deal."|3811|0
units.english: "Deal."
units.italian: "Fatto."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	"What kind of favor?"|3813|0
units.english: "What kind of favor?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di favore?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	"No deal."|3814|0
units.english: "No deal."
units.italian: "Non ci sto."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	"Oh, I don't know. Something always needs doin' around here. I went from rags to riches, you know, and a journey like that leaves lots of disgruntled folk in your wake. Plus business at times requires a certain sort of captain. Whatever it will be, I'll have you know I run a legitimate - well, mostly legitimate - organization, and you won't be asked to do anything too illegal."|3816|0
units.english: "Oh, I don't know. Something always needs doin' around here. I went from rags to riches, you know, and a journey like that leaves lots of disgruntled folk in your wake. Plus business at times requires a certain sort of captain. Whatever it will be, I'll have you know I run a legitimate - well, mostly legitimate - organization, and you won't be asked to do anything too illegal."
units.italian: "Oh, non lo so. Da queste parti c'è sempre qualcosa da fare. Sono passato dalla miseria alla ricchezza, sai, e un viaggio così lascia parecchia gente scontenta dietro di sé. Inoltre gli affari a volte richiedono un certo tipo di capitano. Qualunque cosa sarà, sappi che gestisco un'organizzazione legittima, beh, quasi legittima, e non ti chiederò nulla di troppo illegale."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	He grins. "So, what do you say? Deal?"|3817|0
units.english: He grins. "So, what do you say? Deal?"
units.italian: Sorride. "Allora, che ne dici? Affare fatto?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	"Deal."|3819|0
units.english: "Deal."
units.italian: "Fatto."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	"No deal."|3821|0
units.english: "No deal."
units.italian: "Non ci sto."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|label|3822|0
units.english: last chance
units.italian: last chance

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	Hroar leans back. "Friend, listen up. If the Union won't do it, and I won't do it, then no one will. You'll either have to get those 2,200 bunks yourself, or it just ain't happenin'. I promise I won't ask anything of you too illegal. So, you sure you want to say no?"|3823|0
units.english: Hroar leans back. "Friend, listen up. If the Union won't do it, and I won't do it, then no one will. You'll either have to get those 2,200 bunks yourself, or it just ain't happenin'. I promise I won't ask anything of you too illegal. So, you sure you want to say no?"
units.italian: Hroar si appoggia allo schienale. "Amico, ascolta. Se l'Unione non lo fa, e io non lo faccio, allora nessuno lo farà. O ti procuri da solo quelle 2.200 cuccette, o la cosa non accadrà. Prometto che non ti chiederò nulla di troppo illegale. Quindi, sei sicuro di voler dire di no?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	"I'm in. Deal."|3825|0
units.english: "I'm in. Deal."
units.italian: "Ci sto. Fatto."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	"I'm out. No deal."|3827|0
units.english: "I'm out. No deal."
units.italian: "Sono fuori. Non ci sto."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	Hroar smirks. "Alright. You're out. Get outta my booth, and good luck on your little charity adventure." Hroar goes back to drinking his whiskey as the saloon's swinging door hits you on your way out.|3830|0
units.english: Hroar smirks. "Alright. You're out. Get outta my booth, and good luck on your little charity adventure." Hroar goes back to drinking his whiskey as the saloon's swinging door hits you on your way out.
units.italian: Hroar sogghigna. "Va bene. Sei fuori. Esci dal mio tavolo, e buona fortuna con la tua piccola avventura di beneficenza." Hroar torna a bere il suo whisky mentre la porta a vento del saloon ti colpisce mentre esci.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 9|	"Good. Good. People making deals. That's what society is all about, ya know? Alright, listen up: it'll take me about two weeks to get my fleet ready to transport your friends. Will take a good handful of trips too, but you only need to guide us for the first one. So, come back here then and we'll get this show on the road."|3835|0
units.english: "Good. Good. People making deals. That's what society is all about, ya know? Alright, listen up: it'll take me about two weeks to get my fleet ready to transport your friends. Will take a good handful of trips too, but you only need to guide us for the first one. So, come back here then and we'll get this show on the road."
units.italian: "Bene. Bene. Gente che fa affari. Di questo è fatta la società, sai? Va bene, ascolta: mi serviranno circa due settimane per preparare la mia flotta a trasportare i tuoi amici. Ci vorranno anche un bel po' di viaggi, ma tu devi guidarci solo per il primo. Quindi torna qui allora e mettiamo in moto questa faccenda."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 10|name|3846|0
units.english: Head Back to <planet>
units.italian: Torna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 10|description|3850|0
units.english: Head back to <destination>, and meet up with Hroar's fleet.
units.italian: Torna su <destination> e raggiungi la flotta di Hroar.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 10|Your inbox blinks with a new message from Hroar on <planet>.|3857|0

units.italian: Scorta la flotta di Hroar su <destination> per prendere gli Skadenga.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 11|The <origin> spaceport is filled with crews doing final checks on their various haulers. You find Hroar near a cluster of captains.|3876|0
units.english: The <origin> spaceport is filled with crews doing final checks on their various haulers. You find Hroar near a cluster of captains.
units.italian: Lo spazioporto di <origin> è pieno di equipaggi che fanno gli ultimi controlli sui loro mercantili. Trovi Hroar vicino a un gruppo di capitani.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 11|	"<first>!" Hroar calls out as you near. "Glad you got here in time! Word is the Union boys are furious about this. Undermines their authority and what not; it's great." He claps you on your back. "My captains are ready. How about we get this rodeo started?"|3877|0
units.english: "<first>!" Hroar calls out as you near. "Glad you got here in time! Word is the Union boys are furious about this. Undermines their authority and what not; it's great." He claps you on your back. "My captains are ready. How about we get this rodeo started?"
units.italian: "<first>!" chiama Hroar quando ti avvicini. "Sono contento che tu sia arrivato in tempo! Si dice che i ragazzi dell'Unione siano furiosi. Minaccia la loro autorità e cose simili; è fantastico." Ti dà una pacca sulla schiena. "I miei capitani sono pronti. Che ne dici di far partire questo rodeo?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 11|	"Yee-haw!"|3879|0
units.english: "Yee-haw!"
units.italian: "Iii-ah!"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 11|	"It's about time."|3880|0
units.english: "It's about time."
units.italian: "Era ora."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 11|	Launch sirens blare as the crews all load up in their ships and the fleet takes off!|3881|0
units.english: Launch sirens blare as the crews all load up in their ships and the fleet takes off!
units.italian: Le sirene di lancio suonano mentre gli equipaggi salgono sulle navi e la flotta parte!

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 11|You have reached <planet>, but the Hardy Hroar's Hauler ships have not all arrived yet. You should take off and wait for them to catch up with you.|3897|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but the Hardy Hroar's Hauler ships have not all arrived yet. You should take off and wait for them to catch up with you.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma non tutte le navi di Hardy Hroar's Haulers sono arrivate. Dovresti ripartire e aspettare che ti raggiungano.

units.id: conversation:land at windblain|The reserved and limited government of Windblain pays neither you nor your fleet any heed as you make your way down to the outskirts of Hrithfjall. An empty, windswept landscape beneath gray clouds and a small group of weathered fishermen are waiting for you outside your ship.|3903|0
units.english: The reserved and limited government of Windblain pays neither you nor your fleet any heed as you make your way down to the outskirts of Hrithfjall. An empty, windswept landscape beneath gray clouds and a small group of weathered fishermen are waiting for you outside your ship.
units.italian: Il governo riservato e limitato di Windblain non degna di attenzione né te né la tua flotta mentre scendete verso la periferia di Hrithfjall. Un paesaggio vuoto e battuto dal vento sotto nuvole grigie, e un piccolo gruppo di pescatori consumati dalle intemperie vi aspetta fuori dalla nave.

units.id: conversation:land at windblain|	"I thought I'd be seeing you again," Aldfrith says at the front of his small delegation. "I dreamt that ice rained down upon the seas, and that Ran was glad of it." The creases in his face bunch up as he smiles at the memory, and then his eyes wander to the disembarking Skadenga. A moment later, the Ondurdis joins you.|3904|0
units.english: "I thought I'd be seeing you again," Aldfrith says at the front of his small delegation. "I dreamt that ice rained down upon the seas, and that Ran was glad of it." The creases in his face bunch up as he smiles at the memory, and then his eyes wander to the disembarking Skadenga. A moment later, the Ondurdis joins you.
units.italian: "Pensavo che ti avrei rivisto," dice Aldfrith in testa alla sua piccola delegazione. "Ho sognato che il ghiaccio pioveva sui mari, e che Ran ne era contenta." Le rughe del suo viso si ammassano mentre sorride al ricordo, poi gli occhi gli vagano sugli Skadenga che sbarcano. Poco dopo, l'Ondurdis si unisce a voi.

units.id: conversation:land at windblain|	"So, you are the ice that falls from the stars?" asks Aldfrith with a hint of mirth in his eyes.|3905|0
units.english: "So, you are the ice that falls from the stars?" asks Aldfrith with a hint of mirth in his eyes.
units.italian: "Quindi voi siete il ghiaccio che cade dalle stelle?" chiede Aldfrith con un accenno di ilarità negli occhi.

units.id: conversation:land at windblain|	"We are Skadenga, daughters of Skade. Mistresses of ice, mountain, and cold. But, I think now, she sends us to her sister Ran." The Ondurdis replies.|3906|0
units.english: "We are Skadenga, daughters of Skade. Mistresses of ice, mountain, and cold. But, I think now, she sends us to her sister Ran." The Ondurdis replies.
units.italian: "Noi siamo Skadenga, figlie di Skade. Signore del ghiaccio, della montagna e del freddo. Ma credo che ora lei ci mandi da sua sorella Ran," risponde l'Ondurdis.

units.id: conversation:land at windblain|	Aldfrith nods slowly. "We are the folk of Ran; the offspring of the surf, the students of the wind, and the watchers of the storm. We welcome you and your people here. Though there are few here at present, many more of our number can be found out amongst the surging seas." He glances at the growing number of Skadenga. "If you follow me, I will escort you to our village and show you what buildings you may use. Though I fear we can not house so many."|3907|0
units.english: Aldfrith nods slowly. "We are the folk of Ran; the offspring of the surf, the students of the wind, and the watchers of the storm. We welcome you and your people here. Though there are few here at present, many more of our number can be found out amongst the surging seas." He glances at the growing number of Skadenga. "If you follow me, I will escort you to our village and show you what buildings you may use. Though I fear we can not house so many."
units.italian: Aldfrith annuisce lentamente. "Noi siamo la gente di Ran: la prole dell'onda, gli studenti del vento e i guardiani della tempesta. Vi accogliamo, te e la tua gente. Anche se qui per ora siamo pochi, molti altri del nostro numero si trovano tra i mari agitati." Dà un'occhiata al numero crescente di Skadenga. "Se mi segui, ti accompagnerò al nostro villaggio e ti mostrerò quali edifici potete usare. Temo però che non potremo ospitare così tanti."

units.id: conversation:land at windblain|	The Ondurdis smiles. "We thank you for your hospitality. It is good to find others who remember the old ways. Fear not, though; we are resourceful lot." Turning to you, she continues, "Meet me near the ships at makeshift spaceport in a few hours. I have much to do at moment." She and many others then follow Aldfrith and his group to the halls of Hrithfjall.|3908|0
units.english: The Ondurdis smiles. "We thank you for your hospitality. It is good to find others who remember the old ways. Fear not, though; we are resourceful lot." Turning to you, she continues, "Meet me near the ships at makeshift spaceport in a few hours. I have much to do at moment." She and many others then follow Aldfrith and his group to the halls of Hrithfjall.
units.italian: L'Ondurdis sorride. "Ti ringraziamo per la tua ospitalità. È bello trovare altri che ricordano le vecchie usanze. Non temere, però: siamo gente piena di risorse." Voltandosi verso di te, continua: "Incontrami vicino alle navi allo spazioporto improvvisato tra qualche ora. Ho molto da fare adesso." Lei e molti altri seguono poi Aldfrith e il suo gruppo verso le sale di Hrithfjall.

units.id: conversation:land at windblain|	As you watch them leave, you hear the sound of Hroar's fleet taking off and heading back to Nifel to pick up the rest of the Skadenga.|3909|0
units.english: As you watch them leave, you hear the sound of Hroar's fleet taking off and heading back to Nifel to pick up the rest of the Skadenga.
units.italian: Mentre li guardi allontanarsi, senti il rumore della flotta di Hroar che parte e torna su Nifel a prendere il resto degli Skadenga.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 12|name|3917|0
units.english: Evacuate <origin>
units.italian: Evacua <origin>

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 12|description|3918|0
units.english: Escort Hroar's fleet carrying the Skadenga to <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta la flotta di Hroar che trasporta gli Skadenga fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 12|The fleet touches down just outside the crowded village of Udainsakr. The landscape is filled with the gathered Skadenga.|3925|0
units.english: The fleet touches down just outside the crowded village of Udainsakr. The landscape is filled with the gathered Skadenga.
units.italian: La flotta atterra appena fuori dal villaggio affollato di Udainsakr. Il paesaggio è pieno di Skadenga radunati.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 12|	The Ondurdis approaches you. "Leaving is difficult, but all winters must come to end." She watches as her people climb aboard the fleet. "I will be taking first trip to Windblain, but I must rejoin my folk. Thank you for this, and we shall speak again at our new home."|3926|0
units.english: The Ondurdis approaches you. "Leaving is difficult, but all winters must come to end." She watches as her people climb aboard the fleet. "I will be taking first trip to Windblain, but I must rejoin my folk. Thank you for this, and we shall speak again at our new home."
units.italian: L'Ondurdis ti si avvicina. "Partire è difficile, ma tutti gli inverni devono finire." Guarda la sua gente salire sulla flotta. "Io farò il primo viaggio per Windblain, ma devo riunirmi alla mia gente. Grazie per questo, e ci parleremo ancora nella nostra nuova casa."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 12|	She leaves you with a warm smile in the wintry village.|3927|0
units.english: She leaves you with a warm smile in the wintry village.
units.italian: Ti lascia con un sorriso caldo nel villaggio invernale.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 12|You have reached <planet>, but the Hardy Hroar's Hauler ships have not all arrived yet. You should take off and wait for them to catch up with you.|3943|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but the Hardy Hroar's Hauler ships have not all arrived yet. You should take off and wait for them to catch up with you.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma non tutte le navi di Hardy Hroar's Haulers sono arrivate. Dovresti ripartire e aspettare che ti raggiungano.
