units.english: Evacuate <origin>
units.italian: Evacua <origin>

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga Captain|description|3953|0
units.english: Escort your fleet carrying the Skadenga, to <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta la tua flotta che trasporta gli Skadenga fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga Captain|Your fleet touches down just outside of the crowded village of Udainsakr. The landscape is filled with the gathered Skadenga.|3961|0
units.english: Your fleet touches down just outside of the crowded village of Udainsakr. The landscape is filled with the gathered Skadenga.
units.italian: La tua flotta atterra appena fuori dal villaggio affollato di Udainsakr. Il paesaggio è pieno di Skadenga radunati.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga Captain|	The Ondurdis approaches you. "Leaving is difficult, but all winters must come to end." She looks curiously at your fleet. "This I did not expect. These are not Transport Union. These are yours? You brought your own fleet to help us?"|3962|0
units.english: The Ondurdis approaches you. "Leaving is difficult, but all winters must come to end." She looks curiously at your fleet. "This I did not expect. These are not Transport Union. These are yours? You brought your own fleet to help us?"
units.italian: L'Ondurdis ti si avvicina. "Partire è difficile, ma tutti gli inverni devono finire." Guarda la tua flotta con curiosità. "Questo non me l'aspettavo. Queste non sono dell'Unione dei Trasporti. Sono tue? Hai portato la tua flotta per aiutarci?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga Captain|	You smile and shrug, letting her know that sometimes you just have to do things yourself. She shakes her head. "You are full of surprises, <first>. Perhaps I'll surprise you someday as well."|3963|0
units.english: You smile and shrug, letting her know that sometimes you just have to do things yourself. She shakes her head. "You are full of surprises, <first>. Perhaps I'll surprise you someday as well."
units.italian: Sorridi e alzi le spalle, facendole capire che a volte devi fare le cose da solo. Lei scuote la testa. "Sei pieno di sorprese, <first>. Forse un giorno sorprenderò anche te."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga Captain|	Her eyes wander to her people who are busy embarking. "I must rejoin my folk. But thank you for this, and we shall speak again at our new home." The Ondurdis leaves you with a warm smile in the wintry village.|3964|0
units.english: Her eyes wander to her people who are busy embarking. "I must rejoin my folk. But thank you for this, and we shall speak again at our new home." The Ondurdis leaves you with a warm smile in the wintry village.
units.italian: I suoi occhi vagano sulla sua gente impegnata a imbarcarsi. "Devo riunirmi alla mia gente. Ma grazie per questo, e ci parleremo ancora nella nostra nuova casa." L'Ondurdis ti lascia con un sorriso caldo nel villaggio invernale.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga Captain|You have reached <planet>, but your ships have not all arrived yet. You should take off and wait for them to catch up with you.|3968|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but your ships have not all arrived yet. You should take off and wait for them to catch up with you.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma non tutte le tue navi sono ancora arrivate. Dovresti ripartire e aspettare che ti raggiungano.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|The Ondurdis bows to you when you arrive. "You have chosen good home for us."|3990|0
units.english: The Ondurdis bows to you when you arrive. "You have chosen good home for us."
units.italian: L'Ondurdis si inchina a te quando arrivi. "Hai scelto una buona casa per noi."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	She has a small, wooden box with inlaid runes that looks very similar to the one you saw at Asgard. She opens the box to reveal a blue glowing stone with a single rune inscribed on it. "We call these Tears of Skade. We found few of them buried around Goddess-Stone of Nifel. They are always cold, and may be useful in warm ship." She hands you the box.|3992|0
units.english: She has a small, wooden box with inlaid runes that looks very similar to the one you saw at Asgard. She opens the box to reveal a blue glowing stone with a single rune inscribed on it. "We call these Tears of Skade. We found few of them buried around Goddess-Stone of Nifel. They are always cold, and may be useful in warm ship." She hands you the box.
units.italian: Ha una piccola scatola di legno con rune intarsiate che somiglia molto a quella che hai visto su Asgard. Apre la scatola e rivela una pietra blu luminescente con una sola runa incisa. "Le chiamiamo Lacrime di Skade. Ne abbiamo trovate poche, sepolte intorno alla Pietra della Dea di Nifel. Sono sempre fredde, e possono essere utili su nave calda." Ti porge la scatola.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	"You honor me. Thank you."|3994|0
units.english: "You honor me. Thank you."
units.italian: "Mi onori. Grazie."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	"A glowing stone? After all I did? Where's the money?"|3996|0
units.english: "A glowing stone? After all I did? Where's the money?"
units.italian: "Una pietra luminescente? Dopo tutto quello che ho fatto? E i soldi?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	The Ondurdis shakes her head sadly. "I have given you something more valuable than any amount of money. Yet, you spurn it. There is value here, in this happy community, in our story, that is worth more than credits. Take this sacred stone, for you have earned it, and in time I hope you learn what I have failed to teach."|3997|0
units.english: The Ondurdis shakes her head sadly. "I have given you something more valuable than any amount of money. Yet, you spurn it. There is value here, in this happy community, in our story, that is worth more than credits. Take this sacred stone, for you have earned it, and in time I hope you learn what I have failed to teach."
units.italian: L'Ondurdis scuote la testa con tristezza. "Ti ho dato qualcosa di più prezioso di qualsiasi somma di denaro. Eppure la rifiuti. Qui c'è valore, in questa comunità felice, nella nostra storia, che vale più dei crediti. Prendi questa pietra sacra, perché te la sei guadagnata, e col tempo spero che tu impari quello che io non sono riuscita a insegnarti."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	She leaves you to her happy community and new home, with the strange stone and a lonely silence of your own making.|3998|0
units.english: She leaves you to her happy community and new home, with the strange stone and a lonely silence of your own making.
units.italian: Ti lascia alla sua comunità felice e alla sua nuova casa, con la strana pietra e un silenzio solitario che ti sei creato da solo.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	"No, it is you who honor us. We will not forget this. Now, I told you when we met I would answer question. What would you like to know?"|4001|0
units.english: "No, it is you who honor us. We will not forget this. Now, I told you when we met I would answer question. What would you like to know?"
units.italian: "No, sei tu che onori noi. Non lo dimenticheremo. Ora, quando ci siamo incontrati ti ho detto che avrei risposto a una domanda. Cosa vuoi sapere?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	"How old are you?"|4004|0
units.english: "How old are you?"
units.italian: "Quanti anni hai?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	"Who were the elves?"|4008|0
units.english: "Who were the elves?"
units.italian: "Chi erano gli elfi?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	"Why were the Skadenga making amends?"|4012|0
units.english: "Why were the Skadenga making amends?"
units.italian: "Perché gli Skadenga dovevano rimediare a qualcosa?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	"This Tear of Skade, I've seen something like it before. Might you know more about these enigmatic stones?"|4016|0
units.english: "This Tear of Skade, I've seen something like it before. Might you know more about these enigmatic stones?"
units.italian: "Questa Lacrima di Skade, ne ho vista una cosa simile prima. Puoi dirmi qualcosa di più su queste pietre enigmatiche?"

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	"No. I am done here."|4021|0
units.english: "No. I am done here."
units.italian: "No. Ho finito qui."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	The Ondurdis' eyes sparkle mischievously. "Too old. Suffice to say, my name is Eymani, and I was Pathfinder who discovered cure to Rigellian plague. As to how I am so old, or all that I have seen: I cannot say more, for it is not my story to tell."|4026|0
units.english: The Ondurdis' eyes sparkle mischievously. "Too old. Suffice to say, my name is Eymani, and I was Pathfinder who discovered cure to Rigellian plague. As to how I am so old, or all that I have seen: I cannot say more, for it is not my story to tell."
units.italian: Gli occhi dell'Ondurdis brillano di malizia. "Troppo vecchia. Basti dire che mi chiamo Eymani, e che ero l'apripista che ha scoperto la cura per la peste rigelliana. Quanto a come faccio a essere così vecchia, o a tutto quello che ho visto: non posso dire di più, perché non è la mia storia da raccontare."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	"Elves is broad term. Many creatures over long ages have been called elves. But, here, in Deep, I believe there are two kinds. First, there are alfar, known by many. They were ones who transported us here from Earth. I do not know why they did this, but I do know that it was not out of kindness. They are devious, and they are opaque."|4031|0
units.english: "Elves is broad term. Many creatures over long ages have been called elves. But, here, in Deep, I believe there are two kinds. First, there are alfar, known by many. They were ones who transported us here from Earth. I do not know why they did this, but I do know that it was not out of kindness. They are devious, and they are opaque."
units.italian: "Elfi è parola larga. Molte creature, in lunghi evi, sono state chiamate elfi. Ma qui, nel Deep, credo che ci siano due tipi. Primo, ci sono gli alfar, noti a molti. Sono quelli che ci hanno trasportato qui dalla Terra. Non so perché l'abbiano fatto, ma so che non è stato per bontà. Sono subdoli, e sono opachi."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	The Ondurdis lowers her voice and leans in. "But there is another kind of elf here. The Hudulfolk, the Hidden. They served makers of God-Stones. They are rare, and mostly dormant. I do not think even alfar are aware of them. They cannot be trusted, for no alien can be, but are not devious. Each Hidden is different, but all are connected to natural world. When Skadenga were new upon Nifel, we had some small dealing with them before they returned to sleep of eons."|4032|0
units.english: The Ondurdis lowers her voice and leans in. "But there is another kind of elf here. The Hudulfolk, the Hidden. They served makers of God-Stones. They are rare, and mostly dormant. I do not think even alfar are aware of them. They cannot be trusted, for no alien can be, but are not devious. Each Hidden is different, but all are connected to natural world. When Skadenga were new upon Nifel, we had some small dealing with them before they returned to sleep of eons."
units.italian: L'Ondurdis abbassa la voce e si avvicina. "Ma qui c'è un altro tipo di elfo. Gli Hudulfolk, i Nascosti. Servivano i costruttori delle Pietre-Divine. Sono rari, e per lo più dormienti. Non credo che nemmeno gli alfar ne siano consapevoli. Non ci si può fidare, perché di nessun alieno ci si può fidare, ma non sono subdoli. Ogni Nascosto è diverso, ma tutti sono legati al mondo naturale. Quando gli Skadenga erano nuovi su Nifel, abbiamo avuto qualche piccolo commercio con loro, prima che tornassero al sonno degli eoni."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	The Ondurdis nods slowly. "On Earth, before alfar, or elves, came to us, we had forsaken Skade. Men of Book had persuaded us to abandon old ways and embrace their new religion. We deserted our temples, forsook our trees, and thought ourselves the better for it."|4037|0
units.english: The Ondurdis nods slowly. "On Earth, before alfar, or elves, came to us, we had forsaken Skade. Men of Book had persuaded us to abandon old ways and embrace their new religion. We deserted our temples, forsook our trees, and thought ourselves the better for it."
units.italian: L'Ondurdis annuisce lentamente. "Sulla Terra, prima che gli alfar, o elfi, venissero da noi, avevamo abbandonato Skade. Gli Uomini del Libro ci avevano convinti a lasciare le vecchie usanze e ad abbracciare la loro nuova religione. Abbiamo abbandonato i nostri templi, rinnegato i nostri alberi, e ci siamo considerati migliori per questo."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	Her old face scrunches up in anger at the memory. "When we were brought to Deep, when we saw Goddess-Stone, we realized our folly. We would atone, and we would be strong." She looks up at you, her eyes bright and her face firm. "And strong we have been."|4038|0
units.english: Her old face scrunches up in anger at the memory. "When we were brought to Deep, when we saw Goddess-Stone, we realized our folly. We would atone, and we would be strong." She looks up at you, her eyes bright and her face firm. "And strong we have been."
units.italian: Il suo vecchio viso si raggrinza di rabbia al ricordo. "Quando siamo stati portati nel Deep, quando abbiamo visto la Pietra della Dea, abbiamo capito la nostra follia. Avremmo espiato, e saremmo stati forti." Alza gli occhi su di te, gli occhi luminosi e il viso fermo. "E forti siamo stati."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	"Less than I would like," she says softly. "Longer I live, more I learn how little I know. Before ships came, when we knew only ways of stone, there was different kind of power here. Fragile, gentle, stone-magic. Then came endless colonists, men from stars with ships that sailed night. Stone-magic failed and secret ways shut."|4043|0
units.english: "Less than I would like," she says softly. "Longer I live, more I learn how little I know. Before ships came, when we knew only ways of stone, there was different kind of power here. Fragile, gentle, stone-magic. Then came endless colonists, men from stars with ships that sailed night. Stone-magic failed and secret ways shut."
units.italian: "Meno di quanto vorrei," dice piano. "Più vivo a lungo, più imparo quanto poco so. Prima che arrivassero le navi, quando conoscevamo solo le vie della pietra, qui c'era un altro tipo di potere. Fragile, gentile, magia delle pietre. Poi arrivarono coloni senza fine, uomini dalle stelle con navi che solcavano la notte. La magia delle pietre svanì e le vie segrete si chiusero."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	She looks at you sadly. "These stones are relics from lost age. Stolen age." She pauses. "More I cannot tell, but if you bring me such stone I will look for you, and see if more I might know."|4044|0
units.english: She looks at you sadly. "These stones are relics from lost age. Stolen age." She pauses. "More I cannot tell, but if you bring me such stone I will look for you, and see if more I might know."
units.italian: Ti guarda con tristezza. "Queste pietre sono reliquie di un'epoca perduta. Un'epoca rubata." Si ferma. "Di più non posso dire, ma se mi porti una pietra così, la esaminerò per te, e vedrò se posso saperne di più."

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	"That is enough whispering of old secrets." She straightens up and smooths her dress. "I have much to do, and I imagine so do you. Take care, <first>. May Skade protect you." The leader of the Skadenga returns to her people on the windswept hills of the small, picturesque town of Hrithfjall.|4051|0
units.english: "That is enough whispering of old secrets." She straightens up and smooths her dress. "I have much to do, and I imagine so do you. Take care, <first>. May Skade protect you." The leader of the Skadenga returns to her people on the windswept hills of the small, picturesque town of Hrithfjall.
units.italian: "Basta sussurrare vecchi segreti." Si raddrizza e si liscia il vestito. "Ho molto da fare, e immagino anche tu. Abbi cura di te, <first>. Che Skade ti protegga." La guida degli Skadenga torna alla sua gente sulle colline battute dal vento della piccola e pittoresca cittadina di Hrithfjall.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	With the conversation concluded, you wander back toward your ship as the sun sets. You hear the hustle and bustle all around you of eager people pursuing a new and exciting life. The promise of a new beginning is almost as intoxicating as the faint hint of sea-salt on the cool breeze that ruffles your clothes.|4053|0
units.english: With the conversation concluded, you wander back toward your ship as the sun sets. You hear the hustle and bustle all around you of eager people pursuing a new and exciting life. The promise of a new beginning is almost as intoxicating as the faint hint of sea-salt on the cool breeze that ruffles your clothes.
units.italian: Conclusa la conversazione, torni verso la nave mentre il sole tramonta. Senti tutto intorno a te il viavai di gente desiderosa di una vita nuova ed emozionante. La promessa di un nuovo inizio è quasi inebriante come il tenue sentore di sale marino sulla brezza fresca che ti scompiglia i vestiti.

units.id: mission:Home for Skadenga 13|	You wonder if you're forgetting anything - if you should find Hjlod and speak with her. But she is nowhere in sight, and you realize there will be time to see her again. You climb aboard your ship and leave these people to their new home, and you wonder: in all the bright stars and warm worlds, where might your home be?|4054|0
units.english: You wonder if you're forgetting anything - if you should find Hjlod and speak with her. But she is nowhere in sight, and you realize there will be time to see her again. You climb aboard your ship and leave these people to their new home, and you wonder: in all the bright stars and warm worlds, where might your home be?
units.italian: Ti chiedi se stai dimenticando qualcosa, se dovresti cercare Hjlod e parlarle. Ma non si vede da nessuna parte, e capisci che ci sarà tempo per rivederla. Sali sulla tua nave e lasci questa gente alla sua nuova casa, e ti chiedi: tra tutte le stelle luminose e i mondi caldi, dove sarà la tua casa?

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|description|4060|0
units.english: Take the mourning Skadenga to <destination>, so that they can enact the rites of their dead. Payment is <payment>.
units.italian: Porta gli Skadenga in lutto su <destination>, perché possano celebrare i riti dei loro morti. Il pagamento è <payment>.

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|The familiar sight of <origin> brings up old memories. It's been more than a year since you helped the Skadenga settle <origin>, and you wonder if you should check in on them.|4070|0
units.english: The familiar sight of <origin> brings up old memories. It's been more than a year since you helped the Skadenga settle <origin>, and you wonder if you should check in on them.
units.italian: La vista familiare di <origin> risveglia vecchi ricordi. È passato più di un anno da quando hai aiutato gli Skadenga a stabilirsi su <origin>, e ti chiedi se dovresti andare a trovarli.

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	(Visit Hrithfjall.)|4072|0
units.english: (Visit Hrithfjall.)
units.italian: (Fa' visita a Hrithfjall.)

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	(Don't visit Hrithfjall.)|4073|0
units.english: (Don't visit Hrithfjall.)
units.italian: (Non visitare Hrithfjall.)

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	It's a short journey to the outskirts of Hrithfjall. You are evidently spotted from afar, as someone is waiting for you.|4075|0
units.english: It's a short journey to the outskirts of Hrithfjall. You are evidently spotted from afar, as someone is waiting for you.
units.italian: È un breve viaggio fino alla periferia di Hrithfjall. Evidentemente ti hanno visto da lontano, perché qualcuno ti sta aspettando.

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	Hjlod's lopsided smile is warm and refreshing. "<first>!" She says with genuine joy. "You did not say goodbye! How can I forgive?" You hug her. You walk together along the shore toward Hrithfjall. She tells you all about the growing village - how the Skadenga are thriving here, and how they've gotten along with the Ranfolk.|4076|0
units.english: Hjlod's lopsided smile is warm and refreshing. "<first>!" She says with genuine joy. "You did not say goodbye! How can I forgive?" You hug her. You walk together along the shore toward Hrithfjall. She tells you all about the growing village - how the Skadenga are thriving here, and how they've gotten along with the Ranfolk.
units.italian: Il sorriso storto di Hjlod è caldo e ristoratore. "<first>!" dice con gioia sincera. "Non hai detto arrivederci! Come posso perdonarti?" La abbracci. Camminate insieme lungo la riva verso Hrithfjall. Ti racconta tutto del villaggio in crescita: come gli Skadenga prosperino qui, e come vadano d'accordo con i Ranfolk.

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	She points to a small wooden craft up ahead. "I built her," she says with pride. "No more Ice-Crawler for Hjlod. I am sailor now. I take curious tourist out now and again. Much safer than Ice-Crawler, except when we capsize." She shrugs and grins. "Perhaps someday you'll be my tourist again. This time, I promise no accidents. Also, there are no Ice-Slugs to worry about." She pauses for a moment. "There are Shark-Kraken though. But don't worry. Hjlod vill take care of you."|4077|0
units.english: She points to a small wooden craft up ahead. "I built her," she says with pride. "No more Ice-Crawler for Hjlod. I am sailor now. I take curious tourist out now and again. Much safer than Ice-Crawler, except when we capsize." She shrugs and grins. "Perhaps someday you'll be my tourist again. This time, I promise no accidents. Also, there are no Ice-Slugs to worry about." She pauses for a moment. "There are Shark-Kraken though. But don't worry. Hjlod vill take care of you."
units.italian: Indica una piccola imbarcazione di legno più avanti. "L'ho costruita io," dice con orgoglio. "Basta cingolato del ghiaccio per Hjlod. Adesso sono marinaia. Ogni tanto porto turisti curiosi. Molto più sicuro del cingolato, tranne quando ci capovolgiamo." Alza le spalle e sogghigna. "Forse un giorno sarai di nuovo mio turista. Questa volta prometto niente incidenti. E non ci sono nemmeno Lumache di Ghiaccio di cui preoccuparsi." Si ferma un momento. "Ci sono però gli Squali-Kraken. Ma non preoccuparti. Hjlod si prende cura di te."

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	You spend the afternoon in Hrithfjall, where you are treated like a guest of honor. The Ondurdis seems younger than you remember, and also appears quite fond of old Aldfrith. You eat strange fish, listen to unlikely stories, and laugh at outrageous jokes.|4078|0
units.english: You spend the afternoon in Hrithfjall, where you are treated like a guest of honor. The Ondurdis seems younger than you remember, and also appears quite fond of old Aldfrith. You eat strange fish, listen to unlikely stories, and laugh at outrageous jokes.
units.italian: Passi il pomeriggio a Hrithfjall, dove sei accolto come ospite d'onore. L'Ondurdis sembra più giovane di come la ricordi, e pare anche piuttosto affezionata al vecchio Aldfrith. Mangi pesce strano, ascolti storie improbabili e ridi di barzellette assurde.

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	As the sun sinks in the sky, you announce that you should be heading back. "Wait," the Ondurdis says. "I have task for you. If you are interested."|4079|0
units.english: As the sun sinks in the sky, you announce that you should be heading back. "Wait," the Ondurdis says. "I have task for you. If you are interested."
units.italian: Mentre il sole cala nel cielo, annunci che dovresti tornare indietro. "Aspetta," dice l'Ondurdis. "Ho un compito per te. Se ti interessa."

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	"What is it?"|4081|0
units.english: "What is it?"
units.italian: "Di cosa si tratta?"

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	"Sure; I'd do anything for you guys."|4083|0
units.english: "Sure; I'd do anything for you guys."
units.italian: "Certo; farei qualsiasi cosa per voi."

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	"Hard pass."|4085|0
units.english: "Hard pass."
units.italian: "Proprio no."

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	You explain you've already done enough for them and are needed elsewhere. They graciously accept your excuses, and you leave back to your ship.|4086|0
units.english: You explain you've already done enough for them and are needed elsewhere. They graciously accept your excuses, and you leave back to your ship.
units.italian: Spieghi che hai già fatto abbastanza per loro e che sei necessario altrove. Accettano con grazia le tue scuse, e torni alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	The Ondurdis smiles. "I knew you would accept.|4089|0
units.english: The Ondurdis smiles. "I knew you would accept.
units.italian: L'Ondurdis sorride. "Sapevo che avresti accettato.

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	"We have folk here who have died over last year. Mostly old, a few in accidents, nothing out of ordinary. But each Skadenga carries with them life-stone, upon which they carve their memories. When Skadenga dies, these stones must be returned to their Family-Cairns by their nearest relative or closest friend. But, all our Family-Cairns are on <planet>."|4090|0
units.english: "We have folk here who have died over last year. Mostly old, a few in accidents, nothing out of ordinary. But each Skadenga carries with them life-stone, upon which they carve their memories. When Skadenga dies, these stones must be returned to their Family-Cairns by their nearest relative or closest friend. But, all our Family-Cairns are on <planet>."
units.italian: "Qui abbiamo gente morta nell'ultimo anno. Per lo più vecchi, alcuni in incidenti, niente di straordinario. Ma ogni Skadenga porta con sé una pietra della vita, sulla quale incide i propri ricordi. Quando uno Skadenga muore, queste pietre devono essere riportate ai loro Family-Cairn dal parente più stretto o dall'amico più caro. Ma tutti i nostri Family-Cairn sono su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	She then nods at you. "If you could transport family members of deceased to return their stones, it would mean much to everyone here. We would pay you <payment>."|4091|0
units.english: She then nods at you. "If you could transport family members of deceased to return their stones, it would mean much to everyone here. We would pay you <payment>."
units.italian: Poi ti fa un cenno. "Se potessi trasportare i familiari dei defunti perché riportino le loro pietre, significherebbe molto per tutti qui. Ti pagheremmo <payment>."

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	"Of course."|4093|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certamente."

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	"I'll do it for free."|4095|0
units.english: "I'll do it for free."
units.italian: "Lo faccio gratis."

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	"No thanks."|4097|0
units.english: "No thanks."
units.italian: "No, grazie."

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	You explain to them you have more pressing matters to attend to and cannot be a taxi service for their grieving. They graciously accept your excuses, and you leave back to your ship.|4098|0
units.english: You explain to them you have more pressing matters to attend to and cannot be a taxi service for their grieving. They graciously accept your excuses, and you leave back to your ship.
units.italian: Spieghi che hai faccende più urgenti a cui badare e che non puoi fare da taxi per il loro lutto. Accettano con grazia le tue scuse, e torni alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|label|4100|0
units.english: yes yes
units.italian: yes yes

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	The Ondurdis shakes her head. "You have already done too much for us for too little pay. We can afford to pay you, and we will."|4101|0
units.english: The Ondurdis shakes her head. "You have already done too much for us for too little pay. We can afford to pay you, and we will."
units.italian: L'Ondurdis scuote la testa. "Hai già fatto troppo per noi, per troppo poco. Possiamo permetterci di pagarti, e lo faremo."

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	"The five Stone-Bearers will accompany you back to your ship. They will pay you <payment> for transport to <planet>. May Skade and Ran watch over your journey." The Ondurdis turns this into a toast, which everyone gladly participates in.|4103|0
units.english: "The five Stone-Bearers will accompany you back to your ship. They will pay you <payment> for transport to <planet>. May Skade and Ran watch over your journey." The Ondurdis turns this into a toast, which everyone gladly participates in.
units.italian: "I cinque Portatori di Pietre ti accompagneranno alla tua nave. Ti pagheranno <payment> per il trasporto su <planet>. Che Skade e Ran veglino sul tuo viaggio." L'Ondurdis trasforma la cosa in un brindisi, al quale tutti partecipano volentieri.

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	Hjlod walks with you and your passengers back to your ship. "Be well, <first>."|4104|0
units.english: Hjlod walks with you and your passengers back to your ship. "Be well, <first>."
units.italian: Hjlod accompagna te e i tuoi passeggeri alla nave. "Stai bene, <first>."

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|The abandoned village of Udainsakr is cold, dark, and half-buried in unrelenting snow. Everything feels colder than you remember, and you wonder how long before this planet is a perpetual snowball.|4110|0
units.english: The abandoned village of Udainsakr is cold, dark, and half-buried in unrelenting snow. Everything feels colder than you remember, and you wonder how long before this planet is a perpetual snowball.
units.italian: Il villaggio abbandonato di Udainsakr è freddo, buio e mezzo sepolto da una neve implacabile. Tutto sembra più freddo di come lo ricordi, e ti chiedi quanto manchi prima che questo pianeta diventi una palla di neve perpetua.

units.id: mission:Homecoming to Skadenga|	The five Skadenga you brought are polite and circumspect. Upon landing, they hand you <payment>, leave your ship and head for the Goddess-Stone of Skade with its attendant piles of stones. They each navigate their way to a specific cairn, stand there for a moment, speaking or chanting, and then place their stone upon it. Solemnly, they return to you with their task complete. There is nothing else for them to do here, and they request you take them home.|4111|0
units.english: The five Skadenga you brought are polite and circumspect. Upon landing, they hand you <payment>, leave your ship and head for the Goddess-Stone of Skade with its attendant piles of stones. They each navigate their way to a specific cairn, stand there for a moment, speaking or chanting, and then place their stone upon it. Solemnly, they return to you with their task complete. There is nothing else for them to do here, and they request you take them home.
units.italian: I cinque Skadenga che hai portato sono cortesi e discreti. All'atterraggio ti consegnano <payment>, lasciano la nave e si dirigono verso la Pietra della Dea di Skade con i suoi mucchi di pietre. Ognuno si fa strada fino a un cairn preciso, resta lì un momento, parlando o cantilenando, poi vi depone la sua pietra. Con solennità tornano da te con il compito compiuto. Non c'è altro che possano fare qui, e ti chiedono di riportarli a casa.

units.id: mission:Stones of Skadenga 1|name|4117|0
units.english: Stones of Skadenga
units.italian: Le pietre degli Skadenga

units.id: mission:Stones of Skadenga 1|description|4121|0
units.english: Return the Skadenga mourners to <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta gli Skadenga in lutto su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Stones of Skadenga 1|The Skadenga are gladdened to be home. Something about being on <planet> lifts their spirits, and they thank you for your help.|4127|0
units.english: The Skadenga are gladdened to be home. Something about being on <planet> lifts their spirits, and they thank you for your help.
units.italian: Gli Skadenga sono felici di essere a casa. Qualcosa dell'essere su <planet> solleva i loro animi, e ti ringraziano per il tuo aiuto.

units.id: mission:Stones of Skadenga 2|name|4141|0
units.english: Stones of Skadenga
units.italian: Le pietre degli Skadenga

units.id: mission:Stones of Skadenga 2|description|4142|0
units.english: Take the mourning Skadenga to <stopovers>, so that they can enact the rites of their dead, then return them to <planet>. Payment is <payment>.
units.italian: Porta gli Skadenga in lutto su <stopovers>, perché possano celebrare i riti dei loro morti, poi riportali su <planet>. Il pagamento è <payment>.

units.id: mission:Stones of Skadenga 2|A group of eight Skadenga approach you. They ask if you'd be willing to take them to <stopovers> so that they can return their loved-one's stones to their Family-Cairns, offering <payment> for their transportation.|4151|0
units.english: A group of eight Skadenga approach you. They ask if you'd be willing to take them to <stopovers> so that they can return their loved-one's stones to their Family-Cairns, offering <payment> for their transportation.
units.italian: Un gruppo di otto Skadenga ti si avvicina. Ti chiedono se saresti disposto a portarli su <stopovers> perché possano riportare le pietre dei loro cari ai loro Family-Cairn, offrendo <payment> per il trasporto.

units.id: mission:Stones of Skadenga 2|The eight Skadenga solmenly make their way off your ship and into the icy lands of Nifel. After a few hours they return, cold, and eager to return home to Windblain.|4154|0
units.english: The eight Skadenga solmenly make their way off your ship and into the icy lands of Nifel. After a few hours they return, cold, and eager to return home to Windblain.
units.italian: Gli otto Skadenga scendono solennemente dalla tua nave e si inoltrano nelle terre ghiacciate di Nifel. Dopo qualche ora tornano, freddi e desiderosi di tornare a casa su Windblain.

units.id: mission:Stones of Skadenga 2|The Skadenga are happy to be home. The churning seas of <planet> lift their spirits, and they head out into the sea-sweet air after paying you <payment>.|4157|0
units.english: The Skadenga are happy to be home. The churning seas of <planet> lift their spirits, and they head out into the sea-sweet air after paying you <payment>.
units.italian: Gli Skadenga sono felici di essere a casa. I mari agitati di <planet> sollevano i loro animi, e si avviano nell'aria dolce di mare dopo averti pagato <payment>.

units.id: mission:Stones of Skadenga 3|You're surprised to see the Ondurdis walking toward you.|4170|0
units.english: You're surprised to see the Ondurdis walking toward you.
units.italian: Sei sorpreso di vedere l'Ondurdis che cammina verso di te.

units.id: mission:Stones of Skadenga 3|	She nods politely before speaking. "<first>, I just wanted to thank you for ferrying our Stone-Bearers to Nifel and back. I have added this task to the job board so you can more easily assist in the future. I've also let them know they need enough money to pay for a return trip." The Ondurdis touches your shoulder, and then walks away.|4171|0
units.english: She nods politely before speaking. "<first>, I just wanted to thank you for ferrying our Stone-Bearers to Nifel and back. I have added this task to the job board so you can more easily assist in the future. I've also let them know they need enough money to pay for a return trip." The Ondurdis touches your shoulder, and then walks away.
units.italian: Fa un cenno cortese prima di parlare. "<first>, volevo solo ringraziarti per aver portato i nostri Portatori di Pietre su Nifel e ritorno. Ho aggiunto questo compito alla bacheca degli incarichi, così potrai aiutarci più facilmente in futuro. Ho anche detto loro che hanno bisogno di abbastanza denaro per pagare un viaggio di andata e ritorno." L'Ondurdis ti tocca la spalla, poi si allontana.

units.id: mission:Stone-Bearers to Nifel|description|4177|0
units.english: Take the mourning Skadenga to <stopovers>, so that they can enact the rites of their dead, then return them to <planet>. Payment is <payment>.
units.italian: Porta gli Skadenga in lutto su <stopovers>, perché possano celebrare i riti dei loro morti, poi riportali su <planet>. Il pagamento è <payment>.

units.id: mission:Stone-Bearers to Nifel|The mourners take their small stones and head off to visit the cairns of their ancestors. After some time they return to your ship, happy to see the frozen-wastes of Nifel left behind.|4190|0
units.english: The mourners take their small stones and head off to visit the cairns of their ancestors. After some time they return to your ship, happy to see the frozen-wastes of Nifel left behind.
units.italian: I parenti in lutto prendono le loro piccole pietre e si dirigono verso i cairn dei loro antenati. Dopo qualche tempo tornano alla tua nave, felici di lasciarsi alle spalle le distese ghiacciate di Nifel.

units.id: mission:Stone-Bearers to Nifel|The Skadenga hand you <payment> as they disembark and return to their lives on Windblain.|4194|0
units.english: The Skadenga hand you <payment> as they disembark and return to their lives on Windblain.
units.italian: Gli Skadenga ti consegnano <payment> mentre sbarcano e tornano alla loro vita su Windblain.

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Windblain|name|4200|0
units.english: Hjlod Remembers
units.italian: Hjlod ricorda

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Windblain|description|4201|0
units.english: Hjlod wishes to meet with you again on <planet>.
units.italian: Hjlod desidera incontrarti di nuovo su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Windblain|Your inbox hums with a new message from <planet>:|4211|0
units.english: Your inbox hums with a new message from <planet>:
units.italian: La tua casella di posta ronza con un nuovo messaggio da <planet>:

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Windblain|Dear <first>,|4213|0
units.english: Dear <first>,
units.italian: A <first>,

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Windblain|	I never properly thanked you for saving my life on Nifel all those years ago. If you're ever in the neighborhood, please stop by <planet>.|4214|0
units.english: I never properly thanked you for saving my life on Nifel all those years ago. If you're ever in the neighborhood, please stop by <planet>.
units.italian: Non ti ho mai ringraziato come si deve per avermi salvato la vita su Nifel, tutti quegli anni fa. Se mai ti trovi da queste parti, passa da <planet>.

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Windblain|				Signed, Hjlod|4215|0
units.english: Signed, Hjlod
units.italian: Firmato, Hjlod

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Windblain|Hjlod is waiting for you when you land. She looks healthy, strong, and happy - less gaunt and stressed then you recall her looking on Nifel when you first met. She gives you a hug. "Alvays good to see you, <first>. I have been thinking, vith all that vent on and needed to be done, I never had chance to thank you for saving me from cold."|4219|0
units.english: Hjlod is waiting for you when you land. She looks healthy, strong, and happy - less gaunt and stressed then you recall her looking on Nifel when you first met. She gives you a hug. "Alvays good to see you, <first>. I have been thinking, vith all that vent on and needed to be done, I never had chance to thank you for saving me from cold."
units.italian: Hjlod ti aspetta quando atterri. Sembra sana, forte e felice: meno emaciata e meno stressata di come la ricordi su Nifel al vostro primo incontro. Ti dà un abbraccio. "Sempre bello vederti, <first>. Ho pensato che, con tutto quello che è successo e che andava fatto, non ho mai avuto occasione di ringraziarti per avermi salvata dal freddo."

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Windblain|	She reaches into her pocket and pulls out a small pouch. "I have stone that has long been in my family. I wish to give it to you. Keep you cold in hot ship, remind you of Hjlod in far-off galaxy."|4220|0
units.english: She reaches into her pocket and pulls out a small pouch. "I have stone that has long been in my family. I wish to give it to you. Keep you cold in hot ship, remind you of Hjlod in far-off galaxy."
units.italian: Fruga nella tasca e tira fuori una piccola sacca. "Ho pietra che è da molto nella mia famiglia. Voglio darla a te. Tieni al caldo su nave calda, ricordati di Hjlod in galassia lontana."

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Windblain|	Hjlod gives you a glowing blue Tear of Skade, just like the one The Ondurdis gave you sometime before.|4222|0
units.english: Hjlod gives you a glowing blue Tear of Skade, just like the one The Ondurdis gave you sometime before.
units.italian: Hjlod ti dà una Lacrima di Skade blu luminescente, proprio come quella che l'Ondurdis ti aveva dato tempo prima.

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Windblain|	"How many of these are there?" you ask.|4223|0
units.english: "How many of these are there?" you ask.
units.italian: "Quante ne esistono?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Windblain|	"Only few," she answers. "They were found around the Goddess-Stone in the early days. Passed from Skadenga mother to Skadenga daughter. I have no daughter, but I have you, so this is now yours."|4224|0
units.english: "Only few," she answers. "They were found around the Goddess-Stone in the early days. Passed from Skadenga mother to Skadenga daughter. I have no daughter, but I have you, so this is now yours."
units.italian: "Solo poche," risponde. "Sono state trovate intorno alla Pietra della Dea nei primi tempi. Passate da madre Skadenga a figlia Skadenga. Io non ho figlia, ma ho te, quindi adesso è tua."

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Windblain|	You thank her and spend the rest of the day with her, talking, laughing and walking upon the friendly earth of <planet>.|4225|0
units.english: You thank her and spend the rest of the day with her, talking, laughing and walking upon the friendly earth of <planet>.
units.italian: La ringrazi e passi il resto della giornata con lei, parlando, ridendo e camminando sulla terra amichevole di <planet>.

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Nifel|name|4231|0
units.english: Hjlod Remembers
units.italian: Hjlod ricorda

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Nifel|description|4232|0
units.english: Hjlod wishes to meet with you again on <planet>.
units.italian: Hjlod desidera incontrarti di nuovo su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Nifel|Your inbox hums with a new message from Nifel.|4242|0
units.english: Your inbox hums with a new message from Nifel.
units.italian: La tua casella di posta ronza con un nuovo messaggio da Nifel.

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Nifel|Dear <first>,|4244|0
units.english: Dear <first>,
units.italian: A <first>,

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Nifel|	I never properly thanked you for saving my life all those years ago. If you're ever in the neighborhood, please stop by <planet>.|4245|0
units.english: I never properly thanked you for saving my life all those years ago. If you're ever in the neighborhood, please stop by <planet>.
units.italian: Non ti ho mai ringraziato come si deve per avermi salvato la vita, tutti quegli anni fa. Se mai ti trovi da queste parti, passa da <planet>.

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Nifel|				Signed, Hjlod|4246|0
units.english: Signed, Hjlod
units.italian: Firmato, Hjlod

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Nifel|Nifel is colder than you remember. The snow is deeper, and the ice harder. Despite this, the small recolonized settlement of Udainsakr appears to be thriving. Although it started with less than 50 Skadenga, thanks to the steady flow of pilgrims, the village population now numbers over a thousand.|4251|0
units.english: Nifel is colder than you remember. The snow is deeper, and the ice harder. Despite this, the small recolonized settlement of Udainsakr appears to be thriving. Although it started with less than 50 Skadenga, thanks to the steady flow of pilgrims, the village population now numbers over a thousand.
units.italian: Nifel è più freddo di come lo ricordi. La neve è più profonda, e il ghiaccio più duro. Nonostante questo, il piccolo insediamento ricolonizzato di Udainsakr sembra prosperare. Anche se è iniziato con meno di 50 Skadenga, grazie al flusso costante di pellegrini il villaggio conta ormai più di mille abitanti.

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Nifel|	Hjlod finds you and gives you a small smile. "I am glad you came."|4252|0
units.english: Hjlod finds you and gives you a small smile. "I am glad you came."
units.italian: Hjlod ti trova e ti regala un piccolo sorriso. "Sono contenta che tu sia venuto."

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Nifel|	She reaches into her pocket and pulls out a small wooden box, similar to the one you saw displayed at Asgard years ago. "I have been thinking," Hjlod says. "Maybe all this vas vill of Skade. Maybe you took us to Asgard to make us stronger, to make us better. It is bitter lesson, but I understand it now."|4253|0
units.english: She reaches into her pocket and pulls out a small wooden box, similar to the one you saw displayed at Asgard years ago. "I have been thinking," Hjlod says. "Maybe all this vas vill of Skade. Maybe you took us to Asgard to make us stronger, to make us better. It is bitter lesson, but I understand it now."
units.italian: Fruga nella tasca e tira fuori una piccola scatola di legno, simile a quella che hai visto esposta su Asgard anni fa. "Ho riflettuto," dice Hjlod. "Forse tutto questo era volontà di Skade. Forse ci hai portati su Asgard per farci più forti, per farci migliori. È lezione amara, ma adesso la capisco."

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Nifel|	She holds out the box. "This is Tear of Skade. Only few ever found, and this I give to you. For saving my life, for bringing us back here, for making us stronger."|4254|0
units.english: She holds out the box. "This is Tear of Skade. Only few ever found, and this I give to you. For saving my life, for bringing us back here, for making us stronger."
units.italian: Ti porge la scatola. "Questa è Lacrima di Skade. Solo poche sono state trovate, e questa la do a te. Per avermi salvato la vita, per averci riportati qui, per averci resi più forti."

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Nifel|	The box opens, displaying a small, blue glowing rock. "Alvays makes cold. Alvays. Useful on hot ship. Keep this vith you, and know Skadenga vith you too," Hjlod says, handing it to you.|4256|0
units.english: The box opens, displaying a small, blue glowing rock. "Alvays makes cold. Alvays. Useful on hot ship. Keep this vith you, and know Skadenga vith you too," Hjlod says, handing it to you.
units.italian: La scatola si apre, mostrando una piccola roccia blu luminescente. "Fa sempre freddo. Sempre. Utile su nave calda. Tieni con te, e sappi che Skadenga con te," dice Hjlod, porgendotela.

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Nifel|	Her eyes water, and she wipes them. "Your story is forever chiseled on our stones."|4257|0
units.english: Her eyes water, and she wipes them. "Your story is forever chiseled on our stones."
units.italian: Gli si riempiono gli occhi di lacrime, e se le asciuga. "La tua storia è incisa per sempre sulle nostre pietre."

units.id: mission:Hjlod Remembers Nifel|	She turns and leaves you there, holding a Tear of Skade, and shivering in Nifel's unforgiving cold.|4258|0
units.english: She turns and leaves you there, holding a Tear of Skade, and shivering in Nifel's unforgiving cold.
units.italian: Si volta e ti lascia lì, con una Lacrima di Skade in mano, a rabbrividire nel freddo implacabile di Nifel.

units.id: mission:The Book of Skadenga|As you wander through the spaceport, something catches your eye at a kiosk selling gifts, trinkets, and other odds and ends.|4271|0
units.english: As you wander through the spaceport, something catches your eye at a kiosk selling gifts, trinkets, and other odds and ends.
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, qualcosa attira la tua attenzione a un chiosco che vende regali, ninnoli e altre cianfrusaglie.

units.id: mission:The Book of Skadenga|	There's an old-style book there, bound up in an ice-blue cover, titled: "The Skadenga Saga: Against All Odds, by Hjlod Hrimnirsdottir."|4272|0
units.english: There's an old-style book there, bound up in an ice-blue cover, titled: "The Skadenga Saga: Against All Odds, by Hjlod Hrimnirsdottir."
units.italian: C'è un libro in stile antico, rilegato in una copertina blu ghiaccio, intitolato: "La Saga degli Skadenga: contro ogni previsione, di Hjlod Hrimnirsdottir."

units.id: mission:The Book of Skadenga|	(Ignore the book and move on.)|4274|0
units.english: (Ignore the book and move on.)
units.italian: (Ignora il libro e vai avanti.)

units.id: mission:The Book of Skadenga|	(Pick the book up.)|4276|0
units.english: (Pick the book up.)
units.italian: (Prendi il libro.)

units.id: mission:The Book of Skadenga|	The book feels solid in your hands, and you scan through it. There are chapters about near death survival on Nifel, the subtle hostility of Asgard, the sudden death of the old Ondurdis, who you learn was named Eymani, and the triumph of Hjlod and the survivors on Nifel.|4279|0
units.english: The book feels solid in your hands, and you scan through it. There are chapters about near death survival on Nifel, the subtle hostility of Asgard, the sudden death of the old Ondurdis, who you learn was named Eymani, and the triumph of Hjlod and the survivors on Nifel.
units.italian: Il libro è solido tra le tue mani, e lo scorri. Ci sono capitoli sulla sopravvivenza vicina alla morte su Nifel, la sottile ostilità di Asgard, la morte improvvisa della vecchia Ondurdis, che scopri chiamarsi Eymani, e il trionfo di Hjlod e dei sopravvissuti su Nifel.

units.id: mission:The Book of Skadenga|	The book feels solid in your hands, and you scan through it. There are chapters about near death survival on Nifel, corrupt Deep officials, the colorful haulers on Muspel, and the ultimate triumph on Windblain.|4284|0
units.english: The book feels solid in your hands, and you scan through it. There are chapters about near death survival on Nifel, corrupt Deep officials, the colorful haulers on Muspel, and the ultimate triumph on Windblain.
units.italian: Il libro è solido tra le tue mani, e lo scorri. Ci sono capitoli sulla sopravvivenza vicina alla morte su Nifel, i funzionari corrotti del Deep, i coloriti trasportatori di Muspel e il trionfo finale su Windblain.

units.id: mission:The Book of Skadenga|	The book feels solid in your hands, and you scan through it. There are chapters about near death survival on Nifel, corrupt Deep officials, and the ultimate triumph on Windblain.|4287|0
units.english: The book feels solid in your hands, and you scan through it. There are chapters about near death survival on Nifel, corrupt Deep officials, and the ultimate triumph on Windblain.
units.italian: Il libro è solido tra le tue mani, e lo scorri. Ci sono capitoli sulla sopravvivenza vicina alla morte su Nifel, i funzionari corrotti del Deep e il trionfo finale su Windblain.

units.id: mission:The Book of Skadenga|	You place the book back on its stand as the attendant notices you. "It's pretty popular, that one. I hear it started this whole 'back-to-nature' primalism cult." He shrugs. "Whatever sells, ya know. Anyways, you buying?"|4289|0
units.english: You place the book back on its stand as the attendant notices you. "It's pretty popular, that one. I hear it started this whole 'back-to-nature' primalism cult." He shrugs. "Whatever sells, ya know. Anyways, you buying?"
units.italian: Rimetti il libro sul suo supporto mentre l'addetto ti nota. "È piuttosto popolare, quello. Ho sentito che ha dato inizio a tutta questa setta del primitivismo 'ritorno alla natura'." Alza le spalle. "Vende, che vuoi farci. Comunque, lo compri?"

units.id: mission:The Book of Skadenga|	You decline. You already know that story.|4290|0
units.english: You decline. You already know that story.
units.italian: Rifiuti. Conosci già quella storia.

units.id: mission:The Book of Skadenga|	You keep walking. You already know that story.|4293|0
units.english: You keep walking. You already know that story.
units.italian: Prosegui. Conosci già quella storia.
